WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        LENGTH(TRIM(cause_area)) AS cause_area_len,
        FLOOR(pledge_amount / 10000) * 10000 AS pledge_amount_bucket,
        ABS(pledge_amount - 34035.0) AS pledge_amount_distance
    FROM pledges
    WHERE pledge_amount < 38759.4
      AND awarded_date >= DATE '2024-05-06'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per cause_area, donor_ref
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        cause_area_len,
        pledge_amount_bucket,
        pledge_amount_distance
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref ORDER BY cause_area_len DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(cause_area_len, pledge_amount) AS least_cause_area_len_pledge_amount
    FROM latest
)
SELECT id, metric, amount
FROM (
    SELECT id, least_cause_area_len_pledge_amount, pledge_amount
    FROM labeled
) src
UNPIVOT (
    amount FOR metric IN (least_cause_area_len_pledge_amount, pledge_amount)
) unp

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_pledges
    .filter((F.col("pledge_amount") < 38759.4) & (F.col("awarded_date") >= F.lit("2024-05-06").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "donor_ref",
        "cause_area",
        "pledge_amount",
        "awarded_date",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("cause_area"))).alias("cause_area_len"),
        (F.floor(F.col("pledge_amount") / 10000) * 10000).alias("pledge_amount_bucket"),
        F.abs(F.col("pledge_amount") - 34035.0).alias("pledge_amount_distance"),
    )
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("cause_area", "donor_ref").orderBy(F.col("cause_area_len").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rank") == 1)
    .drop("recency_rank")
)

labeled = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.least(F.col("cause_area_len"), F.col("pledge_amount")).alias("least_cause_area_len_pledge_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    labeled
    .select("id", "least_cause_area_len_pledge_amount", "pledge_amount")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["least_cause_area_len_pledge_amount", "pledge_amount"],
        variableColumnName="metric",
        valueColumnName="amount",
    )
    .filter(F.col("amount").isNotNull())
)

WITH base_grooming_jobs AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_nights,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags,
        pet_age_yrs + kennel_nights AS pet_age_yrs_plus_kennel_nights
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE kennel_size = 'M'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_at per pets_reg_id
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id ORDER BY groomed_at, id) AS prev_groomed_at
    FROM base_grooming_jobs
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_at IS NULL OR groomed_at > prev_groomed_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id ORDER BY groomed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        pets_reg_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(groomed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id, session_no
)
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    events,
    MONTH(session_start) AS session_start_month
FROM session_summary
ORDER BY session_start_month NULLS LAST, session_start, pets_reg_id, session_no
LIMIT 10

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_grooming_jobs = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .filter(F.col("kennel_size") == "M")
    .select(
        "id",
        "pets_reg_id",
        "kennel_nights",
        "groomed_at",
        "diet_tags",
        (F.col("pet_age_yrs") + F.col("kennel_nights")).alias("pet_age_yrs_plus_kennel_nights"),
    )
)

with_prev = base_grooming_jobs.withColumn("prev_groomed_at", F.lag("groomed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id").orderBy("groomed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_at").isNull() | (F.col("groomed_at") > F.col("prev_groomed_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id").orderBy("groomed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("pets_reg_id", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("groomed_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("groomed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("groomed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("groomed_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    session_summary
    .select(
        "pets_reg_id",
        "session_no",
        "session_start",
        "events",
        F.month(F.col("session_start")).alias("session_start_month"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("session_start_month").asc_nulls_last(),
        "session_start",
        "pets_reg_id",
        "session_no",
    )
    .limit(10)
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter water_meters
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        meter_kind,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(burst_cause), 1, 3) AS burst_cause_prefix
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE (meter_age_yrs < 15 OR chlorine_ppm > 0.5)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        meter_kind,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        burst_cause_prefix,
        ROUND(AVG(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, meter_kind ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS chlorine_ppm_avg_3_prior,
        DATEDIFF(meter_fitted_on, LAG(meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, meter_kind ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id)) AS days_since_prev_meter_fitted_on,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id) AS chlorine_ppm_dense_rank,
        SUM(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id) AS meter_kind_pump_station_id_sum_chlorine_ppm,
        ROUND(AVG(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, meter_kind ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS chlorine_ppm_avg_1_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, meter_kind ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id) AS meter_fitted_on_seq,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id) AS rows_in_meter_kind_pump_station_id,
        ROUND(chlorine_ppm - AVG(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id), 2) AS chlorine_ppm_vs_meter_kind_pump_station_id_avg,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_pump_station_id_by_chlorine, 3) AS chlorine_ppm_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id), 3) AS chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm) OVER w_meter_kind_pump_station_id AS meter_kind_pump_station_id_max_chlorine_ppm,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, meter_kind ORDER BY chlorine_ppm NULLS LAST) AS chlorine_ppm_dense_rank_2
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_pump_station_id_by_chlorine AS (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id), w_meter_kind_pump_station_id AS (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(meter_kind) OVER w_meter_fitted_on_seq) AS distinct_meter_kind_in_meter_fitted_on_seq,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist) OVER w_meter_fitted_on_seq AS meter_fitted_on_seq_max_chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
        ROUND(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist / NULLIF(SUM(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist) OVER w_meter_fitted_on_seq, 0), 4) AS chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_share_of_meter_fitted_on_
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_meter_fitted_on_seq AS (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_on_seq)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    meter_kind,
    chlorine_ppm,
    meter_fitted_on,
    burst_cause_prefix,
    chlorine_ppm_avg_3_prior,
    days_since_prev_meter_fitted_on,
    meter_fitted_on_seq,
    chlorine_ppm_percent_rank,
    chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
    meter_kind_pump_station_id_max_chlorine_ppm,
    chlorine_ppm_dense_rank_2,
    distinct_meter_kind_in_meter_fitted_on_seq,
    meter_fitted_on_seq_max_chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
    chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_share_of_meter_fitted_on_
FROM metrics
ORDER BY distinct_meter_kind_in_meter_fitted_on_seq DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_water_meters
    .filter((F.col("meter_age_yrs") < 15) | (F.col("chlorine_ppm") > 0.5))
    .select(
        "id",
        "pump_station_id",
        "meter_kind",
        "chlorine_ppm",
        "meter_fitted_on",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("burst_cause")), 1, 3).alias("burst_cause_prefix"),
    )
)

w_pump_station_id_by_chlorine = Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").desc(), "id")
w_meter_kind_pump_station_id = Window.partitionBy("meter_kind", "pump_station_id")
ranked = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "meter_kind",
        "chlorine_ppm",
        "meter_fitted_on",
        "burst_cause_prefix",
        F.round(F.avg("chlorine_ppm").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id", "meter_kind").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("chlorine_ppm_avg_3_prior"),
        F.datediff(F.col("meter_fitted_on"), F.lag("meter_fitted_on").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id", "meter_kind").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_on").desc(), "id"))).alias("days_since_prev_meter_fitted_on"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").desc(), "id")).alias("chlorine_ppm_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("chlorine_ppm").over(Window.partitionBy("meter_kind", "pump_station_id")).alias("meter_kind_pump_station_id_sum_chlorine_ppm"),
        F.round(F.avg("chlorine_ppm").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id", "meter_kind").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)), 2).alias("chlorine_ppm_avg_1_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id", "meter_kind").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_on").desc(), "id")).alias("meter_fitted_on_seq"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("meter_kind", "pump_station_id")).alias("rows_in_meter_kind_pump_station_id"),
        F.round(F.col("chlorine_ppm") - F.avg("chlorine_ppm").over(Window.partitionBy("meter_kind", "pump_station_id")), 2).alias("chlorine_ppm_vs_meter_kind_pump_station_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_pump_station_id_by_chlorine), 3).alias("chlorine_ppm_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist"),
        F.max("chlorine_ppm").over(w_meter_kind_pump_station_id).alias("meter_kind_pump_station_id_max_chlorine_ppm"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id", "meter_kind").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").asc_nulls_last())).alias("chlorine_ppm_dense_rank_2"),
    )
)

w_meter_fitted_on_seq = Window.partitionBy("meter_fitted_on_seq")
metrics = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("meter_kind").over(w_meter_fitted_on_seq)).alias("distinct_meter_kind_in_meter_fitted_on_seq"),
        F.max("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist").over(w_meter_fitted_on_seq).alias("meter_fitted_on_seq_max_chlorine_ppm_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.col("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist") / F.nullif(F.sum("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist").over(w_meter_fitted_on_seq), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_share_of_meter_fitted_on_"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "meter_kind",
        "chlorine_ppm",
        "meter_fitted_on",
        "burst_cause_prefix",
        "chlorine_ppm_avg_3_prior",
        "days_since_prev_meter_fitted_on",
        "meter_fitted_on_seq",
        "chlorine_ppm_percent_rank",
        "chlorine_ppm_cume_dist",
        "meter_kind_pump_station_id_max_chlorine_ppm",
        "chlorine_ppm_dense_rank_2",
        "distinct_meter_kind_in_meter_fitted_on_seq",
        "meter_fitted_on_seq_max_chlorine_ppm_cume_dist",
        "chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_share_of_meter_fitted_on_",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_meter_kind_in_meter_fitted_on_seq").desc())
)

WITH valid_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        CONCAT_WS('-', payload_kind, mission_state) AS payload_kind_mission_state_label,
        LEAST(frame_seq, burn_secs) AS least_frame_seq_burn_secs,
        burn_secs - frame_seq AS burn_secs_minus_frame_seq
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE frame_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 08:00:00'
      AND mission_state IN ('planned', 'success', 'partial')
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(frame_seq / NULLIF(SUM(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 0), 4) AS frame_seq_share_of_mission_id,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY burn_secs_minus_frame_seq DESC, id) AS burn_secs_minus_frame_seq_tercile,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id) AS rows_in_mission_id
    FROM valid_telemetry_frames
),
combined_details_mission AS (
    -- Attach mission attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        m.apogee_km AS mission_apogee_km,
        m.is_reusable AS mission_is_reusable,
        m.burn_secs AS mission_burn_secs
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per telemetry_frame
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.payload_kind,
        s.burn_secs,
        s.mission_name,
        s.payload_kind_mission_state_label,
        s.least_frame_seq_burn_secs,
        s.burn_secs_minus_frame_seq,
        s.frame_seq_share_of_mission_id,
        s.burn_secs_minus_frame_seq_tercile,
        s.rows_in_mission_id,
        s.mission_apogee_km,
        s.mission_is_reusable,
        s.mission_burn_secs,
        t.id AS telemetry_frame_id,
        t.frame_at AS telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        t.burn_secs AS telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
        t.frame_seq AS telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        t.mission_state AS telemetry_frame_mission_state
    FROM combined_details_mission s
    JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    mission_is_reusable,
    mission_id,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT telemetry_frame_mission_state) AS distinct_telemetry_frame_mission_states
FROM line_level
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((mission_is_reusable, mission_id), (mission_is_reusable), (mission_id))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_telemetry_frames = (
    df_telemetry_frames
    .filter((F.col("frame_at") >= F.lit("2025-01-31 08:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("mission_state").isin("planned", "success", "partial")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "mission_state",
        "payload_kind",
        "frame_seq",
        "burn_secs",
        "frame_at",
        "mission_name",
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("payload_kind"), F.col("mission_state")).alias("payload_kind_mission_state_label"),
        F.least(F.col("frame_seq"), F.col("burn_secs")).alias("least_frame_seq_burn_secs"),
        (F.col("burn_secs") - F.col("frame_seq")).alias("burn_secs_minus_frame_seq"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    valid_telemetry_frames
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("frame_seq") / F.nullif(F.sum("frame_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("frame_seq_share_of_mission_id"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy(F.col("burn_secs_minus_frame_seq").desc(), "id")).alias("burn_secs_minus_frame_seq_tercile"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id")).alias("rows_in_mission_id"),
    )
)

combined_details_mission = (
    ranked.alias("s")
    .join(df_missions.alias("m"), F.col("m.id") == F.col("s.mission_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("m.apogee_km").alias("mission_apogee_km"),
        F.col("m.is_reusable").alias("mission_is_reusable"),
        F.col("m.burn_secs").alias("mission_burn_secs"),
    )
)

line_level = (
    combined_details_mission.alias("s")
    .join(df_telemetry_frames.alias("t"), F.col("t.mission_id") == F.col("s.mission_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.mission_id",
        "s.mission_state",
        "s.payload_kind",
        "s.burn_secs",
        "s.mission_name",
        "s.payload_kind_mission_state_label",
        "s.least_frame_seq_burn_secs",
        "s.burn_secs_minus_frame_seq",
        "s.frame_seq_share_of_mission_id",
        "s.burn_secs_minus_frame_seq_tercile",
        "s.rows_in_mission_id",
        "s.mission_apogee_km",
        "s.mission_is_reusable",
        "s.mission_burn_secs",
        F.col("t.id").alias("telemetry_frame_id"),
        F.col("t.frame_at").alias("telemetry_frame_frame_at"),
        F.col("t.burn_secs").alias("telemetry_frame_burn_secs"),
        F.col("t.frame_seq").alias("telemetry_frame_frame_seq"),
        F.col("t.mission_state").alias("telemetry_frame_mission_state"),
    )
)

result = (
    line_level
    .groupingSets(
        [["mission_is_reusable", "mission_id"], ["mission_is_reusable"], ["mission_id"]],
        "mission_is_reusable", "mission_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("telemetry_frame_mission_state").alias("distinct_telemetry_frame_mission_states"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter payload_items
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        launched_on,
        COALESCE(frame_seq, 0) AS frame_seq_filled,
        DAYOFWEEK(launched_on) AS launched_on_dayofweek,
        GREATEST(frame_seq, payload_kg) AS greatest_frame_seq_payload_kg
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE payload_kg < 16993.5
      AND launched_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-03' AND DATE '2025-10-20'
),
payload_item_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission payload_items metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        COUNT(*) AS payload_item_count,
        MIN(launched_on) AS first_payload_item_launched_on,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN site_country = 'IN' THEN 1 END) AS payload_item_site_country_count
    FROM payload_items
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach payload_items metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(p.payload_item_count, 0) AS payload_item_count,
        p.first_payload_item_launched_on,
        COALESCE(p.payload_item_site_country_count, 0) AS payload_item_site_country_count
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN payload_item_stats p ON p.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
telemetry_frame_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        COUNT(*) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        COUNT(*) AS telemetry_frame_count_2,
        MIN(frame_seq) AS min_telemetry_frame_frame_seq
    FROM telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_count_2, 0) AS telemetry_frame_count_2,
        t.min_telemetry_frame_frame_seq
    FROM with_stats s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frame_stats t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach mission attributes
    SELECT s.*, m.apogee_km AS mission_apogee_km
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
),
exploded_detail_payload_items AS (
    -- One row per payload_item
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.payload_kg,
        s.launched_on,
        s.frame_seq_filled,
        s.greatest_frame_seq_payload_kg,
        s.payload_item_count,
        s.payload_item_site_country_count,
        s.min_telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        p.id AS payload_item_id,
        p.payload_kg AS payload_item_payload_kg,
        p.frame_seq AS payload_item_frame_seq
    FROM joined s
    LEFT JOIN payload_items p ON p.mission_id = s.mission_id
)
SELECT
    id,
    payload_kg,
    launched_on,
    frame_seq_filled,

WITH ev_by_showroom_ref AS (
    -- ev rows per showroom_ref
    SELECT showroom_ref, COUNT(*) AS ev_count, SUM(odometer_km) AS ev_total_odometer_km
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'ev'
    GROUP BY showroom_ref
),
petrol_by_showroom_ref AS (
    -- petrol rows per showroom_ref
    SELECT showroom_ref, COUNT(*) AS petrol_count, ROUND(AVG(odometer_km), 2) AS petrol_avg_odometer_km
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'petrol'
    GROUP BY showroom_ref
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.showroom_ref, b.showroom_ref) AS showroom_ref,
    COALESCE(a.ev_count, 0) AS ev_count,
    a.ev_total_odometer_km,
    COALESCE(b.petrol_count, 0) AS petrol_count,
    COALESCE(b.petrol_avg_odometer_km, 0) AS petrol_avg_odometer_km,
    COALESCE(a.ev_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.petrol_count, 0) AS ev_count_minus_petrol_count
FROM ev_by_showroom_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN petrol_by_showroom_ref b
  ON a.showroom_ref = b.showroom_ref
ORDER BY showroom_ref

ev_by_showroom_ref = (
    df_service_tickets

    .groupBy("showroom_ref")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("ev_count"),
        F.sum("odometer_km").alias("ev_total_odometer_km"),
    )
)

petrol_by_showroom_ref = (

    .filter(F.col("fuel_kind") == "petrol")
    .groupBy("showroom_ref")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("petrol_count"),

    )
)

result = (
    ev_by_showroom_ref.alias("a")
    .join(petrol_by_showroom_ref.alias("b"), F.col("a.showroom_ref") == F.col("b.showroom_ref"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.showroom_ref"), F.col("b.showroom_ref")).alias("showroom_ref"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.ev_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("ev_count"),

    )

    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        meter_fitted_on
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE pump_station_id <= 9

derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(meter_kind), ' ', '_')) AS meter_kind_slug,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_week
    FROM filtered
),
enriched AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.meter_age_yrs,
        s.meter_kind_slug,
        s.meter_fitted_on_week,
        p.station_tier AS pump_station_station_tier,
        p.burst_ts AS pump_station_burst_ts,
        p.tariff_band AS pump_station_tariff_band
    FROM derived s
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching water_meters
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM water_meters w
            WHERE w.pump_station_id = s.pump_station_id
              AND w.burst_cause <> 'pressure'
              AND w.meter_age_yrs <= 16
        )
),
pipe_burst_stats AS (
    -- Per-pump_station pipe_bursts metrics
    SELECT pump_station_id, COUNT(*) AS pipe_burst_count
    FROM pipe_bursts
    GROUP BY pump_station_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach pipe_bursts metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(p.pipe_burst_count, 0) AS pipe_burst_count
    FROM with_activity s
    LEFT JOIN pipe_burst_stats p ON p.pump_station_id = s.pump_station_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach pump_station attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.meter_age_yrs,
        s.meter_kind_slug,
        s.meter_fitted_on_week,
        s.pump_station_station_tier,
        s.pump_station_tariff_band,
        s.pipe_burst_count,
        p.pressure_bar AS pump_station_pressure_bar
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
    WHERE p.pressure_bar <= 4.8
),
with_children_usage_reads AS (
    -- One row per usage_read
    SELECT
        s.id,

        s.meter_age_yrs,
        s.meter_kind_slug,

        u.chlorine_ppm AS usage_read_chlorine_ppm,
        u.usage_m3 AS usage_read_usage_m3,
        u.station_tier AS usage_read_station_tier
    FROM joined s
    LEFT JOIN usage_reads u ON u.water_meter_id = s.id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    pump_station_id,

    meter_fitted_on_week,
    pump_station_station_tier,
    pipe_burst_count,
    pump_station_pressure_bar,

FROM with_children_usage_reads

WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        DATE_FORMAT(arrived_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS arrived_on_label
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE YEAR(arrived_on) = 2024
),
grouped AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        deal_status,
        YEAR(arrived_on) AS arrived_on_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT car_stock_id) AS distinct_car_stock_ids,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_certified_used = TRUE) AS n_is_certified_used_true,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(arrived_on), MIN(arrived_on)) AS arrived_on_span_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT deal_status) AS distinct_deal_status,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY deal_status, YEAR(arrived_on)
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT deal_status, arrived_on_year, metric_name, amount
FROM (
    SELECT deal_status, arrived_on_year, arrived_on_span_days, distinct_deal_status, distinct_car_stock_ids, row_count
    FROM grouped
) src
UNPIVOT (
    amount FOR metric_name IN (arrived_on_span_days AS m_arrived_on_span_days, distinct_deal_status AS m_distinct_deal_status, distinct_car_stock_ids AS m_distinct_car_stock_ids, row_count AS m_row_count)
) unp
ORDER BY deal_status, arrived_on_year, metric_name

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Filter kennels
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        DATE_FORMAT(groomed_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS groomed_ts_label
    FROM kennels
    WHERE groomed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 08:00:00'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per species
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM scoped
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_ts)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        species,
        DATE_FORMAT(groomed_ts, 'yyyy-MM') AS groomed_ts_ym,
        visit_reason,
        SUM(starts_session) AS total_starts_session,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY species, DATE_FORMAT(groomed_ts, 'yyyy-MM'), visit_reason
)
-- Final projection
SELECT species, visit_reason
FROM rollup_base
ORDER BY species NULLS LAST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        flag_is_neutered,
        DATE_ADD(visit_day, 30) AS visit_day_plus_30d,
        COALESCE(coat_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS coat_kind_or_unknown
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE SIZE(diet_tags) >= 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day)) AS visit_day_month_max_pet_age_yrs,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs - AVG(pet_age_yrs) OVER w_visit_day_month, 2) AS pet_age_yrs_vs_visit_day_month_avg,
        SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER w_pet_owner_id AS pet_owner_id_sum_pet_age_yrs,
        ROUND(AVG(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day)), 2) AS visit_day_month_avg_pet_age_yrs,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs - AVG(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id), 2) AS pet_age_yrs_vs_pet_owner_id_avg,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs / NULLIF(SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day)), 0), 4) AS pet_age_yrs_share_of_visit_day_month,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(coat_kind_or_unknown) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id)) AS distinct_coat_kind_or_unknown_in_pet_owner_id,
        MAX(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id, YEAR(visit_day) ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS pet_age_yrs_max_3_prior,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs / NULLIF(SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id), 0), 4) AS pet_age_yrs_share_of_pet_owner_id,
        ROUND(AVG(pet_age_yrs) OVER w_pet_owner_id, 2) AS pet_owner_id_avg_pet_age_yrs,

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_status,
        burn_seconds,
        stage_cnt,
        frame_seq,
        launched_date,
        DATE_ADD(launched_date, 30) AS launched_date_plus_30d,
        COALESCE(mission_status, 'UNKNOWN') AS mission_status_or_unknown
    FROM rockets
    WHERE launched_date >= DATE '2024-04-20'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(burn_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY burn_seconds DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burn_seconds_max_7,
        LEAD(burn_seconds) OVER (ORDER BY burn_seconds DESC, id) AS next_burn_seconds,
        MAX(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_date_plus_30d)) AS launched_date_plus_30d_year_max_frame_seq,
        SUM(stage_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_date_plus_30d)) AS launched_date_plus_30d_year_sum_stage_cnt,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_burn_seconds AS burn_seconds_dense_rank,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY burn_seconds DESC), 3) AS burn_seconds_percent_rank
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_all_by_burn_seconds AS (ORDER BY burn_seconds DESC, id)
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- Top 3 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM windowed
    WHERE burn_seconds_dense_rank <= 3
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    mission_status_or_unknown,
    stage_cnt,
    burn_seconds_dense_rank,
    GROUPING(mission_status_or_unknown) AS is_total_mission_status_or_unknown,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(mission_status)) AS mission_status_list,
    ROUND(SUM(burn_seconds_dense_rank) / NULLIF(SUM(launched_date_plus_30d_year_sum_stage_cnt), 0), 3) AS burn_seconds_dense_rank_to_launched_date_plus_30
FROM top_per_group
GROUP BY CUBE(mission_status_or_unknown, stage_cnt, burn_seconds_dense_rank)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_rockets
    .filter(F.col("launched_date") >= F.lit("2024-04-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_status",
        "burn_seconds",

    )
)

    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("burn_seconds").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("burn_seconds").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("burn_seconds_max_7"),
        F.lead("burn_seconds").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("burn_seconds").desc(), "id")).alias("next_burn_seconds"),

)

WITH recent AS (
    -- Scope the pledges rows
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        CASE WHEN pledge_amount >= 38759.4 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN pledge_amount >= 13692.2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS pledge_amount_tier,
        LOWER(TRIM(cause_area)) AS cause_area_clean,
        COALESCE(pledge_amount, 0.0) AS pledge_amount_filled
    FROM pledges
    WHERE pledge_amount <= 30814.0
),
grouped AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        donor_ref,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cause_area) AS distinct_cause_areas,
        MIN(awarded_date) AS first_awarded_date
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date)
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching pledges
    SELECT s.*
    FROM grouped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pledges p
            WHERE p.donor_ref = s.donor_ref
              AND p.pledge_amount > 18588.1
              AND p.cause_area IN ('health', 'education')
        )
      AND s.donor_ref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    donor_ref,
    distinct_cause_areas,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM without_matches
GROUP BY CUBE(donor_ref, distinct_cause_areas)
ORDER BY donor_ref NULLS LAST, distinct_cause_areas NULLS LAST

WITH applied_monthly AS (
    -- applied rows per pledged_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) AS pledged_on_month, COUNT(*) AS applied_count, ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs), 2) AS applied_avg_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'applied'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on)
),
reported_monthly AS (
    -- reported rows per pledged_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) AS pledged_on_month, COUNT(*) AS reported_count, ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs), 2) AS reported_avg_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'reported'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.pledged_on_month, b.pledged_on_month) AS pledged_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.applied_count, 0) AS applied_count,
    a.applied_avg_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(b.reported_count, 0) AS reported_count,
    COALESCE(b.reported_avg_volunteer_hrs, 0) AS reported_avg_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(a.applied_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.reported_count, 0) AS applied_count_minus_reported_count
FROM applied_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN reported_monthly b
  ON a.pledged_on_month = b.pledged_on_month
ORDER BY pledged_on_month

WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        CONCAT(deal_state, '#', CAST(odometer_km AS STRING)) AS deal_state_ref
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'hybrid'
      AND deal_state = 'signed'
),
combined_details_showroom AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.*,
        sh.deal_state AS showroom_deal_state,
        sh.signed_on AS showroom_signed_on,
        sh.option_tags AS showroom_option_tags
    FROM recent s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref
),
exploded_detail_car_stocks AS (
    -- One row per car_stock
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.deal_state,
        s.showroom_signed_on,
        s.showroom_option_tags,
        c.id AS car_stock_id,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months
    FROM combined_details_showroom s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(car_stock_vin_tail), 1, 4) AS car_stock_vin_tail_prefix
    FROM exploded_detail_car_stocks
    WHERE car_stock_id IS NOT NULL
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        deal_state,
        showroom_option_tags,
        car_stock_id,
        car_stock_vin_tail,
        COALESCE(deal_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS deal_state_or_unknown,
        FLOOR(car_stock_term_months / 10) * 10 AS car_stock_term_months_bucket,
        LENGTH(TRIM(deal_state)) AS deal_state_len
    FROM scored
    WHERE showroom_ref >= 15
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per showroom_ref, deal_state_or_unknown
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        deal_state,
        showroom_option_tags,
        car_stock_id,
        car_stock_vin_tail,
        deal_state_or_unknown,
        car_stock_term_months_bucket,
        deal_state_len
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref, deal_state_or_unknown ORDER BY car_stock_term_months_bucket DESC, id DESC, car_stock_id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM derived
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    showroom_ref,
    deal_state,
    showroom_option_tags,
    car_stock_id,
    deal_state_or_unknown,
    deal_state_len
FROM latest
ORDER BY showroom_ref DESC

WITH recent_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        frame_at,
        mission_name
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE burn_secs < 537
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per mission_id
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM recent_telemetry_frames
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(frame_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_frame_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY mission_id, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    mission_id,
    n_events,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_end) AS session_end_month,
    ROUND(duration_min / NULLIF(session_id, 0), 3) AS duration_min_per_session_id
FROM per_session
ORDER BY mission_id DESC

    )

)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_year
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE arrived_on < DATE '2025-08-06'
      AND drive_mins > 15
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.arrived_on_year,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        sh.deal_state AS showroom_deal_state
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
    WHERE c.body_style NOT IN ('sedan', 'hatch')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        is_certified_used,
        arrived_on_year,
        car_stock_body_style,
        showroom_vin_tail,
        showroom_deal_state,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_certified_used ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id) AS drive_mins_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(arrived_on_year) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_arrived_on_year,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(deal_status) OVER w_car_stock_id_car_stock_body) AS distinct_deal_status_in_car_stock_id_car_stock_b,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_mins, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_certified_used ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_mins,
        LAG(drive_mins, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_certified_used ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id) AS prev_drive_mins,
        FIRST_VALUE(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_certified_used ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_drive_mins,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins, id) AS drive_mins_quintile,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_deal_state, car_stock_id) AS showroom_deal_state_car_stock_id_sum_drive_mins,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY arrived_on_year DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS drive_mins_avg_1_prior,
        MIN(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, car_stock_body_style) AS car_stock_id_car_stock_body_style_min_drive_mins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY arrived_on_year DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LAST_VALUE(drive_mins) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_drive_mins
    FROM combined_details
    WINDOW w_car_stock_id_car_stock_body AS (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, car_stock_body_style)
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        drive_mins,
        is_certified_used,
        arrived_on_year,
        car_stock_body_style,
        showroom_vin_tail,
        showroom_deal_state,
        drive_mins_rank,
        last_arrived_on_year,
        second_drive_mins,
        prev_drive_mins,
        drive_mins_avg_1_prior,
        seq_no,
        CONCAT_WS('|', deal_status, showroom_vin_tail) AS deal_status_showroom_vin_tail_label,
        CASE WHEN showroom_deal_state IN ('signed', 'funded') THEN 'group_a' WHEN showroom_deal_state = 'quoted' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS showroom_deal_state_group,
        last_arrived_on_year + INTERVAL 1 DAYS AS last_arrived_on_year_plus_1d
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE is_certified_used = FALSE
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    drive_mins,
    is_certified_used,
    arrived_on_year,
    showroom_vin_tail,
    showroom_deal_state,
    last_arrived_on_year,
    prev_drive_mins,
    drive_mins_avg_1_prior,
    deal_status_showroom_vin_tail_label,
    showroom_deal_state_group
FROM derived
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        FLOOR(kennel_nights / 5) * 5 AS kennel_nights_bucket
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE kennel_nights > 3
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(kennel_nights_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS kennel_nights_bucket_avg_1_prior,
        MAX(kennel_nights) OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_kennel_nights_so_far,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs / NULLIF(SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(visit_day), pet_owner_id), 0), 4) AS pet_age_yrs_share_of_visit_day_year_pet_owner_id,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id), 3) AS visit_day_cume_dist,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS visit_day_quartile
    FROM recent
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    pet_owner_id,
    visit_day_quartile,
    ROUND(AVG(visit_day_quartile), 2) AS avg_visit_day_quartile,
    MAX(pet_age_yrs_share_of_visit_day_year_pet_owner_id) AS max_pet_age_yrs_share_of_visit_day_year_pet_owne
FROM sequenced
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((pet_owner_id, visit_day_quartile), (pet_owner_id), (visit_day_quartile))
ORDER BY pet_owner_id NULLS LAST, visit_day_quartile NULLS LAST

)

    FROM with_activity
) src

    value FOR measure IN (donor_pledge_amt_2, pledge_amount)
) unp

WITH reserve_by_water_meter AS (
    -- reserve rows per water_meter_id
    SELECT water_meter_id, COUNT(*) AS reserve_count, ROUND(AVG(chlorine_ppm), 2) AS reserve_avg_chlorine_ppm
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE station_tier = 'reserve'
    GROUP BY water_meter_id
),
primary_by_water_meter AS (
    -- primary rows per water_meter_id
    SELECT water_meter_id, COUNT(*) AS primary_count, SUM(chlorine_ppm) AS primary_total_chlorine_ppm
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE station_tier = 'primary'
    GROUP BY water_meter_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.water_meter_id, b.water_meter_id) AS water_meter_id,
    COALESCE(a.reserve_count, 0) AS reserve_count,
    COALESCE(a.reserve_avg_chlorine_ppm, 0) AS reserve_avg_chlorine_ppm,
    COALESCE(b.primary_count, 0) AS primary_count,
    COALESCE(b.primary_total_chlorine_ppm, 0) AS primary_total_chlorine_ppm,

WITH cleaned_pets_regs AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        diet_tags
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE coat_kind = 'long'
      AND SIZE(diet_tags) >= 1
),
pet_owner_id_stats AS (
    -- Median pet_age_yrs per pet_owner_id
    SELECT pet_owner_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(pet_age_yrs, 0.5) AS median_pet_age_yrs
    FROM cleaned_pets_regs
    GROUP BY pet_owner_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_pet_age_yrs,
        ROUND(s.pet_age_yrs - g.median_pet_age_yrs, 2) AS pet_age_yrs_minus_median
    FROM cleaned_pets_regs s
    JOIN pet_owner_id_stats g ON g.pet_owner_id = s.pet_owner_id
    WHERE s.pet_age_yrs >= g.median_pet_age_yrs
),
coat_kind_stats AS (
    -- Avg median_pet_age_yrs per coat_kind
    SELECT coat_kind, AVG(median_pet_age_yrs) AS avg_median_pet_age_yrs
    FROM above_average
    GROUP BY coat_kind
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_median_pet_age_yrs,
        ROUND(s.median_pet_age_yrs - g.avg_median_pet_age_yrs, 2) AS median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg
    FROM above_average s
    JOIN coat_kind_stats g ON g.coat_kind = s.coat_kind
    WHERE s.median_pet_age_yrs > g.avg_median_pet_age_yrs
),
per_label AS (
    -- One row per diet_tag
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pet_owner_id,
        s.coat_kind,
        s.kennel_nights,
        s.pet_age_yrs,
        s.visit_day,
        s.median_pet_age_yrs,
        s.pet_age_yrs_minus_median,
        s.avg_median_pet_age_yrs,
        s.median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg,
        t.diet_tag_pos,
        t.diet_tag
    FROM compared s
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER POSEXPLODE(s.diet_tags) t AS diet_tag_pos, diet_tag
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        pet_age_yrs_minus_median,
        diet_tag_pos,
        diet_tag,
        FIRST_VALUE(pet_age_yrs_minus_median) OVER (PARTITION BY diet_tag_pos, diet_tag ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC NULLS FIRST, id, diet_tag_pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_pet_age_yrs_minus_median,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY diet_tag_pos, diet_tag ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC NULLS FIRST) AS pet_age_yrs_rank,
        ROUND(median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg - AVG(median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id), 2) AS median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg_vs_pet_owner_id_avg
    FROM per_label
),
first_rows AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT *
    FROM sequenced
    WHERE pet_age_yrs_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    pet_owner_id,
    coat_kind,
    pet_age_yrs,
    pet_age_yrs_minus_median,
    diet_tag_pos,
    diet_tag,
    first_pet_age_yrs_minus_median,
    median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg_vs_pet_owner_id_avg,
    COALESCE(diet_tag_pos, 0) AS diet_tag_pos_filled,
    DAYOFWEEK(visit_day) AS visit_day_dayofweek
FROM first_rows
WHERE median_pet_age_yrs_minus_avg_vs_pet_owner_id_avg >= -6.0
ORDER BY id

WITH filtered_grant_awards AS (
    -- Filter grant_awards
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        COALESCE(volunteer_hrs, 0.0) AS volunteer_hrs_filled,
        CASE WHEN volunteer_hrs >= 6.7 THEN 'A' WHEN volunteer_hrs >= 3.6 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS volunteer_hrs_tier
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE donor_segment IN ('major', 'mid')
      AND grant_stage IN ('awarded', 'applied')
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        volunteer_hrs_filled,
        volunteer_hrs + volunteer_hrs_filled AS volunteer_hrs_plus_volunteer_hrs_filled,
        LENGTH(TRIM(volunteer_hrs_tier)) AS volunteer_hrs_tier_len,
        DATE_FORMAT(pledged_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS pledged_on_label
    FROM filtered_grant_awards
),
detail_rows AS (
    -- One row per volunteer_shift
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.campaigns_ch_ref,
        s.grant_stage,
        s.donor_segment,
        s.volunteer_hrs,
        s.volunteer_hrs_tier_len,
        s.pledged_on_label,
        v.id AS volunteer_shift_id,
        v.pledged_date AS volunteer_shift_pledged_date,
        v.grant_stage AS volunteer_shift_grant_stage,
        v.donor_segment AS volunteer_shift_donor_segment,
        v.gift_count AS volunteer_shift_gift_count
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN volunteer_shifts v ON v.campaigns_ch_id = s.campaigns_ch_ref
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.campaigns_ch_ref,
        s.grant_stage,
        s.donor_segment,
        s.volunteer_hrs_tier_len,
        s.volunteer_shift_id,
        s.volunteer_shift_donor_segment,
        s.volunteer_shift_gift_count,
        v.pledged_date AS volunteer_shift_pledged_date_2,
        v.donor_segment AS volunteer_shift_donor_segment_2,

    FROM detail_rows s
    JOIN volunteer_shifts v ON v.id = s.volunteer_shift_id
    JOIN campaigns_ch c ON c.id = s.campaigns_ch_ref
)
SELECT id, volunteer_shift_id, metric_name, reading
FROM (

    FROM combined_details
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (volunteer_shift_gift_count, campaigns_ch_donor_age)
) unp

WITH cleaned_service_tickets AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind = 'diesel'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per deal_state
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_state ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM cleaned_service_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(drive_started_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_drive_started_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_state ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_started_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_started_at,
        MAX(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS is_new_session_max_1_prior,
        RANK() OVER w_drive_started_at_month_sessi_3 AS prev_drive_started_at_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        ROUND(odometer_km - AVG(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_state, is_certified_used), 2) AS odometer_km_vs_deal_state_is_certified_used_avg
    FROM sessionized
    WINDOW w_drive_started_at_month_sessi_3 AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(drive_started_at), session_id ORDER BY prev_drive_started_at)
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching service_tickets
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM service_tickets se
            WHERE se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref
              AND se.drive_started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 08:00:00'
        )
      AND s.showroom_ref >= 17
)
SELECT
    id,
    odometer_km,
    drive_started_at,
    is_new_session,
    second_drive_started_at,
    is_new_session_max_1_prior,
    running_count,
    GREATEST(running_count, session_id) AS greatest_running_count_session_id,
    COALESCE(fuel_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS fuel_kind_or_unknown
FROM screened
ORDER BY odometer_km DESC NULLS FIRST, greatest_running_count_session_id NULLS LAST, id
LIMIT 10

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_service_tickets = (
    df_service_tickets
    .filter(F.col("fuel_kind") == "diesel")
    .select(
        "id",
        "showroom_ref",
        "fuel_kind",
        "deal_state",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_certified_used",
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned_service_tickets.withColumn("prev_drive_started_at", F.lag("drive_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("deal_state").orderBy("drive_started_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_drive_started_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("drive_started_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_drive_started_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("deal_state").orderBy("drive_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

w_drive_started_at_month_sessi_3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("drive_started_at"), "session_id").orderBy("prev_drive_started_at")
ranked = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("drive_started_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("drive_started_at"), "session_id").orderBy("prev_drive_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_drive_started_at"),
        F.max("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("drive_started_at"), "session_id").orderBy("prev_drive_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("is_new_session_max_1_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w_drive_started_at_month_sessi_3).alias("prev_drive_started_at_rank"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("drive_started_at"), "session_id").orderBy("prev_drive_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.round(F.col("odometer_km") - F.avg("odometer_km").over(Window.partitionBy("deal_state", "is_certified_used")), 2).alias("odometer_km_vs_deal_state_is_certified_used_avg"),
    )
)

screened = (
    ranked.alias("s")
    .join(df_service_tickets.alias("se"), (F.col("se.showroom_ref") == F.col("s.showroom_ref")) & (F.col("se.drive_started_at") < F.lit("2025-03-08 08:00:00").cast("timestamp")), "left_semi")
    .filter(F.col("showroom_ref") >= 17)
)

result = (
    screened
    .select(
        "id",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_new_session",
        "second_drive_started_at",
        "is_new_session_max_1_prior",
        "running_count",
        F.greatest(F.col("running_count"), F.col("session_id")).alias("greatest_running_count_session_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("fuel_kind"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("fuel_kind_or_unknown"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("odometer_km").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("greatest_running_count_session_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        "id",
    )

)

WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        arrived_on,

        s.drive_mins_bucket,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style
    FROM base s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        drive_outcome,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        drive_mins_bucket,
        car_stock_body_style,
        LAST_VALUE(drive_mins_bucket) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style, drive_outcome ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_drive_mins_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style, drive_outcome ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS arrived_on_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket ASC, id) AS seq_no,
        LEAD(arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) ORDER BY arrived_on NULLS LAST, id) AS next_arrived_on,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) ORDER BY arrived_on NULLS LAST), 3) AS arrived_on_percent_rank,
        SUM(drive_mins_bucket) OVER w_arrived_on_year_car_stock_id AS arrived_on_year_car_stock_id_sum_drive_mins_buck,
        MAX(drive_mins_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style, drive_outcome ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_drive_mins_bucket_so_far,
        MAX(drive_mins_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS drive_mins_bucket_max_3,
        SUM(drive_mins_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style) AS car_stock_body_style_sum_drive_mins_bucket,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_drive_outcome_car_stock_body, 3) AS drive_mins_bucket_percent_rank,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_mins_bucket, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_mins_bucket,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        LAST_VALUE(arrived_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_arrived_on,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins_bucket) OVER w_arrived_on_year_car_stock_id, 2) AS arrived_on_year_car_stock_id_avg_drive_mins_buck
    FROM with_details_car_stock
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_year_car_stock_id AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on), car_stock_id), w_drive_outcome_car_stock_body AS (PARTITION BY drive_outcome, car_stock_body_style ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket, id)
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT *
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE arrived_on_seq = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    arrived_on,
    vin_tail,
    drive_mins_bucket,
    arrived_on_seq,
    arrived_on_percent_rank,
    arrived_on_year_car_stock_id_sum_drive_mins_buck,
    drive_mins_bucket_max_3,
    car_stock_body_style_sum_drive_mins_bucket,
    second_drive_mins_bucket,
    running_count,
    last_known_arrived_on,
    arrived_on_year_car_stock_id_avg_drive_mins_buck,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(car_stock_body_style), ' ', '_')) AS car_stock_body_style_slug
FROM top_per_group
ORDER BY drive_mins_bucket_max_3 DESC, arrived_on_year_car_stock_id_avg_drive_mins_buck

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref
    FROM pipe_bursts
    WHERE (station_tier = 'reserve' OR flow_lpm <= 1971.7)
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.usage_m3,
        s.meter_fitted_on,
        s.street_ref,
        p.burst_ts AS pump_station_burst_ts,
        p.meter_age_yrs AS pump_station_meter_age_yrs
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref,
        pump_station_burst_ts,
        pump_station_meter_age_yrs,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_pump_station_id AS rows_in_pump_station_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_pump_station_burst_ts_month AS pump_station_meter_age_yrs_dense_rank
    FROM with_parent
    WINDOW w_pump_station_id AS (PARTITION BY pump_station_id), w_pump_station_burst_ts_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(pump_station_burst_ts) ORDER BY pump_station_meter_age_yrs)
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE usage_m3 > (SELECT MIN(usage_m3) FROM with_trends)
)
SELECT
    id,
    meter_fitted_on,
    street_ref,
    pump_station_burst_ts,
    pump_station_meter_age_yrs,
    rows_in_pump_station_id,
    pump_station_meter_age_yrs_dense_rank,
    COALESCE(rows_in_pump_station_id, 0) AS rows_in_pump_station_id_filled
FROM screened
ORDER BY street_ref DESC, pump_station_meter_age_yrs NULLS LAST

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE drive_mins < 80
      AND UPPER(TRIM(vin_tail)) LIKE 'D%'
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ABS(drive_mins - 37) AS drive_mins_distance,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(deal_status), ' ', '_')) AS deal_status_slug,
        ABS(drive_mins - 43) AS drive_mins_distance_2
    FROM prepared
),
joined_car_stock AS (
    -- Join car_stock
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id,
        sh.drive_minutes AS showroom_drive_minutes,
        sh.deal_state AS showroom_deal_state
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per test_drive
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.arrived_on,
        s.drive_mins_distance,
        s.drive_mins_distance_2,
        s.car_stock_vin_tail,
        s.car_stock_showroom_id,
        s.showroom_drive_minutes,
        s.showroom_deal_state,
        t.id AS test_drive_id,
        t.arrived_on AS test_drive_arrived_on,
        t.drive_mins AS test_drive_drive_mins
    FROM joined_car_stock s
    JOIN test_drives t ON t.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching test_drives
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_children s
    WHERE s.car_stock_id IN (
            SELECT t.car_stock_id
            FROM test_drives t
        )
      AND s.arrived_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-03-11' AND DATE '2025-08-06'
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    deal_status,
    drive_mins,
    drive_mins_distance,
    drive_mins_distance_2,
    car_stock_vin_tail,
    car_stock_showroom_id,
    showroom_drive_minutes,
    showroom_deal_state,
    test_drive_id,
    test_drive_drive_mins,
    LENGTH(TRIM(car_stock_vin_tail)) AS car_stock_vin_tail_len
FROM qualified

WITH injury_monthly AS (
    -- injury rows per groomed_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', groomed_at) AS groomed_at_month, COUNT(*) AS injury_count, ROUND(AVG(pet_weight_kg), 2) AS injury_avg_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'injury'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', groomed_at)
),
vaccine_monthly AS (
    -- vaccine rows per groomed_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', groomed_at) AS groomed_at_month, COUNT(*) AS vaccine_count, SUM(pet_weight_kg) AS vaccine_total_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'vaccine'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', groomed_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.groomed_at_month, b.groomed_at_month) AS groomed_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.injury_count, 0) AS injury_count,
    COALESCE(a.injury_avg_pet_weight_kg, 0) AS injury_avg_pet_weight_kg,
    COALESCE(b.vaccine_count, 0) AS vaccine_count,
    COALESCE(b.vaccine_total_pet_weight_kg, 0) AS vaccine_total_pet_weight_kg,
    COALESCE(a.injury_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.vaccine_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM injury_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN vaccine_monthly b
  ON a.groomed_at_month = b.groomed_at_month
ORDER BY groomed_at_month

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

injury_monthly = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .filter(F.col("visit_reason") == "injury")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "groomed_at").alias("groomed_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("injury_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("pet_weight_kg"), 2).alias("injury_avg_pet_weight_kg"),
    )
)

vaccine_monthly = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .filter(F.col("visit_reason") == "vaccine")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "groomed_at").alias("groomed_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("vaccine_count"),
        F.sum("pet_weight_kg").alias("vaccine_total_pet_weight_kg"),
    )
)

result = (
    injury_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(vaccine_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.groomed_at_month") == F.col("b.groomed_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.groomed_at_month"), F.col("b.groomed_at_month")).alias("groomed_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.injury_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("injury_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.injury_avg_pet_weight_kg"), F.lit(0)).alias("injury_avg_pet_weight_kg"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.vaccine_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("vaccine_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.vaccine_total_pet_weight_kg"), F.lit(0)).alias("vaccine_total_pet_weight_kg"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.injury_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.vaccine_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("groomed_at_month")
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter missions
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        is_reusable,
        LEAST(burn_secs, apogee_km) AS least_burn_secs_apogee_km
    FROM missions
    WHERE is_reusable = FALSE
      AND rocket_id >= 24
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_mission_state_is_reusable_by AS apogee_km_dense_rank,
        SUM(least_burn_secs_apogee_km) OVER (ORDER BY apogee_km NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS least_burn_secs_apogee_km_sum_7,
        ROUND(AVG(apogee_km) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, rocket_id), 2) AS mission_state_rocket_id_avg_apogee_km,
        FIRST_VALUE(apogee_km) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, is_reusable ORDER BY apogee_km, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_apogee_km
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_mission_state_is_reusable_by AS (PARTITION BY mission_state, is_reusable ORDER BY apogee_km, id)
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns

WITH prepared_pump_stations AS (
    -- Filter pump_stations
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref,
        DATE_FORMAT(burst_ts, 'MMM yyyy') AS burst_ts_label
    FROM pump_stations
    WHERE pressure_bar > 2.5
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous burst_ts per station_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(burst_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id) AS prev_burst_ts
    FROM prepared_pump_stations
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_burst_ts IS NULL OR burst_ts > prev_burst_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        station_tier,
        session_no,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(burst_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(burst_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(burst_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY station_tier, session_no
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        session_no,
        TO_DATE(session_start) AS session_start_day,
        ROUND(SUM(event_count) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_min), 0), 3) AS event_count_to_duration_min_ratio,
        SUM(event_count) AS total_event_count,
        SUM(session_no) FILTER (WHERE station_tier = 'reserve') AS session_no_station_tier_reserve,
        MIN(session_end) AS first_session_end
    FROM session_summary
    GROUP BY session_no, TO_DATE(session_start)
    HAVING SUM(duration_min) > 48.0
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    session_no,
    session_start_day,
    event_count_to_duration_min_ratio,
    session_no_station_tier_reserve,
    first_session_end,
    ADD_MONTHS(session_start_day, 1) AS session_start_day_plus_1m,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', first_session_end) AS days_since_first_session_end
FROM rollup_base
ORDER BY session_no_station_tier_reserve DESC, event_count_to_duration_min_ratio DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_pump_stations = (
    df_pump_stations
    .filter(F.col("pressure_bar") > 2.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "station_tier",
        "tariff_band",

        "meter_age_yrs",
        "burst_ts",
        "street_ref",
        F.date_format(F.col("burst_ts"), "MMM yyyy").alias("burst_ts_label"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared_pump_stations.withColumn("prev_burst_ts", F.lag("burst_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("station_tier").orderBy("burst_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_burst_ts").isNull() | (F.col("burst_ts") > F.col("prev_burst_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("station_tier").orderBy("burst_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("station_tier", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("burst_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("burst_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("burst_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("burst_ts"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    session_summary
    .groupBy("session_no", F.to_date("session_start").alias("session_start_day"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("event_count") / F.nullif(F.sum("duration_min"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("event_count_to_duration_min_ratio"),
        F.sum("event_count").alias("total_event_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("station_tier") == "reserve", F.col("session_no"))).alias("session_no_station_tier_reserve"),
        F.min("session_end").alias("first_session_end"),
        F.sum("duration_min").alias("sum_duration_min_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_duration_min_check") > 48.0)
    .drop("sum_duration_min_check")
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "session_no",
        "session_start_day",
        "event_count_to_duration_min_ratio",
        "session_no_station_tier_reserve",
        "first_session_end",
        F.add_months(F.col("session_start_day"), 1).alias("session_start_day_plus_1m"),

    )

        F.col("event_count_to_duration_min_ratio").desc_nulls_first(),

WITH cleaned_vet_visits AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', visit_day) AS days_since_visit_day,
        CASE WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 14 THEN 'A' WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 5 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS pet_age_yrs_tier
    FROM vet_visits
),
kennel_size_stats AS (
    -- Median days_since_visit_day per kennel_size
    SELECT kennel_size, PERCENTILE_APPROX(days_since_visit_day, 0.5) AS median_days_since_visit_day
    FROM cleaned_vet_visits
    GROUP BY kennel_size
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_days_since_visit_day,
        ROUND(s.days_since_visit_day - g.median_days_since_visit_day, 2) AS days_since_visit_day_minus_median
    FROM cleaned_vet_visits s
    JOIN kennel_size_stats g ON g.kennel_size = s.kennel_size
    WHERE s.days_since_visit_day >= g.median_days_since_visit_day
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ABS(pet_age_yrs - 10) AS pet_age_yrs_distance,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', visit_day) AS days_since_visit_day_2,
        FLOOR(pet_age_yrs / 5) * 5 AS pet_age_yrs_bucket
    FROM vs_group
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Join pets_reg
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pets_reg_id,
        s.pet_age_yrs,
        s.visit_day,
        s.days_since_visit_day,
        s.pet_age_yrs_tier,
        s.median_days_since_visit_day,
        s.pet_age_yrs_distance,
        s.pet_age_yrs_bucket,
        p.pet_age_yrs AS pets_reg_pet_age_yrs
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN pets_reg p ON p.id = s.pets_reg_id
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    COALESCE(pet_age_yrs_tier, 'ALL') AS pet_age_yrs_tier,
    DATEDIFF(MAX(visit_day), MIN(visit_day)) AS visit_day_span_days,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(median_days_since_visit_day, 0.5) AS median_median_days_since_visit_day,
    SUM(pets_reg_pet_age_yrs) AS total_pets_reg_pet_age_yrs
FROM combined_details
GROUP BY ROLLUP(pets_reg_id, pet_age_yrs_tier)
ORDER BY pets_reg_id NULLS LAST, pet_age_yrs_tier NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned_vet_visits = (
    df_vet_visits
    .select(
        "id",
        "pets_reg_id",
        "kennel_size",
        "pet_age_yrs",
        "visit_day",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("visit_day")).alias("days_since_visit_day"),
        F.when(F.col("pet_age_yrs") >= 14, "A").when(F.col("pet_age_yrs") >= 5, "B").otherwise("C").alias("pet_age_yrs_tier"),
    )
)

kennel_size_stats = (
    cleaned_vet_visits
    .groupBy("kennel_size")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("days_since_visit_day", 0.5).alias("median_days_since_visit_day"))
)

vs_group = (
    cleaned_vet_visits.alias("s")
    .join(kennel_size_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.kennel_size") == F.col("s.kennel_size"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.days_since_visit_day") >= F.col("g.median_days_since_visit_day"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_days_since_visit_day",
        F.round(F.col("s.days_since_visit_day") - F.col("g.median_days_since_visit_day"), 2).alias("days_since_visit_day_minus_median"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    vs_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.abs(F.col("pet_age_yrs") - 10).alias("pet_age_yrs_distance"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("visit_day")).alias("days_since_visit_day_2"),
        (F.floor(F.col("pet_age_yrs") / 5) * 5).alias("pet_age_yrs_bucket"),
    )
)

combined_details = (

    .join(df_pets_reg.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.pets_reg_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.pets_reg_id",
        "s.pet_age_yrs",
        "s.visit_day",
        "s.days_since_visit_day",
        "s.pet_age_yrs_tier",
        "s.median_days_since_visit_day",
        "s.pet_age_yrs_distance",
        "s.pet_age_yrs_bucket",
        F.col("p.pet_age_yrs").alias("pets_reg_pet_age_yrs"),
    )
)

result = (
    combined_details
    .rollup("pets_reg_id", "pet_age_yrs_tier")
    .agg(
        F.datediff(F.max("visit_day"), F.min("visit_day")).alias("visit_day_span_days"),
        F.percentile_approx("median_days_since_visit_day", 0.5).alias("median_median_days_since_visit_day"),
        F.sum("pets_reg_pet_age_yrs").alias("total_pets_reg_pet_age_yrs"),

        "median_median_days_since_visit_day",
        "total_pets_reg_pet_age_yrs",

)

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        CASE WHEN deal_status IN ('funded', 'signed') THEN 'group_a' WHEN deal_status = 'quoted' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS deal_status_group,
        CASE WHEN deal_status IN ('quoted', 'funded') THEN 'group_a' WHEN deal_status = 'signed' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS deal_status_group_2,
        COALESCE(drive_mins, 0) AS drive_mins_filled
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE odometer_kms >= 80112
      AND is_certified_used = FALSE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        vin_tail,
        deal_status_group,
        deal_status_group_2,
        drive_mins_filled - LAG(drive_mins_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used ORDER BY odometer_kms ASC, id) AS drive_mins_filled_change,
        LEAD(drive_mins, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status_group_2, deal_status ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC, id) AS next2_drive_mins,
        SUM(drive_mins_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status_group_2, deal_status ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS drive_mins_filled_sum_4
    FROM scoped
),
enriched AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    deal_status,
    odometer_kms,
    vin_tail,
    deal_status_group,
    deal_status_group_2,
    next2_drive_mins,
    drive_mins_filled_sum_4,
    car_stock_vin_tail,
    car_stock_body_style
FROM enriched
ORDER BY drive_mins_filled_sum_4

WITH suv_by_showroom AS (
    -- suv rows per showroom_id
    SELECT showroom_id, COUNT(*) AS suv_count, ROUND(AVG(term_months), 2) AS suv_avg_term_months
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE body_style = 'suv'
    GROUP BY showroom_id
),
sedan_by_showroom AS (
    -- sedan rows per showroom_id
    SELECT showroom_id, COUNT(*) AS sedan_count, ROUND(AVG(term_months), 2) AS sedan_avg_term_months
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE body_style = 'sedan'
    GROUP BY showroom_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.showroom_id, b.showroom_id) AS showroom_id,
    COALESCE(a.suv_count, 0) AS suv_count,
    COALESCE(a.suv_avg_term_months, 0) AS suv_avg_term_months,
    COALESCE(b.sedan_count, 0) AS sedan_count,
    b.sedan_avg_term_months,
    COALESCE(a.suv_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.sedan_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM suv_by_showroom a
FULL OUTER JOIN sedan_by_showroom b
  ON a.showroom_id = b.showroom_id
ORDER BY showroom_id
