WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month,
        MONTH(awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month_2
    FROM pledges
    WHERE (pledge_amount <= 41673.6 OR donor_ref IS NOT NULL)
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Join donors
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.cause_area,
        s.pledge_amount,
        s.awarded_date,
        s.awarded_date_month,
        d.pledge_amt AS donor_pledge_amt,
        d.gift_aid AS donor_gift_aid,
        d.grant_stage AS donor_grant_stage
    FROM recent s
    JOIN donors d ON d.id = s.donor_ref
),
qualified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose donor matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_parent s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM donors d
            WHERE d.id = s.donor_ref
              AND d.pledged_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-02' AND DATE '2025-08-11'
        )
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date_month,
        donor_pledge_amt,
        donor_gift_aid,
        donor_grant_stage,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', cause_area, donor_grant_stage) AS cause_area_donor_grant_stage_label,
        DATE_FORMAT(awarded_date_month, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS awarded_date_month_label,
        UPPER(TRIM(donor_grant_stage)) AS donor_grant_stage_clean
    FROM qualified
    WHERE donor_pledge_amt <= 44061.0
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per cause_area, donor_grant_stage
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date_month,
        donor_pledge_amt,
        donor_gift_aid,
        donor_grant_stage,
        cause_area_donor_grant_stage_label,
        awarded_date_month_label,
        donor_grant_stage_clean
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_grant_stage ORDER BY donor_pledge_amt DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM tagged
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    WHERE donor_pledge_amt < (SELECT MAX(donor_pledge_amt) FROM latest)
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, ABS(pledge_amount - 20114.5) AS pledge_amount_distance
    FROM with_activity
)
SELECT
    id,
    cause_area,
    pledge_amount,
    awarded_date_month,
    donor_pledge_amt,
    donor_gift_aid,
    donor_grant_stage,
    cause_area_donor_grant_stage_label,
    awarded_date_month_label,
    donor_grant_stage_clean,
    pledge_amount_distance,
    FLOOR(pledge_amount / 10000) * 10000 AS pledge_amount_bucket
FROM derived
ORDER BY awarded_date_month

WITH cleaned_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', mission_state, mission_name) AS mission_state_mission_name_label
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE frame_seq BETWEEN 2958 AND 6023
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per mission_state
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM cleaned_telemetry_frames
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR frame_at > prev_frame_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
telemetry_frame_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payload_kind NOT IN ('sat', 'crew')) AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        COUNT(*) AS telemetry_frame_count
    FROM telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_count
    FROM sessionized s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frame_stats t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_state_mission_name_label,
        prev_frame_at,
        burst_id,
        telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        telemetry_frame_count,
        NTH_VALUE(prev_frame_at, 2) OVER (ORDER BY starts_session, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_prev_frame_at,
        LAST_VALUE(frame_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY starts_session, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_frame_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY starts_session, id) AS starts_session_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(burst_id) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY starts_session, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_burst_id
    FROM summarized_rows
)
SELECT
    mission_id,
    telemetry_frame_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(payload_kind)) AS payload_kind_list,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mission_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_mission_state_is_not_null
FROM with_trends
GROUP BY CUBE(mission_id, telemetry_frame_count)

WITH recent_pets_regs AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        flag_is_neutered,
        diet_tags
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE coat_kind NOT IN ('long', 'curly')
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_visit_day AS visit_day_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_visit_day_month_flag_is_neut AS visit_day_rank_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS visit_day_rank_3,
        LAST_VALUE(visit_day) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_visit_day,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC) AS visit_day_rank_4,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind, flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS visit_day_decile,
        FIRST_VALUE(visit_day) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind, flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_visit_day
    FROM recent_pets_regs
    WINDOW w_all_by_visit_day AS (ORDER BY visit_day DESC NULLS FIRST, id), w_visit_day_month_flag_is_neut AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day), flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day ASC NULLS LAST)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        visit_day_rank,
        visit_day_rank_2,
        last_known_visit_day,
        visit_day_rank_4,
        seq_no,
        visit_day_decile,
        MIN(visit_day_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_day_decile) AS visit_day_decile_min_visit_day_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id ORDER BY visit_day_rank_4 DESC) AS visit_day_rank_4_dense_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(pet_owner_id) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_day_decile)) AS distinct_pet_owner_id_in_visit_day_decile,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_visit_day_decile AS rows_in_visit_day_decile,
        MAX(visit_day_rank_3) OVER (PARTITION BY seq_no, visit_day_rank_4 ORDER BY visit_day_rank DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS visit_day_rank_3_max_4
    FROM with_trends
    WINDOW w_visit_day_decile AS (PARTITION BY visit_day_decile)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    coat_kind,
    visit_day,
    visit_day_rank,
    seq_no,
    visit_day_decile_min_visit_day_rank_2,
    visit_day_rank_4_dense_rank,
    distinct_pet_owner_id_in_visit_day_decile,
    rows_in_visit_day_decile,
    visit_day_rank_3_max_4,
    DATEDIFF(last_known_visit_day, visit_day) AS days_visit_day_to_last_known_visit_day,
    CASE WHEN seq_no >= 7 THEN 'large' WHEN seq_no >= 4 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS seq_no_tier
FROM windowed
ORDER BY visit_day_rank_4_dense_rank DESC, id
LIMIT 20

WITH recent AS (
    -- Filter payload_items
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        YEAR(launched_on) AS launched_on_year,
        YEAR(launched_on) AS launched_on_year_2,
        frame_seq - payload_kg AS frame_seq_minus_payload_kg
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE launched_on IS NOT NULL
      AND mission_id >= 21
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching telemetry_frames
    SELECT s.*
    FROM recent s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM telemetry_frames t
            WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND t.burn_secs <= 537
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE frame_seq > (SELECT AVG(frame_seq) FROM with_activity)
)
SELECT
    site_country,
    mission_id,
    launched_on_year_2,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filtered
GROUP BY ROLLUP(site_country, mission_id, launched_on_year_2)
ORDER BY site_country NULLS LAST, mission_id NULLS LAST, launched_on_year_2 NULLS LAST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Scope the usage_reads rows
    SELECT *
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE meter_fitted_date IS NOT NULL
      AND station_tier = 'primary'
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        chlorine_ppm,
        usage_m3,
        burst_litres,
        meter_fitted_date,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_band, water_meter_id ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id) AS chlorine_ppm_decile,
        ROUND(usage_m3 / NULLIF(SUM(usage_m3) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_band), 0), 4) AS usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band
    FROM filtered
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching usage_reads
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sequenced s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM usage_reads u
            WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.water_meter_id
              AND u.tariff_band = 'house'
        )
      AND s.usage_m3 > 33.5
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(station_tier), 1, 4) AS station_tier_prefix,
        LOWER(TRIM(station_tier)) AS station_tier_clean,
        CASE WHEN burst_litres >= 63335 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN burst_litres >= 44000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS burst_litres_tier
    FROM screened
    WHERE meter_fitted_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-30' AND DATE '2025-11-09'
),
tariff_band_stats AS (
    -- Max usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band per tariff_band
    SELECT tariff_band, MAX(usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band) AS max_usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY tariff_band
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band,
        ROUND(s.usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band - g.max_usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band, 2) AS usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band_minus_max
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN tariff_band_stats g ON g.tariff_band = s.tariff_band
    WHERE s.usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band = g.max_usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    water_meter_id,
    station_tier,
    tariff_band,
    burst_litres,
    chlorine_ppm_decile,
    usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band,
    station_tier_prefix,
    station_tier_clean,
    burst_litres_tier,
    max_usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band,
    usage_m3_share_of_tariff_band_minus_max,
    ROUND(usage_m3 * 0.9, 2) AS usage_m3_adj
FROM compared
ORDER BY station_tier_clean DESC NULLS FIRST, burst_litres_tier DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH reported_by_campaigns_ch_ref AS (
    -- reported rows per campaigns_ch_ref
    SELECT campaigns_ch_ref, COUNT(*) AS reported_count, SUM(volunteer_hrs) AS reported_total_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'reported'
    GROUP BY campaigns_ch_ref
),
applied_by_campaigns_ch_ref AS (
    -- applied rows per campaigns_ch_ref
    SELECT campaigns_ch_ref, COUNT(*) AS applied_count, ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs), 2) AS applied_avg_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'applied'
    GROUP BY campaigns_ch_ref
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.campaigns_ch_ref, b.campaigns_ch_ref) AS campaigns_ch_ref,
    COALESCE(a.reported_count, 0) AS reported_count,
    a.reported_total_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(b.applied_count, 0) AS applied_count,
    b.applied_avg_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(a.reported_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.applied_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM reported_by_campaigns_ch_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN applied_by_campaigns_ch_ref b
  ON a.campaigns_ch_ref = b.campaigns_ch_ref
ORDER BY campaigns_ch_ref

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Filter payload_items
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        ROUND(payload_kg * 1.1, 2) AS payload_kg_adj,
        FLOOR(frame_seq / 5000) * 5000 AS frame_seq_bucket
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE site_country IS NOT NULL
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(launched_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS launched_on_ym,
        mission_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mission_id) AS distinct_mission_ids,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        SUM(payload_kg_adj) AS total_payload_kg_adj
    FROM scoped
    WHERE frame_seq < 9385
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(launched_on, 'yyyy-MM'), mission_id
),
telemetry_frame_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        COUNT(*) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        MAX(frame_at) AS last_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        t.last_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM summary s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frame_stats t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach payload_items metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS payload_item_count,
        (SELECT MAX(p.launched_on) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS last_payload_item_launched_on
    FROM summarized_rows s
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        launched_on_ym,
        mission_id,
        distinct_mission_ids,
        row_count,
        telemetry_frame_count,
        last_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        payload_item_count,
        last_payload_item_launched_on,
        LAST_VALUE(total_payload_kg_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY telemetry_frame_count ORDER BY row_count DESC, launched_on_ym, mission_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_total_payload_kg_adj,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY row_count) AS rows_in_row_count
    FROM with_counts
),
detail_rows_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- One row per telemetry_frame
    SELECT
        s.launched_on_ym,
        s.mission_id,
        s.row_count,
        s.last_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        s.last_payload_item_launched_on,
        s.last_total_payload_kg_adj,
        t.id AS telemetry_frame_id,
        t.frame_at AS telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        t.payload_kind AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
        t.burn_secs AS telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
        t.mission_state AS telemetry_frame_mission_state
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Join telemetry_frames
    SELECT s.*, t.mission_state AS telemetry_frame_mission_state_2
    FROM detail_rows_telemetry_frames s
    JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.id = s.telemetry_frame_id AND UPPER(TRIM(t.mission_name)) LIKE 'D%'
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per payload_item
    SELECT
        s.launched_on_ym,
        s.mission_id,
        s.row_count,
        s.last_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        s.last_payload_item_launched_on,
        s.last_total_payload_kg_adj,
        s.telemetry_frame_id,
        s.telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
        s.telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
        s.telemetry_frame_mission_state,
        p.id AS payload_item_id,
        p.frame_seq AS payload_item_frame_seq,
        p.launched_on AS payload_item_launched_on
    FROM with_parent s
    LEFT JOIN payload_items p ON p.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_children s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND p.site_country = 'US'
              AND p.mission_state IN ('success', 'lost')
        )
)
SELECT
    launched_on_ym,
    mission_id,
    row_count,
    last_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
    last_payload_item_launched_on,
    telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
    telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
    telemetry_frame_mission_state,
    payload_item_launched_on,
    CASE WHEN row_count >= 8 THEN 'A' WHEN row_count >= 5 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS row_count_tier,
    LEAST(payload_item_frame_seq, row_count) AS least_payload_item_frame_seq_row_count
FROM screened
ORDER BY telemetry_frame_payload_kind, telemetry_frame_burn_secs NULLS LAST

WITH scoped_kennels AS (
    -- Scope the kennels rows
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts
    FROM kennels
    WHERE visit_cost > 186.8
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per visit_reason
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM scoped_kennels
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_ts)) / 60 > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        visit_reason,
        burst_id,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(visit_cost) AS session_visit_cost,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY visit_reason, burst_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT session_end, session_start, visit_reason, session_visit_cost
    FROM session_summary
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(session_visit_cost)
    FOR visit_reason IN ('vaccine', 'injury', 'checkup', 'dental')
)
ORDER BY session_end, session_start

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_kennels = (
    df_kennels
    .filter(F.col("visit_cost") > 186.8)
    .select(
        "id",
        "visit_reason",
        "visit_cost",
        "groomed_ts",
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_kennels.withColumn("prev_groomed_ts", F.lag("groomed_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_reason").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_ts").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("groomed_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_groomed_ts")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_reason").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("visit_reason", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("groomed_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("groomed_ts").alias("session_end"),

    )
)

result = (

    .groupBy("session_end", "session_start")
    .pivot("visit_reason", ["vaccine", "injury", "checkup", "dental"])

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        DATE_ADD(launched_on, 7) AS launched_on_plus_7d,
        COALESCE(apogee_km, 0.0) AS apogee_km_filled
    FROM missions
    WHERE apogee_km < 29998.6
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_on_plus_7d), rocket_id) AS rows_in_launched_on_plus_7d_year_rocket_id,
        FIRST_VALUE(burn_secs) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY launched_on_plus_7d ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_burn_secs,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_id ORDER BY launched_on_plus_7d DESC), 3) AS launched_on_plus_7d_percent_rank,
        MIN(apogee_km_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launched_on_plus_7d)) AS launched_on_plus_7d_month_min_apogee_km_filled,
        NTH_VALUE(apogee_km, 2) OVER (ORDER BY launched_on_plus_7d ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_apogee_km,
        FIRST_VALUE(launched_on_plus_7d) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_id ORDER BY launched_on_plus_7d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_launched_on_plus_7d,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_rocket_id_launched_on_plus_7, 3) AS apogee_km_filled_cume_dist,
        ROUND(AVG(apogee_km_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_on_plus_7d), rocket_id), 2) AS launched_on_plus_7d_year_rocket_id_avg_apogee_km,
        ROUND(apogee_km_filled / NULLIF(SUM(apogee_km_filled) OVER w_launched_on_plus_7d_month, 0), 4) AS apogee_km_filled_share_of_launched_on_plus_7d_mo,
        SUM(apogee_km_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_id, YEAR(launched_on_plus_7d) ORDER BY apogee_km_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS apogee_km_filled_sum_6_prior,
        ROUND(burn_secs / NULLIF(SUM(burn_secs) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launched_on_plus_7d)), 0), 4) AS burn_secs_share_of_launched_on_plus_7d_month,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(rocket_id) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launched_on_plus_7d))) AS distinct_rocket_id_in_launched_on_plus_7d_month,
        SUM(apogee_km_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_id, YEAR(launched_on_plus_7d) ORDER BY apogee_km_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_apogee_km_filled
    FROM scoped
    WINDOW w_rocket_id_launched_on_plus_7 AS (PARTITION BY rocket_id, YEAR(launched_on_plus_7d) ORDER BY apogee_km_filled DESC), w_launched_on_plus_7d_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(launched_on_plus_7d))
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        apogee_km_filled,
        rows_in_launched_on_plus_7d_year_rocket_id,
        first_known_burn_secs,
        launched_on_plus_7d_month_min_apogee_km_filled,
        second_apogee_km,
        first_known_launched_on_plus_7d,
        apogee_km_filled_cume_dist,
        apogee_km_filled_share_of_launched_on_plus_7d_mo,
        burn_secs_share_of_launched_on_plus_7d_month,
        distinct_rocket_id_in_launched_on_plus_7d_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', launched_on_plus_7d) AS launched_on_plus_7d_quarter
    FROM ranked
    WHERE launched_on_plus_7d >= DATE '2024-11-01'
)
SELECT
    id,
    rocket_id,
    apogee_km,
    launched_on,
    first_known_burn_secs,
    launched_on_plus_7d_month_min_apogee_km_filled,
    second_apogee_km,
    first_known_launched_on_plus_7d,
    apogee_km_filled_share_of_launched_on_plus_7d_mo,
    burn_secs_share_of_launched_on_plus_7d_month,
    distinct_rocket_id_in_launched_on_plus_7d_month,
    launched_on_plus_7d_quarter
FROM labeled
ORDER BY id DESC, rocket_id DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the volunteer_shifts rows
    SELECT *
    FROM volunteer_shifts
    WHERE (goal_amount > 696145.8 OR pledged_date >= DATE '2024-05-31')
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Keep rows whose campaigns_ch matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scoped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM campaigns_ch c
            WHERE c.id = s.campaigns_ch_id
              AND c.pledge_amt <= 40546.8
        )
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(donor_segment, 'ALL') AS donor_segment,
    campaigns_ch_id,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
    ROUND(STDDEV(goal_amount), 2) AS stddev_goal_amount
FROM without_matches
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((donor_segment, campaigns_ch_id), (donor_segment), (campaigns_ch_id), ())
ORDER BY donor_segment NULLS LAST, campaigns_ch_id NULLS LAST

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(mission_name)) >= 8
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per mission_state, mission_id
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_id ORDER BY frame_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM prepared
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_details_mission AS (
    -- Join missions
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.payload_kind,
        s.burn_secs,
        s.frame_at,
        s.mission_name,
        m.launched_on AS mission_launched_on,
        m.is_reusable AS mission_is_reusable,
        m.rocket_id AS mission_rocket_id
    FROM latest_per_key s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(mission_state)) AS mission_state_len,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(mission_name), 1, 4) AS mission_name_prefix,
        TO_DATE(frame_at) AS frame_at_date
    FROM with_details_mission
),
detail_rows_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- One row per telemetry_frame
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.burn_secs,
        s.frame_at,
        s.mission_name,
        s.mission_launched_on,
        s.mission_rocket_id,
        s.mission_state_len,
        s.mission_name_prefix,
        t.id AS telemetry_frame_id,
        t.frame_at AS telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        t.frame_seq AS telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        t.mission_name AS telemetry_frame_mission_name,
        t.mission_state AS telemetry_frame_mission_state
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        mission_launched_on,
        mission_rocket_id,
        mission_state_len,
        mission_name_prefix,
        telemetry_frame_id,
        telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        ROUND(burn_secs / NULLIF(mission_state_len, 0), 3) AS burn_secs_per_mission_state_len,
        COALESCE(mission_state_len, 0) AS mission_state_len_filled
    FROM detail_rows_telemetry_frames
    WHERE mission_rocket_id <= 23
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM tagged
    WHERE mission_state_len_filled < (SELECT MAX(mission_state_len_filled) FROM tagged)
)
SELECT id, telemetry_frame_id, metric_name, amount
FROM (
    SELECT id, telemetry_frame_id, mission_state_len_filled, burn_secs
    FROM qualified
) src
UNPIVOT (
    amount FOR metric_name IN (mission_state_len_filled AS m_mission_state_len_filled, burn_secs AS m_burn_secs)
) unp

WITH health_by_donor_ref AS (
    -- health rows per donor_ref
    SELECT donor_ref, COUNT(*) AS health_count, ROUND(AVG(pledge_amount), 2) AS health_avg_pledge_amount
    FROM pledges
    WHERE cause_area = 'health'
    GROUP BY donor_ref
),
animals_by_donor_ref AS (
    -- animals rows per donor_ref
    SELECT donor_ref, COUNT(*) AS animals_count, SUM(pledge_amount) AS animals_total_pledge_amount
    FROM pledges
    WHERE cause_area = 'animals'
    GROUP BY donor_ref
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.donor_ref, b.donor_ref) AS donor_ref,
    COALESCE(a.health_count, 0) AS health_count,
    COALESCE(a.health_avg_pledge_amount, 0) AS health_avg_pledge_amount,
    COALESCE(b.animals_count, 0) AS animals_count,
    COALESCE(b.animals_total_pledge_amount, 0) AS animals_total_pledge_amount,
    COALESCE(a.health_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.animals_count, 0) AS health_count_minus_animals_count
FROM health_by_donor_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN animals_by_donor_ref b
  ON a.donor_ref = b.donor_ref
ORDER BY donor_ref

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("health_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("pledge_amount"), 2).alias("health_avg_pledge_amount"),
    )
)

animals_by_donor_ref = (

    )

    .join(animals_by_donor_ref.alias("b"), F.col("a.donor_ref") == F.col("b.donor_ref"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.donor_ref"), F.col("b.donor_ref")).alias("donor_ref"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.health_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("health_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.health_avg_pledge_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("health_avg_pledge_amount"),

        F.coalesce(F.col("b.animals_total_pledge_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("animals_total_pledge_amount"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.health_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.animals_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("health_count_minus_animals_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("donor_ref")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Scope the test_drives rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(vin_tail), 1, 2) AS vin_tail_prefix,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', deal_status, vin_tail) AS deal_status_vin_tail_label,
        LOWER(TRIM(drive_outcome)) AS drive_outcome_clean
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_outcome <> 'thinking'
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Keep rows whose car_stock matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM car_stock c
            WHERE c.id = s.car_stock_id
              AND c.term_months <= 63
        )
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(drive_mins - AVG(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_outcome, MONTH(arrived_on)), 2) AS drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_outcome, MONTH(arrived_on)) AS drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_max_drive_mins
    FROM with_activity
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_is_fleet_by_drive_mins_vs_dr AS drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg_2,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_is_fleet_by_drive_mins_vs_dr, 3) AS drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg_3
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_is_fleet_by_drive_mins_vs_dr AS (PARTITION BY is_fleet ORDER BY drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg NULLS LAST, id)
),
with_windows_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(arrived_on) OVER w_is_fleet_drive_mins_vs_drive AS prev_arrived_on,
        NTH_VALUE(arrived_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY is_fleet, drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg_2 ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_arrived_on
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_is_fleet_drive_mins_vs_drive AS (PARTITION BY is_fleet, drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg_2 ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id)
),
per_group AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        car_stock_id,
        MAX(drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_max_drive_mins) AS max_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_max_drive_min,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(arrived_on), MIN(arrived_on)) AS arrived_on_span_days,
        ROUND(STDDEV(drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg_3), 2) AS stddev_drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_mo,
        MAX(drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_avg_2) AS max_drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month
    FROM with_windows_2
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
combined_details_car_stock AS (
    -- Attach car_stock attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        sh.signed_on AS showroom_signed_on
    FROM per_group s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    car_stock_id,
    max_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month_max_drive_min,
    max_drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_arrived_on_month,
    car_stock_term_months,
    car_stock_arrived_date,
    showroom_signed_on,
    DATEDIFF(showroom_signed_on, car_stock_arrived_date) AS days_car_stock_arrived_date_to_showroom_signed_o,
    MONTH(showroom_signed_on) AS showroom_signed_on_month
FROM combined_details_car_stock
ORDER BY showroom_signed_on_month DESC, car_stock_arrived_date

        w.burst_cause AS water_meter_burst_cause,
        p.station_tier AS pump_station_station_tier,
        p.pressure_bar AS pump_station_pressure_bar
    FROM base_usage_reads s
    JOIN water_meters w ON w.id = s.water_meter_id
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = w.pump_station_id

detail_rows AS (

    SELECT

        p.street_ref AS pipe_burst_street_ref,

        p.station_tier AS pipe_burst_station_tier
    FROM joined s

),

    FROM enriched
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(pipe_burst_flow_lpm)
    FOR tariff_band IN ('house', 'factory', 'shop')
)
ORDER BY pipe_burst_station_tier

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter pet_owners
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_type,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts
    FROM pet_owners
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per coat_type
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY coat_type ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_ts)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY coat_type ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        coat_type,
        session_id,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY coat_type, session_id
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, YEAR(session_end) AS session_end_year
    FROM per_session
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        event_count,
        DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_end_ym,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(coat_type)) AS coat_type_list,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        MIN(session_end) AS first_session_end
    FROM derived
    WHERE session_start < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-05 09:00:00'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT
    row_count,
    event_count,
    MIN(row_count) AS min_row_count
FROM rollup_base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((row_count, event_count), (row_count), ())
ORDER BY row_count NULLS LAST, event_count NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_pet_owners
    .select(
        "id",
        "coat_type",
        "visit_cost",
        "pet_age_yrs",
        "groomed_ts",
    )
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_groomed_ts", F.lag("groomed_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("coat_type").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_ts").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("groomed_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_groomed_ts")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("coat_type").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("coat_type", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("groomed_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("groomed_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("groomed_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("groomed_ts"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

derived = per_session.select("*", F.year(F.col("session_end")).alias("session_end_year"))

rollup_base = (
    derived
    .filter(F.col("session_start") < F.lit("2025-02-05 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .groupBy(
        "event_count",
        F.date_format("session_end", "yyyy-MM").alias("session_end_ym"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("coat_type")).alias("coat_type_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.min("session_end").alias("first_session_end"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .groupingSets(
        [["row_count", "event_count"], ["row_count"], []],
        "row_count", "event_count",
    )
    .agg(F.min("row_count").alias("min_row_count"))
    .orderBy(
        F.col("row_count").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("event_count").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date
    FROM pledges
    WHERE donor_ref IS NOT NULL

enriched AS (
    -- Attach donor attributes

        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.cause_area,
        s.awarded_date,
        d.channel_tags AS donor_channel_tags
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN donors d ON d.id = s.donor_ref

windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        awarded_date,
        LAG(awarded_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY awarded_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS prev_awarded_date,
        FIRST_VALUE(awarded_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY awarded_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_awarded_date,
        NTH_VALUE(awarded_date, 2) OVER (ORDER BY awarded_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_awarded_date,
        DATEDIFF(awarded_date, LAG(awarded_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY awarded_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id)) AS days_since_prev_awarded_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY awarded_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn,
        LAG(awarded_date, 3) OVER (ORDER BY awarded_date DESC, id) AS prev3_awarded_date,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY awarded_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS awarded_date_rank,
        LEAD(awarded_date) OVER (ORDER BY awarded_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS next_awarded_date,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_cause_area_by_awarded_date_t AS awarded_date_dense_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY awarded_date DESC, id) AS awarded_date_tercile
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_cause_area_by_awarded_date_t AS (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY awarded_date)
),
first_rows AS (
    -- Top 5 per group

    FROM windowed
    WHERE awarded_date_dense_rank <= 5
)

SELECT

    first_awarded_date,
    second_awarded_date,
    days_since_prev_awarded_date,
    rn,
    prev3_awarded_date,
    awarded_date_rank,
    next_awarded_date,
    awarded_date_dense_rank,
    ROUND(awarded_date_rank / NULLIF(rn, 0), 3) AS awarded_date_rank_per_rn
FROM first_rows
ORDER BY awarded_date_rank

WITH filtered_pledges AS (
    -- Filter pledges
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date
    FROM pledges
    WHERE donor_ref >= 7
),
with_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.cause_area,
        s.pledge_amount,
        s.awarded_date,
        d.gift_aid AS donor_gift_aid,
        d.pledge_amt AS donor_pledge_amt
    FROM filtered_pledges s
    LEFT JOIN donors d ON d.id = s.donor_ref
),
per_group AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        cause_area,
        donor_gift_aid,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(cause_area)) AS cause_area_list,
        SUM(pledge_amount) AS total_pledge_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cause_area) AS distinct_cause_areas,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(donor_pledge_amt, 0.5) AS median_donor_pledge_amt,
        ROUND(SUM(pledge_amount), 2) AS total_pledge_amount_2
    FROM with_details
    GROUP BY cause_area, donor_gift_aid
),
per_label AS (
    -- One row per cause_area_list_item
    SELECT
        s.cause_area,
        s.donor_gift_aid,
        s.total_pledge_amount,
        s.distinct_cause_areas,
        s.median_donor_pledge_amt,
        s.total_pledge_amount_2,
        t.cause_area_list_item
    FROM per_group s
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(s.cause_area_list) t AS cause_area_list_item
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT

WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(species), ' ', '_')) AS species_slug
    FROM kennels
    WHERE (groomed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-25 09:00:00' OR visit_reason = 'checkup')
),
combined AS (
    -- Stack the branches
    SELECT id, visit_cost AS value, groomed_ts
    FROM kennels
    WHERE visit_reason = 'injury'
      AND species IN ('rabbit', 'dog')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pet_age_yrs AS id, pet_weight_kg AS value, groomed_at AS groomed_ts
    FROM grooming_jobs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT kennel_nights AS id, pet_weight_kg AS value, groomed_at AS groomed_ts
    FROM grooming_jobs
)
SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(value) AS total_value, MAX(groomed_ts) AS latest_groomed_ts
FROM combined
GROUP BY id
ORDER BY id

WITH quoted_by_car_stock AS (
    -- quoted rows per car_stock_id
    SELECT car_stock_id, COUNT(*) AS quoted_count, SUM(odometer_kms) AS quoted_total_odometer_kms
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE deal_status = 'quoted'
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
signed_by_car_stock AS (
    -- signed rows per car_stock_id
    SELECT car_stock_id, COUNT(*) AS signed_count, SUM(odometer_kms) AS signed_total_odometer_kms
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE deal_status = 'signed'
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.car_stock_id, b.car_stock_id) AS car_stock_id,
    COALESCE(a.quoted_count, 0) AS quoted_count,
    COALESCE(a.quoted_total_odometer_kms, 0) AS quoted_total_odometer_kms,
    COALESCE(b.signed_count, 0) AS signed_count,
    COALESCE(b.signed_total_odometer_kms, 0) AS signed_total_odometer_kms,
    COALESCE(a.quoted_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.signed_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM quoted_by_car_stock a
FULL OUTER JOIN signed_by_car_stock b
  ON a.car_stock_id = b.car_stock_id
ORDER BY car_stock_id

    df_finance_deals

    .groupBy("car_stock_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("quoted_count"),
        F.sum("odometer_kms").alias("quoted_total_odometer_kms"),
    )
)

signed_by_car_stock = (

    .filter(F.col("deal_status") == "signed")
    .groupBy("car_stock_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("signed_count"),
        F.sum("odometer_kms").alias("signed_total_odometer_kms"),
    )
)

result = (
    quoted_by_car_stock.alias("a")
    .join(signed_by_car_stock.alias("b"), F.col("a.car_stock_id") == F.col("b.car_stock_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.car_stock_id"), F.col("b.car_stock_id")).alias("car_stock_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.quoted_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("quoted_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.quoted_total_odometer_kms"), F.lit(0)).alias("quoted_total_odometer_kms"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.signed_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("signed_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.signed_total_odometer_kms"), F.lit(0)).alias("signed_total_odometer_kms"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.quoted_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.signed_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("car_stock_id")
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        frame_seq,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        UPPER(TRIM(mission_name)) AS mission_name_clean,
        CASE WHEN frame_seq >= 5128 THEN 'A' WHEN frame_seq >= 2680 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS frame_seq_tier,
        DATE_FORMAT(frame_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS frame_at_label
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE burn_secs < 429
      AND UPPER(TRIM(mission_name)) LIKE 'K%'
),
frame_seq_tier_stats AS (
    -- Max frame_seq per frame_seq_tier
    SELECT frame_seq_tier, MAX(frame_seq) AS max_frame_seq
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY frame_seq_tier
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_frame_seq,
        ROUND(s.frame_seq - g.max_frame_seq, 2) AS frame_seq_minus_max
    FROM valid s
    JOIN frame_seq_tier_stats g ON g.frame_seq_tier = s.frame_seq_tier
    WHERE s.frame_seq = g.max_frame_seq
),
detail_rows_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- One row per telemetry_frame
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.mission_name,
        s.mission_name_clean,
        s.frame_at_label,
        s.frame_seq_minus_max,
        t.id AS telemetry_frame_id,
        t.payload_kind AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
        t.mission_state AS telemetry_frame_mission_state,
        t.burn_secs AS telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
        t.frame_seq AS telemetry_frame_frame_seq
    FROM outliers s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id AND t.frame_seq BETWEEN 2820 AND 8179
),
mission_state_stats AS (
    -- Median frame_seq_minus_max per mission_state
    SELECT mission_state, PERCENTILE_APPROX(frame_seq_minus_max, 0.5) AS median_frame_seq_minus_max
    FROM detail_rows_telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_state
),
outliers_2 AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_frame_seq_minus_max,
        ROUND(s.frame_seq_minus_max - g.median_frame_seq_minus_max, 2) AS frame_seq_minus_max_minus_median
    FROM detail_rows_telemetry_frames s
    JOIN mission_state_stats g ON g.mission_state = s.mission_state
    WHERE s.frame_seq_minus_max >= g.median_frame_seq_minus_max
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(telemetry_frame_burn_secs) OVER (PARTITION BY telemetry_frame_id, telemetry_frame_payload_kind) AS telemetry_frame_id_telemetry_frame_payload_kind_,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq_minus_max, id, telemetry_frame_id) AS frame_seq_minus_max_dense_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(telemetry_frame_frame_seq) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq_minus_max, id, telemetry_frame_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS telemetry_frame_frame_seq_avg_2_prior,
        MAX(median_frame_seq_minus_max) OVER (PARTITION BY telemetry_frame_id, mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_minus_max, id, telemetry_frame_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS median_frame_seq_minus_max_max_1_prior,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_id) OVER (PARTITION BY telemetry_frame_id, telemetry_frame_payload_kind)) AS distinct_mission_id_in_telemetry_frame_id_teleme,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_frame_seq_minus_max_m AS frame_seq_minus_max_minus_median_dense_rank
    FROM outliers_2
    WINDOW w_all_by_frame_seq_minus_max_m AS (ORDER BY frame_seq_minus_max_minus_median DESC)
),
with_details_mission AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.frame_at_label,
        s.telemetry_frame_id,
        s.telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
        s.telemetry_frame_mission_state,
        s.telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
        s.telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        s.median_frame_seq_minus_max,
        s.frame_seq_minus_max_minus_median,
        s.telemetry_frame_id_telemetry_frame_payload_kind_,
        s.frame_seq_minus_max_dense_rank,
        s.telemetry_frame_frame_seq_avg_2_prior,
        s.median_frame_seq_minus_max_max_1_prior,
        m.burn_secs AS mission_burn_secs,
        m.is_reusable AS mission_is_reusable,
        m.apogee_km AS mission_apogee_km
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per payload_item
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.frame_at_label,
        s.telemetry_frame_id,
        s.telemetry_frame_burn_secs,
        s.telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        s.median_frame_seq_minus_max,
        s.frame_seq_minus_max_minus_median,
        s.telemetry_frame_id_telemetry_frame_payload_kind_,
        s.frame_seq_minus_max_dense_rank,
        s.median_frame_seq_minus_max_max_1_prior,
        s.mission_burn_secs,
        s.mission_is_reusable,
        p.id AS payload_item_id,
        p.site_country AS payload_item_site_country,
        p.mission_state AS payload_item_mission_state,
        p.payload_kg AS payload_item_payload_kg
    FROM with_details_mission s
    JOIN payload_items p ON p.mission_id = s.mission_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT telemetry_frame_id, mission_id, payload_item_site_country, median_frame_seq_minus_max_max_1_prior
    FROM exploded_detail
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(median_frame_seq_minus_max_max_1_prior) AS count_v, MAX(median_frame_seq_minus_max_max_1_prior) AS max_v
    FOR payload_item_site_country IN ('US', 'IN')
)
ORDER BY telemetry_frame_id, mission_id

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts
    FROM pump_stations
    WHERE station_tier IN ('reserve', 'primary')
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous burst_ts per station_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(burst_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id) AS prev_burst_ts
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_burst_ts IS NULL OR burst_ts > prev_burst_ts + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        station_tier,
        burst_id,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(burst_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(pressure_bar) AS session_pressure_bar,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(burst_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(burst_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY station_tier, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    station_tier,
    burst_id,
    session_end,
    events,
    session_pressure_bar,
    duration_min,
    COALESCE(duration_min, 0.0) AS duration_min_filled
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_end, burst_id DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_pump_stations
    .filter(F.col("station_tier").isin("reserve", "primary"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "station_tier",
        "tariff_band",
        "pressure_bar",
        "meter_age_yrs",
        "burst_ts",
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_burst_ts", F.lag("burst_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("station_tier").orderBy("burst_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_burst_ts").isNull() | (F.col("burst_ts") > F.col("prev_burst_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("station_tier").orderBy("burst_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("station_tier", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("burst_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("burst_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("pressure_bar").alias("session_pressure_bar"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("burst_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("burst_ts"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    per_session
    .select(
        "station_tier",
        "burst_id",
        "session_end",
        "events",
        "session_pressure_bar",
        "duration_min",
        F.coalesce(F.col("duration_min"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("duration_min_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("session_end").asc(), F.col("burst_id").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter usage_reads
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_date,
        TRUNC(meter_fitted_date, 'MM') AS meter_fitted_date_month_start
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE usage_m3 <= 60.8
),
enriched AS (
    -- Join water_meters
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.water_meter_id,
        s.station_tier,
        s.meter_fitted_date,
        s.meter_fitted_date_month_start,
        w.pump_station_id AS water_meter_pump_station_id,
        w.burst_cause AS water_meter_burst_cause
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN water_meters w ON w.id = s.water_meter_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_station_tier_by_meter_fitted AS meter_fitted_date_decile,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_meter_fitted_date, 3) AS meter_fitted_date_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, MONTH(meter_fitted_date_month_start) ORDER BY meter_fitted_date_month_start DESC) AS meter_fitted_date_month_start_dense_rank,
        DATEDIFF(meter_fitted_date, LAG(meter_fitted_date) OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_pump_station_id, water_meter_id ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id)) AS days_since_prev_meter_fitted_date,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_meter_fitted_date AS meter_fitted_date_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_pump_station_id, water_meter_id ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC), 3) AS meter_fitted_date_cume_dist_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, MONTH(meter_fitted_date_month_start) ORDER BY meter_fitted_date_month_start DESC, id) AS meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_date, id) AS meter_fitted_date_tercile,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_fitted_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_meter_fitted_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LEAD(meter_fitted_date, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, MONTH(meter_fitted_date_month_start) ORDER BY meter_fitted_date_month_start DESC, id) AS next3_meter_fitted_date,
        RANK() OVER w_water_meter_id_station_tier_2 AS meter_fitted_date_rank_2
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_station_tier_by_meter_fitted AS (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id), w_all_by_meter_fitted_date AS (ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id), w_water_meter_id_station_tier_2 AS (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_date)
),
with_trends_2 AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        meter_fitted_date,
        water_meter_pump_station_id,
        water_meter_burst_cause,
        meter_fitted_date_cume_dist,
        days_since_prev_meter_fitted_date,
        meter_fitted_date_rank,
        meter_fitted_date_tercile,
        first_known_meter_fitted_date,
        seq_no,
        meter_fitted_date_rank_2,
        ROUND(meter_fitted_date_cume_dist / NULLIF(SUM(meter_fitted_date_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank, station_tier), 0), 4) AS meter_fitted_date_cume_dist_share_of_meter_fitte,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_next3_meter_fitted_da AS seq_no_2,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_fitted_date) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank, meter_fitted_date_tercile ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_meter_fitted_date,
        SUM(meter_fitted_date_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank, station_tier) AS meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank_station_tier_,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank, meter_fitted_date_tercile ORDER BY meter_fitted_date DESC, id) AS meter_fitted_date_tercile_2,
        MIN(meter_fitted_date_decile) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank, station_tier) AS meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank_station_tier__2,
        LAST_VALUE(seq_no) OVER (ORDER BY next3_meter_fitted_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_seq_no,
        ROUND(AVG(meter_fitted_date_rank) OVER (ORDER BY next3_meter_fitted_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS meter_fitted_date_rank_avg_3
    FROM with_trends
    WINDOW w_all_by_next3_meter_fitted_da AS (ORDER BY next3_meter_fitted_date, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    water_meter_id,
    meter_fitted_date,
    water_meter_pump_station_id,
    water_meter_burst_cause,
    meter_fitted_date_cume_dist,
    seq_no,
    meter_fitted_date_rank_2,
    meter_fitted_date_cume_dist_share_of_meter_fitte,
    seq_no_2,
    first_meter_fitted_date,
    meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank_station_tier_,
    meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank_station_tier__2,
    last_seq_no,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', first_meter_fitted_date) AS days_since_first_meter_fitted_date
FROM with_trends_2
ORDER BY meter_fitted_date_month_start_rank_station_tier__2 DESC

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(visit_reason), ' ', '_')) AS visit_reason_slug,
        FLOOR(visit_cost / 250) * 250 AS visit_cost_bucket
    FROM kennels
    WHERE visit_reason <> 'injury'
),
visit_reason_stats AS (
    -- Median visit_cost per visit_reason
    SELECT visit_reason, PERCENTILE_APPROX(visit_cost, 0.5) AS median_visit_cost
    FROM prepared
    GROUP BY visit_reason
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_visit_cost,
        ROUND(s.visit_cost - g.median_visit_cost, 2) AS visit_cost_minus_median
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN visit_reason_stats g ON g.visit_reason = s.visit_reason
    WHERE s.visit_cost >= g.median_visit_cost
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        groomed_ts + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AS groomed_ts_plus_30m,
        CASE WHEN visit_cost_bucket >= 633 THEN 'large' WHEN visit_cost_bucket >= 277 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS visit_cost_bucket_tier
    FROM compared
)
SELECT
    is_microchipped,
    visit_reason,
    visit_cost_bucket_tier,
    MIN(groomed_ts) AS first_groomed_ts
FROM tagged
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((is_microchipped, visit_reason, visit_cost_bucket_tier), (is_microchipped), (visit_reason), ())
ORDER BY is_microchipped NULLS LAST, visit_reason NULLS LAST, visit_cost_bucket_tier NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

prepared = (
    df_kennels
    .filter(F.col("visit_reason") != "injury")
    .select(
        "id",
        "visit_reason",
        "visit_cost",
        "groomed_ts",
        "is_microchipped",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("visit_reason")), " ", "_")).alias("visit_reason_slug"),
        (F.floor(F.col("visit_cost") / 250) * 250).alias("visit_cost_bucket"),
    )
)

visit_reason_stats = (
    prepared
    .groupBy("visit_reason")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("visit_cost", 0.5).alias("median_visit_cost"))
)

compared = (
    prepared.alias("s")
    .join(visit_reason_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.visit_reason") == F.col("s.visit_reason"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.visit_cost") >= F.col("g.median_visit_cost"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_visit_cost",
        F.round(F.col("s.visit_cost") - F.col("g.median_visit_cost"), 2).alias("visit_cost_minus_median"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    compared
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("groomed_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("groomed_ts_plus_30m"),
        F.when(F.col("visit_cost_bucket") >= 633, "large").when(F.col("visit_cost_bucket") >= 277, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("visit_cost_bucket_tier"),
    )
)

result = (
    tagged
    .groupingSets(
        [["is_microchipped", "visit_reason", "visit_cost_bucket_tier"], ["is_microchipped"], ["visit_reason"], []],
        "is_microchipped", "visit_reason", "visit_cost_bucket_tier",
    )
    .agg(F.min("groomed_ts").alias("first_groomed_ts"))
    .orderBy(
        F.col("is_microchipped").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("visit_reason").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("visit_cost_bucket_tier").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH recent_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        FLOOR(frame_seq / 5000) * 5000 AS frame_seq_bucket,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', mission_name, mission_state) AS mission_name_mission_state_label
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(mission_name, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS mission_name_ref,
        UPPER(TRIM(mission_name)) AS mission_name_clean
    FROM recent_telemetry_frames
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM tagged s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND p.site_country IS NOT NULL
        )
),
without_matches_2 AS (
    -- Rows that have matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM without_matches s
    WHERE s.mission_id IN (
            SELECT p.mission_id
            FROM payload_items p
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    frame_seq,
    burn_secs,
    frame_at,
    mission_name,
    frame_seq_bucket,
    mission_name_mission_state_label,
    mission_name_ref,
    CONCAT_WS(': ', mission_name_clean, mission_name) AS mission_name_clean_mission_name_label,
    CASE WHEN burn_secs >= 441 THEN 'large' WHEN burn_secs >= 293 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS burn_secs_tier
FROM without_matches_2
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(mission_name_clean)) LIKE 'L%'
ORDER BY burn_secs, id
LIMIT 20

WITH success_by_rocket AS (
    -- success rows per rocket_id
    SELECT rocket_id, COUNT(*) AS success_count, ROUND(AVG(burn_secs), 2) AS success_avg_burn_secs
    FROM missions
    WHERE mission_state = 'success'
    GROUP BY rocket_id
),
partial_by_rocket AS (
    -- partial rows per rocket_id
    SELECT rocket_id, COUNT(*) AS partial_count, SUM(burn_secs) AS partial_total_burn_secs
    FROM missions
    WHERE mission_state = 'partial'
    GROUP BY rocket_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.rocket_id, b.rocket_id) AS rocket_id,
    COALESCE(a.success_count, 0) AS success_count,
    a.success_avg_burn_secs,
    COALESCE(b.partial_count, 0) AS partial_count,
    COALESCE(b.partial_total_burn_secs, 0) AS partial_total_burn_secs,
    COALESCE(a.success_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.partial_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM success_by_rocket a
FULL OUTER JOIN partial_by_rocket b
  ON a.rocket_id = b.rocket_id
ORDER BY rocket_id

    .select(

    )

WITH valid_vet_visits AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        groom_mins,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        FLOOR(groom_mins / 25) * 25 AS groom_mins_bucket,
        MONTH(visit_day) AS visit_day_month
    FROM vet_visits
    WHERE kennel_size <> 'M'
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(kennel_size)) AS kennel_size_len,
        CONCAT(kennel_size, '#', CAST(pet_age_yrs AS STRING)) AS kennel_size_ref,
        CASE WHEN kennel_size IN ('M', 'S') THEN 'group_a' WHEN kennel_size = 'L' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS kennel_size_group
    FROM valid_vet_visits
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        groom_mins_bucket,
        visit_day_month,
        kennel_size_ref,
        kennel_size_group,
        LAG(groom_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_day_month ORDER BY groom_mins_bucket, id) AS prev_groom_mins,
        LEAD(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY kennel_size, kennel_size_len ORDER BY kennel_size_len DESC, id) AS next_pet_age_yrs,
        RANK() OVER w_kennel_size_kennel_size_len_2 AS kennel_size_len_rank,
        SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY kennel_size, kennel_size_len ORDER BY kennel_size_len DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pet_age_yrs_sum_2,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(pets_reg_id) OVER w_kennel_size_len_kennel_size) AS distinct_pets_reg_id_in_kennel_size_len_kennel_s
    FROM tagged
    WINDOW w_kennel_size_kennel_size_len_2 AS (PARTITION BY kennel_size, kennel_size_len ORDER BY kennel_size_len DESC), w_kennel_size_len_kennel_size AS (PARTITION BY kennel_size_len, kennel_size_group)
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching grooming_jobs
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_trends s
    WHERE s.pets_reg_id IN (
            SELECT g.pets_reg_id
            FROM grooming_jobs g
            WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(g.diet_tags, 'grain_free')
              AND g.kennel_nights > 15
        )
),
with_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pets_reg_id,
        s.visit_day_month,
        s.kennel_size_ref,
        s.prev_groom_mins,
        s.next_pet_age_yrs,
        s.kennel_size_len_rank,
        p.pet_age_yrs AS pets_reg_pet_age_yrs,
        p.coat_kind AS pets_reg_coat_kind,
        p.diet_tags AS pets_reg_diet_tags,
        pe.pet_age_yrs AS pet_owner_pet_age_yrs,
        pe.groomed_ts AS pet_owner_groomed_ts
    FROM qualified s
    LEFT JOIN pets_reg p ON p.id = s.pets_reg_id
    LEFT JOIN pet_owners pe ON pe.id = p.pet_owner_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        visit_day_month,
        pets_reg_coat_kind,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(prev_groom_mins) FILTER (WHERE pets_reg_coat_kind IN ('curly', 'long')) AS prev_groom_mins_pets_reg_coat_kind_in_curly
    FROM with_details
    GROUP BY visit_day_month, pets_reg_coat_kind
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM summary
    WHERE visit_day_month < (SELECT MAX(visit_day_month) FROM summary)
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        visit_day_month,
        pets_reg_coat_kind,
        cnt,
        prev_groom_mins_pets_reg_coat_kind_in_curly,
        cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER w_all_by_cnt AS cnt_change,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC, visit_day_month, pets_reg_coat_kind) AS cnt_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC, visit_day_month, pets_reg_coat_kind) AS rn
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_all_by_cnt AS (ORDER BY cnt DESC, visit_day_month, pets_reg_coat_kind)
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    pets_reg_coat_kind,
    cnt_rank,
    GROUPING(pets_reg_coat_kind) AS is_total_pets_reg_coat_kind,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM sequenced
GROUP BY CUBE(pets_reg_coat_kind, cnt_rank)
ORDER BY pets_reg_coat_kind NULLS LAST, cnt_rank NULLS LAST

    )
)

w_kennel_size_kennel_size_len_2 = Window.partitionBy("kennel_size", "kennel_size_len").orderBy(F.col("kennel_size_len").desc())
w_kennel_size_len_kennel_size = Window.partitionBy("kennel_size_len", "kennel_size_group")
with_trends = (

        "pet_age_yrs",
        "visit_day",
        "groom_mins_bucket",
        "visit_day_month",
        "kennel_size_ref",
        "kennel_size_group",
        F.lag("groom_mins").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_day_month").orderBy("groom_mins_bucket", "id")).alias("prev_groom_mins"),
        F.lead("pet_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("kennel_size", "kennel_size_len").orderBy(F.col("kennel_size_len").desc(), "id")).alias("next_pet_age_yrs"),
        F.rank().over(w_kennel_size_kennel_size_len_2).alias("kennel_size_len_rank"),
        F.sum("pet_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("kennel_size", "kennel_size_len").orderBy(F.col("kennel_size_len").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)).alias("pet_age_yrs_sum_2"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("pets_reg_id").over(w_kennel_size_len_kennel_size)).alias("distinct_pets_reg_id_in_kennel_size_len_kennel_s"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    with_trends.alias("s")
    .join(df_grooming_jobs.alias("g"), (F.col("g.pets_reg_id") == F.col("s.pets_reg_id")) & (F.array_contains(F.col("g.diet_tags"), "grain_free")) & (F.col("g.kennel_nights") > 15), "left_semi")
)

with_details = (

    .join(df_pets_reg.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.pets_reg_id"), "left")
    .join(df_pet_owners.alias("pe"), F.col("pe.id") == F.col("p.pet_owner_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.pets_reg_id",
        "s.visit_day_month",
        "s.kennel_size_ref",
        "s.prev_groom_mins",
        "s.next_pet_age_yrs",
        "s.kennel_size_len_rank",
        F.col("p.pet_age_yrs").alias("pets_reg_pet_age_yrs"),
        F.col("p.coat_kind").alias("pets_reg_coat_kind"),
        F.col("p.diet_tags").alias("pets_reg_diet_tags"),
        F.col("pe.pet_age_yrs").alias("pet_owner_pet_age_yrs"),
        F.col("pe.groomed_ts").alias("pet_owner_groomed_ts"),
    )
)

summary = (

    )
)

filtered = (

    .filter(F.col("visit_day_month") < F.col("overall_max_visit_day_month"))
    .drop("overall_max_visit_day_month")
)

w_all_by_cnt = Window.orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "visit_day_month", "pets_reg_coat_kind")
sequenced = (

        "pets_reg_coat_kind",
        "cnt",
        "prev_groom_mins_pets_reg_coat_kind_in_curly",

        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "visit_day_month", "pets_reg_coat_kind")).alias("cnt_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "visit_day_month", "pets_reg_coat_kind")).alias("rn"),
    )
)

result = (

WITH filtered_service_tickets AS (
    -- Scope the service_tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at
    FROM service_tickets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per showroom_ref
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM filtered_service_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR drive_started_at > prev_drive_started_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        showroom_ref,
        session_id,
        MIN(drive_started_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(drive_started_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(odometer_km) AS session_odometer_km,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(drive_started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(drive_started_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY showroom_ref, session_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        session_id,
        SUM(session_id) AS total_session_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(SUM(session_id) / NULLIF(SUM(session_odometer_km), 0), 3) AS session_id_to_session_odometer_km_ratio,
        SUM(session_odometer_km) AS total_session_odometer_km,
        COUNT(DISTINCT showroom_ref) AS distinct_showroom_refs,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_min, 0.5) AS median_duration_min
    FROM sessions
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT session_id, metric_name, reading
FROM (
    SELECT session_id, total_session_odometer_km, n_rows
    FROM summary
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (total_session_odometer_km, n_rows)
) unp
ORDER BY session_id, metric_name

WITH valid_service_tickets AS (
    -- Scope the service_tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        is_certified_used,
        CASE WHEN is_certified_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_certified_used_flag,
        MONTH(drive_started_at) AS drive_started_at_month
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE NOT is_certified_used
),
joined AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.fuel_kind,
        s.deal_state,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.is_certified_used_flag,
        s.drive_started_at_month,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail
    FROM valid_service_tickets s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(deal_state) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used)) AS distinct_deal_state_in_is_certified_used,
        LEAD(is_certified_used_flag, 2, 0) OVER w_is_certified_used_flag_by_is AS next2_is_certified_used_flag,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used_flag ORDER BY drive_started_at_month) AS drive_started_at_month_dense_rank,
        odometer_km - LAG(odometer_km) OVER (ORDER BY drive_started_at_month, id) AS odometer_km_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_is_certified_used_flag_by_is AS seq_no,
        NTH_VALUE(odometer_km, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used_flag ORDER BY drive_started_at_month, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_odometer_km,
        SUM(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used) AS is_certified_used_sum_odometer_km,
        ROUND(odometer_km - AVG(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used), 2) AS odometer_km_vs_is_certified_used_avg,
        RANK() OVER w_showroom_ref_by_odometer_km AS odometer_km_rank,
        MIN(is_certified_used_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used) AS is_certified_used_min_is_certified_used_flag,
        ROUND(odometer_km / NULLIF(SUM(odometer_km) OVER w_is_certified_used, 0), 4) AS odometer_km_share_of_is_certified_used,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_showroom_ref_by_odometer_km AS odometer_km_dense_rank,
        ROUND(is_certified_used_flag - AVG(is_certified_used_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used), 2) AS is_certified_used_flag_vs_is_certified_used_avg,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_is_certified_used_flag_by_is_2 AS is_certified_used_flag_dense_rank
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_is_certified_used_flag_by_is AS (PARTITION BY is_certified_used_flag ORDER BY is_certified_used_flag ASC, id), w_showroom_ref_by_odometer_km AS (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY odometer_km ASC NULLS LAST), w_is_certified_used AS (PARTITION BY is_certified_used), w_is_certified_used_flag_by_is_2 AS (PARTITION BY is_certified_used_flag ORDER BY is_certified_used_flag ASC)
),
top_rows AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        is_certified_used,
        is_certified_used_flag,
        drive_started_at_month,

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter vet_visits
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        groom_mins,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day
    FROM vet_visits
    WHERE pets_reg_id <= 30
      AND pet_age_yrs < 13
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    WHERE pet_age_yrs > (SELECT AVG(pet_age_yrs) FROM valid)
)
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    COALESCE(kennel_size, 'ALL') AS kennel_size,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    SUM(pet_age_yrs) AS total_pet_age_yrs,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM screened
GROUP BY CUBE(pets_reg_id, kennel_size)
ORDER BY pets_reg_id NULLS LAST, kennel_size NULLS LAST

WITH cleaned_payload_items AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        frame_seq,
        COALESCE(frame_seq, 0) AS frame_seq_filled
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE frame_seq >= 4045
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(frame_seq_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_frame_seq_filled_so_far,
        MAX(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id) AS mission_id_max_frame_seq,
        ROUND(AVG(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS frame_seq_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_filled), 3) AS frame_seq_filled_percent_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_state) OVER w_mission_id) AS distinct_mission_state_in_mission_id,
        ROUND(frame_seq_filled / NULLIF(SUM(frame_seq_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 0), 4) AS frame_seq_filled_share_of_mission_id
    FROM cleaned_payload_items
    WINDOW w_mission_id AS (PARTITION BY mission_id)
),
mission_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg frame_seq per mission_id
    SELECT mission_id, AVG(frame_seq) AS avg_frame_seq
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_frame_seq,
        ROUND(s.frame_seq - g.avg_frame_seq, 2) AS frame_seq_minus_avg
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN mission_id_stats g ON g.mission_id = s.mission_id
    WHERE s.frame_seq > g.avg_frame_seq
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    mission_state,
    site_country,
    frame_seq,
    frame_seq_filled,
    max_frame_seq_filled_so_far,
    mission_id_max_frame_seq,
    frame_seq_avg_6_prior,
    frame_seq_filled_percent_rank,
    distinct_mission_state_in_mission_id,
    frame_seq_filled_share_of_mission_id,
    avg_frame_seq,
    frame_seq_minus_avg
FROM compared
WHERE distinct_mission_state_in_mission_id <= 7
ORDER BY frame_seq_minus_avg DESC
