WITH applied_by_campaigns_ch_ref AS (
    -- applied rows per campaigns_ch_ref
    SELECT campaigns_ch_ref, COUNT(*) AS applied_count, ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs), 2) AS applied_avg_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'applied'
    GROUP BY campaigns_ch_ref
),
reported_by_campaigns_ch_ref AS (
    -- reported rows per campaigns_ch_ref
    SELECT campaigns_ch_ref, COUNT(*) AS reported_count, SUM(volunteer_hrs) AS reported_total_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'reported'
    GROUP BY campaigns_ch_ref
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.campaigns_ch_ref, b.campaigns_ch_ref) AS campaigns_ch_ref,
    COALESCE(a.applied_count, 0) AS applied_count,
    COALESCE(a.applied_avg_volunteer_hrs, 0) AS applied_avg_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(b.reported_count, 0) AS reported_count,
    COALESCE(b.reported_total_volunteer_hrs, 0) AS reported_total_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(a.applied_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.reported_count, 0) AS applied_count_minus_reported_count
FROM applied_by_campaigns_ch_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN reported_by_campaigns_ch_ref b
  ON a.campaigns_ch_ref = b.campaigns_ch_ref
ORDER BY campaigns_ch_ref

WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        GREATEST(payload_kg, frame_seq) AS greatest_payload_kg_frame_seq,
        DATE_ADD(launched_on, 365) AS launched_on_plus_365d,
        payload_kg + frame_seq AS payload_kg_plus_frame_seq
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE mission_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_parent_mission AS (
    -- Join missions
    SELECT s.*, m.burn_secs AS mission_burn_secs
    FROM recent s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching telemetry_frames
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_parent_mission s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM telemetry_frames t
            WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND t.burn_secs > 276
        )
      AND s.mission_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        launched_on,
        launched_on_plus_365d,
        payload_kg_plus_frame_seq,
        mission_burn_secs,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_mission_state AS rows_in_mission_state,
        ROUND(payload_kg / NULLIF(SUM(payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state), 0), 4) AS payload_kg_share_of_mission_state,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY mission_burn_secs ASC NULLS LAST), 3) AS mission_burn_secs_cume_dist,
        MAX(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state) AS mission_state_max_frame_seq,
        MAX(payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state) AS mission_state_max_payload_kg,
        ROUND(mission_burn_secs / NULLIF(SUM(mission_burn_secs) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state), 0), 4) AS mission_burn_secs_share_of_mission_state
    FROM screened
    WINDOW w_mission_state AS (PARTITION BY mission_state)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        launched_on,
        launched_on_plus_365d,
        payload_kg_plus_frame_seq,
        mission_burn_secs,
        rows_in_mission_state,

),

    SELECT

        s.mission_state,

        t.frame_at AS telemetry_frame_frame_at,
        t.payload_kind AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
        t.mission_name AS telemetry_frame_mission_name
    FROM base_telemetry_frames s
    JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep rows whose mission matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM exploded_detail s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM missions m
            WHERE m.id = s.mission_id
              AND YEAR(m.launched_on) = 2025
        )
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(frame_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS frame_at_label,
        COALESCE(payload_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS payload_kind_or_unknown
    FROM filtered
)

FROM (

    FROM tagged
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(burn_secs)
    FOR telemetry_frame_mission_state IN ('planned', 'success')
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter grooming_jobs
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        groomed_at,
        CASE WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 14 THEN 'large' WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 7 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS pet_age_yrs_tier
    FROM grooming_jobs
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_at per pet_age_yrs_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_age_yrs_tier ORDER BY groomed_at, id) AS prev_groomed_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_at IS NULL OR groomed_at > prev_groomed_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_age_yrs_tier ORDER BY groomed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        pet_age_yrs_tier,
        session_id,
        MIN(groomed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY pet_age_yrs_tier, session_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE event_count > (SELECT AVG(event_count) FROM session_summary)
)
SELECT
    pet_age_yrs_tier,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    duration_min
FROM without_matches
WHERE session_id < 6
ORDER BY duration_min DESC NULLS FIRST, session_start NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .select(

        "kennel_size",

        "kennel_nights",

        F.when(F.col("pet_age_yrs") >= 14, "large").when(F.col("pet_age_yrs") >= 7, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("pet_age_yrs_tier"),
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_groomed_at", F.lag("groomed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("pet_age_yrs_tier").orderBy("groomed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_at").isNull() | (F.col("groomed_at") > F.col("prev_groomed_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("pet_age_yrs_tier").orderBy("groomed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("pet_age_yrs_tier", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("groomed_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("groomed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("groomed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("groomed_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    session_summary
    .crossJoin(session_summary.agg(F.avg("event_count").alias("overall_avg_event_count")))
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > F.col("overall_avg_event_count"))
    .drop("overall_avg_event_count")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .filter(F.col("session_id") < 6)
    .select(
        "pet_age_yrs_tier",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("duration_min").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("session_start").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the grant_awards rows
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        CASE WHEN grant_stage IN ('reported', 'applied') THEN 'group_a' WHEN grant_stage = 'awarded' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS grant_stage_group
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE pledged_on < DATE '2025-07-29'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage_group) AS donor_segment_grant_stage_group_min_volunteer_hr,
        ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage_group, grant_stage ORDER BY pledged_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS volunteer_hrs_avg_3,
        ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_donor_segment, 2) AS donor_segment_avg_volunteer_hrs,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs / NULLIF(SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_donor_segment, 0), 4) AS volunteer_hrs_share_of_donor_segment,
        SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage_group) AS donor_segment_grant_stage_group_sum_volunteer_hr,
        LAST_VALUE(pledged_on) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on), grant_stage_group ORDER BY volunteer_hrs ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_pledged_on,
        MAX(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment) AS donor_segment_max_volunteer_hrs,
        LAST_VALUE(pledged_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage_group, grant_stage ORDER BY pledged_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_pledged_on
    FROM prepared
    WINDOW w_donor_segment AS (PARTITION BY donor_segment)
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        volunteer_hrs_avg_3 - volunteer_hrs AS volunteer_hrs_avg_3_minus_volunteer_hrs,
        FLOOR(volunteer_hrs_avg_3 / 2) * 2 AS volunteer_hrs_avg_3_bucket,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs * 1.1, 2) AS volunteer_hrs_adj
    FROM with_windows
),
per_group AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        volunteer_hrs_avg_3_bucket,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        MAX(last_pledged_on) AS last_last_pledged_on,
        MAX(donor_segment_grant_stage_group_sum_volunteer_hr) AS max_donor_segment_grant_stage_group_sum_voluntee
    FROM derived
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    volunteer_hrs_avg_3_bucket,
    campaigns_ch_ref,
    grant_stage,
    max_donor_segment_grant_stage_group_sum_voluntee,
    LAST_DAY(last_last_pledged_on) AS last_last_pledged_on_month_end
FROM per_group
WHERE last_last_pledged_on < DATE '2025-08-21'
ORDER BY volunteer_hrs_avg_3_bucket DESC, last_last_pledged_on_month_end

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_id,
        term_months,
        arrived_date,
        vin_tail,
        CASE WHEN term_months >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN term_months >= 42 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS term_months_tier,
        COALESCE(term_months, 0) AS term_months_filled
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE vin_tail IS NOT NULL
      AND arrived_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-26' AND DATE '2025-11-03'
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching finance_deals
    SELECT s.*
    FROM prepared s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM finance_deals f
            WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.id
              AND f.deal_status = 'signed'
              AND f.arrived_on IS NOT NULL
        )
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_id,
        term_months,
        arrived_date,
        vin_tail,
        CASE WHEN term_months >= 61 THEN 'large' WHEN term_months >= 42 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS term_months_tier_2,
        CONCAT_WS('-', term_months_tier, vin_tail) AS term_months_tier_vin_tail_label,
        DATE_ADD(arrived_date, 7) AS arrived_date_plus_7d
    FROM with_activity
),
term_months_tier_2_stats AS (
    -- Median term_months per term_months_tier_2
    SELECT term_months_tier_2, PERCENTILE_APPROX(term_months, 0.5) AS median_term_months
    FROM tagged
    GROUP BY term_months_tier_2
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_term_months,
        ROUND(s.term_months - g.median_term_months, 2) AS term_months_minus_median
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN term_months_tier_2_stats g ON g.term_months_tier_2 = s.term_months_tier_2
    WHERE s.term_months >= g.median_term_months
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    arrived_date,
    term_months_tier_2,
    arrived_date_plus_7d,
    median_term_months,
    term_months_minus_median,
    TRUNC(arrived_date, 'MM') AS arrived_date_month_start
FROM above_average
ORDER BY term_months_minus_median, id NULLS LAST

WITH checkup_by_pets_reg AS (
    -- checkup rows per pets_reg_id
    SELECT pets_reg_id, COUNT(*) AS checkup_count, SUM(pet_weight_kg) AS checkup_total_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'checkup'
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
),
injury_by_pets_reg AS (
    -- injury rows per pets_reg_id
    SELECT pets_reg_id, COUNT(*) AS injury_count, SUM(pet_weight_kg) AS injury_total_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'injury'
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.pets_reg_id, b.pets_reg_id) AS pets_reg_id,
    COALESCE(a.checkup_count, 0) AS checkup_count,
    a.checkup_total_pet_weight_kg,
    COALESCE(b.injury_count, 0) AS injury_count,
    COALESCE(b.injury_total_pet_weight_kg, 0) AS injury_total_pet_weight_kg,
    COALESCE(a.checkup_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.injury_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM checkup_by_pets_reg a
FULL OUTER JOIN injury_by_pets_reg b
  ON a.pets_reg_id = b.pets_reg_id
ORDER BY pets_reg_id

WITH scoped_water_meters AS (
    -- Scope the water_meters rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        DATE_FORMAT(meter_fitted_on, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS meter_fitted_on_label
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE pump_station_id >= 11
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on_label,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id ORDER BY chlorine_ppm NULLS LAST, id) AS chlorine_ppm_quartile,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_fitted_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY meter_age_yrs NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_meter_fitted_on
    FROM scoped_water_meters
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching usage_reads
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_trends s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM usage_reads u
            WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.id
              AND u.tariff_band = 'shop'
              AND u.usage_m3 <= 47.9
        )
      AND s.meter_fitted_on_label IS NOT NULL
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching usage_reads
    SELECT s.*
    FROM without_matches s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM usage_reads u
            WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.id
              AND u.station_tier IN ('reserve', 'booster')
              AND u.chlorine_ppm > 1.8
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows that have matching usage_reads
    SELECT s.*
    FROM screened s
    WHERE s.id IN (
            SELECT u.water_meter_id
            FROM usage_reads u
            WHERE u.meter_fitted_date IS NOT NULL
        )
      AND s.meter_fitted_on_label IS NOT NULL
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        meter_kind,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on_label,
        chlorine_ppm_quartile,
        first_known_meter_fitted_on,
        CASE WHEN meter_age_yrs >= 27 THEN 'large' WHEN meter_age_yrs >= 12 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS meter_age_yrs_tier,
        CASE WHEN meter_kind IN ('smart', 'ultrasonic') THEN 'group_a' WHEN meter_kind = 'analog' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS meter_kind_group
    FROM filtered
    WHERE meter_fitted_on_label IS NOT NULL
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    meter_kind,
    chlorine_ppm_quartile,
    first_known_meter_fitted_on,
    meter_age_yrs_tier,
    meter_kind_group,
    LENGTH(TRIM(meter_age_yrs_tier)) AS meter_age_yrs_tier_len,
    CASE WHEN chlorine_ppm_quartile >= 6 THEN 'A' WHEN chlorine_ppm_quartile >= 4 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS chlorine_ppm_quartile_tier
FROM tagged
ORDER BY meter_age_yrs_tier_len DESC

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped
    FROM kennels
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per visit_reason
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_ts)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    is_microchipped,
    visit_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY ROLLUP(is_microchipped, visit_reason)

    df_kennels
    .select(
        "id",
        "visit_reason",

        "groomed_ts",
        "is_microchipped",
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_groomed_ts", F.lag("groomed_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_reason").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_ts").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("groomed_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_groomed_ts")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_reason").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessionized
    .rollup("is_microchipped", "visit_reason")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("n_rows"))

WITH scoped_payload_items AS (
    -- Filter payload_items
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE YEAR(launched_on) = 2025
      AND site_country IS NOT NULL
),
with_parent_mission AS (
    -- Join missions
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.payload_kg,
        s.launched_on,
        m.rocket_id AS mission_rocket_id
    FROM scoped_payload_items s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id AND m.is_reusable = TRUE
    WHERE m.rocket_id IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on ASC), 3) AS launched_on_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY payload_kg DESC, id), 3) AS payload_kg_cume_dist,
        ROUND(AVG(payload_kg) OVER w_mission_state, 2) AS mission_state_avg_payload_kg,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC) AS launched_on_dense_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id) AS rn,
        LAG(payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC, id) AS prev_payload_kg,
        ROUND(payload_kg - AVG(payload_kg) OVER w_mission_state, 2) AS payload_kg_vs_mission_state_avg,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on ASC) AS launched_on_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC), 3) AS launched_on_cume_dist,
        NTH_VALUE(launched_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY payload_kg DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_launched_on,
        LAST_VALUE(payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_payload_kg,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_mission_rocket_id_mission_id, 3) AS launched_on_cume_dist_2,
        FIRST_VALUE(launched_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_launched_on
    FROM with_parent_mission
    WINDOW w_mission_state AS (PARTITION BY mission_state), w_mission_rocket_id_mission_id AS (PARTITION BY mission_rocket_id, mission_id ORDER BY launched_on ASC)
)
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    mission_state,
    payload_kg,
    launched_on,
    mission_rocket_id,
    launched_on_percent_rank,
    payload_kg_cume_dist,
    launched_on_dense_rank,
    rn,
    prev_payload_kg,
    payload_kg_vs_mission_state_avg,
    launched_on_rank,
    launched_on_cume_dist,
    second_launched_on,
    last_payload_kg,
    first_known_launched_on,
    payload_kg + last_payload_kg AS payload_kg_plus_last_payload_kg
FROM windowed
ORDER BY mission_id DESC, id
LIMIT 10

        "s.payload_kg",

        F.col("m.rocket_id").alias("mission_rocket_id"),

)

        F.round(F.col("payload_kg") - F.avg("payload_kg").over(w_mission_state), 2).alias("payload_kg_vs_mission_state_avg"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("mission_rocket_id", "mission_id").orderBy("launched_on")).alias("launched_on_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("mission_rocket_id", "mission_id").orderBy(F.col("launched_on").desc())), 3).alias("launched_on_cume_dist"),
        F.nth_value("launched_on", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id").orderBy(F.col("payload_kg").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_launched_on"),
        F.last("payload_kg").over(Window.partitionBy("mission_rocket_id", "mission_id").orderBy(F.col("launched_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_payload_kg"),

WITH prepared_pledges AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date
    FROM pledges
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        CASE WHEN pledge_amount >= 41673.6 THEN 'large' WHEN pledge_amount >= 14673.7 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS pledge_amount_tier,
        LOWER(TRIM(cause_area)) AS cause_area_clean,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(cause_area), ' ', '_')) AS cause_area_slug
    FROM prepared_pledges
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach donor attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.awarded_date,
        s.pledge_amount_tier,
        s.cause_area_clean,
        s.cause_area_slug,
        d.donor_age,
        d.gift_cnt AS donor_gift_cnt
    FROM scored s
    JOIN donors d ON d.id = s.donor_ref
)
SELECT
    pledge_amount_tier,
    donor_ref,
    GROUPING(pledge_amount_tier) AS is_total_pledge_amount_tier,
    DATEDIFF(MAX(awarded_date), MIN(awarded_date)) AS awarded_date_span_days,
    SUM(donor_gift_cnt) AS total_donor_gift_cnt
FROM joined
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((pledge_amount_tier, donor_ref), (pledge_amount_tier))
ORDER BY pledge_amount_tier NULLS LAST, donor_ref NULLS LAST

WITH base_test_drives AS (
    -- Scope the test_drives rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        CASE WHEN drive_outcome IN ('declined', 'thinking') THEN 'group_a' WHEN drive_outcome = 'bought' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS drive_outcome_group,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(vin_tail), ' ', '_')) AS vin_tail_slug,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(deal_status), ' ', '_')) AS deal_status_slug
    FROM test_drives
),
enriched_car_stock AS (
    -- Join car_stock
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.drive_outcome,
        s.arrived_on,
        s.is_fleet,
        s.drive_outcome_group,
        s.vin_tail_slug,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months
    FROM base_test_drives s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        arrived_on,
        is_fleet,
        drive_outcome_group,
        vin_tail_slug,
        car_stock_arrived_date,
        ABS(car_stock_term_months - 45) AS car_stock_term_months_distance
    FROM enriched_car_stock
),
enriched_car_stock_2 AS (
    -- Join car_stock
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.drive_outcome,
        s.arrived_on,
        s.is_fleet,
        s.drive_outcome_group,
        s.vin_tail_slug,
        s.car_stock_arrived_date,
        s.car_stock_term_months_distance,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months
    FROM scored s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        drive_outcome,
        MAX(car_stock_term_months_distance) AS max_car_stock_term_months_distance,
        COUNT(DISTINCT car_stock_body_style) AS distinct_car_stock_body_styles,
        MAX(car_stock_term_months) AS max_car_stock_term_months
    FROM enriched_car_stock_2
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    drive_outcome,
    max_car_stock_term_months_distance,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(drive_outcome), ' ', '_')) AS drive_outcome_slug,
    CASE WHEN drive_outcome IN ('thinking', 'bought') THEN 'group_a' WHEN drive_outcome = 'declined' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS drive_outcome_group
FROM per_group
WHERE max_car_stock_term_months >= 26
ORDER BY drive_outcome

WITH awarded_monthly AS (
    -- awarded rows per pledged_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) AS pledged_on_month, COUNT(*) AS awarded_count, SUM(volunteer_hrs) AS awarded_total_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'awarded'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on)
),
applied_monthly AS (
    -- applied rows per pledged_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) AS pledged_on_month, COUNT(*) AS applied_count, ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs), 2) AS applied_avg_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE grant_stage = 'applied'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.pledged_on_month, b.pledged_on_month) AS pledged_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.awarded_count, 0) AS awarded_count,
    a.awarded_total_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(b.applied_count, 0) AS applied_count,
    COALESCE(b.applied_avg_volunteer_hrs, 0) AS applied_avg_volunteer_hrs,
    COALESCE(a.awarded_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.applied_count, 0) AS awarded_count_minus_applied_count
FROM awarded_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN applied_monthly b
  ON a.pledged_on_month = b.pledged_on_month
ORDER BY pledged_on_month

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("awarded_count"),
        F.sum("volunteer_hrs").alias("awarded_total_volunteer_hrs"),
    )

applied_monthly = (

        F.round(F.avg("volunteer_hrs"), 2).alias("applied_avg_volunteer_hrs"),
    )

    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.pledged_on_month"), F.col("b.pledged_on_month")).alias("pledged_on_month"),

        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.awarded_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.applied_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("awarded_count_minus_applied_count"),
    )

WITH valid_missions AS (
    -- Filter missions
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', launched_on) AS launched_on_month,
        FLOOR(burn_secs / 100) * 100 AS burn_secs_bucket,
        ROUND(burn_secs / NULLIF(apogee_km, 0), 3) AS burn_secs_per_apogee_km
    FROM missions
    WHERE apogee_km >= 15555.2
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.id) AS telemetry_frame_count
    FROM valid_missions s
),
windowed AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_state,
        launched_on,
        launched_on_month,
        burn_secs_bucket,
        burn_secs_per_apogee_km,
        telemetry_frame_count,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(rocket_id) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state)) AS distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_burn_secs_per_apogee, 3) AS burn_secs_per_apogee_km_percent_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(telemetry_frame_count) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state), 2) AS mission_state_avg_telemetry_frame_count
    FROM profiled
    WINDOW w_all_by_burn_secs_per_apogee AS (ORDER BY burn_secs_per_apogee_km, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_state,
        launched_on_month,
        burn_secs_bucket,
        burn_secs_per_apogee_km,
        telemetry_frame_count,
        distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state,
        burn_secs_per_apogee_km_percent_rank,
        mission_state_avg_telemetry_frame_count,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY burn_secs_per_apogee_km DESC, id) AS burn_secs_per_apogee_km_tercile,
        MAX(telemetry_frame_count) OVER (PARTITION BY distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state ORDER BY distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS telemetry_frame_count_max_4
    FROM windowed
),
line_level_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- One row per telemetry_frame
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.burn_secs_bucket,
        s.burn_secs_per_apogee_km,
        s.telemetry_frame_count,
        s.distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state,
        s.burn_secs_per_apogee_km_percent_rank,
        s.mission_state_avg_telemetry_frame_count,
        t.id AS telemetry_frame_id,
        t.mission_name AS telemetry_frame_mission_name,
        t.frame_seq AS telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        t.payload_kind AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind,
        t.frame_at AS telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN telemetry_frames t ON t.mission_id = s.id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(telemetry_frame_frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY telemetry_frame_count), 2) AS telemetry_frame_count_avg_telemetry_frame_frame_,
        ROUND(AVG(telemetry_frame_frame_seq) OVER (ORDER BY burn_secs_bucket DESC, id, telemetry_frame_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS telemetry_frame_frame_seq_avg_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY telemetry_frame_frame_at ASC) AS telemetry_frame_frame_at_rank,
        LAG(telemetry_frame_frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY telemetry_frame_frame_at ASC, id, telemetry_frame_id) AS prev_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM line_level_telemetry_frames
)
SELECT
    id,
    mission_state,
    burn_secs_per_apogee_km,

    SELECT

        MIN(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, visit_reason ORDER BY kennel_nights, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_pet_age_yrs_so_far
    FROM prepared_grooming_jobs
    WINDOW w_pets_reg_id AS (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id)
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        UPPER(TRIM(mission_name)) AS mission_name_clean
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE burn_secs BETWEEN 137 AND 574
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per mission_id
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR frame_at > prev_frame_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(frame_seq) AS session_frame_seq,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY mission_id, session_id
),
screened AS (
    -- Keep rows whose mission matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM session_summary s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM missions m
            WHERE m.id = s.mission_id
              AND m.burn_secs BETWEEN 313 AND 512
              AND m.launched_on >= DATE '2024-05-23'
        )
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    mission_id,
    session_start,
    events,
    session_frame_seq,
    duration_min
FROM screened
WHERE session_id <= 6
ORDER BY events DESC

WITH recent AS (
    -- Scope the pledges rows
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', awarded_date) AS days_since_awarded_date,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(cause_area), 1, 4) AS cause_area_prefix
    FROM pledges
    WHERE pledge_amount > 13692.2
      AND cause_area = 'education'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        cause_area_prefix,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_all_by_pledge_amount AS pledge_amount_quartile,
        ROUND(AVG(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref ORDER BY days_since_awarded_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS pledge_amount_avg_1_prior,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area) AS rows_in_cause_area
    FROM recent
    WINDOW w_all_by_pledge_amount AS (ORDER BY pledge_amount ASC, id)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per cause_area
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        cause_area_prefix,
        pledge_amount_quartile,
        pledge_amount_avg_1_prior,
        rows_in_cause_area
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY pledge_amount_avg_1_prior DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM windowed
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    pledge_amount_quartile,
    cause_area,
    GROUPING(pledge_amount_quartile) AS is_total_pledge_amount_quartile,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(cause_area)) AS cause_area_list
FROM deduped
GROUP BY ROLLUP(pledge_amount_quartile, cause_area)
ORDER BY pledge_amount_quartile NULLS LAST, cause_area NULLS LAST

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_country, row_count ORDER BY total_thrust_kn ASC), 3) AS total_thrust_kn_percent_rank,

WITH declined_monthly AS (
    -- declined rows per arrived_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_month, COUNT(*) AS declined_count, ROUND(AVG(drive_mins), 2) AS declined_avg_drive_mins
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_outcome = 'declined'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on)
),
thinking_monthly AS (
    -- thinking rows per arrived_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_month, COUNT(*) AS thinking_count, ROUND(AVG(drive_mins), 2) AS thinking_avg_drive_mins
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_outcome = 'thinking'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.arrived_on_month, b.arrived_on_month) AS arrived_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.declined_count, 0) AS declined_count,
    COALESCE(a.declined_avg_drive_mins, 0) AS declined_avg_drive_mins,
    COALESCE(b.thinking_count, 0) AS thinking_count,
    b.thinking_avg_drive_mins,
    COALESCE(a.declined_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.thinking_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM declined_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN thinking_monthly b
  ON a.arrived_on_month = b.arrived_on_month
ORDER BY arrived_on_month

declined_monthly = (
    df_test_drives
    .filter(F.col("drive_outcome") == "declined")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on").alias("arrived_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("declined_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("drive_mins"), 2).alias("declined_avg_drive_mins"),
    )
)

thinking_monthly = (
    df_test_drives
    .filter(F.col("drive_outcome") == "thinking")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on").alias("arrived_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("thinking_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("drive_mins"), 2).alias("thinking_avg_drive_mins"),
    )
)

result = (
    declined_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(thinking_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.arrived_on_month") == F.col("b.arrived_on_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.arrived_on_month"), F.col("b.arrived_on_month")).alias("arrived_on_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.declined_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("declined_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.declined_avg_drive_mins"), F.lit(0)).alias("declined_avg_drive_mins"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.thinking_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("thinking_count"),
        F.col("b.thinking_avg_drive_mins"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.declined_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.thinking_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("arrived_on_month")
)

WITH prepared_service_tickets AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        CASE WHEN odometer_km >= 126685 THEN 'large' WHEN odometer_km >= 81562 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS odometer_km_tier,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', drive_started_at) AS days_since_drive_started_at
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE fuel_kind <> 'hybrid'
      AND showroom_ref IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows that have matching service_tickets
    SELECT s.*
    FROM prepared_service_tickets s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM service_tickets se
            WHERE se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref
        )
),
filtered_2 AS (
    -- Rows that have matching service_tickets
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM service_tickets se
            WHERE se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref
              AND se.deal_state IN ('signed', 'funded')
        )
),
joined_showroom AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.fuel_kind,
        s.deal_state,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.days_since_drive_started_at,
        sh.odometer_km AS showroom_odometer_km,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        sh.drive_minutes AS showroom_drive_minutes
    FROM filtered_2 s
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref AND sh.vin_tail IS NOT NULL
),
joined_showroom_2 AS (

        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.deal_state,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.days_since_drive_started_at,
        s.showroom_odometer_km,
        s.showroom_vin_tail,
        s.showroom_drive_minutes,
        sh.drive_minutes AS showroom_drive_minutes_2,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail_2
    FROM joined_showroom s

),
qualified AS (

    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined_showroom_2 s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM car_stock c
            WHERE c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref
              AND c.body_style = 'sedan'

FROM (

) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR field IN (showroom_drive_minutes, showroom_drive_minutes_2, days_since_drive_started_at, showroom_odometer_km)
) unp
ORDER BY id, field

    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_id,
        term_months,
        arrived_date,
        vin_tail
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE body_style <> 'hatch'
      AND arrived_date < DATE '2025-07-15'
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_id,
        s.term_months,
        s.arrived_date,
        s.vin_tail,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        sh.odometer_km AS showroom_odometer_km,
        sh.option_tags AS showroom_option_tags
    FROM prepared_car_stocks s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        term_months,
        vin_tail,
        showroom_vin_tail,
        showroom_option_tags,
        ROUND(AVG(term_months) OVER w_arrived_date_year, 2) AS arrived_date_year_avg_term_months,
        term_months - LAG(term_months) OVER w_showroom_id_by_arrived_date AS term_months_change
    FROM combined_details
    WINDOW w_arrived_date_year AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_date)), w_showroom_id_by_arrived_date AS (PARTITION BY showroom_id ORDER BY arrived_date, id)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        term_months,
        arrived_date_year_avg_term_months,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY term_months DESC, id) AS term_months_quartile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_term_months_change AS term_months_change_seq
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_all_by_term_months_change AS (ORDER BY term_months_change ASC, id)
)
SELECT id, term_months, term_months_change_seq
FROM windowed
WHERE arrived_date_year_avg_term_months BETWEEN 30.0 AND 69.6
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_at,
        mission_name
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE mission_name IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per mission_id
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR frame_at > prev_frame_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_state,
    payload_kind,
    frame_at,
    prev_frame_at,
    DAYOFWEEK(frame_at) AS frame_at_dayofweek,
    LOWER(TRIM(payload_kind)) AS payload_kind_clean
FROM sessionized
ORDER BY frame_at_dayofweek NULLS LAST, prev_frame_at DESC

)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id").orderBy("frame_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        CASE WHEN meter_kind IN ('smart', 'ultrasonic') THEN 'group_a' WHEN meter_kind = 'analog' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS meter_kind_group,
        COALESCE(meter_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS meter_kind_or_unknown

    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.chlorine_ppm,
        s.meter_fitted_on,
        s.meter_kind_group,
        p.street_ref AS pump_station_street_ref
    FROM cleaned s

),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id) AS meter_kind_pump_station_id_min_chlorine_ppm,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind_group ORDER BY meter_fitted_on NULLS LAST, id) AS seq_no,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(pump_station_id) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind_group)) AS distinct_pump_station_id_in_meter_kind_group,
        NTH_VALUE(chlorine_ppm, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, YEAR(meter_fitted_on) ORDER BY meter_fitted_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_chlorine_ppm,
        LAG(chlorine_ppm, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id) AS prev_chlorine_ppm,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind_group ORDER BY meter_fitted_on NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_meter_fitted_on,
        LAST_VALUE(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_chlorine_ppm,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, YEAR(meter_fitted_on) ORDER BY meter_fitted_on, id), 3) AS meter_fitted_on_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id) AS rows_in_meter_kind_pump_station_id,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id) AS meter_fitted_on_quintile,
        RANK() OVER w_meter_kind_by_meter_fitted_o AS meter_fitted_on_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind_group ORDER BY meter_fitted_on NULLS LAST, id) AS meter_fitted_on_dense_rank
    FROM with_parent_pump_station
    WINDOW w_meter_kind_by_meter_fitted_o AS (PARTITION BY meter_kind ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id)
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        GREATEST(seq_no, meter_fitted_on_rank) AS greatest_seq_no_meter_fitted_on_rank,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', meter_kind_group, meter_kind) AS meter_kind_group_meter_kind_label,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(pump_station_street_ref), 1, 2) AS pump_station_street_ref_prefix
    FROM metrics
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    pump_station_id,
    chlorine_ppm,
    meter_fitted_on,
    meter_kind_group,
    pump_station_street_ref,
    meter_kind_pump_station_id_min_chlorine_ppm,
    seq_no,
    second_chlorine_ppm,
    prev_chlorine_ppm,
    first_meter_fitted_on,
    last_chlorine_ppm,
    meter_fitted_on_cume_dist,
    rows_in_meter_kind_pump_station_id,
    meter_fitted_on_quintile,
    meter_fitted_on_dense_rank,
    greatest_seq_no_meter_fitted_on_rank,
    meter_kind_group_meter_kind_label,
    pump_station_street_ref_prefix,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(meter_kind), 1, 2) AS meter_kind_prefix
FROM derived
WHERE second_chlorine_ppm BETWEEN 0.4 AND 2.5
ORDER BY last_chlorine_ppm, chlorine_ppm DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', deal_state, fuel_kind) AS deal_state_fuel_kind_label
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE (HOUR(drive_started_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 14 OR deal_state IN ('quoted', 'signed'))
),
deal_state_stats AS (
    -- Median odometer_km per deal_state
    SELECT deal_state, PERCENTILE_APPROX(odometer_km, 0.5) AS median_odometer_km
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY deal_state
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_odometer_km,
        ROUND(s.odometer_km - g.median_odometer_km, 2) AS odometer_km_minus_median
    FROM valid s
    JOIN deal_state_stats g ON g.deal_state = s.deal_state
    WHERE s.odometer_km >= g.median_odometer_km
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    COALESCE(deal_state, 'ALL') AS deal_state,
    showroom_ref,
    is_certified_used,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deal_state IN ('signed', 'quoted')) AS n_deal_state_in_signed_quoted,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_certified_used = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_is_certified_used_false,
    ROUND(STDDEV(median_odometer_km), 2) AS stddev_median_odometer_km
FROM compared
GROUP BY CUBE(deal_state, showroom_ref, is_certified_used)
ORDER BY deal_state NULLS LAST, showroom_ref NULLS LAST, is_certified_used NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid = (
    df_service_tickets
    .filter((F.hour(F.col("drive_started_at")).between(9, 14)) | (F.col("deal_state").isin("quoted", "signed")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "showroom_ref",
        "deal_state",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_certified_used",
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("deal_state"), F.col("fuel_kind")).alias("deal_state_fuel_kind_label"),
    )
)

deal_state_stats = (
    valid
    .groupBy("deal_state")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("odometer_km", 0.5).alias("median_odometer_km"))
)

compared = (
    valid.alias("s")
    .join(deal_state_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.deal_state") == F.col("s.deal_state"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.odometer_km") >= F.col("g.median_odometer_km"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_odometer_km",
        F.round(F.col("s.odometer_km") - F.col("g.median_odometer_km"), 2).alias("odometer_km_minus_median"),
    )
)

result = (
    compared
    .cube("deal_state", "showroom_ref", "is_certified_used")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("deal_state").isin("signed", "quoted"), 1)).alias("n_deal_state_in_signed_quoted"),
        F.sum(F.when(~F.col("is_certified_used"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_is_certified_used_false"),
        F.round(F.stddev("median_odometer_km"), 2).alias("stddev_median_odometer_km"),
    )
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("deal_state"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("deal_state"),
        "showroom_ref",
        "is_certified_used",
        "n_deal_state_in_signed_quoted",
        "n_is_certified_used_false",
        "stddev_median_odometer_km",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("deal_state").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("showroom_ref").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("is_certified_used").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH checkup_by_pets_reg AS (
    -- checkup rows per pets_reg_id
    SELECT pets_reg_id, COUNT(*) AS checkup_count, ROUND(AVG(pet_weight_kg), 2) AS checkup_avg_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'checkup'
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
),
dental_by_pets_reg AS (
    -- dental rows per pets_reg_id
    SELECT pets_reg_id, COUNT(*) AS dental_count, SUM(pet_weight_kg) AS dental_total_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'dental'
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.pets_reg_id, b.pets_reg_id) AS pets_reg_id,
    COALESCE(a.checkup_count, 0) AS checkup_count,
    a.checkup_avg_pet_weight_kg,
    COALESCE(b.dental_count, 0) AS dental_count,
    COALESCE(b.dental_total_pet_weight_kg, 0) AS dental_total_pet_weight_kg,
    COALESCE(a.checkup_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.dental_count, 0) AS checkup_count_minus_dental_count
FROM checkup_by_pets_reg a
FULL OUTER JOIN dental_by_pets_reg b
  ON a.pets_reg_id = b.pets_reg_id
ORDER BY pets_reg_id

dental_by_pets_reg = (

    .select(

WITH recent_finance_deals AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        LENGTH(TRIM(vin_tail)) AS vin_tail_len
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE arrived_on < DATE '2025-02-10'
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per car_stock_id
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        vin_tail_len
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM recent_finance_deals
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
with_details_car_stock AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.is_certified_used,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id
    FROM latest_per_key s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS drive_mins_sum_1_prior,
        car_stock_term_months - LAG(car_stock_term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_showroom_id ORDER BY car_stock_arrived_date ASC, id) AS car_stock_term_months_change,
        LEAD(car_stock_arrived_date) OVER w_is_certified_used_by_drive_m AS next_car_stock_arrived_date,
        SUM(car_stock_term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_showroom_id, deal_status) AS car_stock_showroom_id_deal_status_sum_car_stock_
    FROM with_details_car_stock
    WINDOW w_is_certified_used_by_drive_m AS (PARTITION BY is_certified_used ORDER BY drive_mins, id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(next_car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY next_car_stock_arrived_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(next_car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY next_car_stock_arrived_date DESC) AS next_car_stock_arrived_date_rank,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_certified_used) AS car_stock_id_is_certified_used_max_drive_mins,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins_sum_1_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(next_car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY next_car_stock_arrived_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS drive_mins_sum_1_prior_avg_6_prior,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_certified_used) AS rows_in_car_stock_id_is_certified_used
    FROM with_windows
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per test_drive
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.car_stock_term_months,
        s.car_stock_showroom_id,
        s.drive_mins_sum_1_prior,
        s.car_stock_term_months_change,
        s.next_car_stock_arrived_date,
        s.car_stock_showroom_id_deal_status_sum_car_stock_,
        s.seq_no,
        s.next_car_stock_arrived_date_rank,
        s.car_stock_id_is_certified_used_max_drive_mins,
        s.drive_mins_sum_1_prior_avg_6_prior,
        s.rows_in_car_stock_id_is_certified_used,
        t.id AS test_drive_id,
        t.drive_mins AS test_drive_drive_mins,
        t.drive_outcome AS test_drive_drive_outcome,
        t.deal_status AS test_drive_deal_status,
        t.vin_tail AS test_drive_vin_tail
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN test_drives t ON t.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id AND t.drive_mins <= 69
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching car_stock
    SELECT s.*
    FROM line_level s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM car_stock c
            WHERE c.showroom_id = s.car_stock_showroom_id
              AND c.term_months > 28
        )
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key

WITH scoped_grooming_jobs AS (
    -- Filter grooming_jobs
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        visit_reason,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags,
        ABS(kennel_nights - 15) AS kennel_nights_distance
    FROM grooming_jobs
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_at per visit_reason
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_at, id) AS prev_groomed_at
    FROM scoped_grooming_jobs
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_at IS NULL OR groomed_at > prev_groomed_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        visit_reason,
        burst_id,
        MIN(groomed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(kennel_nights) AS session_kennel_nights,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY visit_reason, burst_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        visit_reason,
        burst_id,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        n_events,
        session_kennel_nights,
        duration_min,
        ABS(session_kennel_nights - 66) AS session_kennel_nights_distance,
        LENGTH(TRIM(visit_reason)) AS visit_reason_len,
        FLOOR(duration_min / 50) * 50 AS duration_min_bucket
    FROM per_session
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM tagged
    WHERE visit_reason_len > (SELECT AVG(visit_reason_len) FROM tagged)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    visit_reason,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    n_events,
    session_kennel_nights,
    session_kennel_nights_distance,
    duration_min_bucket,
    COALESCE(visit_reason, 'UNKNOWN') AS visit_reason_or_unknown,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(visit_reason), ' ', '_')) AS visit_reason_slug
FROM screened
ORDER BY visit_reason DESC, visit_reason_or_unknown

WITH prepared_car_stocks AS (
    -- Scope the car_stock rows
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_id,
        body_style,
        term_months,
        vin_tail,
        LAST_DAY(arrived_date) AS arrived_date_month_end,
        DATE_ADD(arrived_date, 365) AS arrived_date_plus_365d
    FROM car_stock
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(arrived_date_plus_365d) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_date_plus_365d) ORDER BY term_months ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_arrived_date_plus_365d,
        ROUND(term_months - AVG(term_months) OVER w_body_style_arrived_date_plus, 2) AS term_months_vs_body_style_arrived_date_plus_365d,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_date_plus_365d), body_style ORDER BY arrived_date_month_end, id) AS arrived_date_month_end_tercile,
        ROUND(term_months / NULLIF(SUM(term_months) OVER w_arrived_date_plus_365d_month_2, 0), 4) AS term_months_share_of_arrived_date_plus_365d_mont,
        LAST_VALUE(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_date_month_end), showroom_id ORDER BY term_months DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_term_months,
        MAX(term_months) OVER w_arrived_date_month_end_month_2 AS arrived_date_month_end_month_max_term_months,
        MIN(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY body_style, MONTH(arrived_date_plus_365d)) AS body_style_arrived_date_plus_365d_month_min_term,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_date_plus_365d)) AS rows_in_arrived_date_plus_365d_month,
        term_months - LAG(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_date_plus_365d), body_style ORDER BY arrived_date_month_end, id) AS term_months_change,
        DATEDIFF(arrived_date_plus_365d, LAG(arrived_date_plus_365d) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_date_plus_365d) ORDER BY term_months ASC, id)) AS days_since_prev_arrived_date_plus_365d,
        DATEDIFF(arrived_date_plus_365d, LAG(arrived_date_plus_365d) OVER w_all_by_term_months) AS days_since_prev_arrived_date_plus_365d_2,
        ROUND(term_months / NULLIF(SUM(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY body_style, MONTH(arrived_date_plus_365d)), 0), 4) AS term_months_share_of_body_style_arrived_date_plu,
        NTH_VALUE(arrived_date_plus_365d, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_date_plus_365d), body_style ORDER BY arrived_date_month_end, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_arrived_date_plus_365d
    FROM prepared_car_stocks
    WINDOW w_body_style_arrived_date_plus AS (PARTITION BY body_style, MONTH(arrived_date_plus_365d)), w_arrived_date_plus_365d_month_2 AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_date_plus_365d)), w_arrived_date_month_end_month_2 AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_date_month_end)), w_all_by_term_months AS (ORDER BY term_months, id)
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        body_style,
        showroom_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(vin_tail)) LIKE 'D%') AS n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE body_style IN ('suv', 'sedan', 'hatch')) AS n_body_style_in_suv_sedan_hatc,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE body_style = 'hatch') AS n_body_style_hatch,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(vin_tail) LIKE '%10%' THEN arrived_date_month_end_tercile ELSE 0 END) AS arrived_date_month_end_tercile_lower_vin_tail_li
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE term_months_share_of_body_style_arrived_date_plu > 0.3
    GROUP BY body_style, showroom_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    body_style,
    showroom_id,
    n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d,
    n_body_style_in_suv_sedan_hatc,
    n_body_style_hatch,
    arrived_date_month_end_tercile_lower_vin_tail_li,
    LOWER(TRIM(body_style)) AS body_style_clean
FROM rollup_base
WHERE n_body_style_hatch <= 7
ORDER BY showroom_id DESC, body_style

    SELECT
        id,
        coat_type,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', groomed_ts) AS days_since_groomed_ts,
        QUARTER(groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_quarter
    FROM pet_owners
    WHERE visit_cost <= 833.5
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(visit_cost * 1.1, 2) AS visit_cost_adj,
        LENGTH(TRIM(coat_type)) AS coat_type_len
    FROM filtered_pet_owners
    WHERE groomed_ts_quarter < 3
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(groomed_ts_quarter, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY groomed_ts_quarter, coat_type_len ORDER BY groomed_ts_quarter ASC, id) AS prev_groomed_ts_quarter,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY groomed_ts_quarter, coat_type_len ORDER BY groomed_ts_quarter ASC, id) AS groomed_ts_quarter_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY groomed_ts_quarter, coat_type_len ORDER BY groomed_ts_quarter ASC), 3) AS groomed_ts_quarter_cume_dist,
        groomed_ts_quarter - LAG(groomed_ts_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY groomed_ts_quarter, coat_type_len ORDER BY groomed_ts_quarter ASC, id) AS groomed_ts_quarter_change
    FROM labeled
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    groomed_ts_quarter_rank,
    groomed_ts_quarter,
    groomed_ts_quarter_change,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    MIN(groomed_ts_quarter_rank) AS min_groomed_ts_quarter_rank
FROM sequenced
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((groomed_ts_quarter_rank, groomed_ts_quarter, groomed_ts_quarter_change), (groomed_ts_quarter_rank), ())
ORDER BY groomed_ts_quarter_rank NULLS LAST, groomed_ts_quarter NULLS LAST, groomed_ts_quarter_change NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_pet_owners = (
    df_pet_owners
    .filter(F.col("visit_cost") <= 833.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "coat_type",
        "visit_cost",
        "pet_age_yrs",
        "groomed_ts",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("groomed_ts")).alias("days_since_groomed_ts"),
        F.quarter(F.col("groomed_ts")).alias("groomed_ts_quarter"),
    )

labeled = (

    .filter(F.col("groomed_ts_quarter") < 3)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("visit_cost") * 1.1, 2).alias("visit_cost_adj"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("coat_type"))).alias("coat_type_len"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    labeled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("groomed_ts_quarter", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("groomed_ts_quarter", "coat_type_len").orderBy("groomed_ts_quarter", "id")).alias("prev_groomed_ts_quarter"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("groomed_ts_quarter", "coat_type_len").orderBy("groomed_ts_quarter", "id")).alias("groomed_ts_quarter_rank"),

        (F.col("groomed_ts_quarter") - F.lag("groomed_ts_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("groomed_ts_quarter", "coat_type_len").orderBy("groomed_ts_quarter", "id"))).alias("groomed_ts_quarter_change"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced
    .groupingSets(
        [["groomed_ts_quarter_rank", "groomed_ts_quarter", "groomed_ts_quarter_change"], ["groomed_ts_quarter_rank"], []],
        "groomed_ts_quarter_rank", "groomed_ts_quarter", "groomed_ts_quarter_change",
    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
        F.min("groomed_ts_quarter_rank").alias("min_groomed_ts_quarter_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("groomed_ts_quarter_rank").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("groomed_ts_quarter").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("groomed_ts_quarter_change").asc_nulls_last(),

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Scope the pipe_bursts rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        CONCAT(meter_kind, '#', CAST(pump_station_id AS STRING)) AS meter_kind_ref,
        GREATEST(flow_lpm, usage_m3) AS greatest_flow_lpm_usage_m3,
        LEAST(usage_m3, flow_lpm) AS least_usage_m3_flow_lpm
    FROM pipe_bursts
    WHERE meter_kind IN ('analog', 'ultrasonic')
      AND station_tier IS NOT NULL
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per pipe_burst
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.usage_m3,
        s.meter_kind_ref,
        s.greatest_flow_lpm_usage_m3,
        p.id AS pipe_burst_id,
        p.station_tier AS pipe_burst_station_tier,
        p.street_ref AS pipe_burst_street_ref,
        p.usage_m3 AS pipe_burst_usage_m3
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN pipe_bursts p ON p.pump_station_id = s.pump_station_id
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Attach pipe_burst attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.meter_fitted_on AS pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
        p.meter_kind AS pipe_burst_meter_kind,
        p.flow_lpm AS pipe_burst_flow_lpm,
        pu.street_ref AS pump_station_street_ref
    FROM line_level s
    JOIN pipe_bursts p ON p.id = s.pipe_burst_id
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations pu ON pu.id = p.pump_station_id
),
with_parent_pump_station AS (
    -- Join pump_stations
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.tariff_band AS pump_station_tariff_band,
        p.station_tier AS pump_station_station_tier
    FROM with_parent s
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    usage_m3,
    meter_kind_ref,
    pipe_burst_id,
    pipe_burst_station_tier,
    pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
    pipe_burst_meter_kind,
    pump_station_street_ref,
    pump_station_station_tier,
    pipe_burst_usage_m3 - usage_m3 AS pipe_burst_usage_m3_minus_usage_m3
FROM with_parent_pump_station
ORDER BY pipe_burst_usage_m3_minus_usage_m3

)

with_parent_pump_station = (

WITH s_monthly AS (
    -- S rows per visit_day_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day) AS visit_day_month, COUNT(*) AS s_count, ROUND(AVG(groom_mins), 2) AS s_avg_groom_mins
    FROM vet_visits
    WHERE kennel_size = 'S'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day)
),
l_monthly AS (
    -- L rows per visit_day_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day) AS visit_day_month, COUNT(*) AS l_count, ROUND(AVG(groom_mins), 2) AS l_avg_groom_mins
    FROM vet_visits
    WHERE kennel_size = 'L'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.visit_day_month, b.visit_day_month) AS visit_day_month,
    COALESCE(a.s_count, 0) AS s_count,
    COALESCE(a.s_avg_groom_mins, 0) AS s_avg_groom_mins,
    COALESCE(b.l_count, 0) AS l_count,
    COALESCE(b.l_avg_groom_mins, 0) AS l_avg_groom_mins,
    COALESCE(a.s_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.l_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM s_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN l_monthly b
  ON a.visit_day_month = b.visit_day_month
ORDER BY visit_day_month

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

s_monthly = (
    df_vet_visits
    .filter(F.col("kennel_size") == "S")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "visit_day").alias("visit_day_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("s_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("groom_mins"), 2).alias("s_avg_groom_mins"),
    )
)

l_monthly = (
    df_vet_visits
    .filter(F.col("kennel_size") == "L")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "visit_day").alias("visit_day_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("l_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("groom_mins"), 2).alias("l_avg_groom_mins"),
    )
)

result = (
    s_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(l_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.visit_day_month") == F.col("b.visit_day_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.visit_day_month"), F.col("b.visit_day_month")).alias("visit_day_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.s_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("s_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.s_avg_groom_mins"), F.lit(0)).alias("s_avg_groom_mins"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.l_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("l_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.l_avg_groom_mins"), F.lit(0)).alias("l_avg_groom_mins"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.s_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.l_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("visit_day_month")
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE odometer_km <= 148631
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        fuel_kind,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        ROUND(odometer_km / NULLIF(SUM(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind, showroom_ref), 0), 4) AS odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_started_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(drive_started_at), deal_state ORDER BY drive_started_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_started_at
    FROM base
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE odometer_km > (SELECT AVG(odometer_km) FROM ranked)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        fuel_kind,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref,
        second_drive_started_at,
        ROUND(odometer_km - AVG(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used, fuel_kind), 2) AS odometer_km_vs_is_certified_used_fuel_kind_avg,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_fuel_kind_by_odometer_km_tie, 3) AS odometer_km_cume_dist
    FROM qualified
    WINDOW w_fuel_kind_by_odometer_km_tie AS (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY odometer_km)
),
with_windows_2 AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref,
        second_drive_started_at,
        odometer_km_vs_is_certified_used_fuel_kind_avg,
        odometer_km_cume_dist,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', drive_started_at) ORDER BY drive_started_at ASC), 3) AS drive_started_at_cume_dist,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_drive_started_at_month_by_dr_2 AS drive_started_at_quintile,
        ROUND(odometer_km_cume_dist - AVG(odometer_km_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind), 2) AS odometer_km_cume_dist_vs_fuel_kind_avg,
        FIRST_VALUE(odometer_km_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', drive_started_at) ORDER BY drive_started_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_odometer_km_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_drive_started_at_month_by_dr_2 AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', drive_started_at) ORDER BY drive_started_at ASC, id)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(drive_started_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(second_drive_started_at)) / 60, 1) AS minutes_second_drive_started_at_to_drive_started,
        second_drive_started_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS AS second_drive_started_at_plus_2h,
        ABS(odometer_km - 134524) AS odometer_km_distance
    FROM with_windows_2
    WHERE odometer_km_cume_dist > 0.1
),
ranked_2 AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(drive_started_at_quintile - AVG(drive_started_at_quintile) OVER (PARTITION BY drive_started_at_quintile), 2) AS drive_started_at_quintile_vs_drive_started_at_qu,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_drive_started_at_quintile_by AS odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref_quar
    FROM annotated
    WINDOW w_drive_started_at_quintile_by AS (PARTITION BY drive_started_at_quintile ORDER BY odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref, id)
),
totals AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        is_certified_used,
        SUM(first_odometer_km_cume_dist) AS total_first_odometer_km_cume_dist,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_certified_used = FALSE THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_is_certified_used_false,
        MIN(drive_started_at) AS first_drive_started_at,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM ranked_2
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    is_certified_used,
    first_drive_started_at,
    IF(is_certified_used, 'yes', 'no') AS is_certified_used_label,
    FLOOR(row_count / 2) * 2 AS row_count_bucket
FROM totals
ORDER BY is_certified_used_label DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_service_tickets
    .filter(F.col("odometer_km") <= 148631)
    .select(
        "id",
        "showroom_ref",
        "fuel_kind",
        "deal_state",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_certified_used",
    )
)

ranked = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "fuel_kind",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_certified_used",
        F.round(F.col("odometer_km") / F.nullif(F.sum("odometer_km").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_kind", "showroom_ref")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref"),
        F.nth_value("drive_started_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("drive_started_at"), "deal_state").orderBy(F.col("drive_started_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_drive_started_at"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    ranked
    .crossJoin(ranked.agg(F.avg("odometer_km").alias("overall_avg_odometer_km")))
    .filter(F.col("odometer_km") > F.col("overall_avg_odometer_km"))
    .drop("overall_avg_odometer_km")
)

w_fuel_kind_by_odometer_km_tie = Window.partitionBy("fuel_kind").orderBy("odometer_km")
with_windows = (
    qualified
    .select(
        "id",
        "fuel_kind",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_certified_used",
        "odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref",
        "second_drive_started_at",
        F.round(F.col("odometer_km") - F.avg("odometer_km").over(Window.partitionBy("is_certified_used", "fuel_kind")), 2).alias("odometer_km_vs_is_certified_used_fuel_kind_avg"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_fuel_kind_by_odometer_km_tie), 3).alias("odometer_km_cume_dist"),
    )
)

w_drive_started_at_month_by_dr_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "drive_started_at")).orderBy("drive_started_at", "id")
with_windows_2 = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
        "is_certified_used",
        "odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref",
        "second_drive_started_at",
        "odometer_km_vs_is_certified_used_fuel_kind_avg",
        "odometer_km_cume_dist",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "drive_started_at")).orderBy("drive_started_at")), 3).alias("drive_started_at_cume_dist"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_drive_started_at_month_by_dr_2).alias("drive_started_at_quintile"),
        F.round(F.col("odometer_km_cume_dist") - F.avg("odometer_km_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_kind")), 2).alias("odometer_km_cume_dist_vs_fuel_kind_avg"),
        F.first("odometer_km_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "drive_started_at")).orderBy("drive_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_odometer_km_cume_dist"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    with_windows_2
    .filter(F.col("odometer_km_cume_dist") > 0.1)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("drive_started_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("second_drive_started_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_second_drive_started_at_to_drive_started"),
        (F.col("second_drive_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")).alias("second_drive_started_at_plus_2h"),
        F.abs(F.col("odometer_km") - 134524).alias("odometer_km_distance"),
    )
)

w_drive_started_at_quintile_by = Window.partitionBy("drive_started_at_quintile").orderBy("odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref", "id")
ranked_2 = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("drive_started_at_quintile") - F.avg("drive_started_at_quintile").over(Window.partitionBy("drive_started_at_quintile")), 2).alias("drive_started_at_quintile_vs_drive_started_at_qu"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_drive_started_at_quintile_by).alias("odometer_km_share_of_fuel_kind_showroom_ref_quar"),
    )
)

totals = (
    ranked_2
    .groupBy("is_certified_used")
    .agg(
        F.sum("first_odometer_km_cume_dist").alias("total_first_odometer_km_cume_dist"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(~F.col("is_certified_used"), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_is_certified_used_false"),
        F.min("drive_started_at").alias("first_drive_started_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 3)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "is_certified_used",
        "first_drive_started_at",
        F.when(F.col("is_certified_used"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("is_certified_used_label"),
        (F.floor(F.col("row_count") / 2) * 2).alias("row_count_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_certified_used_label").desc())
)

    SELECT

        usage_m3,

        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', meter_fitted_date) AS days_since_meter_fitted_date
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE station_tier <> 'reserve'
      AND meter_fitted_date < DATE '2025-04-02'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_water_meter_id_by_usage_m3 AS usage_m3_seq,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY burst_litres DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY usage_m3, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_water_meter_id_by_usage_m3 AS usage_m3_tercile,
        usage_m3 - LAG(usage_m3) OVER (ORDER BY burst_litres DESC, id) AS usage_m3_change,
        LAST_VALUE(chlorine_ppm) OVER (ORDER BY burst_litres DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_chlorine_ppm
    FROM filtered_usage_reads

),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics

        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_date) AS meter_fitted_date_month,

        DATEDIFF(MAX(meter_fitted_date), MIN(meter_fitted_date)) AS meter_fitted_date_span_days
    FROM windowed

    HAVING SUM(seq_no) > 4
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups

    WINDOW w_n_station_tier_booster_by_me AS (PARTITION BY n_station_tier_booster ORDER BY meter_fitted_date_span_days DESC, meter_fitted_date_month, usage_m3_seq)
)

filtered_usage_reads = (
    df_usage_reads
    .filter((F.col("station_tier") != "reserve") & (F.col("meter_fitted_date") < F.lit("2025-04-02").cast("date")))
    .select(
