        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("meter_fitted_date")).alias("days_since_meter_fitted_date"),
    )
)

w_water_meter_id_by_usage_m3 = Window.partitionBy("water_meter_id").orderBy("usage_m3", "id")
windowed = (
    filtered_usage_reads
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w_water_meter_id_by_usage_m3).alias("usage_m3_seq"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("burst_litres").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("usage_m3", "id")).alias("seq_no"),

        (F.col("usage_m3") - F.lag("usage_m3").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("burst_litres").desc(), "id"))).alias("usage_m3_change"),
        F.last("chlorine_ppm").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("burst_litres").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_chlorine_ppm"),
    )
)

totals = (
    windowed
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("month", "meter_fitted_date").alias("meter_fitted_date_month"),
        "usage_m3_seq",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("station_tier") != "booster", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_station_tier_booster"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("station_tier") == "reserve", 1)).alias("n_station_tier_reserve"),
        F.datediff(F.max("meter_fitted_date"), F.min("meter_fitted_date")).alias("meter_fitted_date_span_days"),
        F.sum("seq_no").alias("sum_seq_no_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_seq_no_check") > 4)
    .drop("sum_seq_no_check")
)

w_n_station_tier_booster_by_me = Window.partitionBy("n_station_tier_booster").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_date_span_days").desc(), "meter_fitted_date_month", "usage_m3_seq")

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        FLOOR(visit_cost / 250) * 250 AS visit_cost_bucket
    FROM kennels
    WHERE visit_cost <= 834.6
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per visit_reason
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR groomed_ts > prev_groomed_ts + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        visit_reason,
        session_no,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(visit_cost) AS session_visit_cost,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY visit_reason, session_no
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN duration_min >= 168.0 THEN 'A' WHEN duration_min >= 108.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS duration_min_tier,
        CASE WHEN duration_min >= 156.0 THEN 'A' WHEN duration_min >= 60.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS duration_min_tier_2,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month
    FROM per_session
    WHERE visit_reason IN ('injury', 'checkup')
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY duration_min_tier, TO_DATE(session_end) ORDER BY session_start DESC, visit_reason, session_no) AS session_start_seq,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY duration_min_tier, TO_DATE(session_end) ORDER BY session_start DESC), 3) AS session_start_percent_rank,
        MAX(duration_min) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no, duration_min_tier_2) AS session_no_duration_min_tier_2_max_duration_min,
        LAG(session_end, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY duration_min_tier, TO_DATE(session_end) ORDER BY session_start DESC, visit_reason, session_no) AS prev2_session_end,
        SUM(events) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no, duration_min_tier_2) AS session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    visit_reason,
    session_no,
    MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,
    SUM(session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events) AS total_session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events,
    SUM(session_start_percent_rank) AS total_session_start_percent_rank
FROM with_trends
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((visit_reason, session_no), (visit_reason))
ORDER BY visit_reason NULLS LAST, session_no NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_kennels
    .filter(F.col("visit_cost") <= 834.6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "visit_reason",
        "species",
        "visit_cost",
        "groomed_ts",
        "is_microchipped",
        (F.floor(F.col("visit_cost") / 250) * 250).alias("visit_cost_bucket"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_groomed_ts", F.lag("groomed_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_reason").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_ts").isNull() | (F.col("groomed_ts") > F.col("prev_groomed_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_reason").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("visit_reason", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("groomed_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("groomed_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("visit_cost").alias("session_visit_cost"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("groomed_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("groomed_ts"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

scored = (
    per_session
    .filter(F.col("visit_reason").isin("injury", "checkup"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("duration_min") >= 168.0, "A").when(F.col("duration_min") >= 108.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("duration_min_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_min") >= 156.0, "A").when(F.col("duration_min") >= 60.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("duration_min_tier_2"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("session_start")).alias("session_start_month"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("duration_min_tier", F.to_date("session_end")).orderBy(F.col("session_start").desc(), "visit_reason", "session_no")).alias("session_start_seq"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("duration_min_tier", F.to_date("session_end")).orderBy(F.col("session_start").desc())), 3).alias("session_start_percent_rank"),
        F.max("duration_min").over(Window.partitionBy("session_no", "duration_min_tier_2")).alias("session_no_duration_min_tier_2_max_duration_min"),
        F.lag("session_end", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("duration_min_tier", F.to_date("session_end")).orderBy(F.col("session_start").desc(), "visit_reason", "session_no")).alias("prev2_session_end"),
        F.sum("events").over(Window.partitionBy("session_no", "duration_min_tier_2")).alias("session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .groupingSets(
        [["visit_reason", "session_no"], ["visit_reason"]],
        "visit_reason", "session_no",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("session_start").alias("first_session_start"),
        F.sum("session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events").alias("total_session_no_duration_min_tier_2_sum_events"),
        F.sum("session_start_percent_rank").alias("total_session_start_percent_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("visit_reason").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("session_no").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH filtered_pets_regs AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        flag_is_neutered
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(diet_tags, 'renal')
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        flag_is_neutered,
        FIRST_VALUE(visit_day) OVER (PARTITION BY flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_visit_day,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_visit_day AS visit_day_rank,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(visit_day) ORDER BY visit_day NULLS LAST), 3) AS visit_day_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS visit_day_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_visit_day_ties AS visit_day_dense_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(visit_day) ORDER BY visit_day NULLS LAST, id) AS visit_day_dense_rank_3,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS visit_day_quartile,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_visit_day AS visit_day_dense_rank_4,
        LAST_VALUE(visit_day) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_visit_day,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(visit_day) ORDER BY visit_day NULLS LAST, id) AS visit_day_tercile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        LAG(visit_day, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY flag_is_neutered, pet_owner_id ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id) AS prev3_visit_day,
        RANK() OVER w_flag_is_neutered_by_visit_da_2 AS visit_day_rank_2
    FROM filtered_pets_regs
    WINDOW w_all_by_visit_day AS (ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id), w_all_by_visit_day_ties AS (ORDER BY visit_day DESC), w_flag_is_neutered_by_visit_da_2 AS (PARTITION BY flag_is_neutered ORDER BY visit_day DESC, id)
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- Top 3 per group
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        flag_is_neutered,
        first_visit_day,
        visit_day_rank,
        visit_day_percent_rank,
        visit_day_dense_rank,
        visit_day_dense_rank_2,
        visit_day_dense_rank_3,
        visit_day_quartile,
        visit_day_dense_rank_4,
        last_known_visit_day,
        visit_day_tercile,
        seq_no,
        prev3_visit_day
    FROM ranked
    WHERE visit_day_rank_2 <= 3
      AND coat_kind = 'long'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_visit_day_dense_rank_3 AS rows_in_visit_day_dense_rank_3,
        ROUND(visit_day_dense_rank_4 / NULLIF(SUM(visit_day_dense_rank_4) OVER w_coat_kind_first_visit_day_ye, 0), 4) AS visit_day_dense_rank_4_share_of_coat_kind_first_,
        LEAD(first_visit_day) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_visit_day, id) AS next_first_visit_day,
        LAST_VALUE(visit_day_rank) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_visit_day, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_visit_day_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(visit_day_dense_rank) OVER w_coat_kind_first_visit_day_ye, 2) AS coat_kind_first_visit_day_year_avg_visit_day_den,
        MIN(visit_day_tercile) OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind, YEAR(first_visit_day)) AS coat_kind_first_visit_day_year_min_visit_day_ter
    FROM top_per_group
    WINDOW w_visit_day_dense_rank_3 AS (PARTITION BY visit_day_dense_rank_3), w_coat_kind_first_visit_day_ye AS (PARTITION BY coat_kind, YEAR(first_visit_day))
)
SELECT
    id,
    visit_day,
    first_visit_day,
    visit_day_rank,
    visit_day_dense_rank,
    visit_day_quartile,
    visit_day_dense_rank_4,
    visit_day_tercile,
    seq_no,
    rows_in_visit_day_dense_rank_3,
    visit_day_dense_rank_4_share_of_coat_kind_first_,
    next_first_visit_day,
    last_visit_day_rank,
    coat_kind_first_visit_day_year_avg_visit_day_den,
    coat_kind_first_visit_day_year_min_visit_day_ter
FROM windowed
ORDER BY visit_day_dense_rank_4 DESC NULLS FIRST, coat_kind_first_visit_day_year_min_visit_day_ter DESC, id

        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY visit_cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS visit_cost_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY visit_cost DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (ORDER BY visit_cost DESC NULLS FIRST, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_groomed_ts,

    FROM prepared
),
species_stats AS (
    -- Avg visit_cost_avg_2_prior per species
    SELECT species, AVG(visit_cost_avg_2_prior) AS avg_visit_cost_avg_2_prior
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY species
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_visit_cost_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(s.visit_cost_avg_2_prior - g.avg_visit_cost_avg_2_prior, 2) AS visit_cost_avg_2_prior_minus_avg
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN species_stats g ON g.species = s.species
    WHERE s.visit_cost_avg_2_prior > g.avg_visit_cost_avg_2_prior
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(visit_reason, 'ALL') AS visit_reason,
    COALESCE(species, 'ALL') AS species,
    is_microchipped,
    GROUPING(visit_reason) AS is_total_visit_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT visit_reason) AS distinct_visit_reasons
FROM outliers
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((visit_reason, species, is_microchipped), (visit_reason), ())

WITH prepared AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        is_certified_used,
        INITCAP(TRIM(deal_state)) AS deal_state_clean
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE odometer_km < 119576
      AND deal_state IS NOT NULL
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach car_stock metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car_stock c WHERE c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref) AS car_stock_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car_stock c WHERE c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref) AS car_stock_count_2,
        (SELECT MIN(c.arrived_date) FROM car_stock c WHERE c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref) AS first_car_stock_arrived_date
    FROM prepared s
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per service_ticket
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.fuel_kind,
        s.deal_state,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.car_stock_count,
        s.car_stock_count_2,
        se.id AS service_ticket_id,
        se.is_certified_used AS service_ticket_is_certified_used,
        se.fuel_kind AS service_ticket_fuel_kind,
        se.odometer_km AS service_ticket_odometer_km
    FROM summarized_rows s
    JOIN service_tickets se ON se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref
),
with_details AS (
    -- Attach showroom attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        se.deal_state AS service_ticket_deal_state
    FROM with_children s
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref
    LEFT JOIN service_tickets se ON se.id = s.service_ticket_id
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        is_certified_used,
        car_stock_count,
        car_stock_count_2,
        service_ticket_id,
        service_ticket_is_certified_used,
        service_ticket_fuel_kind,
        service_ticket_odometer_km,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(service_ticket_fuel_kind), ' ', '_')) AS service_ticket_fuel_kind_slug
    FROM with_details
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        is_certified_used,
        car_stock_count,
        service_ticket_id,
        service_ticket_is_certified_used,
        service_ticket_odometer_km,
        CASE WHEN fuel_kind IN ('diesel', 'petrol') THEN 'group_a' WHEN fuel_kind = 'ev' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS fuel_kind_group
    FROM annotated
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    showroom_ref,
    is_certified_used,
    car_stock_count,
    service_ticket_id,
    service_ticket_odometer_km,
    fuel_kind_group
FROM derived
ORDER BY fuel_kind_group

WITH thinking_by_car_stock AS (
    -- thinking rows per car_stock_id
    SELECT car_stock_id, COUNT(*) AS thinking_count, SUM(drive_mins) AS thinking_total_drive_mins
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_outcome = 'thinking'
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
declined_by_car_stock AS (
    -- declined rows per car_stock_id
    SELECT car_stock_id, COUNT(*) AS declined_count, ROUND(AVG(drive_mins), 2) AS declined_avg_drive_mins
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_outcome = 'declined'
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.car_stock_id, b.car_stock_id) AS car_stock_id,
    COALESCE(a.thinking_count, 0) AS thinking_count,
    COALESCE(a.thinking_total_drive_mins, 0) AS thinking_total_drive_mins,
    COALESCE(b.declined_count, 0) AS declined_count,
    COALESCE(b.declined_avg_drive_mins, 0) AS declined_avg_drive_mins,
    COALESCE(a.thinking_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.declined_count, 0) AS thinking_count_minus_declined_count
FROM thinking_by_car_stock a
FULL OUTER JOIN declined_by_car_stock b
  ON a.car_stock_id = b.car_stock_id
ORDER BY car_stock_id

WITH prepared_pipe_bursts AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        street_ref
    FROM pipe_bursts
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(street_ref)) LIKE 'C%'
      AND meter_kind <> 'ultrasonic'
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        usage_m3,
        street_ref,
        SUM(flow_lpm) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id) AS meter_kind_pump_station_id_sum_flow_lpm,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(station_tier) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, pump_station_id)) AS distinct_station_tier_in_meter_kind_pump_station,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY flow_lpm) AS flow_lpm_rank
    FROM prepared_pipe_bursts
),
enriched_pump_station AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.usage_m3,
        s.street_ref,
        s.distinct_station_tier_in_meter_kind_pump_station,
        s.flow_lpm_rank,
        p.station_tier AS pump_station_station_tier,
        p.burst_ts AS pump_station_burst_ts,
        p.tariff_band AS pump_station_tariff_band
    FROM with_trends s
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per meter_kind
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        meter_kind,
        usage_m3,
        street_ref,
        distinct_station_tier_in_meter_kind_pump_station,
        flow_lpm_rank,
        pump_station_station_tier,
        pump_station_burst_ts,
        pump_station_tariff_band
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind ORDER BY usage_m3 DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM enriched_pump_station
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
with_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.usage_m3,
        s.distinct_station_tier_in_meter_kind_pump_station,
        s.flow_lpm_rank,
        s.pump_station_station_tier,
        s.pump_station_burst_ts,
        s.pump_station_tariff_band,
        p.pressure_bar AS pump_station_pressure_bar,
        p.burst_ts AS pump_station_burst_ts_2,
        p.street_ref AS pump_station_street_ref
    FROM latest s
    JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
    WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(p.street_ref)) >= 4
),
water_meter_stats AS (
    -- Per-pump_station water_meters metrics
    SELECT pump_station_id, COUNT(*) AS water_meter_count
    FROM water_meters
    GROUP BY pump_station_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach water_meters metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(w.water_meter_count, 0) AS water_meter_count
    FROM with_details s
    LEFT JOIN water_meter_stats w ON w.pump_station_id = s.pump_station_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    meter_kind,
    usage_m3,
    distinct_station_tier_in_meter_kind_pump_station,
    flow_lpm_rank,
    pump_station_station_tier,
    pump_station_burst_ts,
    pump_station_tariff_band,
    pump_station_pressure_bar,
    water_meter_count,
    pump_station_burst_ts_2 + INTERVAL 1 DAYS AS pump_station_burst_ts_2_plus_1d
FROM with_stats
ORDER BY pump_station_burst_ts DESC, id
LIMIT 10

WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        flag_is_neutered,
        diet_tags,
        CASE WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 13 THEN 'A' WHEN pet_age_yrs >= 5 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS pet_age_yrs_tier
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE kennel_nights >= 10
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        flag_is_neutered,
        pet_age_yrs_tier,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(kennel_nights, 0.5) AS median_kennel_nights,
        SUM(CASE WHEN flag_is_neutered = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_flag_is_neutered_false,
        SUM(pet_age_yrs) AS total_pet_age_yrs,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY flag_is_neutered, pet_age_yrs_tier
    HAVING AVG(pet_age_yrs) > 5
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(total_pet_age_yrs, 0) AS total_pet_age_yrs_filled,
        CASE WHEN pet_age_yrs_tier IN ('C', 'B') THEN 'group_a' WHEN pet_age_yrs_tier = 'A' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS pet_age_yrs_tier_group,
        COALESCE(median_kennel_nights, 0) AS median_kennel_nights_filled
    FROM stats
)

    .drop("avg_pet_age_yrs_check")

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        payload_kind,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per payload_kind
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR frame_at > prev_frame_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        payload_kind,
        burst_id,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY payload_kind, burst_id
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    payload_kind,
    burst_id,
    GROUPING(payload_kind) AS is_total_payload_kind,
    MIN(burst_id) AS min_burst_id,
    ROUND(SUM(event_count) / NULLIF(SUM(burst_id), 0), 3) AS event_count_to_burst_id_ratio,
    MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start
FROM sessions
GROUP BY ROLLUP(payload_kind, burst_id)
ORDER BY payload_kind NULLS LAST, burst_id NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_telemetry_frames
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "payload_kind",
        "burn_secs",
        "frame_at",
        "mission_name",
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_frame_at", F.lag("frame_at").over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy("frame_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_frame_at").isNull() | (F.col("frame_at") > F.col("prev_frame_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy("frame_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("payload_kind", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("frame_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("frame_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("frame_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("frame_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .rollup("payload_kind", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("payload_kind").alias("is_total_payload_kind"),
        F.min("burst_id").alias("min_burst_id"),
        F.round(F.sum("event_count") / F.nullif(F.sum("burst_id"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("event_count_to_burst_id_ratio"),
        F.max("session_start").alias("last_session_start"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("payload_kind").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("burst_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Filter car_stock
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_id,
        body_style,
        term_months,
        arrived_date,
        vin_tail,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(body_style), 1, 2) AS body_style_prefix
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE term_months < 63
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        term_months - LAG(term_months) OVER w_all_by_term_months AS term_months_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY term_months DESC, id) AS rn,
        ROUND(term_months - AVG(term_months) OVER w_arrived_date_year, 2) AS term_months_vs_arrived_date_year_avg,
        LEAD(arrived_date) OVER w_all_by_term_months AS next_arrived_date,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY body_style ORDER BY arrived_date), 3) AS arrived_date_percent_rank,
        LEAD(term_months, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_id ORDER BY term_months, id) AS next2_term_months,
        ROUND(AVG(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_date)), 2) AS arrived_date_year_avg_term_months,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_id ORDER BY arrived_date, id) AS seq_no,
        MAX(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY body_style) AS body_style_max_term_months,
        FIRST_VALUE(term_months) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY body_style ORDER BY arrived_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_term_months
    FROM prepared
    WINDOW w_all_by_term_months AS (ORDER BY term_months DESC, id), w_arrived_date_year AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_date))
),
first_rows AS (
    -- Top 2 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM windowed
    WHERE seq_no <= 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    body_style,
    term_months,
    arrived_date,
    vin_tail,
    body_style_prefix,
    term_months_change,
    rn,
    term_months_vs_arrived_date_year_avg,
    next_arrived_date,
    arrived_date_percent_rank,
    arrived_date_year_avg_term_months,
    seq_no,
    body_style_max_term_months,
    first_known_term_months,
    CASE WHEN first_known_term_months >= 73 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN first_known_term_months >= 32 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS first_known_term_months_tier
FROM first_rows
WHERE showroom_id IS NOT NULL

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_type,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts,
        LEAST(pet_age_yrs, visit_cost) AS least_pet_age_yrs_visit_cost,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(coat_type), ' ', '_')) AS coat_type_slug,
        FLOOR(visit_cost / 250) * 250 AS visit_cost_bucket
    FROM pet_owners
    WHERE visit_cost > 201.0
      AND groomed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 08:00:00'
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_type,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts,
        coat_type_slug,
        visit_cost_bucket,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(coat_type_slug), 1, 3) AS coat_type_slug_prefix,
        LEAST(visit_cost, visit_cost_bucket) AS least_visit_cost_visit_cost_bucket
    FROM scoped
    WHERE pet_age_yrs > 11
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        groomed_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOURS AS groomed_ts_plus_2h,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_month,
        COALESCE(visit_cost_bucket, 0) AS visit_cost_bucket_filled
    FROM tagged
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach pets_reg metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT SUM(p.kennel_nights) FROM pets_reg p WHERE p.pet_owner_id = s.id) AS total_pets_reg_kennel_nights
    FROM derived s
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT groomed_ts_plus_2h, groomed_ts_month, coat_type, visit_cost_bucket_filled
    FROM with_stats
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(visit_cost_bucket_filled) AS min_v, COUNT(visit_cost_bucket_filled) AS n
    FOR coat_type IN ('curly', 'long')
)
ORDER BY groomed_ts_plus_2h, groomed_ts_month

scoped = (
    df_pet_owners
    .filter((F.col("visit_cost") > 201.0) & (F.col("groomed_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-31 08:00:00").cast("timestamp")))

        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("coat_type")), " ", "_")).alias("coat_type_slug"),
        (F.floor(F.col("visit_cost") / 250) * 250).alias("visit_cost_bucket"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    scoped
    .filter(F.col("pet_age_yrs") > 11)
    .select(
        "id",
        "coat_type",
        "visit_cost",
        "pet_age_yrs",
        "groomed_ts",
        "coat_type_slug",
        "visit_cost_bucket",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("coat_type_slug")), 1, 3).alias("coat_type_slug_prefix"),

    )
)

derived = (

    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("groomed_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")).alias("groomed_ts_plus_2h"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("groomed_ts")).alias("groomed_ts_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("visit_cost_bucket"), F.lit(0)).alias("visit_cost_bucket_filled"),

)

    .groupBy("groomed_ts_plus_2h", "groomed_ts_month")
    .pivot("coat_type", ["curly", "long"])

WITH filtered_service_tickets AS (
    -- Scope the service_tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE HOUR(drive_started_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 8
),
enriched AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(drive_started_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS drive_started_at_label
    FROM filtered_service_tickets
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(deal_state)) AS deal_state_len,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(fuel_kind), 1, 3) AS fuel_kind_prefix
    FROM enriched
    WHERE deal_state NOT IN ('funded', 'signed')
),
exploded_detail_service_tickets AS (
    -- One row per service_ticket
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.deal_state,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.deal_state_len,
        s.fuel_kind_prefix,
        se.id AS service_ticket_id,
        se.odometer_km AS service_ticket_odometer_km,
        se.fuel_kind AS service_ticket_fuel_kind,
        se.drive_started_at AS service_ticket_drive_started_at,
        se.deal_state AS service_ticket_deal_state
    FROM derived s
    JOIN service_tickets se ON se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref AND se.odometer_km < 162981
)
SELECT
    service_ticket_deal_state,
    service_ticket_fuel_kind,
    service_ticket_id,
    GROUPING(service_ticket_deal_state) AS is_total_service_ticket_deal_state,
    SUM(CASE WHEN service_ticket_deal_state NOT IN ('signed', 'funded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_service_ticket_deal_state_no,
    SUM(deal_state_len) FILTER (WHERE deal_state = 'signed') AS deal_state_len_deal_state_signed,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(service_ticket_fuel_kind)) AS service_ticket_fuel_kind_list
FROM exploded_detail_service_tickets
GROUP BY CUBE(service_ticket_deal_state, service_ticket_fuel_kind, service_ticket_id)
ORDER BY service_ticket_deal_state NULLS LAST, service_ticket_fuel_kind NULLS LAST, service_ticket_id NULLS LAST

filtered_service_tickets = (

    )
)

exploded_detail_service_tickets = (

        F.col("se.deal_state").alias("service_ticket_deal_state"),

result = (

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("deal_state") == "signed", F.col("deal_state_len"))).alias("deal_state_len_deal_state_signed"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("service_ticket_fuel_kind")).alias("service_ticket_fuel_kind_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("service_ticket_deal_state").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("service_ticket_fuel_kind").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("service_ticket_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH health_by_donor_ref AS (
    -- health rows per donor_ref
    SELECT donor_ref, COUNT(*) AS health_count, SUM(pledge_amount) AS health_total_pledge_amount
    FROM pledges
    WHERE cause_area = 'health'
    GROUP BY donor_ref
),
education_by_donor_ref AS (
    -- education rows per donor_ref
    SELECT donor_ref, COUNT(*) AS education_count, SUM(pledge_amount) AS education_total_pledge_amount
    FROM pledges
    WHERE cause_area = 'education'
    GROUP BY donor_ref
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.donor_ref, b.donor_ref) AS donor_ref,
    COALESCE(a.health_count, 0) AS health_count,
    COALESCE(a.health_total_pledge_amount, 0) AS health_total_pledge_amount,
    COALESCE(b.education_count, 0) AS education_count,
    COALESCE(b.education_total_pledge_amount, 0) AS education_total_pledge_amount,
    COALESCE(a.health_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.education_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM health_by_donor_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN education_by_donor_ref b
  ON a.donor_ref = b.donor_ref
ORDER BY donor_ref

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter pledges
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        DATE_FORMAT(awarded_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS awarded_date_label
    FROM pledges
),
exploded_detail_pledges AS (
    -- One row per pledge
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.pledge_amount,
        s.awarded_date,
        s.awarded_date_label,
        p.id AS pledge_id,
        p.awarded_date AS pledge_awarded_date,
        p.cause_area AS pledge_cause_area
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN pledges p ON p.donor_ref = s.donor_ref
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach donor attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.pledge_amount,
        s.awarded_date,
        s.awarded_date_label,
        s.pledge_id,
        s.pledge_cause_area,
        d.gift_cnt AS donor_gift_cnt,
        d.grant_stage AS donor_grant_stage
    FROM exploded_detail_pledges s
    JOIN donors d ON d.id = s.donor_ref
    WHERE d.grant_stage = 'awarded'
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching pledges
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pledges p
            WHERE p.donor_ref = s.donor_ref
              AND p.awarded_date IS NOT NULL
        )
),
donor_grant_stage_stats AS (
    -- Median donor_gift_cnt per donor_grant_stage
    SELECT donor_grant_stage, PERCENTILE_APPROX(donor_gift_cnt, 0.5) AS median_donor_gift_cnt
    FROM qualified
    GROUP BY donor_grant_stage
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_donor_gift_cnt,
        ROUND(s.donor_gift_cnt - g.median_donor_gift_cnt, 2) AS donor_gift_cnt_minus_median
    FROM qualified s
    JOIN donor_grant_stage_stats g ON g.donor_grant_stage = s.donor_grant_stage
    WHERE s.donor_gift_cnt >= g.median_donor_gift_cnt
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach pledges metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pledges p WHERE p.donor_ref = s.donor_ref) AS pledge_count
    FROM vs_group s
)
SELECT

    pledge_amount,
    awarded_date,
    awarded_date_label,
    pledge_cause_area,
    donor_gift_cnt,
    donor_grant_stage,
    median_donor_gift_cnt,
    donor_gift_cnt_minus_median
FROM with_stats
WHERE donor_ref <= 21

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_nights,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags
    FROM grooming_jobs
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_at per pets_reg_id
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id ORDER BY groomed_at, id) AS prev_groomed_at
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id ORDER BY groomed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        pets_reg_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(groomed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(kennel_nights) AS session_kennel_nights,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    CASE WHEN burst_id >= 4 THEN 'A' WHEN burst_id >= 3 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS burst_id_tier
FROM sessions
WHERE burst_id >= 3
ORDER BY session_end DESC

prepared = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .select(
        "id",
        "pets_reg_id",
        "kennel_nights",
        "groomed_at",
        "diet_tags",
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_groomed_at", F.lag("groomed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id").orderBy("groomed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("groomed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_groomed_at")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id").orderBy("groomed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("pets_reg_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(

        F.max("groomed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("kennel_nights").alias("session_kennel_nights"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("groomed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("groomed_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .filter(F.col("burst_id") >= 3)
    .select(
        "pets_reg_id",
        "session_end",
        "event_count",
        F.when(F.col("burst_id") >= 4, "A").when(F.col("burst_id") >= 3, "B").otherwise("C").alias("burst_id_tier"),

)

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(donor_segment), ' ', '_')) AS donor_segment_slug,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(donor_segment), 1, 2) AS donor_segment_prefix
    FROM volunteer_shifts
    WHERE donor_segment IN ('grassroots', 'mid')
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        donor_segment,
        goal_amount,
        donor_segment_prefix,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_campaigns_ch_id_by_pledged_d AS pledged_date_tercile,
        SUM(goal_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS goal_amount_sum_2_prior,
        ROUND(AVG(goal_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment), 2) AS donor_segment_avg_goal_amount,
        FIRST_VALUE(goal_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_goal_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_date) ORDER BY goal_amount) AS goal_amount_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date DESC) AS pledged_date_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date DESC NULLS FIRST) AS pledged_date_dense_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(campaigns_ch_id) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment)) AS distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_campaigns_ch_id_donor_segmen, 3) AS pledged_date_cume_dist,
        LEAD(goal_amount, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_date) ORDER BY goal_amount, id) AS next_goal_amount
    FROM scoped
    WINDOW w_campaigns_ch_id_by_pledged_d AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date DESC, id), w_campaigns_ch_id_donor_segmen AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id, donor_segment ORDER BY pledged_date, id)
),
top_rows AS (
    -- Top 2 per group
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        donor_segment,
        goal_amount,
        donor_segment_prefix,
        pledged_date_tercile,
        goal_amount_sum_2_prior,
        donor_segment_avg_goal_amount,
        first_goal_amount,
        goal_amount_dense_rank,
        pledged_date_rank,
        distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment,
        pledged_date_cume_dist,
        next_goal_amount
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE pledged_date_dense_rank <= 2
),
stats AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        pledged_date_rank,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        SUM(distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment) AS total_distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN donor_segment NOT IN ('mid', 'grassroots') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_donor_segment_not_in_mid_gra,
        MIN(pledged_date_tercile) AS min_pledged_date_tercile
    FROM top_rows
    GROUP BY pledged_date_rank
),
with_trends_2 AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        pledged_date_rank,
        n_rows,
        total_distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment,
        min_pledged_date_tercile,
        ROUND(AVG(n_rows) OVER w_n_rows, 2) AS n_rows_avg_n_rows,
        ROUND(n_rows - AVG(n_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows), 2) AS n_rows_vs_n_rows_avg,
        ROUND(pledged_date_rank - AVG(pledged_date_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows), 2) AS pledged_date_rank_vs_n_rows_avg,
        pledged_date_rank - LAG(pledged_date_rank) OVER w_all_by_pct_donor_segment_not AS pledged_date_rank_change
    FROM stats
    WINDOW w_n_rows AS (PARTITION BY n_rows), w_all_by_pct_donor_segment_not AS (ORDER BY pct_donor_segment_not_in_mid_gra NULLS LAST, pledged_date_rank)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    pledged_date_rank,
    n_rows,
    total_distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment,
    n_rows_avg_n_rows,
    pledged_date_rank_vs_n_rows_avg,
    pledged_date_rank_change,
    ROUND(n_rows_vs_n_rows_avg / NULLIF(n_rows_avg_n_rows, 0), 3) AS n_rows_vs_n_rows_avg_per_n_rows_avg_n_rows,
    ABS(n_rows - 4) AS n_rows_distance
FROM with_trends_2

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_volunteer_shifts
    .filter(F.col("donor_segment").isin("grassroots", "mid"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "campaigns_ch_id",
        "grant_stage",
        "donor_segment",
        "goal_amount",
        "pledged_date",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("donor_segment")), " ", "_")).alias("donor_segment_slug"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("donor_segment")), 1, 2).alias("donor_segment_prefix"),
    )
)

w_campaigns_ch_id_by_pledged_d = Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_id").orderBy(F.col("pledged_date").desc(), "id")
w_campaigns_ch_id_donor_segmen = Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_id", "donor_segment").orderBy("pledged_date", "id")
with_trends = (
    scoped
    .select(
        "id",
        "campaigns_ch_id",
        "donor_segment",
        "goal_amount",
        "donor_segment_prefix",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_campaigns_ch_id_by_pledged_d).alias("pledged_date_tercile"),
        F.sum("goal_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("grant_stage", "campaigns_ch_id").orderBy(F.col("pledged_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("goal_amount_sum_2_prior"),
        F.round(F.avg("goal_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("donor_segment")), 2).alias("donor_segment_avg_goal_amount"),
        F.first("goal_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("grant_stage", "campaigns_ch_id").orderBy(F.col("pledged_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_goal_amount"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_id", F.date_trunc("month", "pledged_date")).orderBy("goal_amount")).alias("goal_amount_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_id").orderBy(F.col("pledged_date").desc())).alias("pledged_date_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("grant_stage", "campaigns_ch_id").orderBy(F.col("pledged_date").desc_nulls_first())).alias("pledged_date_dense_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("campaigns_ch_id").over(Window.partitionBy("donor_segment"))).alias("distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_campaigns_ch_id_donor_segmen), 3).alias("pledged_date_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("goal_amount", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_id", F.date_trunc("month", "pledged_date")).orderBy("goal_amount", "id")).alias("next_goal_amount"),
    )
)

top_rows = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("pledged_date_dense_rank") <= 2)
    .drop("pledged_date_dense_rank")
)

stats = (
    top_rows
    .groupBy("pledged_date_rank")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.sum("distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment").alias("total_distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(~F.col("donor_segment").isin("mid", "grassroots"), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_donor_segment_not_in_mid_gra"),
        F.min("pledged_date_tercile").alias("min_pledged_date_tercile"),
    )
)

w_n_rows = Window.partitionBy("n_rows")
w_all_by_pct_donor_segment_not = Window.orderBy(F.col("pct_donor_segment_not_in_mid_gra").asc_nulls_last(), "pledged_date_rank")
with_trends_2 = (
    stats
    .select(
        "pledged_date_rank",
        "n_rows",
        "total_distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment",
        "min_pledged_date_tercile",
        F.round(F.avg("n_rows").over(w_n_rows), 2).alias("n_rows_avg_n_rows"),
        F.round(F.col("n_rows") - F.avg("n_rows").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows")), 2).alias("n_rows_vs_n_rows_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("pledged_date_rank") - F.avg("pledged_date_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows")), 2).alias("pledged_date_rank_vs_n_rows_avg"),
        (F.col("pledged_date_rank") - F.lag("pledged_date_rank").over(w_all_by_pct_donor_segment_not)).alias("pledged_date_rank_change"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends_2
    .select(
        "pledged_date_rank",
        "n_rows",
        "total_distinct_campaigns_ch_id_in_donor_segment",

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        deal_status,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE deal_status IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(arrived_on, LAG(arrived_on) OVER w_all_by_arrived_on) AS days_since_prev_arrived_on,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status ORDER BY arrived_on) AS arrived_on_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST) AS arrived_on_dense_rank_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_deal_status_by_arrived_on AS seq_no,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status ORDER BY arrived_on, id) AS arrived_on_decile
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_all_by_arrived_on AS (ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id), w_deal_status_by_arrived_on AS (PARTITION BY deal_status ORDER BY arrived_on, id)
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching test_drives
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM test_drives t
            WHERE t.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
              AND t.deal_status IS NOT NULL
              AND t.arrived_on < DATE '2024-10-24'
        )
),
drive_outcome_stats AS (
    -- Avg arrived_on_decile per drive_outcome
    SELECT drive_outcome, AVG(arrived_on_decile) AS avg_arrived_on_decile
    FROM without_matches
    GROUP BY drive_outcome
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_arrived_on_decile,
        ROUND(s.arrived_on_decile - g.avg_arrived_on_decile, 2) AS arrived_on_decile_minus_avg
    FROM without_matches s
    JOIN drive_outcome_stats g ON g.drive_outcome = s.drive_outcome
    WHERE s.arrived_on_decile > g.avg_arrived_on_decile
)
SELECT
    arrived_on_dense_rank,
    arrived_on_decile,
    DATEDIFF(MAX(arrived_on), MIN(arrived_on)) AS arrived_on_span_days
FROM compared
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((arrived_on_dense_rank, arrived_on_decile), (arrived_on_dense_rank), (arrived_on_decile))
ORDER BY arrived_on_dense_rank NULLS LAST, arrived_on_decile NULLS LAST

WITH scoped_missions AS (
    -- Scope the missions rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        is_reusable
    FROM missions
    WHERE burn_secs < 454
      AND rocket_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per mission_state, rocket_id
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        is_reusable
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, rocket_id ORDER BY apogee_km, id) AS recency_rank
        FROM scoped_missions
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
mission_state_stats AS (
    -- Avg apogee_km per mission_state
    SELECT mission_state, AVG(apogee_km) AS avg_apogee_km
    FROM latest
    GROUP BY mission_state
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_apogee_km,
        ROUND(s.apogee_km - g.avg_apogee_km, 2) AS apogee_km_minus_avg
    FROM latest s
    JOIN mission_state_stats g ON g.mission_state = s.mission_state
    WHERE s.apogee_km > g.avg_apogee_km
)
SELECT
    id,
    rocket_id,
    mission_state,
    burn_secs,
    apogee_km,
    launched_on,
    avg_apogee_km
FROM outliers
WHERE is_reusable = TRUE
ORDER BY burn_secs

WITH sedan_by_showroom AS (
    -- sedan rows per showroom_id
    SELECT showroom_id, COUNT(*) AS sedan_count, ROUND(AVG(term_months), 2) AS sedan_avg_term_months
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE body_style = 'sedan'
    GROUP BY showroom_id
),
pickup_by_showroom AS (
    -- pickup rows per showroom_id
    SELECT showroom_id, COUNT(*) AS pickup_count, SUM(term_months) AS pickup_total_term_months
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE body_style = 'pickup'
    GROUP BY showroom_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.showroom_id, b.showroom_id) AS showroom_id,
    COALESCE(a.sedan_count, 0) AS sedan_count,
    COALESCE(a.sedan_avg_term_months, 0) AS sedan_avg_term_months,
    COALESCE(b.pickup_count, 0) AS pickup_count,
    COALESCE(b.pickup_total_term_months, 0) AS pickup_total_term_months,
    COALESCE(a.sedan_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.pickup_count, 0) AS sedan_count_minus_pickup_count
FROM sedan_by_showroom a
FULL OUTER JOIN pickup_by_showroom b
  ON a.showroom_id = b.showroom_id
ORDER BY showroom_id

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', vin_tail, deal_status) AS vin_tail_deal_status_label,
        CONCAT(vin_tail, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS vin_tail_ref,
        COALESCE(odometer_kms, 0) AS odometer_kms_filled
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE deal_status IN ('signed', 'quoted')
      AND NOT is_certified_used
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        vin_tail_deal_status_label,
        vin_tail_ref,
        odometer_kms_filled,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', arrived_on) AS days_since_arrived_on,
        ROUND(odometer_kms / NULLIF(drive_mins, 0), 3) AS odometer_kms_per_drive_mins,
        CASE WHEN odometer_kms >= 108512 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN odometer_kms >= 70813 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS odometer_kms_tier
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE deal_status NOT IN ('funded', 'quoted')
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per odometer_kms_tier, car_stock_id
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        vin_tail_deal_status_label,
        vin_tail_ref,
        odometer_kms_filled,
        days_since_arrived_on,
        odometer_kms_per_drive_mins,
        odometer_kms_tier
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY odometer_kms_tier, car_stock_id ORDER BY odometer_kms_per_drive_mins, id) AS rn
        FROM tagged
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        is_certified_used,
        car_stock_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(vin_tail)) LIKE 'D%') AS n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(odometer_kms_filled, 0.5) AS median_odometer_kms_filled,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        MAX(odometer_kms_per_drive_mins) AS max_odometer_kms_per_drive_mins,
        ROUND(SUM(odometer_kms) / NULLIF(SUM(odometer_kms_per_drive_mins), 0), 3) AS odometer_kms_to_odometer_kms_per_drive_mins_rati
    FROM unique_rows
    WHERE vin_tail_deal_status_label IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY is_certified_used, car_stock_id
),
test_drive_stats AS (
    -- Per-car_stock test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        car_stock_id,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins), 2) AS avg_test_drive_drive_mins,
        SUM(drive_mins) AS total_test_drive_drive_mins,
        MIN(arrived_on) AS first_test_drive_arrived_on
    FROM test_drives
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.avg_test_drive_drive_mins,
        t.total_test_drive_drive_mins,
        t.first_test_drive_arrived_on
    FROM stats s
    LEFT JOIN test_drive_stats t ON t.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d,
        s.median_odometer_kms_filled,
        s.n_rows,
        s.odometer_kms_to_odometer_kms_per_drive_mins_rati,
        s.avg_test_drive_drive_mins,
        s.total_test_drive_drive_mins,
        s.first_test_drive_arrived_on,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
combined_details_car_stock AS (
    -- Attach car_stock attributes
    SELECT
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d,
        s.median_odometer_kms_filled,
        s.odometer_kms_to_odometer_kms_per_drive_mins_rati,
        s.avg_test_drive_drive_mins,
        s.total_test_drive_drive_mins,
        s.car_stock_arrived_date,
        s.car_stock_vin_tail,
        s.car_stock_body_style,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date_2,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months,
        sh.drive_minutes AS showroom_drive_minutes,
        sh.deal_state AS showroom_deal_state
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
)
SELECT
    is_certified_used,
    car_stock_id,
    n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d,
    median_odometer_kms_filled,
    odometer_kms_to_odometer_kms_per_drive_mins_rati,
    avg_test_drive_drive_mins,
    total_test_drive_drive_mins,
    car_stock_arrived_date,
    car_stock_vin_tail,
    car_stock_body_style,
    car_stock_showroom_id,
    car_stock_arrived_date_2,
    car_stock_term_months,
    showroom_drive_minutes,
    showroom_deal_state
FROM combined_details_car_stock
ORDER BY car_stock_arrived_date NULLS LAST, n_upper_trim_vin_tail_like_d DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH base_pump_stations AS (
    -- Scope the pump_stations rows
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref,
        CONCAT_WS('-', tariff_band, station_tier) AS tariff_band_station_tier_label
    FROM pump_stations
    WHERE meter_age_yrs <= 18
      AND MONTH(burst_ts) IN (1, 3)
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, LOWER(TRIM(street_ref)) AS street_ref_clean
    FROM base_pump_stations
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach pipe_bursts metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(p.meter_fitted_on) FROM pipe_bursts p WHERE p.pump_station_id = s.id) AS first_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
        (SELECT MIN(p.meter_fitted_on) FROM pipe_bursts p WHERE p.pump_station_id = s.id) AS first_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on_2,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.flow_lpm), 2) FROM pipe_bursts p WHERE p.pump_station_id = s.id) AS avg_pipe_burst_flow_lpm
    FROM scored s
)
SELECT id, field, value
FROM (
    SELECT id, avg_pipe_burst_flow_lpm, pressure_bar
    FROM summarized_rows
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    value FOR field IN (avg_pipe_burst_flow_lpm AS avg_pipe_burst_flow_lpm_v, pressure_bar AS m_pressure_bar)
) unp
ORDER BY id, field

WITH recent_missions AS (
    -- Scope the missions rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        launched_on
    FROM missions
    WHERE apogee_km <= 23945.2
),
with_details_rocket AS (
    -- Attach rocket attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.rocket_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.burn_secs,
        s.launched_on,
        r.mission_status AS rocket_mission_status
    FROM recent_missions s
    JOIN rockets r ON r.id = s.rocket_id AND r.burn_seconds >= 128
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_mission_status, rocket_id ORDER BY burn_secs DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(rocket_id) OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_mission_status, mission_state)) AS distinct_rocket_id_in_rocket_mission_status_miss,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_burn_secs AS burn_secs_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY burn_secs ASC, id) AS burn_secs_tercile,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY launched_on DESC, id) AS launched_on_rank,
        ROUND(burn_secs / NULLIF(SUM(burn_secs) OVER w_rocket_mission_status_missio, 0), 4) AS burn_secs_share_of_rocket_mission_status_mission,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_burn_secs, 3) AS burn_secs_cume_dist
    FROM with_details_rocket
    WINDOW w_all_by_burn_secs AS (ORDER BY burn_secs, id), w_rocket_mission_status_missio AS (PARTITION BY rocket_mission_status, mission_state)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        launched_on,
        rocket_mission_status,
        seq_no,
        distinct_rocket_id_in_rocket_mission_status_miss,
        burn_secs_tercile,
        launched_on_rank,
        burn_secs_share_of_rocket_mission_status_mission,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY launched_on_rank) AS rows_in_launched_on_rank,
        ROUND(burn_secs - AVG(burn_secs) OVER (PARTITION BY launched_on_rank), 2) AS burn_secs_vs_launched_on_rank_avg,
        SUM(burn_secs_tercile) OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_mission_status, burn_secs_tercile ORDER BY burn_secs, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS burn_secs_tercile_sum_1_prior,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(rocket_id) OVER (PARTITION BY launched_on_rank)) AS distinct_rocket_id_in_launched_on_rank,
        MAX(launched_on_rank) OVER w_launched_on_rank AS launched_on_rank_max_launched_on_rank
    FROM with_trends
    WINDOW w_launched_on_rank AS (PARTITION BY launched_on_rank)
)
SELECT
    id,
    rocket_id,
    rocket_mission_status,
    seq_no,
    burn_secs_tercile,
    burn_secs_share_of_rocket_mission_status_mission,
    rows_in_launched_on_rank,
    burn_secs_vs_launched_on_rank_avg,
    burn_secs_tercile_sum_1_prior,
    distinct_rocket_id_in_launched_on_rank,
    launched_on_rank_max_launched_on_rank,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rocket_mission_status), ' ', '_')) AS rocket_mission_status_slug
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY burn_secs_tercile DESC NULLS FIRST, burn_secs_vs_launched_on_rank_avg

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(grant_stage), 1, 2) AS grant_stage_prefix
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE campaigns_ch_ref <= 25
      AND donor_segment IS NOT NULL
),
donor_segment_stats AS (
    -- Max volunteer_hrs per donor_segment
    SELECT donor_segment, MAX(volunteer_hrs) AS max_volunteer_hrs
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY donor_segment
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_volunteer_hrs,
        ROUND(s.volunteer_hrs - g.max_volunteer_hrs, 2) AS volunteer_hrs_minus_max
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN donor_segment_stats g ON g.donor_segment = s.donor_segment
    WHERE s.volunteer_hrs = g.max_volunteer_hrs
),
grant_award_stats AS (
    -- Per-campaigns_ch grant_awards metrics
    SELECT
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        MIN(pledged_on) AS first_grant_award_pledged_on,
        SUM(volunteer_hrs) AS total_grant_award_volunteer_hrs
    FROM grant_awards
    GROUP BY campaigns_ch_ref
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach grant_awards metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.first_grant_award_pledged_on,
        g.total_grant_award_volunteer_hrs
    FROM compared s
    LEFT JOIN grant_award_stats g ON g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_ref
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(volunteer_hrs, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', first_grant_award_pledged_on) ORDER BY max_volunteer_hrs DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_volunteer_hrs,
        MAX(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', first_grant_award_pledged_on) ORDER BY max_volunteer_hrs DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS volunteer_hrs_max_7,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs / NULLIF(SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_campaigns_ch_ref_donor_segme, 0), 4) AS volunteer_hrs_share_of_campaigns_ch_ref_donor_se,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_campaigns_ch_ref_by_voluntee AS volunteer_hrs_minus_max_dense_rank,
        MAX(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, donor_segment ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_volunteer_hrs_so_far,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', first_grant_award_pledged_on) ORDER BY max_volunteer_hrs DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS max_volunteer_hrs_tercile
    FROM profiled
    WINDOW w_campaigns_ch_ref_donor_segme AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_ref, donor_segment), w_campaigns_ch_ref_by_voluntee AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_ref ORDER BY volunteer_hrs_minus_max ASC)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        grant_stage_prefix,
        volunteer_hrs_minus_max,
        first_grant_award_pledged_on,
        total_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
        volunteer_hrs_max_7,
        volunteer_hrs_minus_max_dense_rank,
        max_volunteer_hrs_so_far,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_volunteer_hrs, 3) AS volunteer_hrs_percent_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(donor_segment) OVER w_grant_stage) AS distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_all_by_volunteer_hrs AS volunteer_hrs_decile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY volunteer_hrs_minus_max_dense_rank, max_volunteer_hrs_tercile ORDER BY max_volunteer_hrs_tercile ASC, id) AS rn,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs - AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage), 2) AS volunteer_hrs_vs_grant_stage_avg,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY volunteer_hrs ASC, id) AS volunteer_hrs_quartile
    FROM sequenced
    WINDOW w_all_by_volunteer_hrs AS (ORDER BY volunteer_hrs ASC, id), w_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage)
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(grant_stage_prefix, '#', CAST(rn AS STRING)) AS grant_stage_prefix_ref,
        COALESCE(donor_segment, 'UNKNOWN') AS donor_segment_or_unknown
    FROM metrics
),
tagged_2 AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(volunteer_hrs_quartile / 2) * 2 AS volunteer_hrs_quartile_bucket
    FROM tagged
    WHERE volunteer_hrs_decile <= 9
)
SELECT
    id,
    donor_segment,
    grant_stage_prefix,
    volunteer_hrs_minus_max,
    total_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
    volunteer_hrs_max_7,
    max_volunteer_hrs_so_far,
    volunteer_hrs_percent_rank,
    distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
    volunteer_hrs_decile,
    rn,
    volunteer_hrs_quartile,
    grant_stage_prefix_ref,
    donor_segment_or_unknown,
    volunteer_hrs_quartile_bucket
FROM tagged_2
ORDER BY volunteer_hrs_quartile DESC, max_volunteer_hrs_so_far, id
LIMIT 5

w_campaigns_ch_ref_donor_segme = Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_ref", "donor_segment")
w_campaigns_ch_ref_by_voluntee = Window.partitionBy("campaigns_ch_ref").orderBy("volunteer_hrs_minus_max")
sequenced = (
    profiled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("volunteer_hrs", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("donor_segment", F.date_trunc("month", "first_grant_award_pledged_on")).orderBy(F.col("max_volunteer_hrs").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_volunteer_hrs"),
        F.max("volunteer_hrs").over(Window.partitionBy("donor_segment", F.date_trunc("month", "first_grant_award_pledged_on")).orderBy(F.col("max_volunteer_hrs").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("volunteer_hrs_max_7"),
        F.round(F.col("volunteer_hrs") / F.nullif(F.sum("volunteer_hrs").over(w_campaigns_ch_ref_donor_segme), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("volunteer_hrs_share_of_campaigns_ch_ref_donor_se"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_campaigns_ch_ref_by_voluntee).alias("volunteer_hrs_minus_max_dense_rank"),
        F.max("volunteer_hrs").over(Window.partitionBy("grant_stage", "donor_segment").orderBy(F.col("volunteer_hrs").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_volunteer_hrs_so_far"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("donor_segment", F.date_trunc("month", "first_grant_award_pledged_on")).orderBy(F.col("max_volunteer_hrs").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("max_volunteer_hrs_tercile"),
    )
)

w_all_by_volunteer_hrs = Window.orderBy("volunteer_hrs", "id")
w_grant_stage = Window.partitionBy("grant_stage")
metrics = (

        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_volunteer_hrs), 3).alias("volunteer_hrs_percent_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("donor_segment").over(w_grant_stage)).alias("distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_all_by_volunteer_hrs).alias("volunteer_hrs_decile"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("volunteer_hrs_minus_max_dense_rank", "max_volunteer_hrs_tercile").orderBy("max_volunteer_hrs_tercile", "id")).alias("rn"),

        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("volunteer_hrs", "id")).alias("volunteer_hrs_quartile"),
    )
)

tagged = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat(F.col("grant_stage_prefix"), F.lit("#"), F.col("rn").cast("string")).alias("grant_stage_prefix_ref"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("donor_segment"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("donor_segment_or_unknown"),
    )

tagged_2 = (

result = (
    tagged_2

        "volunteer_hrs_max_7",

        "volunteer_hrs_percent_rank",

    )

WITH success_monthly AS (
    -- success rows per frame_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', frame_at) AS frame_at_month, COUNT(*) AS success_count, ROUND(AVG(frame_seq), 2) AS success_avg_frame_seq
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE mission_state = 'success'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', frame_at)
),
lost_monthly AS (
    -- lost rows per frame_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', frame_at) AS frame_at_month, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(AVG(frame_seq), 2) AS lost_avg_frame_seq
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE mission_state = 'lost'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', frame_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.frame_at_month, b.frame_at_month) AS frame_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.success_count, 0) AS success_count,
    COALESCE(a.success_avg_frame_seq, 0) AS success_avg_frame_seq,
    COALESCE(b.lost_count, 0) AS lost_count,
    b.lost_avg_frame_seq,
    COALESCE(a.success_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.lost_count, 0) AS success_count_minus_lost_count
FROM success_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN lost_monthly b
  ON a.frame_at_month = b.frame_at_month
ORDER BY frame_at_month

success_monthly = (
    df_telemetry_frames

    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "frame_at").alias("frame_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("success_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("frame_seq"), 2).alias("success_avg_frame_seq"),
    )
)

lost_monthly = (
    df_telemetry_frames
    .filter(F.col("mission_state") == "lost")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "frame_at").alias("frame_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("lost_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("frame_seq"), 2).alias("lost_avg_frame_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    success_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(lost_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.frame_at_month") == F.col("b.frame_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.frame_at_month"), F.col("b.frame_at_month")).alias("frame_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.success_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("success_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.success_avg_frame_seq"), F.lit(0)).alias("success_avg_frame_seq"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.lost_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("lost_count"),
        F.col("b.lost_avg_frame_seq"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.success_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.lost_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("success_count_minus_lost_count"),

WITH recent_missions AS (
    -- Scope the missions rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        is_reusable,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', launched_on) AS launched_on_month,
        CONCAT(mission_state, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS mission_state_ref,
        IF(is_reusable, 'yes', 'no') AS is_reusable_label
    FROM missions
    WHERE launched_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-03-20' AND DATE '2025-05-29'
      AND NOT is_reusable
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach payload_items metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(p.launched_on) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS first_payload_item_launched_on,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS payload_item_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS payload_item_count_2
    FROM recent_missions s
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_stats s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.id
              AND p.launched_on < DATE '2025-06-24'
        )
),
with_children_payload_items AS (
    -- One row per payload_item
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.rocket_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.apogee_km,
        s.mission_state_ref,
        s.payload_item_count_2,
        p.id AS payload_item_id,
        p.launched_on AS payload_item_launched_on,
        p.frame_seq AS payload_item_frame_seq,
        p.site_country AS payload_item_site_country,
        p.payload_kg AS payload_item_payload_kg
    FROM screened s
    JOIN payload_items p ON p.mission_id = s.id
),
joined_payload_item AS (
    -- Attach payload_item attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.launched_on AS payload_item_launched_on_2
    FROM with_children_payload_items s
    LEFT JOIN payload_items p ON p.id = s.payload_item_id
),
with_parent_rocket AS (
    -- Join rockets
    SELECT
        s.*,
        r.burn_seconds AS rocket_burn_seconds,
        r.stage_cnt AS rocket_stage_cnt,
        r.frame_seq AS rocket_frame_seq
    FROM joined_payload_item s
    JOIN rockets r ON r.id = s.rocket_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    rocket_id,
    mission_state,
    apogee_km,
    payload_item_count_2,
    payload_item_id,
    payload_item_launched_on,
    payload_item_frame_seq,
    payload_item_site_country,
    rocket_burn_seconds,
    rocket_frame_seq,
    ROUND(apogee_km / NULLIF(payload_item_payload_kg, 0), 3) AS apogee_km_per_payload_item_payload_kg
FROM with_parent_rocket
ORDER BY apogee_km, payload_item_site_country DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH scoped_vet_visits AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        groom_mins,
        pet_age_yrs
    FROM vet_visits
    WHERE kennel_size = 'M'
),
pets_reg_id_stats AS (
    -- Median groom_mins per pets_reg_id
    SELECT pets_reg_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(groom_mins, 0.5) AS median_groom_mins
    FROM scoped_vet_visits
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_groom_mins,
        ROUND(s.groom_mins - g.median_groom_mins, 2) AS groom_mins_minus_median
    FROM scoped_vet_visits s
    JOIN pets_reg_id_stats g ON g.pets_reg_id = s.pets_reg_id
    WHERE s.groom_mins >= g.median_groom_mins
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(TRIM(kennel_size)) AS kennel_size_clean,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(kennel_size), 1, 2) AS kennel_size_prefix,
        UPPER(TRIM(kennel_size)) AS kennel_size_clean_2
    FROM above_average
    WHERE median_groom_mins < 148.0
)
SELECT id, metric_name, amount
FROM (
    SELECT id, groom_mins_minus_median, median_groom_mins
    FROM scored
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    amount FOR metric_name IN (groom_mins_minus_median, median_groom_mins)
) unp

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter finance_deals
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        odometer_kms,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_quarter,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', arrived_on) AS days_since_arrived_on
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE LOWER(vin_tail) LIKE '%09%'
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        vin_tail,
        arrived_on_quarter,
        days_since_arrived_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(arrived_on_quarter) OVER (ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_arrived_on_quarter,
        SUM(days_since_arrived_on) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS days_since_arrived_on_sum_3_prior,
        MAX(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id) AS car_stock_id_max_odometer_kms,
        ROUND(days_since_arrived_on / NULLIF(SUM(days_since_arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id), 0), 4) AS days_since_arrived_on_share_of_car_stock_id,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        ROUND(AVG(days_since_arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id), 2) AS car_stock_id_avg_days_since_arrived_on,
        NTH_VALUE(arrived_on_quarter, 2) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_arrived_on_quarter,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id) AS rows_in_car_stock_id,
        LEAD(days_since_arrived_on) OVER w_all_by_days_since_arrived_on_3 AS next_days_since_arrived_on,
        LEAD(days_since_arrived_on, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on, id) AS next_days_since_arrived_on_2,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_odometer_kms_ties, 3) AS odometer_kms_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_all_by_days_since_arrived_on_3 AS (ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on ASC, id), w_all_by_odometer_kms_ties AS (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(TRIM(vin_tail), 1, 2) AS vin_tail_prefix
    FROM sequenced
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    days_since_arrived_on,
    first_arrived_on_quarter,
    days_since_arrived_on_sum_3_prior,
    days_since_arrived_on_share_of_car_stock_id,
    running_count,
    second_arrived_on_quarter,
    next_days_since_arrived_on,
    next_days_since_arrived_on_2,
    odometer_kms_cume_dist,
    vin_tail_prefix,
    CASE WHEN days_since_arrived_on >= 595 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN days_since_arrived_on >= 175 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS days_since_arrived_on_tier
FROM scored
ORDER BY next_days_since_arrived_on_2 DESC

WITH filtered_car_stocks AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_id,
        body_style,
        term_months,
        arrived_date,
        vin_tail
    FROM car_stock
    WHERE term_months > 43
      AND arrived_date IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_showroom AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT s.*, sh.signed_on AS showroom_signed_on
    FROM filtered_car_stocks s
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_id
),
with_details AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_id,
        s.body_style,
        s.term_months,
        s.arrived_date,
        sh.deal_state AS showroom_deal_state,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail
    FROM enriched_showroom s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_id
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    showroom_deal_state,
    body_style,
    SUM(term_months) AS total_term_months,
    SUM(term_months) FILTER (WHERE showroom_vin_tail IS NOT NULL) AS term_months_showroom_vin_tail_is_not_nul,
    SUM(term_months) FILTER (WHERE showroom_deal_state <> 'funded') AS term_months_showroom_deal_state_funded
FROM with_details
GROUP BY ROLLUP(showroom_deal_state, body_style)
