WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        CASE WHEN odometer_km >= 156083 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN odometer_km >= 95170 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS odometer_km_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', drive_started_at) AS drive_started_at_month,
        IF(is_certified_used, 'yes', 'no') AS is_certified_used_label
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE is_certified_used = TRUE
),
screened AS (
    -- Keep rows whose showroom matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM showrooms sh
            WHERE sh.id = s.showroom_ref
              AND sh.deal_state IN ('signed', 'funded')
              AND sh.signed_on >= DATE '2024-10-12'
        )
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        showroom_ref,
        is_certified_used_label,
        MIN(odometer_km) AS min_odometer_km
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY showroom_ref, is_certified_used_label
),
combined_details_showroom AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.is_certified_used_label,
        s.min_odometer_km,
        sh.option_tags AS showroom_option_tags,
        sh.drive_minutes AS showroom_drive_minutes,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail
    FROM totals s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN showroom_drive_minutes >= 75 THEN 'A' WHEN showroom_drive_minutes >= 33 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS showroom_drive_minutes_tier,
        ROUND(showroom_drive_minutes / NULLIF(min_odometer_km, 0), 3) AS showroom_drive_minutes_per_min_odometer_km,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(showroom_option_tags, 'sunroof') AS has_sunroof
    FROM combined_details_showroom
    WHERE LOWER(showroom_vin_tail) LIKE '%55%'
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    COALESCE(showroom_drive_minutes_tier, 'ALL') AS showroom_drive_minutes_tier,
    COALESCE(is_certified_used_label, 'ALL') AS is_certified_used_label,
    showroom_ref,
    SUM(showroom_drive_minutes_per_min_odometer_km) AS total_showroom_drive_minutes_per_min_odometer_km,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(showroom_vin_tail) LIKE '%23%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_lower_showroom_vin_tail_like,
    SUM(showroom_drive_minutes) AS total_showroom_drive_minutes
FROM labeled
GROUP BY ROLLUP(showroom_drive_minutes_tier, is_certified_used_label, showroom_ref)
ORDER BY showroom_drive_minutes_tier NULLS LAST, is_certified_used_label NULLS LAST, showroom_ref NULLS LAST

WITH prepared_usage_reads AS (
    -- Filter usage_reads
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        chlorine_ppm,
        usage_m3,
        burst_litres,
        meter_fitted_date
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE (usage_m3 <= 50.9 OR tariff_band IN ('factory', 'house'))
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        chlorine_ppm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_date,
        FIRST_VALUE(usage_m3) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier, MONTH(meter_fitted_date) ORDER BY burst_litres DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_usage_m3,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, tariff_band ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id), 3) AS chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, tariff_band ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC) AS chlorine_ppm_dense_rank,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier, MONTH(meter_fitted_date) ORDER BY burst_litres DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_chlorine_ppm_so_far,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY water_meter_id, tariff_band ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id) AS chlorine_ppm_quintile
    FROM prepared_usage_reads
),
first_rows AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        chlorine_ppm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_date,
        first_usage_m3,
        chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
        max_chlorine_ppm_so_far,
        chlorine_ppm_quintile
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE chlorine_ppm_dense_rank = 1
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        max_chlorine_ppm_so_far - usage_m3 AS max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3
    FROM first_rows
),
station_tier_stats AS (
    -- Median max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3 per station_tier
    SELECT station_tier, PERCENTILE_APPROX(max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3, 0.5) AS median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3
    FROM labeled
    GROUP BY station_tier
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3,
        ROUND(s.max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3 - g.median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3, 2) AS max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_minus_med
    FROM labeled s
    JOIN station_tier_stats g ON g.station_tier = s.station_tier
    WHERE s.max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3 >= g.median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY chlorine_ppm_quintile ORDER BY median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_avg_4,
        RANK() OVER w_meter_fitted_date_month_by_m AS max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY chlorine_ppm_quintile, YEAR(meter_fitted_date)), 2) AS chlorine_ppm_quintile_meter_fitted_date_year_avg,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(station_tier) OVER (PARTITION BY chlorine_ppm_quintile, YEAR(meter_fitted_date))) AS distinct_station_tier_in_chlorine_ppm_quintile_m,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY chlorine_ppm_quintile, station_tier ORDER BY chlorine_ppm_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_max_1_prior
    FROM vs_group
    WINDOW w_meter_fitted_date_month_by_m AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_date) ORDER BY max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3 DESC)
),
station_tier_stats_2 AS (
    -- Avg max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank per station_tier
    SELECT station_tier, AVG(max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank) AS avg_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY station_tier
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank,
        ROUND(s.max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank - g.avg_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank, 2) AS max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank_minu
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN station_tier_stats_2 g ON g.station_tier = s.station_tier
    WHERE s.max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank > g.avg_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank
)
-- Final projection
SELECT DISTINCT
    max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_minus_med,
    median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3
FROM outliers
ORDER BY max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_minus_med NULLS LAST

        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("water_meter_id", "tariff_band").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("water_meter_id", "tariff_band").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").desc())).alias("chlorine_ppm_dense_rank"),

        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("water_meter_id", "tariff_band").orderBy(F.col("chlorine_ppm").desc(), "id")).alias("chlorine_ppm_quintile"),
    )

labeled = (

    .withColumn("max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3", F.col("max_chlorine_ppm_so_far") - F.col("usage_m3"))

station_tier_stats = (

    .groupBy("station_tier")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3", 0.5).alias("median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3"))

    .filter(F.col("s.max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3") >= F.col("g.median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3"))
    .select(

        "g.median_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3",

)

        F.rank().over(w_meter_fitted_date_month_by_m).alias("max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy("chlorine_ppm_quintile", F.year("meter_fitted_date"))), 2).alias("chlorine_ppm_quintile_meter_fitted_date_year_avg"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("station_tier").over(Window.partitionBy("chlorine_ppm_quintile", F.year("meter_fitted_date")))).alias("distinct_station_tier_in_chlorine_ppm_quintile_m"),
        F.max("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist").over(Window.partitionBy("chlorine_ppm_quintile", "station_tier").orderBy("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("chlorine_ppm_cume_dist_max_1_prior"),

    .groupBy("station_tier")
    .agg(F.avg("max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank").alias("avg_max_chlorine_ppm_so_far_minus_usage_m3_rank"))

outliers = (

    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM finance_deals f
            WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
        )
      AND s.arrived_on >= DATE '2024-10-24'
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        is_fleet,
        SUM(drive_mins_distance) AS total_drive_mins_distance,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(vin_tail) LIKE '%31%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_lower_vin_tail_like_31,
        SUM(drive_mins) AS total_drive_mins
    FROM with_activity
    GROUP BY is_fleet
    HAVING SUM(drive_mins_distance) > 18
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        is_fleet,
        total_drive_mins_distance,
        n_lower_vin_tail_like_31,
        total_drive_mins,
        LAST_VALUE(total_drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY n_lower_vin_tail_like_31, is_fleet ORDER BY n_lower_vin_tail_like_31, is_fleet ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_total_drive_mins,
        LEAD(total_drive_mins, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY is_fleet ORDER BY total_drive_mins NULLS LAST, is_fleet) AS next_total_drive_mins,
        ROUND(total_drive_mins_distance / NULLIF(SUM(total_drive_mins_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY n_lower_vin_tail_like_31, is_fleet), 0), 4) AS total_drive_mins_distance_share_of_n_lower_vin_t
    FROM rollup_base
)

SELECT is_fleet, field, metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT is_fleet, last_total_drive_mins, total_drive_mins_distance, n_lower_vin_tail_like_31
    FROM with_windows
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR field IN (last_total_drive_mins, total_drive_mins_distance, n_lower_vin_tail_like_31)
) unp

WITH recent_kennels AS (
    -- Filter kennels
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts
    FROM kennels
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per species
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM recent_kennels
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_ts)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per species, visit_reason
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        prev_groomed_ts,
        new_session_flag,
        session_no
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY species, visit_reason ORDER BY session_no DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM sessionized
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT id, field, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, new_session_flag, session_no
    FROM latest_per_key
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR field IN (new_session_flag AS m_new_session_flag, session_no AS m_session_no)
) unp

WITH cleaned_finance_deals AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        vin_tail,
        ABS(drive_mins - 33) AS drive_mins_distance

with_details_car_stock AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.vin_tail,
        s.drive_mins_distance,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail
    FROM cleaned_finance_deals s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        vin_tail,
        car_stock_arrived_date,
        LAG(car_stock_arrived_date) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins_distance, id) AS prev_car_stock_arrived_date,
        SUM(drive_mins_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status) AS deal_status_sum_drive_mins_distance,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY car_stock_arrived_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS drive_mins_distance_avg_3,
        drive_mins_distance - LAG(drive_mins_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY car_stock_arrived_date DESC, id) AS drive_mins_distance_change,
        LAG(car_stock_arrived_date) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_distance DESC, id) AS prev_car_stock_arrived_date_2,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status) AS deal_status_sum_drive_mins,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY drive_mins_distance, id) AS drive_mins_distance_dense_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins_distance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        LAG(drive_mins_distance) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_distance DESC, id) AS prev_drive_mins_distance
    FROM with_details_car_stock
)
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    prev_car_stock_arrived_date,
    deal_status_sum_drive_mins_distance,
    drive_mins_distance_avg_3,
    drive_mins_distance_change,
    prev_car_stock_arrived_date_2,
    deal_status_sum_drive_mins,
    running_count,
    prev_drive_mins_distance,
    FLOOR(running_count / 5) * 5 AS running_count_bucket,
    GREATEST(prev_drive_mins_distance, running_count) AS greatest_prev_drive_mins_distance_running_count
FROM with_windows
WHERE deal_status_sum_drive_mins BETWEEN 184 AND 855
ORDER BY prev_car_stock_arrived_date NULLS LAST, drive_mins_distance_change DESC

WITH filtered_test_drives AS (
    -- Filter test_drives
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        COALESCE(deal_status, 'UNKNOWN') AS deal_status_or_unknown,
        QUARTER(arrived_on) AS arrived_on_quarter
    FROM test_drives
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on) ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter) AS arrived_on_quarter_dense_rank,
        ROUND(drive_mins - AVG(drive_mins) OVER w_drive_outcome, 2) AS drive_mins_vs_drive_outcome_avg,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status_or_unknown ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter), 3) AS arrived_on_quarter_cume_dist,
        arrived_on_quarter - LAG(arrived_on_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on) ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter, id) AS arrived_on_quarter_change
    FROM filtered_test_drives
    WINDOW w_drive_outcome AS (PARTITION BY drive_outcome)
),
test_drive_stats AS (
    -- Per-car_stock test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        car_stock_id,
        COUNT(*) AS test_drive_count,
        SUM(drive_mins) AS total_test_drive_drive_mins
    FROM test_drives
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.test_drive_count, 0) AS test_drive_count,
        t.total_test_drive_drive_mins
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN test_drive_stats t ON t.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
)
SELECT
    deal_status_or_unknown,
    drive_outcome,
    arrived_on_quarter,
    GROUPING(deal_status_or_unknown) AS is_total_deal_status_or_unknown,
    SUM(CASE WHEN drive_outcome NOT IN ('thinking', 'bought') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_drive_outcome_not_in_thinkin
FROM with_stats
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((deal_status_or_unknown, drive_outcome, arrived_on_quarter), (deal_status_or_unknown), ())
ORDER BY deal_status_or_unknown NULLS LAST, drive_outcome NULLS LAST, arrived_on_quarter NULLS LAST

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Filter pump_stations
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref,
        CONCAT_WS('|', station_tier, tariff_band) AS station_tier_tariff_band_label,
        DATE_FORMAT(burst_ts, 'yyyy-MM') AS burst_ts_label,
        burst_ts + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AS burst_ts_plus_30m
    FROM pump_stations
    WHERE LOWER(street_ref) LIKE '%l %'
),
pipe_burst_stats AS (
    -- Per-pump_station pipe_bursts metrics
    SELECT
        pump_station_id,
        MAX(meter_fitted_on) AS last_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
        MAX(meter_fitted_on) AS last_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on_2,
        MIN(meter_fitted_on) AS first_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on
    FROM pipe_bursts
    GROUP BY pump_station_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach pipe_bursts metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.last_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
        p.last_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on_2,
        p.first_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN pipe_burst_stats p ON p.pump_station_id = s.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(burst_ts), MONTH(last_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on)) AS rows_in_burst_ts_month_last_pipe_burst_meter_fit,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(burst_ts) ORDER BY burst_ts_plus_30m), 3) AS burst_ts_plus_30m_percent_rank
    FROM summarized_rows
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(pressure_bar * 0.25, 2) AS pressure_bar_adj,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(tariff_band), ' ', '_')) AS tariff_band_slug,
        ROUND(pressure_bar * 1.5, 2) AS pressure_bar_adj_2
    FROM metrics
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        pressure_bar,
        street_ref,
        station_tier_tariff_band_label,
        burst_ts_label,
        burst_ts_plus_30m,
        last_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
        first_pipe_burst_meter_fitted_on,
        rows_in_burst_ts_month_last_pipe_burst_meter_fit,
        pressure_bar_adj,
        tariff_band_slug,
        pressure_bar_adj_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pressure_bar, id) AS pressure_bar_seq,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY pressure_bar, id) AS pressure_bar_quartile,
        FIRST_VALUE(pressure_bar) OVER (ORDER BY pressure_bar, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_pressure_bar,

WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the grooming_jobs rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        visit_reason,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags,
        COALESCE(pet_weight_kg, 0.0) AS pet_weight_kg_filled,
        FLOOR(pet_age_yrs / 5) * 5 AS pet_age_yrs_bucket,
        groomed_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS AS groomed_at_plus_2h
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE pet_weight_kg < 41.0
      AND SIZE(diet_tags) >= 2
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Keep rows whose pets_reg matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pets_reg p
            WHERE p.id = s.pets_reg_id
              AND p.kennel_nights < 27
        )
),
with_details_pets_reg AS (
    -- Attach pets_reg attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pets_reg_id,
        s.visit_reason,
        s.pet_weight_kg,
        s.kennel_nights,
        s.groomed_at,
        s.diet_tags,
        s.pet_age_yrs_bucket,
        p.pet_age_yrs AS pets_reg_pet_age_yrs,
        p.visit_day AS pets_reg_visit_day,
        p.coat_kind AS pets_reg_coat_kind,
        pe.groomed_ts AS pet_owner_groomed_ts
    FROM with_activity s
    JOIN pets_reg p ON p.id = s.pets_reg_id
    LEFT JOIN pet_owners pe ON pe.id = p.pet_owner_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(pet_weight_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, visit_reason) AS pets_reg_id_visit_reason_sum_pet_weight_kg,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY kennel_nights DESC, id) AS kennel_nights_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(pet_owner_groomed_ts) OVER (ORDER BY pet_weight_kg, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_pet_owner_groomed_ts,
        LAG(pets_reg_visit_day) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY kennel_nights DESC, id) AS prev_pets_reg_visit_day,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_visit_reason_by_kennel_night_2 AS kennel_nights_dense_rank
    FROM with_details_pets_reg
    WINDOW w_visit_reason_by_kennel_night_2 AS (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY kennel_nights DESC)
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(last_pet_owner_groomed_ts, 'yyyy-MM') AS last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym,
        visit_reason,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visit_reason NOT IN ('vaccine', 'checkup')) AS n_visit_reason_not_in_vaccine
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(last_pet_owner_groomed_ts, 'yyyy-MM'), visit_reason
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
ranked_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym,
        visit_reason,
        n_rows,
        n_visit_reason_not_in_vaccine,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(visit_reason) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows, n_visit_reason_not_in_vaccine)) AS distinct_visit_reason_in_n_rows_n_visit_reason_n,
        ROUND(AVG(n_rows) OVER (ORDER BY n_rows, last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym, visit_reason ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS n_rows_avg_3,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY n_rows, last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym, visit_reason ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count
    FROM stats
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(running_count, n_rows) AS least_running_count_n_rows,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(visit_reason), ' ', '_')) AS visit_reason_slug,
        FLOOR(n_rows / 2) * 2 AS n_rows_bucket
    FROM ranked_2
    WHERE n_rows_avg_3 >= 2.1
),
ranked_3 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym,
        visit_reason,
        running_count,
        least_running_count_n_rows,
        visit_reason_slug,
        n_rows_bucket,
        ROUND(running_count / NULLIF(SUM(running_count) OVER (PARTITION BY n_rows_bucket, n_rows), 0), 4) AS running_count_share_of_n_rows_bucket_n_rows,
        ROUND(AVG(n_rows_avg_3) OVER w_n_rows_bucket_n_rows, 2) AS n_rows_bucket_n_rows_avg_n_rows_avg_3
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_n_rows_bucket_n_rows AS (PARTITION BY n_rows_bucket, n_rows)
),
enriched_2 AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym,
        visit_reason,
        running_count,
        least_running_count_n_rows,
        visit_reason_slug,
        running_count_share_of_n_rows_bucket_n_rows,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', visit_reason_slug, visit_reason) AS visit_reason_slug_visit_reason_label
    FROM ranked_3
)
SELECT
    last_pet_owner_groomed_ts_ym,
    least_running_count_n_rows,
    visit_reason_slug,
    visit_reason_slug_visit_reason_label
FROM enriched_2
WHERE visit_reason_slug IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY visit_reason_slug NULLS LAST

        F.size(F.collect_set("kennel_size").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id"))).alias("distinct_kennel_size_in_pets_reg_id"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_pets_reg_id).alias("rows_in_pets_reg_id"),

    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .crossJoin(with_windows.agg(F.avg("rows_in_pets_reg_id").alias("overall_avg_rows_in_pets_reg_id")))
    .filter(F.col("rows_in_pets_reg_id") > F.col("overall_avg_rows_in_pets_reg_id"))
    .drop("overall_avg_rows_in_pets_reg_id")
)

result = (
    filtered
    .cube("visit_reason", "distinct_kennel_size_in_pets_reg_id")

        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
        F.max("rows_in_pets_reg_id").alias("max_rows_in_pets_reg_id"),
    )
    .select(

        "distinct_kennel_size_in_pets_reg_id",
        "gid",
        "max_rows_in_pets_reg_id",
    )
)

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        COALESCE(cause_area, 'UNKNOWN') AS cause_area_or_unknown,
        ADD_MONTHS(awarded_date, 3) AS awarded_date_plus_3m
    FROM pledges
    WHERE awarded_date >= DATE '2024-08-23'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(awarded_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date_plus_3m) ORDER BY pledge_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_awarded_date,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date_plus_3m) ORDER BY pledge_amount, id), 3) AS pledge_amount_cume_dist,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(donor_ref) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, cause_area_or_unknown)) AS distinct_donor_ref_in_cause_area_cause_area_or_u,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area_or_unknown ORDER BY awarded_date_plus_3m NULLS LAST), 3) AS awarded_date_plus_3m_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER w_cause_area_or_unknown_by_awa_2 AS awarded_date_plus_3m_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, cause_area_or_unknown ORDER BY awarded_date) AS awarded_date_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(awarded_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date_plus_3m) ORDER BY pledge_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_awarded_date,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area_or_unknown ORDER BY awarded_date_plus_3m NULLS LAST) AS awarded_date_plus_3m_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_cause_area_or_unknown_by_awa AS awarded_date_plus_3m_rank_2,
        LAG(awarded_date_plus_3m, 3) OVER w_cause_area_or_unknown_by_awa_2 AS prev3_awarded_date_plus_3m,
        SUM(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, cause_area_or_unknown) AS cause_area_cause_area_or_unknown_sum_pledge_amou,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, cause_area_or_unknown ORDER BY awarded_date), 3) AS awarded_date_percent_rank
    FROM scoped
    WINDOW w_cause_area_or_unknown_by_awa_2 AS (PARTITION BY cause_area_or_unknown ORDER BY awarded_date_plus_3m NULLS LAST, id), w_cause_area_or_unknown_by_awa AS (PARTITION BY cause_area_or_unknown ORDER BY awarded_date_plus_3m NULLS LAST)
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', first_known_awarded_date) AS days_since_first_known_awarded_date
    FROM windowed
)
SELECT
    id,
    cause_area,
    pledge_amount,
    cause_area_or_unknown,
    awarded_date_plus_3m,
    second_awarded_date,
    pledge_amount_cume_dist,
    distinct_donor_ref_in_cause_area_cause_area_or_u,
    awarded_date_plus_3m_rank,
    awarded_date_dense_rank,
    first_known_awarded_date,
    awarded_date_plus_3m_dense_rank,
    awarded_date_plus_3m_rank_2,
    cause_area_cause_area_or_unknown_sum_pledge_amou,
    awarded_date_percent_rank,
    days_since_first_known_awarded_date,
    CONCAT_WS('-', cause_area_or_unknown, cause_area) AS cause_area_or_unknown_cause_area_label,
    CASE WHEN cause_area IN ('animals', 'education') THEN 'group_a' WHEN cause_area = 'climate' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS cause_area_group
FROM scored
ORDER BY cause_area_cause_area_or_unknown_sum_pledge_amou, id
LIMIT 20

WITH cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(fuel_kind), ' ', '_')) AS fuel_kind_slug
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE NOT is_certified_used
      AND drive_started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-13 13:00:00'
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, COALESCE(fuel_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS fuel_kind_or_unknown
    FROM cleaned
),
derived_2 AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        MONTH(drive_started_at) AS drive_started_at_month,
        LENGTH(TRIM(fuel_kind)) AS fuel_kind_len,
        UPPER(TRIM(fuel_kind)) AS fuel_kind_clean
    FROM derived
),
with_children_car_stocks AS (
    -- One row per car_stock
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.deal_state,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.fuel_kind_or_unknown,
        s.fuel_kind_clean,
        c.id AS car_stock_id,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        c.term_months AS car_stock_term_months,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date
    FROM derived_2 s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref AND UPPER(TRIM(c.vin_tail)) LIKE 'D%'
)
SELECT
    showroom_ref,
    deal_state,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    MAX(car_stock_term_months) AS max_car_stock_term_months
FROM with_children_car_stocks
GROUP BY ROLLUP(showroom_ref, deal_state)
ORDER BY showroom_ref NULLS LAST, deal_state NULLS LAST

WITH prepared_finance_deals AS (
    -- Filter finance_deals
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE odometer_kms < 108611
      AND deal_status = 'quoted'
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach finance_deals metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT SUM(f.drive_mins) FROM finance_deals f WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id) AS total_finance_deal_drive_mins,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_deals f WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id) AS finance_deal_count
    FROM prepared_finance_deals s
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        total_finance_deal_drive_mins,
        finance_deal_count,
        DAYOFWEEK(arrived_on) AS arrived_on_dayofweek,
        COALESCE(finance_deal_count, 0) AS finance_deal_count_filled,
        CONCAT(deal_status, '#', CAST(odometer_kms AS STRING)) AS deal_status_ref
    FROM with_counts
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(finance_deal_count, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used ORDER BY total_finance_deal_drive_mins ASC, id) AS prev2_finance_deal_count,
        finance_deal_count - LAG(finance_deal_count) OVER (PARTITION BY is_certified_used ORDER BY total_finance_deal_drive_mins ASC, id) AS finance_deal_count_change
    FROM derived
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    arrived_on,
    is_certified_used,
    total_finance_deal_drive_mins,
    finance_deal_count,
    finance_deal_count_filled,
    deal_status_ref,
    prev2_finance_deal_count,
    finance_deal_count_change,
    ADD_MONTHS(arrived_on, 1) AS arrived_on_plus_1m,
    arrived_on_dayofweek + prev2_finance_deal_count AS arrived_on_dayofweek_plus_prev2_finance_deal_cou
FROM sequenced
ORDER BY car_stock_id

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        CASE WHEN deal_status IN ('quoted', 'signed') THEN 'group_a' WHEN deal_status = 'funded' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS deal_status_group,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_month,
        COALESCE(deal_status, 'UNKNOWN') AS deal_status_or_unknown
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE deal_status <> 'quoted'
),
filtered_2 AS (
    -- Rows that have matching finance_deals
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM finance_deals f
            WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
              AND f.deal_status = 'funded'
        )
),
test_drive_stats AS (
    -- Per-car_stock test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        car_stock_id,
        MIN(arrived_on) AS first_test_drive_arrived_on,
        COUNT(*) AS test_drive_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT is_fleet THEN 1 END) AS test_drive_is_fleet_count
    FROM test_drives
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.first_test_drive_arrived_on,
        COALESCE(t.test_drive_count, 0) AS test_drive_count,
        COALESCE(t.test_drive_is_fleet_count, 0) AS test_drive_is_fleet_count
    FROM filtered_2 s
    LEFT JOIN test_drive_stats t ON t.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
),
combined_details_car_stock AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.odometer_kms,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.arrived_on,
        s.deal_status_group,
        s.deal_status_or_unknown,
        s.test_drive_count,
        s.test_drive_is_fleet_count,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail
    FROM summarized_rows s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        deal_status_group,
        deal_status_or_unknown,
        test_drive_count,
        test_drive_is_fleet_count,
        car_stock_body_style,
        showroom_vin_tail,
        ROUND(AVG(test_drive_is_fleet_count) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status), 2) AS deal_status_avg_test_drive_is_fleet_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY test_drive_is_fleet_count ORDER BY test_drive_count, id) AS seq_no,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status) AS rows_in_deal_status,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(deal_status_group) OVER w_deal_status) AS distinct_deal_status_group_in_deal_status
    FROM combined_details_car_stock
    WINDOW w_deal_status AS (PARTITION BY deal_status)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per car_stock_body_style
    SELECT
        id,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        deal_status_group,
        deal_status_or_unknown,
        test_drive_count,
        test_drive_is_fleet_count,
        car_stock_body_style,
        showroom_vin_tail,
        deal_status_avg_test_drive_is_fleet_count,
        seq_no,
        rows_in_deal_status,
        distinct_deal_status_group_in_deal_status
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_body_style ORDER BY deal_status_avg_test_drive_is_fleet_count DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM ranked
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per car_stock_body_style, deal_status_or_unknown
    SELECT
        id,
        odometer_kms,

WITH cleaned_kennels AS (
    -- Filter kennels
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        is_microchipped,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(visit_reason), 1, 4) AS visit_reason_prefix,
        LENGTH(TRIM(visit_reason)) AS visit_reason_len,
        IF(is_microchipped, 'yes', 'no') AS is_microchipped_label
    FROM kennels
    WHERE species IS NOT NULL
      AND is_microchipped = TRUE
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(visit_reason_len) OVER w_visit_reason_len_is_microchi AS visit_reason_len_is_microchipped_min_visit_reaso,
        ROUND(visit_reason_len / NULLIF(SUM(visit_reason_len) OVER w_visit_reason_len_is_microchi, 0), 4) AS visit_reason_len_share_of_visit_reason_len_is_mi,
        visit_cost - LAG(visit_cost) OVER w_is_microchipped_label_specie AS visit_cost_change,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason_len ORDER BY visit_cost DESC), 3) AS visit_cost_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(visit_cost) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY visit_cost DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_visit_cost
    FROM cleaned_kennels
    WINDOW w_visit_reason_len_is_microchi AS (PARTITION BY visit_reason_len, is_microchipped), w_is_microchipped_label_specie AS (PARTITION BY is_microchipped_label, species ORDER BY visit_cost, id)
)
SELECT id, field, value
FROM (
    SELECT id, visit_reason_len, visit_reason_len_is_microchipped_min_visit_reaso
    FROM with_trends
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR field IN (visit_reason_len, visit_reason_len_is_microchipped_min_visit_reaso)
) unp
ORDER BY id, field

WITH cleaned_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Scope the telemetry_frames rows
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        payload_kind,
        burn_secs,
        mission_name,
        CASE WHEN frame_seq >= 6023 THEN 'large' WHEN frame_seq >= 3287 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS frame_seq_tier
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per mission_id, payload_kind
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        payload_kind,
        burn_secs,
        mission_name,
        frame_seq_tier
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, payload_kind ORDER BY burn_secs DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM cleaned_telemetry_frames
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    burn_secs,
    mission_name,
    frame_seq_tier,
    COALESCE(burn_secs, 0) AS burn_secs_filled,
    CONCAT_WS(' / ', frame_seq_tier, payload_kind) AS frame_seq_tier_payload_kind_label
FROM latest
WHERE burn_secs BETWEEN 201 AND 441
ORDER BY mission_id DESC

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter payload_items
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        COALESCE(mission_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS mission_state_or_unknown
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE (frame_seq >= 4160 OR mission_state NOT IN ('partial', 'lost'))
),
with_parent_mission AS (
    -- Attach mission attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.frame_seq,
        s.launched_on,
        m.is_reusable AS mission_is_reusable,
        m.launched_on AS mission_launched_on,
        m.rocket_id AS mission_rocket_id
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id AND m.apogee_km <= 23437.1
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_is_reusable, mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_frame_seq,
        MAX(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, mission_rocket_id ORDER BY mission_launched_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS frame_seq_max_2,
        SUM(frame_seq) OVER w_launched_on_year AS launched_on_year_sum_frame_seq,
        ROUND(frame_seq - AVG(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_is_reusable, mission_id), 2) AS frame_seq_vs_mission_is_reusable_mission_id_avg,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_mission_launched_on_month_mi AS launched_on_dense_rank,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_is_reusable, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', mission_launched_on) ORDER BY launched_on, id), 3) AS launched_on_percent_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_on)) AS rows_in_launched_on_year,
        ROUND(frame_seq / NULLIF(SUM(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 0), 4) AS frame_seq_share_of_mission_id,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mission_launched_on) AS mission_launched_on_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_mission_is_reusable_mission_2 AS rows_in_mission_is_reusable_mission_id,
        ROUND(AVG(frame_seq) OVER (ORDER BY mission_launched_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS frame_seq_avg_4,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_id) OVER w_launched_on_year) AS distinct_mission_id_in_launched_on_year,
        MIN(frame_seq) OVER w_launched_on_year AS launched_on_year_min_frame_seq,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_rocket_id) OVER w_mission_id) AS distinct_mission_rocket_id_in_mission_id,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_rocket_id) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_on))) AS distinct_mission_rocket_id_in_launched_on_year
    FROM with_parent_mission
    WINDOW w_launched_on_year AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_on)), w_mission_launched_on_month_mi AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(mission_launched_on), mission_rocket_id ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id), w_mission_is_reusable_mission_2 AS (PARTITION BY mission_is_reusable, mission_id), w_mission_id AS (PARTITION BY mission_id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        mission_launched_on,
        mission_rocket_id,
        last_frame_seq,
        launched_on_year_sum_frame_seq,
        launched_on_dense_rank,
        launched_on_percent_rank,
        rows_in_launched_on_year,
        frame_seq_share_of_mission_id,
        mission_launched_on_rank,
        frame_seq_avg_4,
        distinct_mission_id_in_launched_on_year,
        COALESCE(launched_on_dense_rank, 0) AS launched_on_dense_rank_filled
    FROM windowed
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        frame_seq,
        last_frame_seq,
        launched_on_dense_rank,
        rows_in_launched_on_year,
        frame_seq_share_of_mission_id,
        mission_launched_on_rank,
        launched_on_dense_rank_filled,
        ROUND(rows_in_launched_on_year - AVG(rows_in_launched_on_year) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 2) AS rows_in_launched_on_year_vs_mission_id_avg,
        ROUND(launched_on_dense_rank - AVG(launched_on_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 2) AS launched_on_dense_rank_vs_mission_id_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(frame_seq_avg_4) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 2) AS mission_id_avg_frame_seq_avg_4
    FROM enriched
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    frame_seq,
    last_frame_seq,
    launched_on_dense_rank,
    rows_in_launched_on_year,
    mission_launched_on_rank,
    rows_in_launched_on_year_vs_mission_id_avg,
    launched_on_dense_rank_vs_mission_id_avg,
    COALESCE(frame_seq, 0) AS frame_seq_filled,
    ROUND(launched_on_dense_rank / NULLIF(last_frame_seq, 0), 3) AS launched_on_dense_rank_per_last_frame_seq
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY rows_in_launched_on_year_vs_mission_id_avg DESC, frame_seq_filled DESC

        (SELECT MAX(v.visit_day) FROM vet_visits v WHERE v.pets_reg_id = s.pets_reg_id) AS last_vet_visit_visit_day
    FROM filtered s
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS

    PERCENTILE_APPROX(vet_visit_kennel_size_count, 0.5) AS median_vet_visit_kennel_size_count,

FROM with_counts
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((kennel_size, pets_reg_id, vet_visit_kennel_size_count), (kennel_size))

    FROM prepared

with_activity AS (

    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE s.campaigns_ch_ref IN (
            SELECT v.campaigns_ch_id
            FROM volunteer_shifts v

    SELECT

        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(g.volunteer_hrs), 2) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_ref) AS avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_ref) AS grant_award_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.donor_segment = 'grassroots') FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_ref) AS grant_award_donor_segment_count
    FROM with_activity s
),
enriched_2 AS (
    -- Join campaigns_ch
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.campaigns_ch_ref,
        s.grant_stage,
        s.donor_segment,
        s.pledged_on,
        s.volunteer_hrs_bucket,

        c.pledge_amt AS campaigns_ch_pledge_amt,
        c.donor_age AS campaigns_ch_donor_age
    FROM with_counts s

    WHERE c.pledge_amt > 5752.1
),
screened AS (

FROM enriched_campaigns_ch

),

        s.id,
        s.campaigns_ch_id,
        s.grant_stage,
        s.pledged_date,
        c.donor_age AS campaigns_ch_donor_age
    FROM base s
    JOIN campaigns_ch c ON c.id = s.campaigns_ch_id
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        grant_stage,
        pledged_date,
        campaigns_ch_donor_age,
        FLOOR(campaigns_ch_donor_age / 10) * 10 AS campaigns_ch_donor_age_bucket,
        COALESCE(campaigns_ch_donor_age, 0) AS campaigns_ch_donor_age_filled,
        COALESCE(grant_stage, 'UNKNOWN') AS grant_stage_or_unknown
    FROM with_details
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        grant_stage,
        campaigns_ch_donor_age,
        campaigns_ch_donor_age_bucket,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(grant_stage_or_unknown), 1, 3) AS grant_stage_or_unknown_prefix
    FROM scored
    WHERE grant_stage_or_unknown IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(campaigns_ch_donor_age) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage ORDER BY campaigns_ch_donor_age, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS campaigns_ch_donor_age_avg_4,
        ROUND(campaigns_ch_donor_age / NULLIF(SUM(campaigns_ch_donor_age) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage), 0), 4) AS campaigns_ch_donor_age_share_of_grant_stage,
        FIRST_VALUE(campaigns_ch_donor_age) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage ORDER BY campaigns_ch_donor_age, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_campaigns_ch_donor_age,
        MAX(campaigns_ch_donor_age) OVER w_grant_stage AS grant_stage_max_campaigns_ch_donor_age
    FROM derived
    WINDOW w_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    WHERE campaigns_ch_donor_age_avg_4 > (SELECT AVG(campaigns_ch_donor_age_avg_4) FROM metrics)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    grant_stage,
    campaigns_ch_donor_age,
    campaigns_ch_donor_age_bucket,
    grant_stage_or_unknown_prefix,
    campaigns_ch_donor_age_avg_4,
    campaigns_ch_donor_age_share_of_grant_stage,
    first_campaigns_ch_donor_age,
    grant_stage_max_campaigns_ch_donor_age,
    CONCAT(grant_stage, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS grant_stage_ref,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(grant_stage), 1, 4) AS grant_stage_prefix
FROM filtered
WHERE campaigns_ch_donor_age_bucket <= 76
ORDER BY grant_stage_max_campaigns_ch_donor_age, campaigns_ch_donor_age_bucket

WITH filtered_payload_items AS (
    -- Scope the payload_items rows
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE payload_kg BETWEEN 2653.2 AND 18919.2
      AND launched_on < DATE '2025-10-04'
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_mission_state_mission_id_by AS frame_seq_rank,
        ROUND(frame_seq - AVG(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_id), 2) AS frame_seq_vs_mission_state_mission_id_avg,
        ROUND(frame_seq / NULLIF(SUM(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_id), 0), 4) AS frame_seq_share_of_mission_state_mission_id
    FROM filtered_payload_items
    WINDOW w_mission_state_mission_id_by AS (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id)
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.mission_id,
        s.mission_state,
        s.frame_seq,
        s.frame_seq_rank,
        s.frame_seq_vs_mission_state_mission_id_avg,
        s.frame_seq_share_of_mission_state_mission_id,
        m.apogee_km AS mission_apogee_km,
        r.frame_seq AS rocket_frame_seq,
        r.burn_seconds AS rocket_burn_seconds
    FROM with_trends s
    LEFT JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
    JOIN rockets r ON r.id = m.rocket_id
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per mission_state
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        frame_seq,
        frame_seq_rank,
        frame_seq_vs_mission_state_mission_id_avg,
        frame_seq_share_of_mission_state_mission_id,
        mission_apogee_km,
        rocket_frame_seq,
        rocket_burn_seconds
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_seq_vs_mission_state_mission_id_avg, id) AS row_num
        FROM combined_details
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT frame_seq_rank, mission_state, rocket_burn_seconds
    FROM unique_rows
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(rocket_burn_seconds)
    FOR mission_state IN ('lost', 'success')
)
ORDER BY frame_seq_rank

WITH filtered_kennels AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_reason,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_hour
    FROM kennels
    WHERE visit_reason IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per species
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM filtered_kennels
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR groomed_ts > prev_groomed_ts + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        species,
        session_no,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(visit_cost) AS session_visit_cost,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY species, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    species,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    session_visit_cost,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
WHERE event_count < 6

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_kennels = (
    df_kennels
    .filter(F.col("visit_reason").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "visit_reason",
        "species",
        "visit_cost",
        "groomed_ts",
        "is_microchipped",
        F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("groomed_ts")).alias("groomed_ts_hour"),
    )
)

with_prev = filtered_kennels.withColumn("prev_groomed_ts", F.lag("groomed_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("species").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_ts").isNull() | (F.col("groomed_ts") > F.col("prev_groomed_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("species").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("species", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("groomed_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("groomed_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("visit_cost").alias("session_visit_cost"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("groomed_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("groomed_ts"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .filter(F.col("event_count") < 6)
    .select(
        "species",
        "session_end",
        "event_count",
        "session_visit_cost",
        "duration_min",
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        meter_fitted_date,
        ABS(chlorine_ppm - 2.4) AS chlorine_ppm_distance
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE station_tier IN ('booster', 'reserve')
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Join water_meters
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.water_meter_id,
        s.station_tier,
        s.tariff_band,
        s.chlorine_ppm_distance,
        w.meter_fitted_on AS water_meter_meter_fitted_on,
        w.chlorine_ppm AS water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
        p.burst_ts AS pump_station_burst_ts,
        p.tariff_band AS pump_station_tariff_band
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN water_meters w ON w.id = s.water_meter_id AND w.meter_fitted_on < DATE '2025-03-17'
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = w.pump_station_id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_station_tier_pump_station_bu AS rows_in_station_tier_pump_station_burst_ts_month,
        LAST_VALUE(water_meter_chlorine_ppm) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm_distance ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
        LAG(water_meter_meter_fitted_on) OVER w_all_by_chlorine_ppm_distance_2 AS prev_water_meter_meter_fitted_on,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm_distance) OVER w_station_tier_pump_station_ta AS station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_max_chlori,
        SUM(chlorine_ppm_distance) OVER w_station_tier_pump_station_ta AS station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_sum_chlori,
        MAX(water_meter_chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier, pump_station_tariff_band ORDER BY water_meter_chlorine_ppm NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_water_meter_chlorine_ppm_so_far,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pump_station_burst_ts), pump_station_tariff_band ORDER BY chlorine_ppm_distance DESC, id) AS chlorine_ppm_distance_rank,
        MIN(chlorine_ppm_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier, pump_station_tariff_band) AS station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_min_chlori,
        ROUND(AVG(water_meter_chlorine_ppm) OVER w_station_tier_pump_station_ta, 2) AS station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_avg_water_,
        ROUND(water_meter_chlorine_ppm / NULLIF(SUM(water_meter_chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pump_station_burst_ts)), 0), 4) AS water_meter_chlorine_ppm_share_of_station_tier_p,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm_distance ASC), 3) AS chlorine_ppm_distance_cume_dist,
        ROUND(chlorine_ppm_distance - AVG(chlorine_ppm_distance) OVER w_station_tier_pump_station_bu, 2) AS chlorine_ppm_distance_vs_station_tier_pump_stati
    FROM combined_details
    WINDOW w_station_tier_pump_station_bu AS (PARTITION BY station_tier, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pump_station_burst_ts)), w_all_by_chlorine_ppm_distance_2 AS (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm_distance ASC, id), w_station_tier_pump_station_ta AS (PARTITION BY station_tier, pump_station_tariff_band)
),
first_rows AS (
    -- Top 2 per group
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        chlorine_ppm_distance,
        water_meter_meter_fitted_on,
        water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
        pump_station_burst_ts,
        pump_station_tariff_band,
        rows_in_station_tier_pump_station_burst_ts_month,
        last_known_water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
        prev_water_meter_meter_fitted_on,
        station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_max_chlori,
        station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_sum_chlori,
        max_water_meter_chlorine_ppm_so_far,
        station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_min_chlori,
        station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_avg_water_,
        water_meter_chlorine_ppm_share_of_station_tier_p,
        chlorine_ppm_distance_cume_dist,
        chlorine_ppm_distance_vs_station_tier_pump_stati
    FROM sequenced
    WHERE chlorine_ppm_distance_rank <= 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    water_meter_id,
    station_tier,
    tariff_band,
    chlorine_ppm_distance,
    water_meter_meter_fitted_on,
    water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
    pump_station_tariff_band,
    rows_in_station_tier_pump_station_burst_ts_month,
    last_known_water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
    prev_water_meter_meter_fitted_on,
    station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_max_chlori,
    station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_sum_chlori,
    max_water_meter_chlorine_ppm_so_far,
    station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_min_chlori,
    water_meter_chlorine_ppm_share_of_station_tier_p,
    chlorine_ppm_distance_cume_dist,
    COALESCE(chlorine_ppm_distance, 0.0) AS chlorine_ppm_distance_filled
FROM first_rows
ORDER BY rows_in_station_tier_pump_station_burst_ts_month DESC, station_tier_pump_station_tariff_band_min_chlori DESC

WITH cleaned_pipe_bursts AS (
    -- Filter pipe_bursts
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        usage_m3 - flow_lpm AS usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
        COALESCE(meter_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS meter_kind_or_unknown
    FROM pipe_bursts
    WHERE flow_lpm < 2357.6
      AND pump_station_id IS NOT NULL
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LENGTH(TRIM(meter_kind_or_unknown)) AS meter_kind_or_unknown_len
    FROM cleaned_pipe_bursts
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LAST_DAY(meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_month_end
    FROM tagged
    WHERE meter_fitted_on < DATE '2025-05-25'
)
SELECT
    meter_kind_or_unknown,
    meter_kind_or_unknown_len,
    pump_station_id,
    MAX(meter_fitted_on_month_end) AS last_meter_fitted_on_month_end,
    ROUND(STDDEV(flow_lpm), 2) AS stddev_flow_lpm
FROM derived
GROUP BY ROLLUP(meter_kind_or_unknown, meter_kind_or_unknown_len, pump_station_id)
ORDER BY meter_kind_or_unknown NULLS LAST, meter_kind_or_unknown_len NULLS LAST, pump_station_id NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned_pipe_bursts = (
    df_pipe_bursts
    .filter((F.col("flow_lpm") < 2357.6) & (F.col("pump_station_id").isNotNull()))
    .select(
        "id",
        "pump_station_id",
        "flow_lpm",
        "usage_m3",
        "meter_fitted_on",
        (F.col("usage_m3") - F.col("flow_lpm")).alias("usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("meter_kind"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("meter_kind_or_unknown"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    cleaned_pipe_bursts
    .withColumn("meter_kind_or_unknown_len", F.length(F.trim(F.col("meter_kind_or_unknown"))))
)

derived = (
    tagged
    .filter(F.col("meter_fitted_on") < F.lit("2025-05-25").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("meter_fitted_on_month_end", F.last_day(F.col("meter_fitted_on")))
)

result = (
    derived
    .rollup("meter_kind_or_unknown", "meter_kind_or_unknown_len", "pump_station_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("meter_fitted_on_month_end").alias("last_meter_fitted_on_month_end"),
        F.round(F.stddev("flow_lpm"), 2).alias("stddev_flow_lpm"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("meter_kind_or_unknown").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("meter_kind_or_unknown_len").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("pump_station_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the water_meters rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        meter_age_yrs + chlorine_ppm AS meter_age_yrs_plus_chlorine_ppm
    FROM water_meters
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_age_yrs_plus_chlorine_ppm,
        ROUND(chlorine_ppm * 0.25, 2) AS chlorine_ppm_adj
    FROM prepared
),
with_details AS (
    -- Join pump_stations
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_age_yrs,
        s.meter_age_yrs_plus_chlorine_ppm,
        p.tariff_band AS pump_station_tariff_band,
        p.meter_age_yrs AS pump_station_meter_age_yrs,
        p.burst_ts AS pump_station_burst_ts
    FROM derived s
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id AND p.burst_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-02 13:00:00'
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach usage_reads metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_reads u WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.id) AS usage_read_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_reads u WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.id) AS usage_read_count_2,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.usage_m3), 2) FROM usage_reads u WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.id) AS avg_usage_read_usage_m3
    FROM with_details s
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    pump_station_id,
    meter_age_yrs,
    meter_age_yrs_plus_chlorine_ppm,
    pump_station_tariff_band,
    pump_station_meter_age_yrs,
    usage_read_count,
    avg_usage_read_usage_m3
FROM summarized_rows
WHERE meter_age_yrs > 4
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH recent AS (
    -- Filter payload_items
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE YEAR(launched_on) = 2024
      AND site_country IN ('JP', 'IN', 'FR')
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per site_country
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY payload_kg DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM recent
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, COALESCE(frame_seq, 0) AS frame_seq_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE mission_id >= 27
),
windowed AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_id) OVER w_site_country) AS distinct_mission_id_in_site_country,
        ROUND(frame_seq_filled / NULLIF(SUM(frame_seq_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country), 0), 4) AS frame_seq_filled_share_of_site_country,
        NTH_VALUE(frame_seq_filled, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_frame_seq_filled
    FROM annotated
    WINDOW w_site_country AS (PARTITION BY site_country)
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(t.frame_seq) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS max_telemetry_frame_frame_seq
    FROM windowed s
),
annotated_2 AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', launched_on) AS launched_on_week
    FROM summarized_rows
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT launched_on, mission_id, mission_state, frame_seq
    FROM annotated_2
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(frame_seq)
    FOR mission_state IN ('lost', 'success', 'planned')
)

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        CASE WHEN burn_secs >= 429 THEN 'A' WHEN burn_secs >= 293 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS burn_secs_tier
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per mission_state
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM scoped
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR frame_at > prev_frame_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        mission_state,
        burst_id,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY mission_state, burst_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        mission_state,
        burst_id,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        event_count,
        duration_min,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(mission_state) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(session_end))) AS distinct_mission_state_in_session_end_month,
        MAX(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(session_end)) AS session_end_month_max_burst_id,
        LAG(burst_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, burst_id ORDER BY event_count ASC NULLS LAST, mission_state, burst_id) AS prev_burst_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_session_start_year_event_cou AS session_end_dense_rank
    FROM session_summary
    WINDOW w_session_start_year_event_cou AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(session_start), event_count ORDER BY session_end DESC)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        mission_state,
        burst_id,
        session_start,
        event_count,
        distinct_mission_state_in_session_end_month,
        session_end_month_max_burst_id,
        session_end_dense_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, YEAR(session_end)) AS rows_in_mission_state_session_end_year,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY session_end_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST), 3) AS session_end_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        LAG(burst_id, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(session_end), event_count ORDER BY session_end, mission_state, burst_id) AS prev2_burst_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_session_end_to_date_event_co AS rn,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(session_end), event_count ORDER BY session_end), 3) AS session_end_cume_dist
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_session_end_to_date_event_co AS (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(session_end), event_count ORDER BY session_end, mission_state, burst_id)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT session_start, mission_state, event_count
    FROM with_trends
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(event_count)
    FOR mission_state IN ('lost', 'planned')
)

)

result = (

WITH base_pet_owners AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_type,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts,
        DATE_FORMAT(groomed_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS groomed_ts_label,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', groomed_ts) AS days_since_groomed_ts,
        ROUND(visit_cost * 1.07, 2) AS visit_cost_adj
    FROM pet_owners
    WHERE coat_type IN ('long', 'curly')
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts,
        groomed_ts_label,
        days_since_groomed_ts,
        visit_cost_adj,
        SUM(visit_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(groomed_ts)) AS groomed_ts_month_sum_visit_cost,
        LAG(days_since_groomed_ts) OVER (ORDER BY visit_cost_adj DESC, id) AS prev_days_since_groomed_ts,
        MIN(days_since_groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(groomed_ts)) AS groomed_ts_month_min_days_since_groomed_ts,
        ROUND(days_since_groomed_ts / NULLIF(SUM(days_since_groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(groomed_ts)), 0), 4) AS days_since_groomed_ts_share_of_groomed_ts_month
    FROM base_pet_owners
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        QUARTER(groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_quarter,
        FLOOR(pet_age_yrs / 5) * 5 AS pet_age_yrs_bucket,
        CASE WHEN visit_cost_adj >= 881.0 THEN 'A' WHEN visit_cost_adj >= 345.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS visit_cost_adj_tier
    FROM sequenced
)
SELECT
    groomed_ts_quarter,
    visit_cost_adj_tier,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    MAX(groomed_ts) AS last_groomed_ts,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM tagged
GROUP BY ROLLUP(groomed_ts_quarter, visit_cost_adj_tier)
ORDER BY groomed_ts_quarter NULLS LAST, visit_cost_adj_tier NULLS LAST

WITH filtered_campaigns_chs AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        donor_age,
        pledge_amt,
        pledged_date,
        DATE_FORMAT(pledged_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS pledged_date_label,
        COALESCE(pledge_amt, 0.0) AS pledge_amt_filled
    FROM campaigns_ch
    WHERE pledge_amt >= 13628.1
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(pledge_amt_filled / NULLIF(SUM(pledge_amt_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area), 0), 4) AS pledge_amt_filled_share_of_cause_area,
        FIRST_VALUE(pledge_amt_filled) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY pledge_amt_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pledge_amt_filled,
        ROUND(AVG(pledge_amt) OVER (ORDER BY pledged_date ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS pledge_amt_avg_2
    FROM filtered_campaigns_chs
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE first_known_pledge_amt_filled > (SELECT AVG(first_known_pledge_amt_filled) FROM with_trends)
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amt,
        pledged_date_label,
        pledge_amt_filled,
        GREATEST(pledge_amt_avg_2, pledge_amt_filled) AS greatest_pledge_amt_avg_2_pledge_amt_filled,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(pledged_date_label), 1, 4) AS pledged_date_label_prefix
    FROM screened
)
SELECT
    id,
    cause_area,
    pledge_amt,
    greatest_pledge_amt_avg_2_pledge_amt_filled,
    pledged_date_label_prefix,
    CONCAT(cause_area, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS cause_area_ref
FROM labeled
ORDER BY greatest_pledge_amt_avg_2_pledge_amt_filled, pledge_amt DESC NULLS FIRST, id
LIMIT 20

    FROM pledges

annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        days_since_awarded_date,
        CASE WHEN cause_area IN ('education', 'climate') THEN 'group_a' WHEN cause_area = 'animals' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS cause_area_group,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month
    FROM base
    WHERE pledge_amount < 22932.3
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM annotated
    WHERE pledge_amount > (SELECT AVG(pledge_amount) FROM annotated)
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE days_since_awarded_date > (SELECT AVG(days_since_awarded_date) FROM without_matches)
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE pledge_amount < (SELECT MAX(pledge_amount) FROM with_activity)
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_ADD(awarded_date, 7) AS awarded_date_plus_7d
    FROM screened
),
cause_area_group_stats AS (
    -- Max pledge_amount per cause_area_group
    SELECT cause_area_group, MAX(pledge_amount) AS max_pledge_amount
    FROM tagged
    GROUP BY cause_area_group
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_pledge_amount,
        ROUND(s.pledge_amount - g.max_pledge_amount, 2) AS pledge_amount_minus_max
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN cause_area_group_stats g ON g.cause_area_group = s.cause_area_group
    WHERE s.pledge_amount = g.max_pledge_amount
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        cause_area_group,
        awarded_date_month,
        FIRST_VALUE(awarded_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area_group ORDER BY awarded_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_awarded_date,
        NTH_VALUE(days_since_awarded_date, 2) OVER (ORDER BY awarded_date_plus_7d NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_days_since_awarded_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_cause_area_awarded_date_mont AS rows_in_cause_area_awarded_date_month,
        LAG(awarded_date_month) OVER w_cause_area_group_by_awarded_2 AS prev_awarded_date_month
    FROM above_average
    WINDOW w_cause_area_awarded_date_mont AS (PARTITION BY cause_area, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date)), w_cause_area_group_by_awarded_2 AS (PARTITION BY cause_area_group ORDER BY awarded_date, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    cause_area,
    pledge_amount,
    cause_area_group,
    awarded_date_month,
    first_awarded_date,
    prev_awarded_date_month
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC

WITH valid_service_tickets AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', fuel_kind, deal_state) AS fuel_kind_deal_state_label,

    FROM service_tickets

        deal_state_group,
        deal_state,

        MAX(odometer_km) AS max_odometer_km,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(AVG(odometer_km), 2) AS avg_odometer_km
    FROM valid_service_tickets
    GROUP BY fuel_kind, deal_state_group, deal_state
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT fuel_kind, deal_state_group, metric, reading
FROM (
    SELECT fuel_kind, deal_state_group, n_rows, max_odometer_km, total_odometer_km
    FROM totals
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric IN (n_rows, max_odometer_km, total_odometer_km)
) unp
ORDER BY fuel_kind, deal_state_group, metric

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref
    FROM pump_stations
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous burst_ts per tariff_band
    SELECT *, LAG(burst_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_band ORDER BY burst_ts, id) AS prev_burst_ts
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_burst_ts IS NULL OR burst_ts > prev_burst_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_band ORDER BY burst_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        tariff_band,
        session_no,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(burst_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(burst_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(burst_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY tariff_band, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    tariff_band,
    events,
    duration_min,
    FLOOR(duration_min / 50) * 50 AS duration_min_bucket,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(tariff_band), 1, 3) AS tariff_band_prefix
FROM sessions

WITH cleaned AS (
