    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        COALESCE(grant_stage, 'UNKNOWN') AS grant_stage_or_unknown
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE pledged_on >= DATE '2024-05-22'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage_or_unknown ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC), 3) AS volunteer_hrs_percent_rank,
        SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage AS campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage_or_unknown_sum_volu,
        LEAD(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage_or_unknown ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC, id) AS next_volunteer_hrs,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_grant_stage_pledged_on_month, 3) AS volunteer_hrs_cume_dist,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(grant_stage) OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_ref, grant_stage_or_unknown)) AS distinct_grant_stage_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_s,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs - AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage), 2) AS volunteer_hrs_vs_grant_stage_avg,
        DATEDIFF(pledged_on, LAG(pledged_on) OVER w_donor_segment_grant_stage_or_2) AS days_since_prev_pledged_on,
        LAG(volunteer_hrs, 2) OVER (ORDER BY pledged_on, id) AS prev2_volunteer_hrs,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(donor_segment) OVER w_grant_stage) AS distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
        SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS volunteer_hrs_sum_1_prior,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage) AS rows_in_grant_stage,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pledged_on, id) AS pledged_on_rank,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs / NULLIF(SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage), 0), 4) AS volunteer_hrs_share_of_grant_stage,
        MAX(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_grant_stage AS grant_stage_max_volunteer_hrs,
        ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage), 2) AS grant_stage_avg_volunteer_hrs
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_ref, grant_stage_or_unknown), w_grant_stage_pledged_on_month AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC), w_donor_segment_grant_stage_or_2 AS (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage_or_unknown ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC, id), w_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        pledged_on,
        grant_stage_or_unknown,
        volunteer_hrs_percent_rank,
        next_volunteer_hrs,
        volunteer_hrs_cume_dist,
        distinct_grant_stage_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_s,
        volunteer_hrs_vs_grant_stage_avg,
        days_since_prev_pledged_on,
        prev2_volunteer_hrs,
        distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
        rows_in_grant_stage,
        pledged_on_rank,
        volunteer_hrs_share_of_grant_stage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY grant_stage_max_volunteer_hrs, id) AS seq_no,
        SUM(rows_in_grant_stage) OVER (ORDER BY grant_stage_max_volunteer_hrs, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS rows_in_grant_stage_sum_6_prior,
        ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) ORDER BY volunteer_hrs_sum_1_prior ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS volunteer_hrs_percent_rank_avg_2_prior,
        RANK() OVER w_pledged_on_month_by_voluntee_2 AS volunteer_hrs_sum_1_prior_rank,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs_percent_rank - AVG(volunteer_hrs_percent_rank) OVER w_pledged_on_rank_grant_stage, 2) AS volunteer_hrs_percent_rank_vs_pledged_on_rank_gr,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY grant_stage_max_volunteer_hrs), 3) AS grant_stage_max_volunteer_hrs_percent_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_pledged_on_month_by_voluntee_2 AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_on) ORDER BY volunteer_hrs_sum_1_prior ASC, id), w_pledged_on_rank_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY pledged_on_rank, grant_stage_or_unknown)
)
SELECT
    id,
    campaigns_ch_ref,
    grant_stage,
    pledged_on,
    grant_stage_or_unknown,
    next_volunteer_hrs,
    volunteer_hrs_cume_dist,
    days_since_prev_pledged_on,
    prev2_volunteer_hrs,
    distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
    rows_in_grant_stage,
    pledged_on_rank,
    volunteer_hrs_share_of_grant_stage,
    seq_no,
    rows_in_grant_stage_sum_6_prior,
    volunteer_hrs_percent_rank_avg_2_prior,
    volunteer_hrs_percent_rank_vs_pledged_on_rank_gr,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(grant_stage_or_unknown), 1, 4) AS grant_stage_or_unknown_prefix
FROM with_trends
WHERE campaigns_ch_ref >= 16
ORDER BY prev2_volunteer_hrs DESC, id

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        gift_count - goal_amount AS gift_count_minus_goal_amount,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', pledged_date) AS days_since_pledged_date
    FROM volunteer_shifts
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach grant_awards metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(g.volunteer_hrs) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_id) AS min_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
        (SELECT MAX(g.pledged_on) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_id) AS last_grant_award_pledged_on,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(g.volunteer_hrs), 2) FROM grant_awards g WHERE g.campaigns_ch_ref = s.campaigns_ch_id) AS avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs
    FROM valid s
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    COALESCE(donor_segment, 'ALL') AS donor_segment,
    COALESCE(grant_stage, 'ALL') AS grant_stage,
    campaigns_ch_id,
    MAX(avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs) AS max_avg_grant_award_volunteer_hrs,
    ROUND(AVG(gift_count), 2) AS avg_gift_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(grant_stage)) AS grant_stage_list
FROM with_stats
GROUP BY ROLLUP(donor_segment, grant_stage, campaigns_ch_id)

WITH scoped_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        CONCAT(payload_kind, '#', CAST(frame_seq AS STRING)) AS payload_kind_ref
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach mission attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        m.is_reusable AS mission_is_reusable,
        m.mission_state AS mission_mission_state,
        m.launched_on AS mission_launched_on
    FROM scoped_telemetry_frames s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND p.payload_kg >= 7398.1
              AND p.site_country NOT IN ('JP', 'IN')
        )
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE frame_seq > (SELECT AVG(frame_seq) FROM with_activity)
),
mission_mission_state_stats AS (
    -- Median frame_seq per mission_mission_state
    SELECT mission_mission_state, PERCENTILE_APPROX(frame_seq, 0.5) AS median_frame_seq
    FROM without_matches
    GROUP BY mission_mission_state
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_frame_seq,
        ROUND(s.frame_seq - g.median_frame_seq, 2) AS frame_seq_minus_median
    FROM without_matches s
    JOIN mission_mission_state_stats g ON g.mission_mission_state = s.mission_mission_state
    WHERE s.frame_seq >= g.median_frame_seq
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    payload_kind,
    frame_seq,
    frame_at,
    mission_name,
    payload_kind_ref,
    mission_is_reusable,
    mission_mission_state,
    median_frame_seq,
    frame_seq_minus_median,
    CASE WHEN payload_kind IN ('sat', 'cargo') THEN 'group_a' WHEN payload_kind = 'probe' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS payload_kind_group
FROM outliers
WHERE payload_kind_ref IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 5

)

        arrived_date_year - LAG(arrived_date_year) OVER w_arrived_date_year_by_arrived_2 AS arrived_date_year_change,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(body_style) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_id)) AS distinct_body_style_in_showroom_id,
        term_months - LAG(term_months) OVER (PARTITION BY arrived_date_year ORDER BY arrived_date_year DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS term_months_change
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_arrived_date_year_by_arrived_2 AS (PARTITION BY arrived_date_year ORDER BY arrived_date_year DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
test_drive_stats AS (
    -- Per-car_stock test_drives metrics
    SELECT
        car_stock_id,
        MAX(arrived_on) AS last_test_drive_arrived_on,
        COUNT(*) AS test_drive_count
    FROM test_drives

),
with_stats AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.last_test_drive_arrived_on,
        COALESCE(t.test_drive_count, 0) AS test_drive_count
    FROM with_windows s
    LEFT JOIN test_drive_stats t ON t.car_stock_id = s.id
),
screened AS (

    SELECT s.*

    WHERE EXISTS (

            FROM test_drives t
            WHERE t.car_stock_id = s.id

WITH cleaned_payload_items AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        COALESCE(payload_kg, 0.0) AS payload_kg_filled,
        QUARTER(launched_on) AS launched_on_quarter,
        FLOOR(payload_kg / 5000) * 5000 AS payload_kg_bucket
    FROM payload_items
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(payload_kg_bucket / NULLIF(SUM(payload_kg_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country), 0), 4) AS payload_kg_bucket_share_of_mission_id_site_count,
        SUM(payload_kg_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country) AS mission_id_site_country_sum_payload_kg_filled,
        SUM(launched_on_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY launched_on_quarter DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS launched_on_quarter_sum_2_prior,
        ROUND(payload_kg_filled - AVG(payload_kg_filled) OVER w_mission_id_site_country, 2) AS payload_kg_filled_vs_mission_id_site_country_avg
    FROM cleaned_payload_items
    WINDOW w_mission_id_site_country AS (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country)
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_trends s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND p.mission_state <> 'partial'
              AND p.site_country IN ('JP', 'FR')
        )
)
SELECT id, metric, amount
FROM (
    SELECT id, launched_on_quarter, frame_seq, payload_kg_bucket, launched_on_quarter_sum_2_prior
    FROM screened
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    amount FOR metric IN (launched_on_quarter AS launched_on_quarter_v, frame_seq AS m_frame_seq, payload_kg_bucket AS payload_kg_bucket_v, launched_on_quarter_sum_2_prior AS m_launched_on_quarter_sum_2_prior)
) unp
ORDER BY id, metric

WITH base_service_tickets AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        LENGTH(TRIM(deal_state)) AS deal_state_len
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE odometer_km BETWEEN 77235 AND 134524
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per showroom_ref
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM base_service_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(drive_started_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_drive_started_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
car_stock_stats AS (
    -- Per-showroom car_stock metrics
    SELECT
        showroom_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN body_style = 'sedan' THEN 1 END) AS car_stock_body_style_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN body_style = 'pickup' THEN 1 END) AS car_stock_body_style_count_2
    FROM car_stock
    GROUP BY showroom_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach car_stock metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(c.car_stock_body_style_count, 0) AS car_stock_body_style_count,
        COALESCE(c.car_stock_body_style_count_2, 0) AS car_stock_body_style_count_2
    FROM sessionized s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock_stats c ON c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref
)
SELECT
    id,
    showroom_ref,
    fuel_kind,
    odometer_km,
    drive_started_at,
    deal_state_len,
    prev_drive_started_at,
    session_no,
    car_stock_body_style_count,
    session_no + is_new_session AS session_no_plus_is_new_session,
    drive_started_at + INTERVAL 1 DAYS AS drive_started_at_plus_1d
FROM profiled
WHERE NOT is_certified_used
ORDER BY drive_started_at_plus_1d DESC, id NULLS LAST

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the missions rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        LENGTH(TRIM(mission_state)) AS mission_state_len
    FROM missions
    WHERE (is_reusable = TRUE OR burn_secs >= 264)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(burn_secs) OVER w_mission_state AS mission_state_sum_burn_secs,
        MAX(mission_state_len) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_state_len ORDER BY apogee_km DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_mission_state_len_so_far,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(rocket_id) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state)) AS distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_mission_state_len_rocket_id AS burn_secs_quartile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_state_len ORDER BY apogee_km DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(burn_secs) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state_len, rocket_id ORDER BY burn_secs DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_burn_secs,
        SUM(apogee_km) OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_id ORDER BY mission_state_len DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_apogee_km
    FROM prepared
    WINDOW w_mission_state AS (PARTITION BY mission_state), w_mission_state_len_rocket_id AS (PARTITION BY mission_state_len, rocket_id ORDER BY burn_secs DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
summary AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        burn_secs_quartile,
        ROUND(AVG(distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state), 2) AS avg_distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mission_state) AS distinct_mission_states,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(mission_state)) AS mission_state_list
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    burn_secs_quartile,
    avg_distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state,
    cnt,
    mission_state_list
FROM summary
ORDER BY burn_secs_quartile DESC, avg_distinct_rocket_id_in_mission_state DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH filtered_tariffs_waters AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        burst_cause,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        DATE_FORMAT(meter_fitted_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS meter_fitted_on_label
    FROM dim_tariffs_water
    WHERE meter_fitted_on < DATE '2025-05-04'
      AND pressure_bar BETWEEN 1.2 AND 7.6
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        meter_fitted_on_label,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_month,
        CASE WHEN chlorine_ppm >= 3.0 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN chlorine_ppm >= 0.7 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS chlorine_ppm_tier
    FROM filtered_tariffs_waters
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(meter_fitted_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS meter_fitted_on_ym,
        TO_DATE(meter_fitted_on_month) AS meter_fitted_on_month_day,
        chlorine_ppm_tier,
        MIN(meter_fitted_on_month) AS first_meter_fitted_on_month,
        ROUND(AVG(chlorine_ppm), 2) AS avg_chlorine_ppm
    FROM derived
    WHERE meter_fitted_on IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING SUM(chlorine_ppm) > 0.7
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(TRIM(chlorine_ppm_tier), 1, 3) AS chlorine_ppm_tier_prefix
    FROM rollup_base
    WHERE meter_fitted_on_month_day >= DATE '2024-09-01'
)
SELECT
    meter_fitted_on_ym,
    meter_fitted_on_month_day,
    chlorine_ppm_tier,
    first_meter_fitted_on_month,
    avg_chlorine_ppm,
    chlorine_ppm_tier_prefix,
    ROUND(avg_chlorine_ppm * 0.25, 2) AS avg_chlorine_ppm_adj,
    ROUND(avg_chlorine_ppm * 1.5, 2) AS avg_chlorine_ppm_adj_2
FROM enriched
ORDER BY first_meter_fitted_on_month DESC NULLS FIRST

        LENGTH(TRIM(meter_kind)) AS meter_kind_len,
        CASE WHEN usage_m3_filled >= 63.0 THEN 'large' WHEN usage_m3_filled >= 40.5 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS usage_m3_filled_tier
    FROM scoped
    WHERE pump_station_id <= 32
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(meter_kind), ' ', '_')) AS meter_kind_slug
    FROM labeled
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(meter_fitted_on_year) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind_len ORDER BY usage_m3_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_meter_fitted_on_year,
        MAX(meter_fitted_on_year) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_on_year, station_tier) AS meter_fitted_on_year_station_tier_max_meter_fitt,
        SUM(usage_m3) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_fitted_on_year, station_tier) AS meter_fitted_on_year_station_tier_sum_usage_m3,
        ROUND(AVG(usage_m3_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY usage_m3_filled_tier ORDER BY meter_kind_len ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS usage_m3_filled_avg_4
    FROM annotated
),
ranked_2 AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(usage_m3_filled - AVG(usage_m3_filled) OVER w_station_tier_usage_m3_filled, 2) AS usage_m3_filled_vs_station_tier_usage_m3_filled_,

        LAG(usage_m3) OVER (ORDER BY meter_kind_len, id) AS prev_usage_m3,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_station_tier_usage_m3_filled AS rows_in_station_tier_usage_m3_filled_tier,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY meter_kind_len, id), 3) AS meter_kind_len_cume_dist
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_station_tier_usage_m3_filled AS (PARTITION BY station_tier, usage_m3_filled_tier), w_all_by_meter_fitted_on_year AS (ORDER BY meter_fitted_on_year_station_tier_max_meter_fitt ASC, id)
),

),
derived AS (

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        ROUND(frame_seq / NULLIF(payload_kg, 0), 3) AS frame_seq_per_payload_kg,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(site_country), ' ', '_')) AS site_country_slug
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE mission_id IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(payload_kg) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq_per_payload_kg, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS payload_kg_avg_6_prior,
        MAX(payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY payload_kg, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_payload_kg_so_far,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq_per_payload_kg, id) AS frame_seq_per_payload_kg_quintile,
        LAST_VALUE(frame_seq_per_payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_seq_per_payload_kg ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_frame_seq_per_payload_kg
    FROM cleaned
),
combined_details_mission AS (
    -- Attach mission attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        m.launched_on AS mission_launched_on,
        r.stage_cnt AS rocket_stage_cnt
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN missions m ON m.id = s.mission_id AND m.is_reusable = TRUE
    LEFT JOIN rockets r ON r.id = m.rocket_id
    WHERE m.launched_on >= DATE '2024-05-02'
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        frame_seq_per_payload_kg,
        site_country_slug,
        payload_kg_avg_6_prior,
        max_payload_kg_so_far,
        frame_seq_per_payload_kg_quintile,
        last_frame_seq_per_payload_kg,
        mission_launched_on,
        rocket_stage_cnt,
        RANK() OVER w_mission_state_mission_id_by AS rocket_stage_cnt_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_id ORDER BY rocket_stage_cnt, id) AS seq_no
    FROM combined_details_mission
    WINDOW w_mission_state_mission_id_by AS (PARTITION BY mission_state, mission_id ORDER BY rocket_stage_cnt, id)
)
SELECT id, field, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, rocket_stage_cnt_rank, seq_no, frame_seq_per_payload_kg_quintile
    FROM sequenced

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter pump_stations
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref
    FROM pump_stations
    WHERE TO_DATE(burst_ts) < DATE '2025-02-06'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous burst_ts per station_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(burst_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id) AS prev_burst_ts
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_burst_ts IS NULL OR burst_ts > prev_burst_ts + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        station_tier,
        session_id,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(burst_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(burst_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(burst_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY station_tier, session_id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(duration_min) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY session_end DESC, station_tier, session_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_duration_min,
        LEAD(session_start) OVER (ORDER BY session_start DESC, station_tier, session_id) AS next_session_start,
        FIRST_VALUE(n_events) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY session_end DESC, station_tier, session_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_n_events,
        MAX(duration_min) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_end), station_tier) AS session_end_month_station_tier_max_duration_min
    FROM session_summary
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        session_end + INTERVAL 7 DAYS AS session_end_plus_7d,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_end) AS session_end_month
    FROM windowed
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(station_tier, 'ALL') AS station_tier,
    first_n_events,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(n_events, 0.5) AS median_n_events,
    ROUND(SUM(duration_min), 2) AS total_duration_min,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(station_tier)) AS station_tier_list
FROM labeled
GROUP BY CUBE(station_tier, first_n_events)

)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("station_tier").orderBy("burst_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

        F.max("burst_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),

    )

    .select(
        "*",

        F.lead("session_start").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("session_start").desc(), "station_tier", "session_id")).alias("next_session_start"),
        F.first("n_events").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("session_end").desc(), "station_tier", "session_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_n_events"),

    )
)

labeled = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "*",

        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("session_end")).alias("session_end_month"),
    )
)

result = (

    .cube("station_tier", "first_n_events")

WITH filtered_grooming_jobs AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        visit_reason,
        kennel_size,
        kennel_nights,
        diet_tags,
        ROUND(pet_weight_kg * 0.25, 2) AS pet_weight_kg_adj,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(diet_tags, 'renal') AS has_renal
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE TO_DATE(groomed_at) < DATE '2025-01-31'
      AND pets_reg_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(kennel_nights) OVER (PARTITION BY has_renal, kennel_size) AS has_renal_kennel_size_max_kennel_nights,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY kennel_nights DESC, id) AS rn,
        SUM(pet_weight_kg_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason, pets_reg_id) AS visit_reason_pets_reg_id_sum_pet_weight_kg_adj,
        MAX(kennel_nights) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason, pets_reg_id) AS visit_reason_pets_reg_id_max_kennel_nights,
        LAG(pet_weight_kg_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY kennel_size, has_renal ORDER BY pet_weight_kg_adj ASC, id) AS prev_pet_weight_kg_adj,
        ROUND(pet_weight_kg_adj / NULLIF(SUM(pet_weight_kg_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id), 0), 4) AS pet_weight_kg_adj_share_of_pets_reg_id,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY kennel_size, has_renal ORDER BY pet_weight_kg_adj ASC), 3) AS pet_weight_kg_adj_percent_rank,
        SUM(pet_weight_kg_adj) OVER (PARTITION BY visit_reason ORDER BY kennel_nights, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pet_weight_kg_adj,
        MAX(pet_weight_kg_adj) OVER (ORDER BY kennel_nights DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pet_weight_kg_adj_max_4,
        ROUND(AVG(kennel_nights) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id), 2) AS pets_reg_id_avg_kennel_nights
    FROM filtered_grooming_jobs
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    pets_reg_id,
    visit_reason,
    kennel_size,
    kennel_nights,
    pet_weight_kg_adj,
    has_renal,
    has_renal_kennel_size_max_kennel_nights,
    rn,
    prev_pet_weight_kg_adj,
    pet_weight_kg_adj_share_of_pets_reg_id,
    pet_weight_kg_adj_percent_rank,
    running_pet_weight_kg_adj,
    pet_weight_kg_adj_max_4,
    pets_reg_id_avg_kennel_nights,
    LENGTH(TRIM(visit_reason)) AS visit_reason_len
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY id

WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the pipe_bursts rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref,
        ROUND(flow_lpm / NULLIF(usage_m3, 0), 3) AS flow_lpm_per_usage_m3
    FROM pipe_bursts
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per station_tier
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref,
        flow_lpm_per_usage_m3
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY flow_lpm_per_usage_m3 DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_details_pump_station AS (
    -- Attach pump_station attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.meter_kind,
        s.flow_lpm,
        s.usage_m3,
        s.meter_fitted_on,
        s.flow_lpm_per_usage_m3,
        p.pressure_bar AS pump_station_pressure_bar,
        p.tariff_band AS pump_station_tariff_band
    FROM latest_per_key s
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(meter_kind, 'ALL') AS meter_kind,
    pump_station_id,
    GROUPING(meter_kind) AS is_total_meter_kind,
    ROUND(STDDEV(flow_lpm), 2) AS stddev_flow_lpm
FROM with_details_pump_station
GROUP BY ROLLUP(meter_kind, pump_station_id)
ORDER BY meter_kind NULLS LAST, pump_station_id NULLS LAST

WITH scoped_payload_items AS (
    -- Scope the payload_items rows
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        LOWER(TRIM(mission_state)) AS mission_state_clean
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE payload_kg < 18582.3
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', launched_on) AS days_since_launched_on,
        ROUND(payload_kg * 0.9, 2) AS payload_kg_adj
    FROM scoped_payload_items
    WHERE mission_id <= 34
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id) AS frame_seq_dense_rank,
        MIN(payload_kg) OVER w_mission_id AS mission_id_min_payload_kg,
        FIRST_VALUE(payload_kg) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_payload_kg,
        ROUND(AVG(days_since_launched_on) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 2) AS mission_id_avg_days_since_launched_on,
        MAX(days_since_launched_on) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS days_since_launched_on_max_7
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_mission_id AS (PARTITION BY mission_id)
),
telemetry_frame_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        SUM(frame_seq) AS total_telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN mission_state NOT IN ('lost', 'planned') THEN 1 END) AS telemetry_frame_mission_state_count
    FROM telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.total_telemetry_frame_frame_seq,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_mission_state_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_mission_state_count
    FROM windowed s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frame_stats t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
totals AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN first_payload_kg >= 11708.9 THEN 'large' WHEN first_payload_kg >= 8319.2 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS first_payload_kg_tier,
        site_country,
        DATE_FORMAT(launched_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS launched_on_ym,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE site_country = 'US') AS n_site_country_us,
        ROUND(STDDEV(days_since_launched_on_max_7), 2) AS stddev_days_since_launched_on_max_7,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mission_state) AS distinct_mission_states,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(site_country)) AS site_country_list,
        ROUND(SUM(mission_id_avg_days_since_launched_on), 2) AS total_mission_id_avg_days_since_launched_on
    FROM summarized_rows
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN first_payload_kg_tier IN ('large', 'small') THEN 'group_a' WHEN first_payload_kg_tier = 'medium' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS first_payload_kg_tier_group,
        LENGTH(TRIM(site_country)) AS site_country_len,
        SIZE(site_country_list) AS site_country_list_count
    FROM totals
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per first_payload_kg_tier_group
    SELECT
        first_payload_kg_tier,
        site_country,
        launched_on_ym,
        n_site_country_us,
        stddev_days_since_launched_on_max_7,
        distinct_mission_states,
        site_country_list,
        total_mission_id_avg_days_since_launched_on,
        first_payload_kg_tier_group,
        site_country_len,
        site_country_list_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY first_payload_kg_tier_group ORDER BY site_country_list_count, first_payload_kg_tier, site_country, launched_on_ym) AS rn
        FROM labeled
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    first_payload_kg_tier,
    site_country,
    launched_on_ym,
    distinct_mission_states,
    total_mission_id_avg_days_since_launched_on,
    site_country_len,
    site_country_list_count,
    SIZE(site_country_list) AS site_country_list_count_2,
    FLOOR(site_country_len / 2) * 2 AS site_country_len_bucket
FROM unique_rows
ORDER BY total_mission_id_avg_days_since_launched_on DESC, site_country_len DESC NULLS FIRST, first_payload_kg_tier, site_country, launched_on_ym
LIMIT 20

enriched = (

        F.max("days_since_launched_on").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("frame_seq").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("days_since_launched_on_max_7"),

summarized_rows = (

    .select(

        "t.total_telemetry_frame_frame_seq",

WITH recent AS (
    -- Filter test_drives
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        TRUNC(arrived_on, 'MM') AS arrived_on_month_start,
        COALESCE(drive_mins, 0) AS drive_mins_filled
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_mins > 25
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching finance_deals
    SELECT s.*
    FROM recent s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM finance_deals f
            WHERE f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
              AND f.deal_status IN ('signed', 'funded')
              AND f.drive_mins >= 37
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per car_stock_id
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        arrived_on_month_start,
        drive_mins_filled
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM with_activity
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(drive_mins_filled - AVG(drive_mins_filled) OVER w_arrived_on_month_start_month, 2) AS drive_mins_filled_vs_arrived_on_month_start_mont,
        SUM(drive_mins_filled) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS drive_mins_filled_sum_7,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_drive_mins_filled AS drive_mins_filled_seq,
        DATEDIFF(arrived_on_month_start, LAG(arrived_on_month_start) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id)) AS days_since_prev_arrived_on_month_start,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS drive_mins_filled_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins_filled) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS drive_mins_filled_avg_7
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_month_start_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_on_month_start), car_stock_id), w_all_by_drive_mins_filled AS (ORDER BY drive_mins_filled DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
car_stock_id_stats AS (
    -- Median drive_mins_filled_seq per car_stock_id
    SELECT car_stock_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(drive_mins_filled_seq, 0.5) AS median_drive_mins_filled_seq
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY car_stock_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_drive_mins_filled_seq,
        ROUND(s.drive_mins_filled_seq - g.median_drive_mins_filled_seq, 2) AS drive_mins_filled_seq_minus_median
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN car_stock_id_stats g ON g.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
    WHERE s.drive_mins_filled_seq >= g.median_drive_mins_filled_seq
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per car_stock_id
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_fleet,
        arrived_on_month_start,
        drive_mins_filled,
        drive_mins_filled_vs_arrived_on_month_start_mont,
        drive_mins_filled_sum_7,
        drive_mins_filled_seq,
        days_since_prev_arrived_on_month_start,
        drive_mins_filled_rank,
        drive_mins_filled_avg_7,
        median_drive_mins_filled_seq,
        drive_mins_filled_seq_minus_median
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins_filled_avg_7, id) AS row_num
        FROM compared
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    deal_status,
    arrived_on_month_start,
    drive_mins_filled,
    drive_mins_filled_vs_arrived_on_month_start_mont,
    drive_mins_filled_sum_7,
    drive_mins_filled_rank,
    drive_mins_filled_avg_7,
    median_drive_mins_filled_seq,
    drive_mins_filled_seq_minus_median
FROM unique_rows
WHERE days_since_prev_arrived_on_month_start BETWEEN 60 AND 160
ORDER BY arrived_on_month_start DESC, drive_mins_filled_rank NULLS LAST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per showroom_ref
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR drive_started_at > prev_drive_started_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        showroom_ref,
        session_no,
        MIN(drive_started_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(drive_started_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(drive_started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(drive_started_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY showroom_ref, session_no
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Keep rows whose showroom matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM session_summary s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM showrooms sh
            WHERE sh.id = s.showroom_ref
              AND sh.odometer_km >= 42204
              AND sh.drive_minutes > 17
        )
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(session_no / NULLIF(events, 0), 3) AS session_no_per_events
    FROM without_matches
)
SELECT
    showroom_ref,
    session_no,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min,
    session_no_per_events,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', session_end) AS session_end_year,
    ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(session_end) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(session_start)) / 60, 1) AS minutes_session_start_to_session_end
FROM annotated
ORDER BY session_end_year DESC

WITH filtered_pets_regs AS (
    -- Filter pets_reg
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        kennel_nights,
        visit_day,
        diet_tags,
        ABS(pet_age_yrs - 11) AS pet_age_yrs_distance
    FROM pets_reg
    WHERE (visit_day >= DATE '2024-09-09' OR flag_is_neutered = FALSE)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        diet_tags,
        pet_age_yrs_distance,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind ORDER BY visit_day ASC) AS visit_day_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', visit_day) ORDER BY pet_age_yrs_distance ASC, id) AS pet_age_yrs_distance_dense_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id) AS rows_in_pet_owner_id,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs_distance - AVG(pet_age_yrs_distance) OVER w_pet_owner_id_coat_kind, 2) AS pet_age_yrs_distance_vs_pet_owner_id_coat_kind_a,
        SUM(pet_age_yrs_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id) AS pet_owner_id_sum_pet_age_yrs_distance,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(coat_kind) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id)) AS distinct_coat_kind_in_pet_owner_id,
        FIRST_VALUE(visit_day) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id ORDER BY kennel_nights, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_visit_day,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY coat_kind ORDER BY visit_day ASC, id), 3) AS visit_day_cume_dist,
        MIN(pet_age_yrs_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id, coat_kind) AS pet_owner_id_coat_kind_min_pet_age_yrs_distance
    FROM filtered_pets_regs
    WINDOW w_pet_owner_id_coat_kind AS (PARTITION BY pet_owner_id, coat_kind)
),
top_rows AS (
    -- Top 3 per group
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        visit_day,
        diet_tags,
        pet_age_yrs_distance,
        visit_day_rank,

WITH cleaned_water_meters AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        LEAST(chlorine_ppm, meter_age_yrs) AS least_chlorine_ppm_meter_age_yrs,
        ABS(chlorine_ppm - 1.1) AS chlorine_ppm_distance,
        CASE WHEN chlorine_ppm >= 2.8 THEN 'A' WHEN chlorine_ppm >= 1.5 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS chlorine_ppm_tier
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE pump_station_id <= 21
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_age_yrs,
        least_chlorine_ppm_meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm_distance,
        chlorine_ppm_tier,
        NTH_VALUE(chlorine_ppm_distance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind ORDER BY chlorine_ppm_distance DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_chlorine_ppm_distance,
        ROUND(chlorine_ppm_distance / NULLIF(SUM(chlorine_ppm_distance) OVER w_burst_cause_chlorine_ppm_tie, 0), 4) AS chlorine_ppm_distance_share_of_burst_cause_chlor,
        LAG(chlorine_ppm_distance, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY chlorine_ppm_tier ORDER BY chlorine_ppm ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS prev2_chlorine_ppm_distance
    FROM cleaned_water_meters
    WINDOW w_burst_cause_chlorine_ppm_tie AS (PARTITION BY burst_cause, chlorine_ppm_tier)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(chlorine_ppm_tier, 'ALL') AS chlorine_ppm_tier,
    COALESCE(burst_cause, 'ALL') AS burst_cause,
    pump_station_id,
    GROUPING(chlorine_ppm_tier) AS is_total_chlorine_ppm_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT chlorine_ppm_tier) AS distinct_chlorine_ppm_tiers,
    MAX(meter_age_yrs) AS max_meter_age_yrs
FROM ranked
GROUP BY CUBE(chlorine_ppm_tier, burst_cause, pump_station_id)

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Filter missions
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        CASE WHEN apogee_km >= 22364.0 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN apogee_km >= 13644.0 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS apogee_km_tier,
        COALESCE(apogee_km, 0.0) AS apogee_km_filled
    FROM missions
    WHERE is_reusable = FALSE
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM prepared
    WHERE apogee_km_filled < (SELECT MAX(apogee_km_filled) FROM prepared)
),
telemetry_frame_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        COUNT(*) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        COUNT(*) AS telemetry_frame_count_2
    FROM telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_count_2, 0) AS telemetry_frame_count_2
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frame_stats t ON t.mission_id = s.id
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach payload_items metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS payload_item_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS payload_item_count_2,
        (SELECT MIN(p.payload_kg) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS min_payload_item_payload_kg
    FROM summarized_rows s
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    rocket_id,
    burn_secs,
    apogee_km,
    launched_on,
    apogee_km_tier,
    apogee_km_filled,
    telemetry_frame_count,
    telemetry_frame_count_2,
    payload_item_count,
    min_payload_item_payload_kg,
    CASE WHEN apogee_km >= 23703.8 THEN 'A' WHEN apogee_km >= 14128.4 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS apogee_km_tier_2
FROM with_counts
WHERE telemetry_frame_count < 6
ORDER BY apogee_km DESC NULLS FIRST, apogee_km_tier_2 DESC, id
LIMIT 20

WITH scoped_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        mission_name,
        ABS(frame_seq - 2870) AS frame_seq_distance,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', frame_at) AS days_since_frame_at
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE mission_id >= 14
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(mission_name), 1, 2) AS mission_name_prefix,
        CONCAT(mission_name, '#', CAST(frame_seq AS STRING)) AS mission_name_ref
    FROM scoped_telemetry_frames
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows that have matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payload_items p
            WHERE p.mission_id = s.mission_id
              AND p.payload_kg <= 17841.0
        )
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(t.frame_at) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS first_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM filtered s
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per mission_id
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        mission_name,
        frame_seq_distance,
        days_since_frame_at,
        mission_name_prefix,
        mission_name_ref,
        first_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY days_since_frame_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM with_stats
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_mission_id_by_frame_seq_dist AS frame_seq_distance_rank,
        ROUND(days_since_frame_at - AVG(days_since_frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, YEAR(first_telemetry_frame_frame_at)), 2) AS days_since_frame_at_vs_mission_id_first_telemetr,
        LAST_VALUE(days_since_frame_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_distance NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_days_since_frame_at
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_mission_id_by_frame_seq_dist AS (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY frame_seq_distance NULLS LAST, id)
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.payload_kind = 'probe') FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS telemetry_frame_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN t.mission_state = 'partial' THEN 1 END) FROM telemetry_frames t WHERE t.mission_id = s.mission_id) AS telemetry_frame_mission_state_count
    FROM with_trends s
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM with_counts
    WHERE frame_seq_distance < (SELECT MAX(frame_seq_distance) FROM with_counts)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    burn_secs,
    frame_seq_distance,
    mission_name_prefix,
    mission_name_ref,
    first_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
    frame_seq_distance_rank,
    days_since_frame_at_vs_mission_id_first_telemetr,
    telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
    telemetry_frame_count,
    telemetry_frame_mission_state_count,
    frame_seq_distance_rank + days_since_frame_at AS frame_seq_distance_rank_plus_days_since_frame_at
FROM with_activity

WITH prepared_volunteer_shifts AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(donor_segment), 1, 4) AS donor_segment_prefix
    FROM volunteer_shifts
    WHERE grant_stage <> 'reported'
      AND goal_amount > 872675.9
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage ORDER BY goal_amount, id) AS rn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, donor_segment ORDER BY gift_count DESC, id) AS seq_no_2,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_grant_stage AS rows_in_grant_stage,
        ROUND(AVG(goal_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, donor_segment ORDER BY gift_count DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS goal_amount_avg_3_prior
    FROM prepared_volunteer_shifts
    WINDOW w_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Join campaigns_ch
    SELECT s.*, c.pledge_amt AS campaigns_ch_pledge_amt
    FROM windowed s
    LEFT JOIN campaigns_ch c ON c.id = s.campaigns_ch_id
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per grant_stage, donor_segment
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        donor_segment_prefix,
        rn,
        seq_no_2,
        rows_in_grant_stage,
        goal_amount_avg_3_prior,
        campaigns_ch_pledge_amt
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, donor_segment ORDER BY rows_in_grant_stage, id) AS recency_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
SELECT *

WITH valid_service_tickets AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE drive_started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 13:00:00'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per showroom_ref
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM valid_service_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR drive_started_at > prev_drive_started_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        showroom_ref,
        session_id,
        MIN(drive_started_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(drive_started_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(odometer_km) AS session_odometer_km,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(drive_started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(drive_started_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY showroom_ref, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    showroom_ref,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    session_odometer_km,
    duration_min,
    ABS(n_events - 4) AS n_events_distance
FROM session_summary
ORDER BY duration_min DESC, showroom_ref, session_id
LIMIT 5

    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        ADD_MONTHS(pledged_date, 12) AS pledged_date_plus_12m
    FROM volunteer_shifts
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date_plus_12m,
        ROUND(goal_amount - AVG(goal_amount) OVER w_pledged_date_plus_12m_month, 2) AS goal_amount_vs_pledged_date_plus_12m_month_grant,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage, donor_segment ORDER BY goal_amount DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS goal_amount_tercile,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grant_stage_donor_segment_by AS goal_amount_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(pledged_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, YEAR(pledged_date) ORDER BY pledged_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pledged_date,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, YEAR(pledged_date) ORDER BY pledged_date), 3) AS pledged_date_percent_rank,
        ROUND(gift_count - AVG(gift_count) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_date_plus_12m), grant_stage), 2) AS gift_count_vs_pledged_date_plus_12m_month_grant_,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment ORDER BY pledged_date NULLS LAST, id) AS pledged_date_rank,
        SUM(gift_count) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment ORDER BY pledged_date NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_gift_count,
        ROUND(AVG(goal_amount) OVER w_pledged_date_plus_12m_month, 2) AS pledged_date_plus_12m_month_grant_stage_avg_goal,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(donor_segment) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage)) AS distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
        MAX(gift_count) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, YEAR(pledged_date) ORDER BY pledged_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS gift_count_max_2,
        LAST_VALUE(pledged_date_plus_12m) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment ORDER BY pledged_date NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_pledged_date_plus_12m,
        LEAD(goal_amount, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(pledged_date_plus_12m), donor_segment ORDER BY pledged_date_plus_12m ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS next2_goal_amount,
        ROUND(AVG(gift_count) OVER w_pledged_date_plus_12m_month, 2) AS pledged_date_plus_12m_month_grant_stage_avg_gift,
        SUM(gift_count) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(pledged_date_plus_12m), donor_segment ORDER BY pledged_date_plus_12m ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS gift_count_sum_3_prior
    FROM prepared_volunteer_shifts
    WINDOW w_pledged_date_plus_12m_month AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_date_plus_12m), grant_stage), w_grant_stage_donor_segment_by AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage, donor_segment ORDER BY goal_amount DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    grant_stage,
    donor_segment,
    gift_count,
    goal_amount,
    pledged_date_plus_12m,
    goal_amount_tercile,
    goal_amount_dense_rank,
    gift_count_vs_pledged_date_plus_12m_month_grant_,
    pledged_date_rank,
    running_gift_count,
    pledged_date_plus_12m_month_grant_stage_avg_goal,
    distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage,
    gift_count_max_2,
    LENGTH(TRIM(grant_stage)) AS grant_stage_len
FROM ranked
ORDER BY distinct_donor_segment_in_grant_stage DESC

            SELECT g.pets_reg_id

            WHERE g.groomed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-13 15:00:00'

    MIN(kennel_nights) AS min_kennel_nights
FROM with_activity
GROUP BY CUBE(pets_reg_id, visit_reason, kennel_size)

WITH valid_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Scope the telemetry_frames rows
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        ROUND(frame_seq / NULLIF(burn_secs, 0), 3) AS frame_seq_per_burn_secs,
        COALESCE(frame_seq, 0) AS frame_seq_filled
    FROM telemetry_frames
    WHERE (mission_id IS NOT NULL OR LOWER(mission_name) LIKE '%s %')
),
telemetry_frame_stats AS (
    -- Per-mission telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        mission_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payload_kind = 'probe') AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        MAX(frame_at) AS last_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM telemetry_frames
    GROUP BY mission_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach telemetry_frames metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count, 0) AS telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
        t.last_telemetry_frame_frame_at
    FROM valid_telemetry_frames s
    LEFT JOIN telemetry_frame_stats t ON t.mission_id = s.mission_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(mission_state), ' ', '_')) AS mission_state_slug
    FROM profiled
    WHERE mission_id IS NOT NULL
),
mission_state_stats AS (
    -- Max frame_seq_per_burn_secs per mission_state
    SELECT mission_state, MAX(frame_seq_per_burn_secs) AS max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs
    FROM tagged
    GROUP BY mission_state
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs,
        ROUND(s.frame_seq_per_burn_secs - g.max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs, 2) AS frame_seq_per_burn_secs_minus_max
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN mission_state_stats g ON g.mission_state = s.mission_state
    WHERE s.frame_seq_per_burn_secs = g.max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching payload_items
    SELECT s.*
    FROM vs_group s
    WHERE s.mission_id IN (
            SELECT p.mission_id
            FROM payload_items p
        )
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    frame_seq,
    burn_secs,
    frame_at,
    frame_seq_per_burn_secs,
    telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count,
    last_telemetry_frame_frame_at,
    mission_state_slug,
    frame_seq_per_burn_secs_minus_max,
    CASE WHEN frame_seq_per_burn_secs >= 8.5 THEN 'A' WHEN frame_seq_per_burn_secs >= 2.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS frame_seq_per_burn_secs_tier
FROM without_matches

valid_telemetry_frames = (
    df_telemetry_frames
    .filter((F.col("mission_id").isNotNull()) | (F.lower(F.col("mission_name")).like("%s %")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "mission_state",
        "frame_seq",
        "burn_secs",
        "frame_at",
        F.round(F.col("frame_seq") / F.nullif(F.col("burn_secs"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("frame_seq_per_burn_secs"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("frame_seq"), F.lit(0)).alias("frame_seq_filled"),
    )
)

telemetry_frame_stats = (
    df_telemetry_frames
    .groupBy("mission_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("payload_kind") == "probe", 1)).alias("telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count"),
        F.max("frame_at").alias("last_telemetry_frame_frame_at"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    valid_telemetry_frames.alias("s")
    .join(telemetry_frame_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.mission_id") == F.col("s.mission_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count"),
        "t.last_telemetry_frame_frame_at",
    )
)

tagged = (
    profiled
    .filter(F.col("mission_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("mission_state_slug", F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("mission_state")), " ", "_")))
)

mission_state_stats = (
    tagged
    .groupBy("mission_state")
    .agg(F.max("frame_seq_per_burn_secs").alias("max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs"))
)

vs_group = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(mission_state_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.mission_state") == F.col("s.mission_state"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.frame_seq_per_burn_secs") == F.col("g.max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs",
        F.round(F.col("s.frame_seq_per_burn_secs") - F.col("g.max_frame_seq_per_burn_secs"), 2).alias("frame_seq_per_burn_secs_minus_max"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    vs_group.alias("s")
    .join(df_payload_items.alias("p"), F.col("p.mission_id") == F.col("s.mission_id"), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "frame_seq",
        "burn_secs",
        "frame_at",
        "frame_seq_per_burn_secs",
        "telemetry_frame_payload_kind_count",
        "last_telemetry_frame_frame_at",
        "mission_state_slug",
        "frame_seq_per_burn_secs_minus_max",
        F.when(F.col("frame_seq_per_burn_secs") >= 8.5, "A").when(F.col("frame_seq_per_burn_secs") >= 2.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("frame_seq_per_burn_secs_tier"),
    )
)

    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        pledged_date,
        goal_amount + gift_count AS goal_amount_plus_gift_count,
        ROUND(goal_amount * 1.1, 2) AS goal_amount_adj,
        DAYOFWEEK(pledged_date) AS pledged_date_dayofweek
    FROM volunteer_shifts
    WHERE gift_count > 25
),
with_details_campaigns_ch AS (
    -- Join campaigns_ch
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.pledged_date AS campaigns_ch_pledged_date,
        c.pledge_amt AS campaigns_ch_pledge_amt
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN campaigns_ch c ON c.id = s.campaigns_ch_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT campaigns_ch_pledged_date, grant_stage, goal_amount_plus_gift_count
    FROM with_details_campaigns_ch
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(goal_amount_plus_gift_count)
    FOR grant_stage IN ('applied', 'reported', 'awarded')
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_volunteer_shifts
    .filter(F.col("gift_count") > 25)
    .select(
        "id",
        "campaigns_ch_id",
        "grant_stage",
        "donor_segment",
        "gift_count",
        "pledged_date",
        (F.col("goal_amount") + F.col("gift_count")).alias("goal_amount_plus_gift_count"),
        F.round(F.col("goal_amount") * 1.1, 2).alias("goal_amount_adj"),
        F.dayofweek(F.col("pledged_date")).alias("pledged_date_dayofweek"),
    )
)

with_details_campaigns_ch = (
    cleaned.alias("s")
    .join(df_campaigns_ch.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.campaigns_ch_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.pledged_date").alias("campaigns_ch_pledged_date"),
        F.col("c.pledge_amt").alias("campaigns_ch_pledge_amt"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_details_campaigns_ch
    .groupBy("campaigns_ch_pledged_date")
    .pivot("grant_stage", ["applied", "reported", "awarded"])
    .agg(F.sum("goal_amount_plus_gift_count"))
)

WITH valid_service_tickets AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE showroom_ref IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous drive_started_at per fuel_kind
    SELECT *, LAG(drive_started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at, id) AS prev_drive_started_at
    FROM valid_service_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_drive_started_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(drive_started_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_drive_started_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        fuel_kind,
        session_id,
        MIN(drive_started_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(drive_started_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(drive_started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(drive_started_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY fuel_kind, session_id
),
per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_end_ym,
        n_events,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(fuel_kind)) AS fuel_kind_list,
        ROUND(SUM(duration_min) / NULLIF(SUM(session_id), 0), 3) AS duration_min_to_session_id_ratio,
        MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,
        SUM(n_events) AS total_n_events
    FROM sessions
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM'), n_events
)
SELECT
    session_end_ym,
    n_events,
    fuel_kind_list,
    total_n_events,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', first_session_start) AS days_since_first_session_start
FROM per_group
ORDER BY session_end_ym DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_service_tickets = (
    df_service_tickets
    .filter(F.col("showroom_ref").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "showroom_ref",
        "fuel_kind",
        "odometer_km",
        "drive_started_at",
    )
)

with_prev = valid_service_tickets.withColumn("prev_drive_started_at", F.lag("drive_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_kind").orderBy("drive_started_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_drive_started_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("drive_started_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_drive_started_at")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_kind").orderBy("drive_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("fuel_kind", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("drive_started_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("drive_started_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("drive_started_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("drive_started_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    sessions
    .groupBy(
        F.date_format("session_end", "yyyy-MM").alias("session_end_ym"),
        "n_events",
    )
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("fuel_kind")).alias("fuel_kind_list"),
        F.round(F.sum("duration_min") / F.nullif(F.sum("session_id"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("duration_min_to_session_id_ratio"),
        F.min("session_start").alias("first_session_start"),
        F.sum("n_events").alias("total_n_events"),
    )
)

result = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "session_end_ym",
        "n_events",
        "fuel_kind_list",
        "total_n_events",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("first_session_start")).alias("days_since_first_session_start"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("session_end_ym").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter finance_deals
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE is_certified_used = TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status ORDER BY arrived_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS odometer_kms_max_2_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status, car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC, id) AS arrived_on_rank,
        SUM(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id) AS car_stock_id_sum_odometer_kms,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id) AS rows_in_car_stock_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status, car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC) AS arrived_on_dense_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_all_by_drive_mins AS drive_mins_tercile,
        MIN(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id) AS car_stock_id_min_drive_mins,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(deal_status) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id)) AS distinct_deal_status_in_car_stock_id,
        LEAD(odometer_kms) OVER w_all_by_drive_mins AS next_odometer_kms,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id) AS car_stock_id_max_drive_mins,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status ORDER BY arrived_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS drive_mins_max_3,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY deal_status, car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC, id) AS arrived_on_tercile
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_all_by_drive_mins AS (ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id)
),
top_rows AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        odometer_kms_max_2_prior,
        car_stock_id_sum_odometer_kms,
        rows_in_car_stock_id,
        arrived_on_dense_rank,
        drive_mins_tercile,
        car_stock_id_min_drive_mins,
        distinct_deal_status_in_car_stock_id,
        next_odometer_kms,
        car_stock_id_max_drive_mins,
        drive_mins_max_3,
        arrived_on_tercile
    FROM ranked
    WHERE arrived_on_rank = 1
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY arrived_on_tercile) AS rows_in_arrived_on_tercile,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_on), drive_mins_tercile ORDER BY odometer_kms_max_2_prior ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_drive_mins,
        ROUND(odometer_kms_max_2_prior - AVG(odometer_kms_max_2_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on), arrived_on_dense_rank), 2) AS odometer_kms_max_2_prior_vs_arrived_on_month_arr,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_all_by_next_odometer_kms AS next_odometer_kms_decile,
        MIN(arrived_on_tercile) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(arrived_on), drive_mins_tercile ORDER BY odometer_kms_max_2_prior ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_arrived_on_tercile_so_far,
        LEAD(rows_in_car_stock_id, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_tercile ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS next_rows_in_car_stock_id,
        LAST_VALUE(odometer_kms_max_2_prior) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins_tercile ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_odometer_kms_max_2_prior
    FROM top_rows
    WINDOW w_all_by_next_odometer_kms AS (ORDER BY next_odometer_kms ASC NULLS LAST, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    deal_status,
    odometer_kms,
    drive_mins,
    is_certified_used,
    car_stock_id_sum_odometer_kms,
    rows_in_car_stock_id,
    drive_mins_tercile,
    car_stock_id_min_drive_mins,
    distinct_deal_status_in_car_stock_id,
    next_odometer_kms,
    car_stock_id_max_drive_mins,
    drive_mins_max_3,
    arrived_on_tercile,
    rows_in_arrived_on_tercile,
    running_drive_mins,
    odometer_kms_max_2_prior_vs_arrived_on_month_arr,
    min_arrived_on_tercile_so_far,
    next_rows_in_car_stock_id,
    FLOOR(odometer_kms_max_2_prior / 100000) * 100000 AS odometer_kms_max_2_prior_bucket,
    LENGTH(TRIM(deal_status)) AS deal_status_len
FROM sequenced
WHERE car_stock_id <= 24
ORDER BY drive_mins_max_3 DESC

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_finance_deals

    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("odometer_kms").over(Window.partitionBy("deal_status").orderBy("arrived_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("odometer_kms_max_2_prior"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("deal_status", "car_stock_id").orderBy(F.col("arrived_on").desc(), "id")).alias("arrived_on_rank"),
        F.sum("odometer_kms").over(Window.partitionBy("car_stock_id")).alias("car_stock_id_sum_odometer_kms"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("car_stock_id")).alias("rows_in_car_stock_id"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("deal_status", "car_stock_id").orderBy(F.col("arrived_on").desc())).alias("arrived_on_dense_rank"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_all_by_drive_mins).alias("drive_mins_tercile"),
        F.min("drive_mins").over(Window.partitionBy("car_stock_id")).alias("car_stock_id_min_drive_mins"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("deal_status").over(Window.partitionBy("car_stock_id"))).alias("distinct_deal_status_in_car_stock_id"),
        F.lead("odometer_kms").over(w_all_by_drive_mins).alias("next_odometer_kms"),
        F.max("drive_mins").over(Window.partitionBy("car_stock_id")).alias("car_stock_id_max_drive_mins"),
        F.max("drive_mins").over(Window.partitionBy("deal_status").orderBy("arrived_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("drive_mins_max_3"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("deal_status", "car_stock_id").orderBy(F.col("arrived_on").desc(), "id")).alias("arrived_on_tercile"),
    )
)

top_rows = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("arrived_on_rank") == 1)
    .drop("arrived_on_rank")
)

w_all_by_next_odometer_kms = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_odometer_kms").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
sequenced = (
    top_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("arrived_on_tercile")).alias("rows_in_arrived_on_tercile"),
        F.sum("drive_mins").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("arrived_on"), "drive_mins_tercile").orderBy("odometer_kms_max_2_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_drive_mins"),
        F.round(F.col("odometer_kms_max_2_prior") - F.avg("odometer_kms_max_2_prior").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on"), "arrived_on_dense_rank")), 2).alias("odometer_kms_max_2_prior_vs_arrived_on_month_arr"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_all_by_next_odometer_kms).alias("next_odometer_kms_decile"),
        F.min("arrived_on_tercile").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("arrived_on"), "drive_mins_tercile").orderBy("odometer_kms_max_2_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_arrived_on_tercile_so_far"),
        F.lead("rows_in_car_stock_id", 1, 0).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("drive_mins_tercile").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("next_rows_in_car_stock_id"),
        F.last("odometer_kms_max_2_prior", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("drive_mins_tercile").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_odometer_kms_max_2_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("car_stock_id") <= 24)
    .select(
        "id",
        "car_stock_id",
        "deal_status",
        "odometer_kms",
        "drive_mins",
        "is_certified_used",
        "car_stock_id_sum_odometer_kms",
        "rows_in_car_stock_id",
        "drive_mins_tercile",
        "car_stock_id_min_drive_mins",
        "distinct_deal_status_in_car_stock_id",
        "next_odometer_kms",
        "car_stock_id_max_drive_mins",
        "drive_mins_max_3",
        "arrived_on_tercile",
        "rows_in_arrived_on_tercile",
        "running_drive_mins",
        "odometer_kms_max_2_prior_vs_arrived_on_month_arr",
        "min_arrived_on_tercile_so_far",
        "next_rows_in_car_stock_id",
        (F.floor(F.col("odometer_kms_max_2_prior") / 100000) * 100000).alias("odometer_kms_max_2_prior_bucket"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("deal_status"))).alias("deal_status_len"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("drive_mins_max_3").desc())
)

WITH recent AS (
    -- Filter rockets
    SELECT *
    FROM rockets
    WHERE launched_date < DATE '2025-05-29'
      AND frame_seq <= 6689
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per mission_status
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_status,
        burn_seconds,
        stage_cnt,
        frame_seq,
        launched_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mission_status ORDER BY launched_date, id) AS recency_rank
        FROM recent
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
mission_status_stats AS (
    -- Max stage_cnt per mission_status
    SELECT mission_status, MAX(stage_cnt) AS max_stage_cnt
    FROM unique_rows
    GROUP BY mission_status
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_stage_cnt,
        ROUND(s.stage_cnt - g.max_stage_cnt, 2) AS stage_cnt_minus_max
    FROM unique_rows s
    JOIN mission_status_stats g ON g.mission_status = s.mission_status
    WHERE s.stage_cnt = g.max_stage_cnt
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach missions metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(m.launched_on) FROM missions m WHERE m.rocket_id = s.id) AS last_mission_launched_on
    FROM outliers s
)
SELECT
    stage_cnt,
    COALESCE(mission_status, 'ALL') AS mission_status,
    ROUND(STDDEV(burn_seconds), 2) AS stddev_burn_seconds
FROM profiled
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((stage_cnt, mission_status), (stage_cnt))
ORDER BY stage_cnt NULLS LAST, mission_status NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_rockets
    .filter((F.col("launched_date") < F.lit("2025-05-29").cast("date")) & (F.col("frame_seq") <= 6689))
)

unique_rows = (
    recent
    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("mission_status").orderBy("launched_date", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rank") == 1)
    .drop("recency_rank")
)

mission_status_stats = (
    unique_rows
    .groupBy("mission_status")
    .agg(F.max("stage_cnt").alias("max_stage_cnt"))
)

outliers = (
    unique_rows.alias("s")
    .join(mission_status_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.mission_status") == F.col("s.mission_status"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.stage_cnt") == F.col("g.max_stage_cnt"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_stage_cnt",
        F.round(F.col("s.stage_cnt") - F.col("g.max_stage_cnt"), 2).alias("stage_cnt_minus_max"),
    )
)

mission_stats = (
    df_missions
    .groupBy("rocket_id")
    .agg(F.max("launched_on").alias("last_mission_launched_on"))
)

profiled = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(mission_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.rocket_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "m.last_mission_launched_on")
)

result = (
    profiled
    .groupingSets(
        [["stage_cnt", "mission_status"], ["stage_cnt"]],
        "stage_cnt", "mission_status",
    )
    .agg(F.round(F.stddev("burn_seconds"), 2).alias("stddev_burn_seconds"))
    .select(
        "stage_cnt",
        F.coalesce(F.col("mission_status"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("mission_status"),
        "stddev_burn_seconds",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("stage_cnt").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("mission_status").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
