WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter usage_reads
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        chlorine_ppm,
        usage_m3,
        burst_litres,
        meter_fitted_date,
        INITCAP(TRIM(tariff_band)) AS tariff_band_clean,
        ABS(chlorine_ppm - 2.1) AS chlorine_ppm_distance,
        DATE_ADD(meter_fitted_date, 90) AS meter_fitted_date_plus_90d
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE burst_litres <= 78579
),
screened AS (
    -- Keep rows whose water_meter matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM water_meters w
            WHERE w.id = s.water_meter_id
              AND w.meter_age_yrs BETWEEN 8 AND 24
        )
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        usage_m3,
        burst_litres,
        tariff_band_clean,
        DAYOFWEEK(meter_fitted_date) AS meter_fitted_date_dayofweek,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(tariff_band), ' ', '_')) AS tariff_band_slug
    FROM screened
),
enriched_water_meter AS (
    -- Join water_meters
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.water_meter_id,
        s.station_tier,
        s.tariff_band,
        s.usage_m3,
        s.burst_litres,
        s.tariff_band_clean,
        s.meter_fitted_date_dayofweek,
        s.tariff_band_slug,
        w.meter_age_yrs AS water_meter_meter_age_yrs,
        w.chlorine_ppm AS water_meter_chlorine_ppm
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN water_meters w ON w.id = s.water_meter_id
    WHERE w.chlorine_ppm <= 3.1
),
tariff_band_stats AS (
    -- Avg usage_m3 per tariff_band
    SELECT tariff_band, AVG(usage_m3) AS avg_usage_m3
    FROM enriched_water_meter
    GROUP BY tariff_band
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_usage_m3,
        ROUND(s.usage_m3 - g.avg_usage_m3, 2) AS usage_m3_minus_avg
    FROM enriched_water_meter s
    JOIN tariff_band_stats g ON g.tariff_band = s.tariff_band
    WHERE s.usage_m3 > g.avg_usage_m3
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per tariff_band
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        usage_m3,
        burst_litres,
        tariff_band_clean,
        meter_fitted_date_dayofweek,
        tariff_band_slug,
        water_meter_meter_age_yrs,
        water_meter_chlorine_ppm,
        avg_usage_m3,
        usage_m3_minus_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_band ORDER BY water_meter_meter_age_yrs DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM compared
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    water_meter_id,
    station_tier,
    tariff_band,
    usage_m3,
    meter_fitted_date_dayofweek,

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter telemetry_frames
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        payload_kind,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name,
        CASE WHEN frame_seq >= 7279 THEN 'A' WHEN frame_seq >= 2958 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS frame_seq_tier
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per payload_kind
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(frame_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_frame_at)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY payload_kind ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        payload_kind,
        burst_id,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY payload_kind, burst_id
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    burst_id,
    events,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    SUM(burst_id) FILTER (WHERE payload_kind = 'sat') AS burst_id_payload_kind_sat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payload_kind IN ('sat', 'crew', 'cargo') THEN events ELSE 0 END) AS events_payload_kind_in_sat_crew_car
FROM sessions
GROUP BY CUBE(burst_id, events)

        F.when(F.col("frame_seq") >= 7279, "A").when(F.col("frame_seq") >= 2958, "B").otherwise("C").alias("frame_seq_tier"),
    )

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_frame_at", F.lag("frame_at").over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy("frame_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_frame_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("frame_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_frame_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("payload_kind").orderBy("frame_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

    .groupBy("payload_kind", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("frame_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("frame_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("frame_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("frame_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (

    .cube("burst_id", "events")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("payload_kind") == "sat", F.col("burst_id"))).alias("burst_id_payload_kind_sat"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("payload_kind").isin("sat", "crew", "cargo"), F.col("events")).otherwise(0)).alias("events_payload_kind_in_sat_crew_car"),

WITH base_grant_awards AS (
    -- Filter grant_awards
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        DATE_ADD(pledged_on, 90) AS pledged_on_plus_90d,
        FLOOR(volunteer_hrs / 2) * 2 AS volunteer_hrs_bucket
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE campaigns_ch_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND volunteer_hrs >= 4.7
),
combined_details_campaigns_ch AS (
    -- Attach campaigns_ch attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.campaigns_ch_ref,
        s.grant_stage,
        s.donor_segment,
        s.volunteer_hrs,
        s.pledged_on,
        s.pledged_on_plus_90d,
        c.pledged_date AS campaigns_ch_pledged_date
    FROM base_grant_awards s
    JOIN campaigns_ch c ON c.id = s.campaigns_ch_ref
    WHERE c.pledged_date < DATE '2025-02-21'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(grant_stage) OVER w_donor_segment) AS distinct_grant_stage_in_donor_segment,
        MAX(volunteer_hrs) OVER (ORDER BY campaigns_ch_pledged_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS volunteer_hrs_max_1_prior,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_pledged_on, 3) AS pledged_on_percent_rank,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs - AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_donor_segment, 2) AS volunteer_hrs_vs_donor_segment_avg,
        NTH_VALUE(pledged_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage ORDER BY pledged_on_plus_90d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_pledged_on,
        ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_donor_segment, 2) AS donor_segment_avg_volunteer_hrs,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY grant_stage ORDER BY pledged_on_plus_90d DESC, id) AS pledged_on_plus_90d_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment) AS rows_in_donor_segment,
        LAST_VALUE(pledged_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY pledged_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_pledged_on,
        ROUND(volunteer_hrs / NULLIF(SUM(volunteer_hrs) OVER w_grant_stage, 0), 4) AS volunteer_hrs_share_of_grant_stage
    FROM combined_details_campaigns_ch
    WINDOW w_donor_segment AS (PARTITION BY donor_segment), w_all_by_pledged_on AS (ORDER BY pledged_on DESC, id), w_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage)
),
per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(pledged_on_plus_90d, 'yyyy-MM') AS pledged_on_plus_90d_ym,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(grant_stage)) AS grant_stage_list,
        MAX(pledged_on) AS last_pledged_on
    FROM ranked
    WHERE campaigns_ch_pledged_date < DATE '2025-04-21'
    GROUP BY 1
),
ranked_2 AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        pledged_on_plus_90d_ym,
        grant_stage_list,
        DATEDIFF(last_pledged_on, LAG(last_pledged_on) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_pledged_on) ORDER BY last_pledged_on, pledged_on_plus_90d_ym)) AS days_since_prev_last_pledged_on,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last_pledged_on DESC, pledged_on_plus_90d_ym) AS last_pledged_on_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last_pledged_on DESC, pledged_on_plus_90d_ym) AS rn
    FROM per_group
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    pledged_on_plus_90d_ym,
    grant_stage_list,
    days_since_prev_last_pledged_on,
    last_pledged_on_rank,
    rn,
    FLOOR(last_pledged_on_rank / 2) * 2 AS last_pledged_on_rank_bucket
FROM ranked_2
ORDER BY rn, last_pledged_on_rank_bucket NULLS LAST

        )
)

    volunteer_shift_count,

    campaigns_ch_ref,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN donor_segment IN ('grassroots', 'mid') THEN volunteer_hrs ELSE 0 END) AS volunteer_hrs_donor_segment_in_grassroots
FROM filtered
GROUP BY CUBE(volunteer_shift_count, grant_stage, campaigns_ch_ref)

WITH base_kennels AS (
    -- Scope the kennels rows
    SELECT
        id,
        species,
        visit_cost,
        groomed_ts,
        is_microchipped,
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_day
    FROM kennels
    WHERE is_microchipped = TRUE
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per species
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM base_kennels
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR groomed_ts > prev_groomed_ts + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        species,
        session_id,
        MIN(groomed_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(visit_cost) AS session_visit_cost,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY species, session_id
)
SELECT species, session_id, metric, reading
FROM (
    SELECT species, session_id, session_visit_cost, duration_min
    FROM session_summary
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric IN (session_visit_cost, duration_min)
) unp

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_kennels = (
    df_kennels
    .filter(F.col("is_microchipped"))

        "species",
        "visit_cost",
        "groomed_ts",
        "is_microchipped",
        F.date_trunc("day", F.col("groomed_ts")).alias("groomed_ts_day"),
    )
)

)

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("species", "session_id")

        F.max("groomed_ts").alias("session_end"),

)

result = (

    WHERE (burst_cause IN ('pressure', 'digging', 'freeze') OR pump_station_id <= 10)

windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY meter_age_yrs DESC), 3) AS meter_age_yrs_cume_dist,
        ROUND(AVG(meter_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(meter_fitted_on), pump_station_id ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS meter_age_yrs_avg_3,
        RANK() OVER w_meter_kind_by_meter_age_yrs AS meter_age_yrs_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_meter_fitted_on_month_burst AS rows_in_meter_fitted_on_month_burst_cause,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(meter_fitted_on), meter_kind) AS rows_in_meter_fitted_on_month_meter_kind,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(pump_station_id) OVER w_meter_fitted_on_month_burst) AS distinct_pump_station_id_in_meter_fitted_on_mont,
        ROUND(AVG(meter_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind ORDER BY meter_age_yrs ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS meter_age_yrs_avg_1_prior,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_on), burst_cause) AS meter_fitted_on_month_burst_cause_max_chlorine_p,
        MIN(chlorine_ppm) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_on), burst_cause) AS meter_fitted_on_month_burst_cause_min_chlorine_p,
        DATEDIFF(meter_fitted_on, LAG(meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(meter_fitted_on), pump_station_id ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id)) AS days_since_prev_meter_fitted_on,
        MAX(meter_age_yrs) OVER w_meter_fitted_on_month_meter AS meter_fitted_on_month_meter_kind_max_meter_age_y,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(pump_station_id) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(meter_fitted_on), meter_kind)) AS distinct_pump_station_id_in_meter_fitted_on_mont_2
    FROM base_water_meters
    WINDOW w_meter_kind_by_meter_age_yrs AS (PARTITION BY meter_kind ORDER BY meter_age_yrs ASC), w_meter_fitted_on_month_burst AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_on), burst_cause), w_meter_fitted_on_month_meter AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(meter_fitted_on), meter_kind)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, burst_cause) AS rows_in_pump_station_id_burst_cause,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_age_yrs_avg_3) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY meter_age_yrs_avg_3, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_meter_age_yrs_avg_3,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(meter_kind) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, burst_cause)) AS distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau,
        NTH_VALUE(meter_fitted_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_age_yrs_rank, pump_station_id ORDER BY days_since_prev_meter_fitted_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_meter_fitted_on,
        SUM(meter_age_yrs_avg_1_prior) OVER (ORDER BY meter_age_yrs_avg_3, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS meter_age_yrs_avg_1_prior_sum_6_prior,
        ROUND(AVG(meter_age_yrs_cume_dist) OVER (ORDER BY meter_fitted_on_month_burst_cause_max_chlorine_p ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS meter_age_yrs_cume_dist_avg_6_prior
    FROM windowed
)
-- Final projection

    distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau,
    second_meter_fitted_on,
    meter_age_yrs_avg_1_prior_sum_6_prior,

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref,
        usage_m3 - flow_lpm AS usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
        COALESCE(meter_kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS meter_kind_or_unknown
    FROM pipe_bursts
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(street_ref)) LIKE 'M%'
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per station_tier
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        station_tier,
        meter_kind,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref,
        usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
        meter_kind_or_unknown
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY flow_lpm DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM unique_rows
    WHERE flow_lpm < (SELECT MAX(flow_lpm) FROM unique_rows)
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        flow_lpm,
        usage_m3,
        meter_fitted_on,
        street_ref,
        usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
        LEAST(flow_lpm, usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm) AS least_flow_lpm_usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_year
    FROM filtered
    WHERE flow_lpm >= 592.1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    flow_lpm,
    usage_m3,
    street_ref,
    usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
    least_flow_lpm_usage_m3_minus_flow_lpm,
    meter_fitted_on_year,
    TO_DATE(meter_fitted_on_year) AS meter_fitted_on_year_date,
    ROUND(usage_m3 / NULLIF(flow_lpm, 0), 3) AS usage_m3_per_flow_lpm
FROM labeled
WHERE usage_m3 >= 46.7
ORDER BY flow_lpm DESC, usage_m3

WITH recent_pledges AS (
    -- Scope the pledges rows
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        DATE_FORMAT(awarded_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS awarded_date_label,
        DATE_FORMAT(awarded_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS awarded_date_label_2
    FROM pledges
    WHERE awarded_date >= DATE '2024-09-19'
      AND cause_area IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per cause_area, donor_ref
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        awarded_date_label,
        awarded_date_label_2
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref ORDER BY awarded_date DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM recent_pledges
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        awarded_date_label,
        awarded_date_label_2,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area) AS rows_in_cause_area,
        LAG(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, cause_area ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS prev_pledge_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_donor_ref_cause_area_by_pled_2 AS pledge_amount_dense_rank
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_donor_ref_cause_area_by_pled_2 AS (PARTITION BY donor_ref, cause_area ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount_dense_rank,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month,
        ROUND(SUM(prev_pledge_amount), 2) AS total_prev_pledge_amount,
        ROUND(AVG(prev_pledge_amount), 2) AS avg_prev_pledge_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        SUM(pledge_amount_dense_rank) AS total_pledge_amount_dense_rank,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cause_area) AS distinct_cause_areas
    FROM sequenced
    GROUP BY cause_area, pledge_amount_dense_rank, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT pledge_amount_dense_rank, awarded_date_month, cause_area, avg_prev_pledge_amount
    FROM rollup_base
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(avg_prev_pledge_amount)
    FOR cause_area IN ('climate', 'animals', 'health', 'education')
)

WITH recent_telemetry_frames AS (
    -- Scope the telemetry_frames rows
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        frame_seq,
        burn_secs,
        frame_at,
        mission_name
    FROM telemetry_frames
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous frame_at per mission_state
    SELECT *, LAG(frame_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_at, id) AS prev_frame_at
    FROM recent_telemetry_frames
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_frame_at IS NULL OR frame_at > prev_frame_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_state ORDER BY frame_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        mission_state,
        session_no,
        MIN(frame_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(frame_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(frame_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(frame_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY mission_state, session_no
)
SELECT
    mission_state,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', session_start) AS days_since_session_start
FROM per_session

WITH base_finance_deals AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_year
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE (deal_status IN ('quoted', 'signed') OR UPPER(TRIM(vin_tail)) LIKE 'B%')
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date
    FROM base_finance_deals s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        car_stock_arrived_date,
        LAST_VALUE(car_stock_arrived_date) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date), car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_car_stock_arrived_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on_year)) AS rows_in_arrived_on_year_year,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_arrived_on_year_month_deal_s AS rows_in_arrived_on_year_month_deal_status,
        LAST_VALUE(arrived_on) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) ORDER BY arrived_on_year DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_arrived_on,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(deal_status) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on_year))) AS distinct_deal_status_in_arrived_on_year_year,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date), car_stock_id ORDER BY arrived_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        LAG(odometer_kms) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id) AS prev_odometer_kms,
        NTH_VALUE(drive_mins, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on), car_stock_body_style ORDER BY arrived_on_year, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_drive_mins,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS drive_mins_avg_3_prior,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status) AS arrived_on_year_month_deal_status_sum_drive_mins,
        ROUND(odometer_kms / NULLIF(SUM(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status), 0), 4) AS odometer_kms_share_of_arrived_on_year_month_deal,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(car_stock_body_style) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status)) AS distinct_car_stock_body_style_in_arrived_on_year,
        SUM(drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS drive_mins_sum_3_prior,
        SUM(odometer_kms) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY odometer_kms DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS odometer_kms_sum_3_prior
    FROM with_parent
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_year_month_deal_s AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on_year), deal_status)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    deal_status,
    drive_mins,
    arrived_on,
    is_certified_used,
    car_stock_arrived_date,
    last_car_stock_arrived_date,
    rows_in_arrived_on_year_year,
    last_arrived_on,
    running_count,
    second_drive_mins,
    drive_mins_avg_3_prior,
    arrived_on_year_month_deal_status_sum_drive_mins,
    odometer_kms_share_of_arrived_on_year_month_deal,
    distinct_car_stock_body_style_in_arrived_on_year,
    drive_mins_sum_3_prior,
    odometer_kms_sum_3_prior,
    DATEDIFF(car_stock_arrived_date, last_arrived_on) AS days_last_arrived_on_to_car_stock_arrived_date
FROM ranked
ORDER BY odometer_kms_sum_3_prior, deal_status DESC NULLS FIRST

        F.size(F.collect_set("deal_status").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("arrived_on_year")))).alias("distinct_deal_status_in_arrived_on_year_year"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "car_stock_arrived_date"), "car_stock_id").orderBy(F.col("arrived_on").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.lag("odometer_kms").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("odometer_kms").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_odometer_kms"),
        F.nth_value("drive_mins", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("arrived_on"), "car_stock_body_style").orderBy("arrived_on_year", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_drive_mins"),
        F.round(F.avg("drive_mins").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("odometer_kms").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("drive_mins_avg_3_prior"),
        F.sum("drive_mins").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on_year"), "deal_status")).alias("arrived_on_year_month_deal_status_sum_drive_mins"),
        F.round(F.col("odometer_kms") / F.nullif(F.sum("odometer_kms").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on_year"), "deal_status")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("odometer_kms_share_of_arrived_on_year_month_deal"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("car_stock_body_style").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "arrived_on_year"), "deal_status"))).alias("distinct_car_stock_body_style_in_arrived_on_year"),
        F.sum("drive_mins").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("odometer_kms").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("drive_mins_sum_3_prior"),
        F.sum("odometer_kms").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "car_stock_arrived_date")).orderBy(F.col("odometer_kms").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("odometer_kms_sum_3_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "deal_status",
        "drive_mins",
        "arrived_on",
        "is_certified_used",
        "car_stock_arrived_date",
        "last_car_stock_arrived_date",
        "rows_in_arrived_on_year_year",
        "last_arrived_on",
        "running_count",
        "second_drive_mins",
        "drive_mins_avg_3_prior",
        "arrived_on_year_month_deal_status_sum_drive_mins",
        "odometer_kms_share_of_arrived_on_year_month_deal",
        "distinct_car_stock_body_style_in_arrived_on_year",
        "drive_mins_sum_3_prior",
        "odometer_kms_sum_3_prior",
        F.datediff(F.col("car_stock_arrived_date"), F.col("last_arrived_on")).alias("days_last_arrived_on_to_car_stock_arrived_date"),
    )
    .orderBy("odometer_kms_sum_3_prior", F.col("deal_status").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Scope the grooming_jobs rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        visit_reason,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs / NULLIF(pet_weight_kg, 0), 3) AS pet_age_yrs_per_pet_weight_kg
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE (visit_reason = 'checkup' OR kennel_nights BETWEEN 10 AND 27)
),
exploded AS (
    -- One row per diet_tag
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pets_reg_id,
        s.visit_reason,
        s.kennel_size,
        s.pet_weight_kg,
        s.kennel_nights,
        s.pet_age_yrs,
        s.groomed_at,
        s.pet_age_yrs_per_pet_weight_kg,
        t.diet_tag
    FROM valid s
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(s.diet_tags) t AS diet_tag
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(diet_tag, 'ALL') AS diet_tag,
    COALESCE(visit_reason, 'ALL') AS visit_reason,
    COALESCE(kennel_size, 'ALL') AS kennel_size,
    MAX(groomed_at) AS last_groomed_at
FROM exploded
GROUP BY ROLLUP(diet_tag, visit_reason, kennel_size)
ORDER BY diet_tag NULLS LAST, visit_reason NULLS LAST, kennel_size NULLS LAST

WITH valid_usage_reads AS (
    -- Filter usage_reads
    SELECT
        id,
        water_meter_id,
        chlorine_ppm,
        burst_litres,
        meter_fitted_date,
        ABS(chlorine_ppm - 2.1) AS chlorine_ppm_distance
    FROM usage_reads
    WHERE water_meter_id IS NOT NULL
      AND burst_litres > 49130
),
usage_read_stats AS (
    -- Per-water_meter usage_reads metrics
    SELECT
        water_meter_id,
        MAX(meter_fitted_date) AS last_usage_read_meter_fitted_date,
        COUNT(*) AS usage_read_count
    FROM usage_reads
    GROUP BY water_meter_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach usage_reads metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        u.last_usage_read_meter_fitted_date,
        COALESCE(u.usage_read_count, 0) AS usage_read_count
    FROM valid_usage_reads s
    LEFT JOIN usage_read_stats u ON u.water_meter_id = s.water_meter_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach water_meter attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.water_meter_id,
        s.chlorine_ppm,
        s.burst_litres,
        s.last_usage_read_meter_fitted_date,
        s.usage_read_count,
        w.meter_fitted_on AS water_meter_meter_fitted_on
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN water_meters w ON w.id = s.water_meter_id
    WHERE w.meter_fitted_on >= DATE '2025-02-19'
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching usage_reads
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM usage_reads u
            WHERE u.water_meter_id = s.water_meter_id
              AND u.tariff_band = 'factory'
        )
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    water_meter_id,
    chlorine_ppm,
    burst_litres,
    water_meter_meter_fitted_on
FROM screened
ORDER BY water_meter_meter_fitted_on DESC, burst_litres NULLS LAST

    FROM labeled

    value FOR measure IN (pet_weight_kg, pet_weight_kg_distance)
) unp

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        coat_type,
        visit_cost,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_ts,
        TO_DATE(groomed_ts) AS groomed_ts_date
    FROM pet_owners
    WHERE TO_DATE(groomed_ts) < DATE '2025-02-24'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_ts per coat_type
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY coat_type ORDER BY groomed_ts, id) AS prev_groomed_ts
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(groomed_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_groomed_ts)) / 60 > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY coat_type ORDER BY groomed_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
coat_type_stats AS (
    -- Max session_no per coat_type
    SELECT coat_type, MAX(session_no) AS max_session_no
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY coat_type
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_session_no,
        ROUND(s.session_no - g.max_session_no, 2) AS session_no_minus_max
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN coat_type_stats g ON g.coat_type = s.coat_type
    WHERE s.session_no = g.max_session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    coat_type,
    groomed_ts,
    prev_groomed_ts,
    session_no,
    session_no_minus_max,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', groomed_ts_date) AS days_since_groomed_ts_date,
    COALESCE(max_session_no, 0.0) AS max_session_no_filled
FROM outliers
ORDER BY session_no_minus_max DESC, coat_type

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_pet_owners
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("groomed_ts")) < F.lit("2025-02-24").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "coat_type",
        "visit_cost",
        "pet_age_yrs",
        "groomed_ts",
        F.to_date(F.col("groomed_ts")).alias("groomed_ts_date"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_groomed_ts", F.lag("groomed_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("coat_type").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_groomed_ts").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("groomed_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_groomed_ts")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("coat_type").orderBy("groomed_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

coat_type_stats = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("coat_type")
    .agg(F.max("session_no").alias("max_session_no"))
)

outliers = (
    sessionized.alias("s")
    .join(coat_type_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.coat_type") == F.col("s.coat_type"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.session_no") == F.col("g.max_session_no"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_session_no",
        F.round(F.col("s.session_no") - F.col("g.max_session_no"), 2).alias("session_no_minus_max"),
    )
)

result = (
    outliers
    .select(
        "id",
        "coat_type",
        "groomed_ts",
        "prev_groomed_ts",
        "session_no",
        "session_no_minus_max",

        F.coalesce(F.col("max_session_no"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("max_session_no_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("session_no_minus_max").desc(), "coat_type")
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the finance_deals rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', arrived_on) AS days_since_arrived_on,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_quarter
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE drive_mins >= 37
),
with_parent_car_stock AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.vin_tail,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.days_since_arrived_on,
        s.arrived_on_quarter,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id
    FROM base s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_mins,
        vin_tail,
        days_since_arrived_on,
        arrived_on_quarter,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(car_stock_arrived_date), is_certified_used ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter DESC, id), 3) AS arrived_on_quarter_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_car_stock_arrived_date_year, 3) AS days_since_arrived_on_cume_dist,
        LAG(days_since_arrived_on) OVER w_car_stock_arrived_date_year_2 AS prev_days_since_arrived_on,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(car_stock_showroom_id) OVER w_is_certified_used) AS distinct_car_stock_showroom_id_in_is_certified_u,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on, id) AS days_since_arrived_on_quartile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(car_stock_arrived_date), is_certified_used ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter DESC, id) AS arrived_on_quarter_seq,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(car_stock_arrived_date), car_stock_id) AS rows_in_car_stock_arrived_date_month_car_stock_i
    FROM with_parent_car_stock
    WINDOW w_car_stock_arrived_date_year AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on), w_car_stock_arrived_date_year_2 AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(car_stock_arrived_date) ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on, id), w_is_certified_used AS (PARTITION BY is_certified_used)
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        vin_tail,
        days_since_arrived_on,
        arrived_on_quarter_percent_rank,
        days_since_arrived_on_quartile,
        arrived_on_quarter_seq,
        rows_in_car_stock_arrived_date_month_car_stock_i,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(car_stock_id) OVER w_arrived_on_quarter_seq) AS distinct_car_stock_id_in_arrived_on_quarter_seq,
        LAG(prev_days_since_arrived_on, 3) OVER w_all_by_prev_days_since_arriv AS prev3_prev_days_since_arrived_on,
        ROUND(drive_mins - AVG(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY arrived_on_quarter_seq), 2) AS drive_mins_vs_arrived_on_quarter_seq_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(days_since_arrived_on) OVER (ORDER BY arrived_on_quarter_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS days_since_arrived_on_avg_7,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_arrived_on_quartile DESC NULLS FIRST), 3) AS days_since_arrived_on_quartile_percent_rank
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_quarter_seq AS (PARTITION BY arrived_on_quarter_seq), w_all_by_prev_days_since_arriv AS (ORDER BY prev_days_since_arrived_on ASC, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    vin_tail,
    days_since_arrived_on,
    arrived_on_quarter_percent_rank,
    days_since_arrived_on_quartile,
    arrived_on_quarter_seq,
    rows_in_car_stock_arrived_date_month_car_stock_i,
    drive_mins_vs_arrived_on_quarter_seq_avg,
    days_since_arrived_on_avg_7

WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the pets_reg rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        visit_day,
        diet_tags,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', visit_day) AS days_since_visit_day,
        CONCAT(coat_kind, '#', CAST(pet_owner_id AS STRING)) AS coat_kind_ref,
        COALESCE(pet_age_yrs, 0) AS pet_age_yrs_filled
    FROM pets_reg
),
with_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.coat_type AS pet_owner_coat_type,
        p.groomed_ts AS pet_owner_groomed_ts,
        p.visit_cost AS pet_owner_visit_cost
    FROM base s
    JOIN pet_owners p ON p.id = s.pet_owner_id AND p.coat_type NOT IN ('curly', 'long')
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching vet_visits
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_details s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM vet_visits v
            WHERE v.pets_reg_id = s.id
              AND v.pet_age_yrs >= 8
        )
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        pet_owner_id,
        coat_kind,
        kennel_nights,
        visit_day,
        diet_tags,
        days_since_visit_day,
        coat_kind_ref,
        pet_age_yrs_filled,
        pet_owner_coat_type,
        pet_owner_visit_cost,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs_filled / NULLIF(SUM(pet_age_yrs_filled) OVER w_pet_owner_groomed_ts_month, 0), 4) AS pet_age_yrs_filled_share_of_pet_owner_groomed_ts,
        DATEDIFF(visit_day, LAG(visit_day) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_visit_day, id)) AS days_since_prev_visit_day,
        LAST_VALUE(days_since_visit_day) OVER (PARTITION BY pet_owner_coat_type ORDER BY pet_owner_visit_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_days_since_visit_day,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_days_since_visit_day_2, 3) AS days_since_visit_day_percent_rank
    FROM without_matches
    WINDOW w_pet_owner_groomed_ts_month AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pet_owner_groomed_ts)), w_all_by_days_since_visit_day_2 AS (ORDER BY days_since_visit_day)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(pet_owner_coat_type, 'ALL') AS pet_owner_coat_type,
    COALESCE(coat_kind, 'ALL') AS coat_kind,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(pet_age_yrs_filled) AS total_pet_age_yrs_filled
FROM with_trends
GROUP BY ROLLUP(pet_owner_coat_type, coat_kind)
ORDER BY pet_owner_coat_type NULLS LAST, coat_kind NULLS LAST

WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        groomed_at
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE visit_reason = 'vaccine'
      AND kennel_nights < 27
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM recent
    WHERE kennel_nights > (SELECT MIN(kennel_nights) FROM recent)
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach vet_visits metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(v.groom_mins) FROM vet_visits v WHERE v.pets_reg_id = s.pets_reg_id) AS min_vet_visit_groom_mins,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vet_visits v WHERE v.pets_reg_id = s.pets_reg_id) AS vet_visit_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vet_visits v WHERE v.pets_reg_id = s.pets_reg_id) AS vet_visit_count_2
    FROM filtered s
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', groomed_at) AS days_since_groomed_at
    FROM summarized_rows
),
with_parent_pets_reg AS (
    -- Attach pets_reg attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pets_reg_id,
        s.pet_weight_kg,
        s.kennel_nights,
        s.vet_visit_count,
        s.vet_visit_count_2,
        p.kennel_nights AS pets_reg_kennel_nights,
        p.flag_is_neutered AS pets_reg_flag_is_neutered
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN pets_reg p ON p.id = s.pets_reg_id
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        pets_reg_id,
        pets_reg_flag_is_neutered,
        CASE WHEN pet_weight_kg >= 42.9 THEN 'large' WHEN pet_weight_kg >= 12.0 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS pet_weight_kg_tier,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pets_reg_flag_is_neutered = FALSE) AS n_pets_reg_flag_is_neutered_fa,
        ROUND(SUM(pet_weight_kg) / NULLIF(SUM(kennel_nights), 0), 3) AS pet_weight_kg_to_kennel_nights_ratio,
        MAX(vet_visit_count_2) AS max_vet_visit_count_2
    FROM with_parent_pets_reg
    WHERE vet_visit_count_2 <= 6
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    pets_reg_flag_is_neutered,
    pet_weight_kg_tier,
    n_pets_reg_flag_is_neutered_fa,
    pet_weight_kg_to_kennel_nights_ratio,
    max_vet_visit_count_2,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(pet_weight_kg_tier), ' ', '_')) AS pet_weight_kg_tier_slug,
    ABS(max_vet_visit_count_2 - 3) AS max_vet_visit_count_2_distance
FROM stats

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .filter((F.col("visit_reason") == "vaccine") & (F.col("kennel_nights") < 27))
    .select(
        "id",
        "pets_reg_id",
        "pet_weight_kg",
        "kennel_nights",
        "groomed_at",
    )
)

filtered = (
    recent
    .crossJoin(recent.agg(F.min("kennel_nights").alias("overall_min_kennel_nights")))
    .filter(F.col("kennel_nights") > F.col("overall_min_kennel_nights"))
    .drop("overall_min_kennel_nights")
)

vet_visit_stats = (
    df_vet_visits
    .groupBy("pets_reg_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("groom_mins").alias("min_vet_visit_groom_mins"),
        F.count("*").alias("vet_visit_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("vet_visit_count_2"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    filtered.alias("s")
    .join(vet_visit_stats.alias("v"), F.col("v.pets_reg_id") == F.col("s.pets_reg_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "v.min_vet_visit_groom_mins",
        F.coalesce(F.col("v.vet_visit_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("vet_visit_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("v.vet_visit_count_2"), F.lit(0)).alias("vet_visit_count_2"),
    )
)

scored = (
    summarized_rows
    .withColumn("days_since_groomed_at", F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("groomed_at")))
)

with_parent_pets_reg = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(df_pets_reg.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.pets_reg_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.pets_reg_id",
        "s.pet_weight_kg",
        "s.kennel_nights",
        "s.vet_visit_count",
        "s.vet_visit_count_2",
        F.col("p.kennel_nights").alias("pets_reg_kennel_nights"),
        F.col("p.flag_is_neutered").alias("pets_reg_flag_is_neutered"),
    )
)

stats = (
    with_parent_pets_reg
    .filter(F.col("vet_visit_count_2") <= 6)
    .groupBy(
        "pets_reg_id",
        "pets_reg_flag_is_neutered",
        F.when(F.col("pet_weight_kg") >= 42.9, "large").when(F.col("pet_weight_kg") >= 12.0, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("pet_weight_kg_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("pets_reg_flag_is_neutered"), 1)).alias("n_pets_reg_flag_is_neutered_fa"),
        F.round(F.sum("pet_weight_kg") / F.nullif(F.sum("kennel_nights"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("pet_weight_kg_to_kennel_nights_ratio"),
        F.max("vet_visit_count_2").alias("max_vet_visit_count_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "pets_reg_id",
        "pets_reg_flag_is_neutered",
        "pet_weight_kg_tier",
        "n_pets_reg_flag_is_neutered_fa",
        "pet_weight_kg_to_kennel_nights_ratio",
        "max_vet_visit_count_2",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("pet_weight_kg_tier")), " ", "_")).alias("pet_weight_kg_tier_slug"),
        F.abs(F.col("max_vet_visit_count_2") - 3).alias("max_vet_visit_count_2_distance"),
    )
)

WITH stacked AS (
    -- Stack the branches
    SELECT
        visit_reason,
        id AS ref_id,
        species,
        'kennel' AS origin
    FROM kennels

    UNION ALL

        'grooming_job' AS origin
    FROM grooming_jobs

SELECT origin, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(ref_id) AS total_ref_id
FROM stacked
GROUP BY origin
ORDER BY origin

WITH valid_missions AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        is_reusable,
        CASE WHEN burn_secs >= 507 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN burn_secs >= 320 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS burn_secs_tier,
        LENGTH(TRIM(mission_state)) AS mission_state_len,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', launched_on) AS days_since_launched_on
    FROM missions
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching missions
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_missions s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM missions m
            WHERE m.rocket_id = s.rocket_id
              AND m.apogee_km <= 23437.1
        )
      AND s.mission_state_len <= 11
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(apogee_km) OVER (ORDER BY mission_state_len ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS prev_apogee_km,
        ROUND(mission_state_len - AVG(mission_state_len) OVER (PARTITION BY is_reusable), 2) AS mission_state_len_vs_is_reusable_avg
    FROM without_matches
)
SELECT id, field, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, apogee_km, mission_state_len_vs_is_reusable_avg, prev_apogee_km
    FROM metrics
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR field IN (apogee_km, mission_state_len_vs_is_reusable_avg, prev_apogee_km)
) unp
ORDER BY id, field

WITH valid_pump_stations AS (
    -- Scope the pump_stations rows
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts
    FROM pump_stations
    WHERE station_tier = 'booster'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous burst_ts per station_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(burst_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id) AS prev_burst_ts
    FROM valid_pump_stations
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_burst_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(burst_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_burst_ts)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY station_tier ORDER BY burst_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        station_tier,
        burst_id,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(burst_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(meter_age_yrs) AS session_meter_age_yrs,

WITH scoped_pump_stations AS (
    -- Scope the pump_stations rows
    SELECT
        id,
        station_tier,
        tariff_band,
        pressure_bar,
        meter_age_yrs,
        burst_ts,
        street_ref,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(street_ref), ' ', '_')) AS street_ref_slug,
        meter_age_yrs + pressure_bar AS meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar
    FROM pump_stations
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(burst_ts, 'yyyy-MM') AS burst_ts_ym,
        ROUND(AVG(meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar), 2) AS avg_meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar,
        MIN(burst_ts) AS first_burst_ts,
        MAX(pressure_bar) AS max_pressure_bar,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM scoped_pump_stations
    WHERE street_ref_slug IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(burst_ts, 'yyyy-MM')
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM rollup_base
    WHERE distinct_ids < (SELECT MAX(distinct_ids) FROM rollup_base)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    burst_ts_ym,
    avg_meter_age_yrs_plus_pressure_bar,
    max_pressure_bar,
    distinct_ids
FROM screened
WHERE distinct_ids >= 2
ORDER BY burst_ts_ym DESC
LIMIT 10

        visit_reason,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        kennel_nights,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(visit_reason), 1, 2) AS visit_reason_prefix
    FROM grooming_jobs
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous groomed_at per kennel_size
    SELECT *, LAG(groomed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY kennel_size ORDER BY groomed_at, id) AS prev_groomed_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_groomed_at IS NULL OR groomed_at > prev_groomed_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY kennel_size ORDER BY groomed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        kennel_size,
        session_id,
        MIN(groomed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(groomed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(pet_weight_kg) AS session_pet_weight_kg,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(groomed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(groomed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY kennel_size, session_id
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE events > (SELECT AVG(events) FROM session_summary)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT kennel_size, session_id, field, metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT kennel_size, session_id, duration_min, session_pet_weight_kg
    FROM with_activity
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR field IN (duration_min, session_pet_weight_kg)
) unp

    FROM pledges

windowed AS (

    SELECT

        ROUND(pledge_amount_bucket - AVG(pledge_amount_bucket) OVER w_cause_area_donor_ref, 2) AS pledge_amount_bucket_vs_cause_area_donor_ref_avg,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_awarded_date, id), 3) AS days_since_awarded_date_cume_dist,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_days_since_awarded_da_2, 3) AS days_since_awarded_date_cume_dist_2,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, cause_area) AS rows_in_donor_ref_cause_area,
        MAX(days_since_awarded_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref) AS cause_area_donor_ref_max_days_since_awarded_date,
        LAG(days_since_awarded_date, 3, 0) OVER w_awarded_date_month_by_awarde AS prev3_days_since_awarded_date,
        MAX(pledge_amount) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_awarded_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS pledge_amount_max_3_prior,
        MIN(pledge_amount_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, cause_area) AS donor_ref_cause_area_min_pledge_amount_bucket,
        ROUND(pledge_amount - AVG(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref), 2) AS pledge_amount_vs_cause_area_donor_ref_avg,
        LAG(pledge_amount_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(awarded_date) ORDER BY awarded_date, id) AS prev_pledge_amount_bucket,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_all_by_days_since_awarded_da AS days_since_awarded_date_decile,

        pledge_amount - LAG(pledge_amount) OVER w_all_by_days_since_awarded_da AS pledge_amount_change,

)

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        gift_count,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date
    FROM volunteer_shifts
    WHERE goal_amount > 872675.9
      AND pledged_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-05-31' AND DATE '2025-08-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, FLOOR(goal_amount / 1000000) * 1000000 AS goal_amount_bucket
    FROM prepared
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_id,
        grant_stage,
        goal_amount,
        pledged_date,
        goal_amount_bucket,
        DATEDIFF(pledged_date, LAG(pledged_date) OVER w_campaigns_ch_id_by_pledged_d) AS days_since_prev_pledged_date,
        LAST_VALUE(gift_count) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_gift_count,
        LAST_VALUE(goal_amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_goal_amount,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date), 3) AS pledged_date_cume_dist,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date, id), 3) AS pledged_date_cume_dist_2,
        SUM(goal_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_goal_amount
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_campaigns_ch_id_by_pledged_d AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_id ORDER BY pledged_date, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    campaigns_ch_id,
    grant_stage,
    goal_amount,
    pledged_date,
    goal_amount_bucket,
    days_since_prev_pledged_date,
    last_known_gift_count,
    last_known_goal_amount,
    pledged_date_cume_dist,
    pledged_date_cume_dist_2,
    running_goal_amount,
    DATE_FORMAT(pledged_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS pledged_date_label,
    COALESCE(running_goal_amount, 0.0) AS running_goal_amount_filled
FROM windowed
ORDER BY campaigns_ch_id DESC NULLS FIRST, pledged_date_cume_dist_2 DESC

WITH valid_launch_sites AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        site_country,
        payload_kind,
        thrust_kn,
        burn_secs,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', launched_on) AS launched_on_week,
        LENGTH(TRIM(site_country)) AS site_country_len
    FROM launch_sites
    WHERE launched_on < DATE '2025-02-20'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM valid_launch_sites
    WHERE burn_secs < (SELECT MAX(burn_secs) FROM valid_launch_sites)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', launched_on_week) AS days_since_launched_on_week,
        LENGTH(TRIM(payload_kind)) AS payload_kind_len
    FROM filtered
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT launched_on_week, site_country_len, site_country, payload_kind_len
    FROM annotated
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(payload_kind_len)
    FOR site_country IN ('US', 'FR')
)
ORDER BY launched_on_week, site_country_len

        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        COALESCE(cause_area, 'UNKNOWN') AS cause_area_or_unknown,
        MONTH(awarded_date) AS awarded_date_month
    FROM pledges
    WHERE pledge_amount > 11835.9
      AND donor_ref IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_donor AS (
    -- Attach donor attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.donor_ref,
        s.cause_area,
        s.pledge_amount,
        s.awarded_date,
        s.awarded_date_month,
        d.pledge_amt AS donor_pledge_amt,
        d.channel_tags AS donor_channel_tags
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN donors d ON d.id = s.donor_ref
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        awarded_date_month,
        donor_pledge_amt,
        donor_channel_tags,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref ORDER BY awarded_date_month, id), 3) AS awarded_date_month_percent_rank,
        MAX(awarded_date_month) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) ORDER BY donor_pledge_amt, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS awarded_date_month_max_6_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref ORDER BY awarded_date_month, id) AS awarded_date_month_rank,
        awarded_date_month - LAG(awarded_date_month) OVER w_awarded_date_month_by_pledge AS awarded_date_month_change,
        ROUND(awarded_date_month / NULLIF(SUM(awarded_date_month) OVER w_awarded_date_month_cause_are, 0), 4) AS awarded_date_month_share_of_awarded_date_month_c,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC, id) AS pledge_amount_decile,
        LAST_VALUE(awarded_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month ORDER BY pledge_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_awarded_date,
        MAX(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month, cause_area) AS awarded_date_month_cause_area_max_pledge_amount,
        pledge_amount - LAG(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month ORDER BY awarded_date ASC, id) AS pledge_amount_change,
        ROUND(pledge_amount - AVG(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month, cause_area), 2) AS pledge_amount_vs_awarded_date_month_cause_area_a,
        RANK() OVER w_donor_ref_by_awarded_date_mo_2 AS awarded_date_month_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) ORDER BY donor_pledge_amt, id) AS donor_pledge_amt_dense_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_awarded_date_month_cause_are AS rows_in_awarded_date_month_cause_area,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', awarded_date) ORDER BY donor_pledge_amt), 3) AS donor_pledge_amt_cume_dist
    FROM enriched_donor
    WINDOW w_awarded_date_month_by_pledge AS (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month ORDER BY pledge_amount, id), w_awarded_date_month_cause_are AS (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month, cause_area), w_donor_ref_by_awarded_date_mo_2 AS (PARTITION BY donor_ref ORDER BY awarded_date_month)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        donor_pledge_amt,
        awarded_date_month_percent_rank,
        awarded_date_month_max_6_prior,
        awarded_date_month_rank,

        pledge_amount_decile,

        pledge_amount_change,
        pledge_amount_vs_awarded_date_month_cause_area_a,
        awarded_date_month_rank_2,
        donor_pledge_amt_dense_rank,
        rows_in_awarded_date_month_cause_area,
        NTH_VALUE(donor_pledge_amt_cume_dist, 2) OVER (ORDER BY pledge_amount_decile ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_donor_pledge_amt_cume_dist,
        MIN(donor_pledge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY awarded_date_month) AS awarded_date_month_min_donor_pledge_amt,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, awarded_date_month_rank ORDER BY awarded_date_month_rank NULLS LAST), 3) AS awarded_date_month_rank_percent_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(awarded_date_month_change) OVER (PARTITION BY pledge_amount_decile, awarded_date_month_rank_2), 2) AS pledge_amount_decile_awarded_date_month_rank_2_a
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    id,
    cause_area,
    awarded_date_month_percent_rank,
    awarded_date_month_max_6_prior,
    awarded_date_month_rank,
    awarded_date_month_change,

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the grooming_jobs rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        visit_reason,
        kennel_size,
        pet_weight_kg,
        pet_age_yrs,
        groomed_at,
        diet_tags,
        FLOOR(pet_weight_kg / 10) * 10 AS pet_weight_kg_bucket,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', visit_reason, kennel_size) AS visit_reason_kennel_size_label
    FROM grooming_jobs
),
grooming_job_stats AS (
    -- Per-pets_reg grooming_jobs metrics
    SELECT
        pets_reg_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN visit_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS grooming_job_visit_reason_count
    FROM grooming_jobs
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach grooming_jobs metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(g.grooming_job_visit_reason_count, 0) AS grooming_job_visit_reason_count
    FROM prepared s
    LEFT JOIN grooming_job_stats g ON g.pets_reg_id = s.pets_reg_id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, kennel_size ORDER BY grooming_job_visit_reason_count, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pet_age_yrs,
        NTH_VALUE(pet_weight_kg_bucket, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY grooming_job_visit_reason_count, pets_reg_id ORDER BY groomed_at DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_pet_weight_kg_bucket
    FROM summarized_rows
)
SELECT
    id,
    pets_reg_id,
    visit_reason,
    kennel_size,
    pet_weight_kg,
    pet_age_yrs,
    diet_tags,
    pet_weight_kg_bucket,
    grooming_job_visit_reason_count,
    running_pet_age_yrs,
    second_pet_weight_kg_bucket
FROM sequenced
ORDER BY pet_weight_kg, second_pet_weight_kg_bucket DESC

WITH filtered_water_meters AS (
    -- Filter water_meters
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        CASE WHEN burst_cause IN ('freeze', 'digging') THEN 'group_a' WHEN burst_cause = 'pressure' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS burst_cause_group
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE meter_fitted_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-16' AND DATE '2025-06-27'
      AND meter_age_yrs <= 21
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm ASC NULLS LAST), 3) AS chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, burst_cause) AS rows_in_pump_station_id_burst_cause,
        ROUND(meter_age_yrs / NULLIF(SUM(meter_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, burst_cause), 0), 4) AS meter_age_yrs_share_of_pump_station_id_burst_cau,
        meter_age_yrs - LAG(meter_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY meter_kind, burst_cause_group ORDER BY chlorine_ppm DESC, id) AS meter_age_yrs_change,
        chlorine_ppm - LAG(chlorine_ppm) OVER (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS chlorine_ppm_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm ASC NULLS LAST, id) AS seq_no,
        LAG(meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, meter_kind ORDER BY meter_age_yrs, id) AS prev_meter_fitted_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_fitted_on) OVER (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_meter_fitted_on,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(meter_kind) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, burst_cause)) AS distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau
    FROM filtered_water_meters
    WINDOW w_all_by_chlorine_ppm_ties AS (ORDER BY chlorine_ppm ASC NULLS LAST)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        meter_fitted_on,
        chlorine_ppm_cume_dist,
        rows_in_pump_station_id_burst_cause,
        meter_age_yrs_share_of_pump_station_id_burst_cau,
        meter_age_yrs_change,
        chlorine_ppm_change,
        prev_meter_fitted_on,
        first_meter_fitted_on,
        distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY burst_cause, distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau) AS rows_in_burst_cause_distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_,
        MAX(chlorine_ppm_change) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id ORDER BY meter_age_yrs_change NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_chlorine_ppm_change_so_far,
        MIN(chlorine_ppm_cume_dist) OVER w_burst_cause_distinct_meter_k AS burst_cause_distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_,
        LAG(first_meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', prev_meter_fitted_on), seq_no ORDER BY distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau ASC, id) AS prev_first_meter_fitted_on
    FROM sequenced
    WINDOW w_burst_cause_distinct_meter_k AS (PARTITION BY burst_cause, distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau)
)
SELECT
    id,
    burst_cause,
    meter_kind,
    meter_age_yrs,
    meter_fitted_on,
    meter_age_yrs_change,
    chlorine_ppm_change,
    prev_meter_fitted_on,
    distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau,
    rows_in_burst_cause_distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_,
    max_chlorine_ppm_change_so_far,
    burst_cause_distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_
FROM with_trends
ORDER BY distinct_meter_kind_in_pump_station_id_burst_cau DESC NULLS FIRST, meter_age_yrs DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH recent AS (
    -- Scope the grooming_jobs rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        pet_age_yrs,
        diet_tags,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(visit_reason), 1, 4) AS visit_reason_prefix,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(diet_tags, 'renal') AS has_renal
    FROM grooming_jobs
    WHERE pet_weight_kg BETWEEN 16.6 AND 34.8
      AND pet_age_yrs BETWEEN 7 AND 15
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, has_renal ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC, id) AS next_pet_age_yrs,
        MIN(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, has_renal ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_pet_age_yrs_so_far,
        ROUND(AVG(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, has_renal ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS pet_age_yrs_avg_4,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_kennel_size_has_renal_by_pet AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(pet_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_pet_age_yrs,
        ROUND(pet_age_yrs / NULLIF(SUM(pet_age_yrs) OVER w_kennel_size, 0), 4) AS pet_age_yrs_share_of_kennel_size
    FROM recent
    WINDOW w_kennel_size_has_renal_by_pet AS (PARTITION BY kennel_size, has_renal ORDER BY pet_age_yrs DESC, id), w_kennel_size AS (PARTITION BY kennel_size)
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        pets_reg_id,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(kennel_size)) AS kennel_size_list,
        ROUND(SUM(min_pet_age_yrs_so_far) / NULLIF(SUM(pet_age_yrs_share_of_kennel_size), 0), 3) AS min_pet_age_yrs_so_far_to_pet_age_yrs_share_of_k
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
),
per_label AS (
    -- One row per kennel_size_list_item
    SELECT
        s.pets_reg_id,
        s.cnt,
        s.min_pet_age_yrs_so_far_to_pet_age_yrs_share_of_k,
        t.kennel_size_list_item
    FROM stats s
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(s.kennel_size_list) t AS kennel_size_list_item
)
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    cnt,
    min_pet_age_yrs_so_far_to_pet_age_yrs_share_of_k,
    kennel_size_list_item,
    CASE WHEN cnt >= 8 THEN 'large' WHEN cnt >= 3 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS cnt_tier,
    FLOOR(cnt / 2) * 2 AS cnt_bucket
FROM per_label
ORDER BY cnt, kennel_size_list_item DESC, pets_reg_id
LIMIT 5

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_grooming_jobs
    .filter((F.col("pet_weight_kg").between(16.6, 34.8)) & (F.col("pet_age_yrs").between(7, 15)))
    .select(

        "kennel_size",
        "pet_age_yrs",
        "diet_tags",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("visit_reason")), 1, 4).alias("visit_reason_prefix"),
        F.array_contains(F.col("diet_tags"), "renal").alias("has_renal"),
    )
)

w_kennel_size_has_renal_by_pet = Window.partitionBy("kennel_size", "has_renal").orderBy(F.col("pet_age_yrs").desc(), "id")
w_kennel_size = Window.partitionBy("kennel_size")
with_windows = (
    recent
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("pet_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id", "has_renal").orderBy(F.col("pet_age_yrs").desc(), "id")).alias("next_pet_age_yrs"),
        F.min("pet_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id", "has_renal").orderBy(F.col("pet_age_yrs").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_pet_age_yrs_so_far"),
        F.round(F.avg("pet_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id", "has_renal").orderBy(F.col("pet_age_yrs").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("pet_age_yrs_avg_4"),
        F.row_number().over(w_kennel_size_has_renal_by_pet).alias("seq_no"),
        F.first("pet_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("pets_reg_id").orderBy(F.col("pet_age_yrs").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_pet_age_yrs"),
        F.round(F.col("pet_age_yrs") / F.nullif(F.sum("pet_age_yrs").over(w_kennel_size), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("pet_age_yrs_share_of_kennel_size"),
    )
)

stats = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("pets_reg_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("kennel_size")).alias("kennel_size_list"),
        F.round(F.sum("min_pet_age_yrs_so_far") / F.nullif(F.sum("pet_age_yrs_share_of_kennel_size"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("min_pet_age_yrs_so_far_to_pet_age_yrs_share_of_k"),
    )
)

per_label = (
    stats
    .select(
        "pets_reg_id",
        "cnt",
        "min_pet_age_yrs_so_far_to_pet_age_yrs_share_of_k",
        F.explode("kennel_size_list").alias("kennel_size_list_item"),

result = (

    .select(
        "pets_reg_id",
        "cnt",
        "min_pet_age_yrs_so_far_to_pet_age_yrs_share_of_k",
        "kennel_size_list_item",

    .limit(5)
)

WITH base_payload_items AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        launched_on,
        CASE WHEN payload_kg >= 13991.1 THEN 'A' WHEN payload_kg >= 6285.3 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS payload_kg_tier
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE mission_id <= 27
      AND payload_kg < 13295.2
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_mission_id_by_launched_on_ti AS launched_on_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(launched_on) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_launched_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(launched_on) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_launched_on_2,
        DATEDIFF(launched_on, LAG(launched_on) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id)) AS days_since_prev_launched_on,
        LAST_VALUE(launched_on) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_launched_on,
        RANK() OVER w_site_country_by_launched_on_2 AS launched_on_rank_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY launched_on) AS launched_on_rank_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(launched_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_launched_on
    FROM base_payload_items
    WINDOW w_mission_id_by_launched_on_ti AS (PARTITION BY mission_id ORDER BY launched_on DESC), w_site_country_by_launched_on_2 AS (PARTITION BY site_country ORDER BY launched_on ASC, id)
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_state,
        site_country,
        payload_kg_tier,
        launched_on_rank,
        first_launched_on,
        days_since_prev_launched_on,
        launched_on_rank_2,
        launched_on_rank_3,
        first_known_launched_on,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(site_country), 1, 4) AS site_country_prefix
    FROM with_windows
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_prev_launched_on, id) AS days_since_prev_launched_on_seq,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_prev_launched_on) AS days_since_prev_launched_on_rank,
        ROUND(launched_on_rank / NULLIF(SUM(launched_on_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY launched_on_rank_3), 0), 4) AS launched_on_rank_share_of_launched_on_rank_3,
        launched_on_rank_3 - LAG(launched_on_rank_3) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_prev_launched_on, id) AS launched_on_rank_3_change,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(site_country) OVER (PARTITION BY launched_on_rank_3)) AS distinct_site_country_in_launched_on_rank_3
    FROM derived
)
SELECT
    id,
    first_launched_on,
    launched_on_rank_2,
    launched_on_rank_3,
    first_known_launched_on,
    site_country_prefix,
    days_since_prev_launched_on_seq,
    days_since_prev_launched_on_rank,
    distinct_site_country_in_launched_on_rank_3,
    UPPER(TRIM(payload_kg_tier)) AS payload_kg_tier_clean
FROM with_trends
ORDER BY first_launched_on DESC, launched_on_rank_2 DESC, id
LIMIT 20

WITH prepared_vet_visits AS (
    -- Filter vet_visits
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        kennel_size,
        groom_mins,
        visit_day,
        ABS(pet_age_yrs - 14) AS pet_age_yrs_distance,
        DATE_FORMAT(visit_day, 'MMM yyyy') AS visit_day_label
    FROM vet_visits
    WHERE pets_reg_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_details AS (
    -- Attach pets_reg attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.diet_tags AS pets_reg_diet_tags
    FROM prepared_vet_visits s
    LEFT JOIN pets_reg p ON p.id = s.pets_reg_id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        pets_reg_id,
        groom_mins,
        visit_day,
        pet_age_yrs_distance,
        DATEDIFF(visit_day, LAG(visit_day) OVER (PARTITION BY pets_reg_id, kennel_size ORDER BY pet_age_yrs_distance, id)) AS days_since_prev_visit_day,
        ROUND(AVG(pet_age_yrs_distance) OVER (ORDER BY groom_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS pet_age_yrs_distance_avg_6_prior
    FROM with_details
),
grouped AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        pets_reg_id,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(visit_day), MIN(visit_day)) AS visit_day_span_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pets_reg_id) AS distinct_pets_reg_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(pet_age_yrs_distance, 0.5) AS median_pet_age_yrs_distance,
        MIN(pet_age_yrs_distance) AS min_pet_age_yrs_distance,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY pets_reg_id
    HAVING AVG(pet_age_yrs_distance) > 4
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    pets_reg_id,
    distinct_pets_reg_ids,
    ROUND(STDDEV(distinct_ids), 2) AS stddev_distinct_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(distinct_pets_reg_ids, 0.5) AS median_distinct_pets_reg_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pets_reg_id) AS distinct_pets_reg_ids_2
FROM grouped
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((pets_reg_id, distinct_pets_reg_ids), (pets_reg_id), (distinct_pets_reg_ids))
ORDER BY pets_reg_id NULLS LAST, distinct_pets_reg_ids NULLS LAST

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        site_country,
        payload_kg,
        frame_seq,
        ROUND(payload_kg * 0.9, 2) AS payload_kg_adj,
        CONCAT(mission_state, '#', CAST(mission_id AS STRING)) AS mission_state_ref,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', site_country, mission_state) AS site_country_mission_state_label
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE (mission_id >= 8 OR frame_seq >= 4283)
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(mission_state_ref), ' ', '_')) AS mission_state_ref_slug,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(site_country), 1, 3) AS site_country_prefix,
        CASE WHEN payload_kg_adj >= 24750.2 THEN 'large' WHEN payload_kg_adj >= 9900.7 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS payload_kg_adj_tier
    FROM base
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(payload_kg, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id) AS prev_payload_kg,
        MAX(payload_kg_adj) OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS payload_kg_adj_max_3_prior,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(site_country) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id)) AS distinct_site_country_in_mission_id,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY frame_seq DESC), 3) AS frame_seq_cume_dist,
        ROUND(payload_kg / NULLIF(SUM(payload_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id), 0), 4) AS payload_kg_share_of_mission_id
    FROM scored
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_id,
    payload_kg,
    frame_seq,
    payload_kg_adj,
    mission_state_ref,
    site_country_mission_state_label,
    site_country_prefix,
    prev_payload_kg,
    payload_kg_adj_max_3_prior,
    distinct_site_country_in_mission_id,
    payload_kg_share_of_mission_id,
    LENGTH(TRIM(payload_kg_adj_tier)) AS payload_kg_adj_tier_len,
    CONCAT(mission_state_ref, '#', CAST(mission_id AS STRING)) AS mission_state_ref_ref
FROM with_trends

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_payload_items
    .filter((F.col("mission_id") >= 8) | (F.col("frame_seq") >= 4283))
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "site_country",
        "payload_kg",
        "frame_seq",
        F.round(F.col("payload_kg") * 0.9, 2).alias("payload_kg_adj"),
        F.concat(F.col("mission_state"), F.lit("#"), F.col("mission_id").cast("string")).alias("mission_state_ref"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("site_country"), F.col("mission_state")).alias("site_country_mission_state_label"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("mission_state_ref")), " ", "_")).alias("mission_state_ref_slug"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("site_country")), 1, 3).alias("site_country_prefix"),
        F.when(F.col("payload_kg_adj") >= 24750.2, "large").when(F.col("payload_kg_adj") >= 9900.7, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("payload_kg_adj_tier"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("payload_kg", 1, 0).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("frame_seq").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_payload_kg"),
        F.max("payload_kg_adj").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("frame_seq").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("payload_kg_adj_max_3_prior"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_country").over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id"))).alias("distinct_site_country_in_mission_id"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("frame_seq").desc())), 3).alias("frame_seq_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.col("payload_kg") / F.nullif(F.sum("payload_kg").over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("payload_kg_share_of_mission_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_id",
        "payload_kg",
        "frame_seq",
        "payload_kg_adj",
        "mission_state_ref",
        "site_country_mission_state_label",
        "site_country_prefix",
        "prev_payload_kg",
        "payload_kg_adj_max_3_prior",
        "distinct_site_country_in_mission_id",
        "payload_kg_share_of_mission_id",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("payload_kg_adj_tier"))).alias("payload_kg_adj_tier_len"),
