WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the water_meters rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        chlorine_ppm,
        meter_fitted_on,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', meter_fitted_on) AS days_since_meter_fitted_on
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE burst_cause IN ('pressure', 'digging')
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach pump_station attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.pump_station_id,
        s.burst_cause,
        s.meter_age_yrs,
        s.chlorine_ppm,
        s.meter_fitted_on,
        s.days_since_meter_fitted_on,
        p.station_tier AS pump_station_station_tier,
        p.street_ref AS pump_station_street_ref,
        p.pressure_bar AS pump_station_pressure_bar
    FROM prepared s
    LEFT JOIN pump_stations p ON p.id = s.pump_station_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_pump_station_station_tier_by AS meter_fitted_on_dense_rank,
        ROUND(days_since_meter_fitted_on / NULLIF(SUM(days_since_meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier), 0), 4) AS days_since_meter_fitted_on_share_of_pump_station,
        MAX(meter_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_meter_age_yrs_so_far,
        RANK() OVER w_meter_fitted_on_month_by_day AS days_since_meter_fitted_on_rank,
        LAG(days_since_meter_fitted_on, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_id, pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY pump_station_pressure_bar DESC, id) AS prev3_days_since_meter_fitted_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(meter_fitted_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_meter_fitted_on,
        ROUND(AVG(days_since_meter_fitted_on) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier), 2) AS pump_station_station_tier_avg_days_since_meter_f,
        ROUND(pump_station_pressure_bar / NULLIF(SUM(pump_station_pressure_bar) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier), 0), 4) AS pump_station_pressure_bar_share_of_pump_station_,
        LAST_VALUE(meter_fitted_on) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_on ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_meter_fitted_on,
        ROUND(pump_station_pressure_bar - AVG(pump_station_pressure_bar) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier), 2) AS pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_statio,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_all_by_meter_fitted_on AS meter_fitted_on_quartile,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_on DESC, id) AS meter_fitted_on_quartile_2,
        meter_age_yrs - LAG(meter_age_yrs) OVER (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_on ASC, id) AS meter_age_yrs_change,
        MIN(days_since_meter_fitted_on) OVER w_pump_station_station_tier AS pump_station_station_tier_min_days_since_meter_f
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_pump_station_station_tier_by AS (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier ORDER BY meter_fitted_on ASC), w_meter_fitted_on_month_by_day AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(meter_fitted_on) ORDER BY days_since_meter_fitted_on, id), w_all_by_meter_fitted_on AS (ORDER BY meter_fitted_on ASC, id), w_pump_station_station_tier AS (PARTITION BY pump_station_station_tier)
),
leaders AS (
    -- Top 3 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE meter_fitted_on_dense_rank <= 3
),
per_group AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        YEAR(meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_year,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN burst_cause IN ('freeze', 'pressure', 'age') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_burst_cause_in_freeze_pressu,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(last_known_meter_fitted_on), MIN(last_known_meter_fitted_on)) AS last_known_meter_fitted_on_span_days,
        MIN(pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_statio) AS min_pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_st
    FROM leaders
    GROUP BY YEAR(meter_fitted_on)
)
SELECT
    meter_fitted_on_year,
    pct_burst_cause_in_freeze_pressu,
    last_known_meter_fitted_on_span_days,
    min_pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_st,
    COALESCE(meter_fitted_on_year, 0) AS meter_fitted_on_year_filled
FROM per_group
WHERE pct_burst_cause_in_freeze_pressu > 15.0
ORDER BY min_pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_st DESC NULLS FIRST, meter_fitted_on_year DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_water_meters
    .filter(F.col("burst_cause").isin("pressure", "digging"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "pump_station_id",
        "burst_cause",
        "meter_kind",
        "meter_age_yrs",
        "chlorine_ppm",
        "meter_fitted_on",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("meter_fitted_on")).alias("days_since_meter_fitted_on"),
    )
)

joined = (
    prepared.alias("s")
    .join(df_pump_stations.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.pump_station_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.pump_station_id",
        "s.burst_cause",
        "s.meter_age_yrs",
        "s.chlorine_ppm",
        "s.meter_fitted_on",
        "s.days_since_meter_fitted_on",
        F.col("p.station_tier").alias("pump_station_station_tier"),
        F.col("p.street_ref").alias("pump_station_street_ref"),
        F.col("p.pressure_bar").alias("pump_station_pressure_bar"),
    )
)

w_pump_station_station_tier_by = Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier").orderBy("meter_fitted_on")
w_meter_fitted_on_month_by_day = Window.partitionBy(F.month("meter_fitted_on")).orderBy("days_since_meter_fitted_on", "id")
w_all_by_meter_fitted_on = Window.orderBy("meter_fitted_on", "id")
w_pump_station_station_tier = Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier")
with_trends = (
    joined
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_pump_station_station_tier_by).alias("meter_fitted_on_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("days_since_meter_fitted_on") / F.nullif(F.sum("days_since_meter_fitted_on").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("days_since_meter_fitted_on_share_of_pump_station"),
        F.max("meter_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier").orderBy("meter_fitted_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_meter_age_yrs_so_far"),
        F.rank().over(w_meter_fitted_on_month_by_day).alias("days_since_meter_fitted_on_rank"),
        F.lag("days_since_meter_fitted_on", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_id", "pump_station_station_tier").orderBy(F.col("pump_station_pressure_bar").desc(), "id")).alias("prev3_days_since_meter_fitted_on"),
        F.first("meter_fitted_on", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_meter_fitted_on"),
        F.round(F.avg("days_since_meter_fitted_on").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier")), 2).alias("pump_station_station_tier_avg_days_since_meter_f"),
        F.round(F.col("pump_station_pressure_bar") / F.nullif(F.sum("pump_station_pressure_bar").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("pump_station_pressure_bar_share_of_pump_station_"),
        F.last("meter_fitted_on", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier").orderBy("meter_fitted_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_meter_fitted_on"),
        F.round(F.col("pump_station_pressure_bar") - F.avg("pump_station_pressure_bar").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier")), 2).alias("pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_statio"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_all_by_meter_fitted_on).alias("meter_fitted_on_quartile"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier").orderBy(F.col("meter_fitted_on").desc(), "id")).alias("meter_fitted_on_quartile_2"),
        (F.col("meter_age_yrs") - F.lag("meter_age_yrs").over(Window.partitionBy("pump_station_station_tier").orderBy("meter_fitted_on", "id"))).alias("meter_age_yrs_change"),
        F.min("days_since_meter_fitted_on").over(w_pump_station_station_tier).alias("pump_station_station_tier_min_days_since_meter_f"),
    )
)

leaders = with_trends.filter(F.col("meter_fitted_on_dense_rank") <= 3)

per_group = (
    leaders
    .groupBy(F.year("meter_fitted_on").alias("meter_fitted_on_year"))
    .agg(
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("burst_cause").isin("freeze", "pressure", "age"), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_burst_cause_in_freeze_pressu"),
        F.datediff(F.max("last_known_meter_fitted_on"), F.min("last_known_meter_fitted_on")).alias("last_known_meter_fitted_on_span_days"),
        F.min("pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_statio").alias("min_pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_st"),
    )
)

result = (
    per_group
    .filter(F.col("pct_burst_cause_in_freeze_pressu") > 15.0)
    .select(
        "meter_fitted_on_year",
        "pct_burst_cause_in_freeze_pressu",
        "last_known_meter_fitted_on_span_days",
        "min_pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_st",
        F.coalesce(F.col("meter_fitted_on_year"), F.lit(0)).alias("meter_fitted_on_year_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("min_pump_station_pressure_bar_vs_pump_station_st").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("meter_fitted_on_year").desc(),
    )
)

WITH cleaned_missions AS (
    -- Scope the missions rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        is_reusable,
        LEAST(burn_secs, apogee_km) AS least_burn_secs_apogee_km,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', launched_on) AS launched_on_week,
        CASE WHEN apogee_km >= 22917.6 THEN 'A' WHEN apogee_km >= 16762.5 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS apogee_km_tier
    FROM missions
    WHERE rocket_id IS NOT NULL
      AND mission_state IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        apogee_km,
        launched_on,
        is_reusable,
        launched_on_week,
        apogee_km_tier,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', launched_on_week) AS days_since_launched_on_week
    FROM cleaned_missions
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach missions metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(m.launched_on) FROM missions m WHERE m.rocket_id = s.rocket_id) AS last_mission_launched_on,
        (SELECT MAX(m.launched_on) FROM missions m WHERE m.rocket_id = s.rocket_id) AS last_mission_launched_on_2
    FROM enriched s
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY is_reusable ORDER BY launched_on_week DESC, id) AS launched_on_week_rank,
        MIN(apogee_km) OVER (PARTITION BY is_reusable ORDER BY launched_on_week DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_apogee_km_so_far,
        ROUND(AVG(apogee_km) OVER (PARTITION BY rocket_id), 2) AS rocket_id_avg_apogee_km,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY is_reusable ORDER BY launched_on_week DESC) AS launched_on_week_rank_2,
        LAG(last_mission_launched_on_2) OVER (PARTITION BY is_reusable ORDER BY launched_on_week DESC, id) AS prev_last_mission_launched_on_2,
        days_since_launched_on_week - LAG(days_since_launched_on_week) OVER (PARTITION BY is_reusable ORDER BY launched_on_week DESC, id) AS days_since_launched_on_week_change
    FROM summarized_rows
),
ranked_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(launched_on_week_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY apogee_km_tier ORDER BY days_since_launched_on_week DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS launched_on_week_rank_2_avg_3,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY apogee_km_tier ORDER BY days_since_launched_on_week DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count
    FROM ranked
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching telemetry_frames
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked_2 s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM telemetry_frames t
            WHERE t.mission_id = s.id
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    rocket_id,
    apogee_km,
    launched_on,
    launched_on_week,
    apogee_km_tier,
    days_since_launched_on_week,
    last_mission_launched_on,
    last_mission_launched_on_2,
    launched_on_week_rank,
    min_apogee_km_so_far,
    rocket_id_avg_apogee_km,
    launched_on_week_rank_2,
    prev_last_mission_launched_on_2,
    days_since_launched_on_week_change,
    running_count,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_mission_launched_on) AS last_mission_launched_on_month,
    IF(is_reusable, 'yes', 'no') AS is_reusable_label
FROM with_activity
ORDER BY rocket_id_avg_apogee_km DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_missions = (
    df_missions
    .filter((F.col("rocket_id").isNotNull()) & (F.col("mission_state").isNotNull()))
    .select(
        "id",
        "rocket_id",
        "mission_state",
        "burn_secs",
        "apogee_km",
        "launched_on",
        "is_reusable",
        F.least(F.col("burn_secs"), F.col("apogee_km")).alias("least_burn_secs_apogee_km"),
        F.date_trunc("week", F.col("launched_on")).alias("launched_on_week"),
        F.when(F.col("apogee_km") >= 22917.6, "A").when(F.col("apogee_km") >= 16762.5, "B").otherwise("C").alias("apogee_km_tier"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned_missions
    .select(
        "id",
        "rocket_id",
        "apogee_km",
        "launched_on",
        "is_reusable",
        "launched_on_week",
        "apogee_km_tier",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2026-01-01").cast("date"), F.col("launched_on_week")).alias("days_since_launched_on_week"),
    )
)

mission_stats = (
    df_missions
    .groupBy("rocket_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("launched_on").alias("last_mission_launched_on"),
        F.max("launched_on").alias("last_mission_launched_on_2"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    enriched.alias("s")
    .join(mission_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.rocket_id") == F.col("s.rocket_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "m.last_mission_launched_on", "m.last_mission_launched_on_2")
)

ranked = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_reusable").orderBy(F.col("launched_on_week").desc(), "id")).alias("launched_on_week_rank"),
        F.min("apogee_km").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reusable").orderBy(F.col("launched_on_week").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_apogee_km_so_far"),
        F.round(F.avg("apogee_km").over(Window.partitionBy("rocket_id")), 2).alias("rocket_id_avg_apogee_km"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_reusable").orderBy(F.col("launched_on_week").desc())).alias("launched_on_week_rank_2"),
        F.lag("last_mission_launched_on_2").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reusable").orderBy(F.col("launched_on_week").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_last_mission_launched_on_2"),
        (F.col("days_since_launched_on_week") - F.lag("days_since_launched_on_week").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reusable").orderBy(F.col("launched_on_week").desc(), "id"))).alias("days_since_launched_on_week_change"),
    )
)

ranked_2 = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("launched_on_week_rank_2_avg_3", F.round(F.avg("launched_on_week_rank_2").over(Window.partitionBy("apogee_km_tier").orderBy(F.col("days_since_launched_on_week").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2))
    .withColumn("running_count", F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("apogee_km_tier").orderBy(F.col("days_since_launched_on_week").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

        payload_kind AS label,
        frame_at AS event_time,
        'telemetry_frame_3' AS source
    FROM telemetry_frames
)
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, MAX(event_time) AS latest_event_time
FROM combined

WITH valid_payload_items AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        mission_id,
        site_country,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        COALESCE(payload_kg, 0.0) AS payload_kg_filled
    FROM payload_items
    WHERE mission_id IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(frame_seq) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launched_on) ORDER BY payload_kg_filled DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_frame_seq,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY payload_kg_filled), 3) AS payload_kg_filled_cume_dist,
        MIN(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id) AS mission_id_min_frame_seq,
        ROUND(AVG(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country), 2) AS site_country_avg_frame_seq,
        MAX(payload_kg_filled) OVER (ORDER BY payload_kg_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS payload_kg_filled_max_1_prior,
        SUM(frame_seq) OVER w_mission_id AS mission_id_sum_frame_seq,
        ROUND(payload_kg_filled - AVG(payload_kg_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY site_country), 2) AS payload_kg_filled_vs_site_country_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country ORDER BY frame_seq DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS frame_seq_avg_3_prior
    FROM valid_payload_items
    WINDOW w_mission_id AS (PARTITION BY mission_id)
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', launched_on) AS days_since_launched_on,
        CONCAT(site_country, '#', CAST(mission_id AS STRING)) AS site_country_ref,
        DATE_FORMAT(launched_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS launched_on_label
    FROM windowed
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        site_country,
        frame_seq,
        launched_on,
        payload_kg_filled,
        last_known_frame_seq,
        payload_kg_filled_cume_dist,
        mission_id_min_frame_seq,
        mission_id_sum_frame_seq,
        payload_kg_filled_vs_site_country_avg,
        frame_seq_avg_3_prior,
        days_since_launched_on,
        launched_on_label,
        MIN(frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country ORDER BY payload_kg_filled_vs_site_country_avg, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_frame_seq_so_far,
        ROUND(AVG(payload_kg_filled_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country ORDER BY payload_kg_filled_vs_site_country_avg, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS payload_kg_filled_cume_dist_avg_7,
        MIN(site_country_avg_frame_seq) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_launched_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_site_country_avg_frame_seq_so_far,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launched_on)) AS rows_in_launched_on_year,
        mission_id_min_frame_seq - LAG(mission_id_min_frame_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY mission_id, site_country ORDER BY payload_kg_filled_vs_site_country_avg, id) AS mission_id_min_frame_seq_change,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_days_since_launched_o_2 AS days_since_launched_on_rank
    FROM derived
    WINDOW w_all_by_days_since_launched_o_2 AS (ORDER BY days_since_launched_on DESC)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    site_country,
    frame_seq,
    launched_on,
    payload_kg_filled,
    payload_kg_filled_cume_dist,
    mission_id_min_frame_seq,
    mission_id_sum_frame_seq,
    payload_kg_filled_vs_site_country_avg,
    frame_seq_avg_3_prior,
    days_since_launched_on,
    min_site_country_avg_frame_seq_so_far,
    rows_in_launched_on_year,
    mission_id_min_frame_seq_change,
    days_since_launched_on_rank,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(site_country), 1, 4) AS site_country_prefix
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY launched_on DESC NULLS FIRST

        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy("payload_kg_filled")), 3).alias("payload_kg_filled_cume_dist"),
        F.min("frame_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("mission_id")).alias("mission_id_min_frame_seq"),
        F.round(F.avg("frame_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("site_country")), 2).alias("site_country_avg_frame_seq"),

        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("launched_on"))).alias("rows_in_launched_on_year"),

        F.rank().over(w_all_by_days_since_launched_o_2).alias("days_since_launched_on_rank"),
    )
)

result = (

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the water_meters rows
    SELECT
        id,
        pump_station_id,
        burst_cause,
        meter_kind,
        meter_age_yrs,
        meter_fitted_on,
        MONTH(meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_month,
        FLOOR(meter_age_yrs / 5) * 5 AS meter_age_yrs_bucket,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', meter_fitted_on) AS meter_fitted_on_month_2
    FROM water_meters
    WHERE pump_station_id <= 33
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching water_meters
    SELECT s.*
    FROM prepared s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM water_meters w
            WHERE w.pump_station_id = s.pump_station_id
              AND w.meter_fitted_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-12' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
              AND w.burst_cause = 'freeze'
        )
      AND s.meter_age_yrs >= 9
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(TRIM(meter_kind)) AS meter_kind_clean,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(burst_cause), 1, 4) AS burst_cause_prefix,
        meter_fitted_on_month_2 + INTERVAL 1 DAYS AS meter_fitted_on_month_2_plus_1d
    FROM without_matches
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching water_meters
    SELECT s.*
    FROM annotated s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM water_meters w
            WHERE w.pump_station_id = s.pump_station_id
              AND w.meter_kind = 'analog'
              AND w.meter_fitted_on >= DATE '2024-12-25'
        )
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    meter_fitted_on_month,
    meter_kind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM with_activity
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((meter_fitted_on_month, meter_kind), (meter_fitted_on_month), (meter_kind), ())

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        odometer_kms,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        GREATEST(drive_mins, odometer_kms) AS greatest_drive_mins_odometer_kms,
        YEAR(arrived_on) AS arrived_on_year
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE drive_mins <= 57
),
joined AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.deal_status,
        s.drive_mins,
        s.greatest_drive_mins_odometer_kms,
        s.arrived_on_year,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id,
        c.arrived_date AS car_stock_arrived_date,
        sh.drive_minutes AS showroom_drive_minutes
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
    LEFT JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = c.showroom_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(car_stock_arrived_date), arrived_on_year ORDER BY greatest_drive_mins_odometer_kms DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        MAX(showroom_drive_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date), deal_status) AS car_stock_arrived_date_month_deal_status_max_sho,
        ROUND(drive_mins - AVG(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_showroom_id), 2) AS drive_mins_vs_car_stock_showroom_id_avg,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY showroom_drive_minutes ASC) AS showroom_drive_minutes_rank,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_showroom_id) AS car_stock_showroom_id_max_drive_mins,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins ASC) AS drive_mins_dense_rank,
        LAG(arrived_on_year) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(car_stock_arrived_date), arrived_on_year ORDER BY greatest_drive_mins_odometer_kms DESC, id) AS prev_arrived_on_year,
        showroom_drive_minutes - LAG(showroom_drive_minutes) OVER w_car_stock_showroom_id_deal_s AS showroom_drive_minutes_change,
        FIRST_VALUE(car_stock_arrived_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY showroom_drive_minutes ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_car_stock_arrived_date,
        MIN(arrived_on_year) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_showroom_id) AS car_stock_showroom_id_min_arrived_on_year,
        ROUND(AVG(arrived_on_year) OVER (ORDER BY showroom_drive_minutes ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS arrived_on_year_avg_2,
        LEAD(arrived_on_year, 3) OVER w_all_by_showroom_drive_minute_4 AS next3_arrived_on_year,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins ASC) AS drive_mins_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(car_stock_id) OVER w_car_stock_arrived_date_month) AS distinct_car_stock_id_in_car_stock_arrived_date_,
        LEAD(showroom_drive_minutes, 1, 0) OVER w_car_stock_id_by_drive_mins AS next_showroom_drive_minutes,
        ROUND(arrived_on_year - AVG(arrived_on_year) OVER w_car_stock_arrived_date_month, 2) AS arrived_on_year_vs_car_stock_arrived_date_month_
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_car_stock_showroom_id_deal_s AS (PARTITION BY car_stock_showroom_id, deal_status ORDER BY arrived_on_year, id), w_all_by_showroom_drive_minute_4 AS (ORDER BY showroom_drive_minutes ASC, id), w_car_stock_arrived_date_month AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', car_stock_arrived_date), deal_status), w_car_stock_id_by_drive_mins AS (PARTITION BY car_stock_id ORDER BY drive_mins ASC, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    deal_status,
    drive_mins,
    greatest_drive_mins_odometer_kms,
    arrived_on_year,
    car_stock_showroom_id,
    car_stock_arrived_date,
    showroom_drive_minutes,
    seq_no,
    car_stock_arrived_date_month_deal_status_max_sho,
    car_stock_showroom_id_max_drive_mins,
    drive_mins_dense_rank,
    prev_arrived_on_year,
    showroom_drive_minutes_change,
    next3_arrived_on_year,
    distinct_car_stock_id_in_car_stock_arrived_date_,
    next_showroom_drive_minutes,
    COALESCE(arrived_on_year, 0) AS arrived_on_year_filled
FROM metrics
ORDER BY next3_arrived_on_year, prev_arrived_on_year

WITH prepared_service_tickets AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        deal_state,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        CONCAT(deal_state, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS deal_state_ref,
        COALESCE(deal_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS deal_state_or_unknown,
        CASE WHEN odometer_km >= 148631 THEN 'large' WHEN odometer_km >= 81562 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS odometer_km_tier
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE (showroom_ref IS NOT NULL OR odometer_km > 83776)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', drive_started_at) AS drive_started_at_month,
        odometer_km_tier,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(deal_state)) AS deal_state_list,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(fuel_kind)) AS fuel_kind_list,
        MIN(odometer_km) AS min_odometer_km
    FROM prepared_service_tickets
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', drive_started_at), odometer_km_tier
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        drive_started_at_month,
        odometer_km_tier,
        fuel_kind_list,
        SUM(min_odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY odometer_km_tier ORDER BY min_odometer_km NULLS LAST, drive_started_at_month, odometer_km_tier ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_odometer_km_sum_3,
        LEAD(min_odometer_km) OVER w_odometer_km_tier_by_min_odom_2 AS next_min_odometer_km
    FROM grouped
    WINDOW w_odometer_km_tier_by_min_odom_2 AS (PARTITION BY odometer_km_tier ORDER BY min_odometer_km NULLS LAST, drive_started_at_month, odometer_km_tier)
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(odometer_km_tier), 1, 3) AS odometer_km_tier_prefix,
        ABS(min_odometer_km_sum_3 - 360000) AS min_odometer_km_sum_3_distance
    FROM ranked
    WHERE SIZE(fuel_kind_list) >= 2
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        drive_started_at_month,
        odometer_km_tier,
        min_odometer_km_sum_3,
        next_min_odometer_km,
        INITCAP(TRIM(odometer_km_tier)) AS odometer_km_tier_clean,
        FLOOR(next_min_odometer_km / 50000) * 50000 AS next_min_odometer_km_bucket
    FROM tagged
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM labeled
    WHERE next_min_odometer_km_bucket > (SELECT AVG(next_min_odometer_km_bucket) FROM labeled)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT drive_started_at_month, odometer_km_tier, next_min_odometer_km_bucket
    FROM with_activity
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(next_min_odometer_km_bucket)
    FOR odometer_km_tier IN ('large', 'medium', 'small')
)
ORDER BY drive_started_at_month

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_service_tickets = (

w_odometer_km_tier_by_min_odom_2 = Window.partitionBy("odometer_km_tier").orderBy(F.col("min_odometer_km").asc_nulls_last(), "drive_started_at_month", "odometer_km_tier")

    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("odometer_km_tier")), 1, 3).alias("odometer_km_tier_prefix"),
        F.abs(F.col("min_odometer_km_sum_3") - 360000).alias("min_odometer_km_sum_3_distance"),
    )
)

labeled = (

    .select(
        "drive_started_at_month",
        "odometer_km_tier",

result = (

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        donor_age,
        pledge_amt,
        pledged_date,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', pledged_date) AS days_since_pledged_date
    FROM campaigns_ch
    WHERE donor_age <= 60
      AND pledge_amt >= 15462.0
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        cause_area,
        donor_age,
        pledge_amt,
        pledged_date,
        MAX(donor_age) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY donor_age DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS donor_age_max_4,
        LAG(pledged_date, 3) OVER w_cause_area_pledged_date_mont AS prev3_pledged_date,
        ROUND(days_since_pledged_date / NULLIF(SUM(days_since_pledged_date) OVER w_cause_area, 0), 4) AS days_since_pledged_date_share_of_cause_area,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_pledged_date_month_by_days_s AS days_since_pledged_date_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(pledge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY donor_age DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_pledge_amt,
        ROUND(pledge_amt - AVG(pledge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area), 2) AS pledge_amt_vs_cause_area_avg,
        DATEDIFF(pledged_date, LAG(pledged_date) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(pledged_date) ORDER BY days_since_pledged_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id)) AS days_since_prev_pledged_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_pledged_date_month AS rows_in_pledged_date_month,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_cause_area_pledged_date_mont_2, 3) AS days_since_pledged_date_cume_dist
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_cause_area_pledged_date_mont AS (PARTITION BY cause_area, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_date) ORDER BY days_since_pledged_date ASC, id), w_cause_area AS (PARTITION BY cause_area), w_pledged_date_month_by_days_s AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(pledged_date) ORDER BY days_since_pledged_date DESC NULLS FIRST), w_pledged_date_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(pledged_date)), w_cause_area_pledged_date_mont_2 AS (PARTITION BY cause_area, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pledged_date) ORDER BY days_since_pledged_date ASC)
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(cause_area, 'UNKNOWN') AS cause_area_or_unknown,
        ROUND(first_pledge_amt * 1.5, 2) AS first_pledge_amt_adj
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE days_since_pledged_date_cume_dist <= 0.8
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    cause_area,
    donor_age,
    pledge_amt,
    pledged_date,
    donor_age_max_4,
    days_since_pledged_date_share_of_cause_area,
    first_pledge_amt,
    pledge_amt_vs_cause_area_avg,
    days_since_prev_pledged_date,
    rows_in_pledged_date_month,
    days_since_pledged_date_cume_dist,
    first_pledge_amt_adj,
    ABS(first_pledge_amt - 32109.7) AS first_pledge_amt_distance,
    donor_age_max_4 - pledge_amt AS donor_age_max_4_minus_pledge_amt
FROM derived

WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the missions rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rocket_id,
        mission_state,
        burn_secs,
        is_reusable,
        DATE_FORMAT(launched_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS launched_on_label,
        CASE WHEN mission_state IN ('partial', 'lost') THEN 'group_a' WHEN mission_state = 'planned' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS mission_state_group,
        CASE WHEN burn_secs >= 546 THEN 'large' WHEN burn_secs >= 218 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS burn_secs_tier
    FROM missions
    WHERE rocket_id IS NOT NULL
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LENGTH(TRIM(mission_state_group)) AS mission_state_group_len
    FROM scoped
    WHERE burn_secs > 218
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(burn_secs / 100) * 100 AS burn_secs_bucket,
        FLOOR(burn_secs / 100) * 100 AS burn_secs_bucket_2,
        IF(is_reusable, 'yes', 'no') AS is_reusable_label
    FROM annotated
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    WHERE burn_secs_bucket_2 > (SELECT AVG(burn_secs_bucket_2) FROM enriched)
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach payload_items metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(p.launched_on) FROM payload_items p WHERE p.mission_id = s.id) AS first_payload_item_launched_on
    FROM with_activity s
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    mission_state,
    burn_secs,
    is_reusable,
    launched_on_label,
    mission_state_group,
    burn_secs_tier,
    mission_state_group_len,
    burn_secs_bucket,
    burn_secs_bucket_2,
    first_payload_item_launched_on,
    CASE WHEN is_reusable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reusable_flag
FROM summarized_rows
ORDER BY mission_state_group DESC, mission_state_group_len NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped = (
    df_missions
    .filter(F.col("rocket_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "rocket_id",
        "mission_state",
        "burn_secs",
        "is_reusable",
        F.date_format(F.col("launched_on"), "yyyy-MM").alias("launched_on_label"),
        F.when(F.col("mission_state").isin("partial", "lost"), "group_a").when(F.col("mission_state") == "planned", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("mission_state_group"),
        F.when(F.col("burn_secs") >= 546, "large").when(F.col("burn_secs") >= 218, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("burn_secs_tier"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    scoped
    .filter(F.col("burn_secs") > 218)
    .withColumn("mission_state_group_len", F.length(F.trim(F.col("mission_state_group"))))
)

enriched = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.floor(F.col("burn_secs") / 100) * 100).alias("burn_secs_bucket"),
        (F.floor(F.col("burn_secs") / 100) * 100).alias("burn_secs_bucket_2"),
        F.when(F.col("is_reusable"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("is_reusable_label"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    enriched
    .crossJoin(enriched.agg(F.avg("burn_secs_bucket_2").alias("overall_avg_burn_secs_bucket_2")))
    .filter(F.col("burn_secs_bucket_2") > F.col("overall_avg_burn_secs_bucket_2"))
    .drop("overall_avg_burn_secs_bucket_2")
)

payload_item_stats = (
    df_payload_items
    .groupBy("mission_id")
    .agg(F.min("launched_on").alias("first_payload_item_launched_on"))
)

summarized_rows = (
    with_activity.alias("s")
    .join(payload_item_stats.alias("p"), F.col("p.mission_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "p.first_payload_item_launched_on")
)

result = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "mission_state",
        "burn_secs",
        "is_reusable",
        "launched_on_label",
        "mission_state_group",
        "burn_secs_tier",
        "mission_state_group_len",
        "burn_secs_bucket",
        "burn_secs_bucket_2",
        "first_payload_item_launched_on",
        F.when(F.col("is_reusable"), 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_reusable_flag"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("mission_state_group").desc(),
        F.col("mission_state_group_len").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

WITH prepared AS (
    -- Filter grant_awards
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        donor_segment,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(grant_stage), ' ', '_')) AS grant_stage_slug,
        CONCAT(donor_segment, '#', CAST(campaigns_ch_ref AS STRING)) AS donor_segment_ref
    FROM grant_awards
    WHERE donor_segment = 'major'
      AND grant_stage = 'awarded'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(donor_segment) OVER w_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage) AS distinct_donor_segment_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant,
        NTH_VALUE(volunteer_hrs, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_volunteer_hrs,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_grant_stage_by_pledged_on_ti, 3) AS pledged_on_cume_dist,
        LAG(volunteer_hrs, 3, 0) OVER w_all_by_pledged_on AS prev3_volunteer_hrs,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_pledged_on, 3) AS pledged_on_cume_dist_2,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage AS rows_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage,
        ROUND(AVG(volunteer_hrs) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment, grant_stage ORDER BY volunteer_hrs DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS volunteer_hrs_avg_2_prior
    FROM prepared
    WINDOW w_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY campaigns_ch_ref, grant_stage), w_grant_stage_by_pledged_on_ti AS (PARTITION BY grant_stage ORDER BY pledged_on ASC), w_all_by_pledged_on AS (ORDER BY pledged_on, id)
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        campaigns_ch_ref,
        grant_stage,
        volunteer_hrs,
        pledged_on,
        donor_segment_ref,
        distinct_donor_segment_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant,
        second_volunteer_hrs,
        rows_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage,
        volunteer_hrs_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(pledged_on_cume_dist_2 - AVG(pledged_on_cume_dist_2) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_segment), 2) AS pledged_on_cume_dist_2_vs_donor_segment_avg,
        LEAD(second_volunteer_hrs) OVER (ORDER BY second_volunteer_hrs DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS next_second_volunteer_hrs,
        LEAD(pledged_on_cume_dist, 2) OVER w_pledged_on_month_grant_stage AS next2_pledged_on_cume_dist
    FROM windowed
    WINDOW w_pledged_on_month_grant_stage AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(pledged_on), grant_stage ORDER BY prev3_volunteer_hrs, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    campaigns_ch_ref,
    grant_stage,
    volunteer_hrs,
    donor_segment_ref,
    distinct_donor_segment_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant,
    second_volunteer_hrs,
    rows_in_campaigns_ch_ref_grant_stage,
    volunteer_hrs_avg_2_prior,
    pledged_on_cume_dist_2_vs_donor_segment_avg,
    next_second_volunteer_hrs,
    next2_pledged_on_cume_dist,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', pledged_on) AS days_since_pledged_on
FROM sequenced
ORDER BY pledged_on_cume_dist_2_vs_donor_segment_avg

    )
)

sequenced = (

WITH scoped_finance_deals AS (
    -- Filter finance_deals
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        vin_tail,
        is_certified_used,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', arrived_on) AS arrived_on_month,
        CONCAT(deal_status, '#', CAST(car_stock_id AS STRING)) AS deal_status_ref
    FROM finance_deals
    WHERE arrived_on >= DATE '2024-04-21'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        arrived_on_month,
        deal_status_ref,
        LEAD(arrived_on, 3) OVER w_arrived_on_year_by_drive_min AS next3_arrived_on,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on) ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS drive_mins_max_3_prior
    FROM scoped_finance_deals
    WINDOW w_arrived_on_year_by_drive_min AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(arrived_on) ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id)
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        deal_status,
        drive_mins,
        arrived_on,
        is_certified_used,
        arrived_on_month,
        deal_status_ref,
        DATEDIFF(next3_arrived_on, LAG(next3_arrived_on) OVER w_all_by_arrived_on_month) AS days_since_prev_next3_arrived_on,
        ROUND(drive_mins_max_3_prior - AVG(drive_mins_max_3_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(next3_arrived_on)), 2) AS drive_mins_max_3_prior_vs_next3_arrived_on_year_,
        LAG(arrived_on_month, 3) OVER w_all_by_arrived_on_month AS prev3_arrived_on_month,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_all_by_arrived_on_month_ties, 3) AS arrived_on_month_cume_dist
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_all_by_arrived_on_month AS (ORDER BY arrived_on_month DESC, id), w_all_by_arrived_on_month_ties AS (ORDER BY arrived_on_month DESC)
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per finance_deal
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.arrived_on_month,
        s.days_since_prev_next3_arrived_on,
        s.drive_mins_max_3_prior_vs_next3_arrived_on_year_,
        f.id AS finance_deal_id,
        f.drive_mins AS finance_deal_drive_mins,
        f.odometer_kms AS finance_deal_odometer_kms,
        f.is_certified_used AS finance_deal_is_certified_used,
        f.deal_status AS finance_deal_deal_status
    FROM sequenced s
    JOIN finance_deals f ON f.car_stock_id = s.car_stock_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.arrived_on_month,
        s.drive_mins_max_3_prior_vs_next3_arrived_on_year_,
        s.finance_deal_id,
        s.finance_deal_drive_mins,
        s.finance_deal_odometer_kms,
        s.finance_deal_is_certified_used,
        s.finance_deal_deal_status,
        c.body_style AS car_stock_body_style,
        c.vin_tail AS car_stock_vin_tail,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id
    FROM with_children s
    JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach car_stock metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(c.arrived_date) FROM car_stock c WHERE c.showroom_id = s.car_stock_showroom_id) AS first_car_stock_arrived_date,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car_stock c WHERE c.showroom_id = s.car_stock_showroom_id) AS car_stock_count,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.term_months), 2) FROM car_stock c WHERE c.showroom_id = s.car_stock_showroom_id) AS avg_car_stock_term_months
    FROM joined s
),
joined_2 AS (
    -- Attach car_stock attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.car_stock_id,
        s.arrived_on_month,
        s.drive_mins_max_3_prior_vs_next3_arrived_on_year_,
        s.finance_deal_id,
        s.finance_deal_drive_mins,
        s.finance_deal_odometer_kms,
        s.finance_deal_is_certified_used,
        s.car_stock_showroom_id,
        s.car_stock_count,
        s.avg_car_stock_term_months,
        c.showroom_id AS car_stock_showroom_id_2
    FROM summarized_rows s
    LEFT JOIN car_stock c ON c.id = s.car_stock_id
)
SELECT
    id,
    car_stock_id,
    arrived_on_month,
    drive_mins_max_3_prior_vs_next3_arrived_on_year_,
    finance_deal_id,
    finance_deal_drive_mins,
    car_stock_showroom_id,
    car_stock_count,
    avg_car_stock_term_months,
    car_stock_showroom_id_2
FROM joined_2
WHERE finance_deal_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY car_stock_showroom_id

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter pledges
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        cause_area,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        CONCAT(cause_area, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS cause_area_ref,
        LOWER(TRIM(cause_area)) AS cause_area_clean
    FROM pledges
    WHERE pledge_amount >= 18588.1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_cause_area_donor_ref_by_pled AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(awarded_date) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area ORDER BY awarded_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_awarded_date,
        SUM(pledge_amount) OVER (ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pledge_amount,
        NTILE(5) OVER w_cause_area_donor_ref_by_pled AS pledge_amount_quintile,
        LEAD(awarded_date) OVER w_cause_area_donor_ref_by_pled AS next_awarded_date,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(donor_ref) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area)) AS distinct_donor_ref_in_cause_area,
        LAST_VALUE(awarded_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_awarded_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area) AS rows_in_cause_area,
        NTH_VALUE(pledge_amount, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_pledge_amount,
        ROUND(pledge_amount - AVG(pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cause_area), 2) AS pledge_amount_vs_cause_area_avg
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_cause_area_donor_ref_by_pled AS (PARTITION BY cause_area, donor_ref ORDER BY pledge_amount DESC, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        donor_ref,
        pledge_amount,
        awarded_date,
        cause_area_clean,
        seq_no,
        first_awarded_date,
        running_pledge_amount,
        next_awarded_date,
        distinct_donor_ref_in_cause_area,
        last_known_awarded_date,
        rows_in_cause_area,
        pledge_amount_vs_cause_area_avg,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(next_awarded_date), donor_ref) AS rows_in_next_awarded_date_month_donor_ref,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY first_awarded_date ASC, id), 3) AS first_awarded_date_percent_rank,
        pledge_amount_quintile - LAG(pledge_amount_quintile) OVER w_seq_no_donor_ref_by_last_kno AS pledge_amount_quintile_change,
        MAX(running_pledge_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY seq_no, distinct_donor_ref_in_cause_area ORDER BY second_pledge_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pledge_amount_max_2,
        LEAD(awarded_date) OVER w_seq_no_distinct_donor_ref_in_2 AS next_awarded_date_2,
        LEAD(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY seq_no, donor_ref ORDER BY last_known_awarded_date, id) AS next_seq_no,
        ROUND(seq_no - AVG(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY donor_ref, MONTH(next_awarded_date)), 2) AS seq_no_vs_donor_ref_next_awarded_date_month_avg
    FROM ranked

WITH base_service_tickets AS (
    -- Filter service_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        showroom_ref,
        fuel_kind,
        odometer_km,
        drive_started_at,
        is_certified_used,
        COALESCE(odometer_km, 0) AS odometer_km_filled,
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', drive_started_at) AS drive_started_at_day
    FROM service_tickets
    WHERE odometer_km <= 148631
      AND fuel_kind IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS odometer_km_sum_7,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY showroom_ref ORDER BY drive_started_at), 3) AS drive_started_at_cume_dist,
        SUM(odometer_km_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_odometer_km_filled,
        ROUND(odometer_km - AVG(odometer_km) OVER w_fuel_kind, 2) AS odometer_km_vs_fuel_kind_avg,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_fuel_kind_by_drive_started_a_3 AS drive_started_at_day_tercile,
        ROUND(AVG(odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS odometer_km_avg_4
    FROM base_service_tickets
    WINDOW w_fuel_kind AS (PARTITION BY fuel_kind), w_fuel_kind_by_drive_started_a_3 AS (PARTITION BY fuel_kind ORDER BY drive_started_at_day DESC, id)
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Join showrooms
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.drive_started_at,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.odometer_km_filled,
        s.drive_started_at_day,
        s.odometer_km_sum_7,
        s.drive_started_at_cume_dist,
        s.odometer_km_avg_4,
        sh.vin_tail AS showroom_vin_tail,
        sh.odometer_km AS showroom_odometer_km,
        sh.option_tags AS showroom_option_tags
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN showrooms sh ON sh.id = s.showroom_ref
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching service_tickets
    SELECT s.*
    FROM combined_details s
    WHERE s.showroom_ref IN (
            SELECT se.showroom_ref
            FROM service_tickets se
        )
),
exploded_detail_service_tickets AS (
    -- One row per service_ticket
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.showroom_ref,
        s.odometer_km,
        s.is_certified_used,
        s.odometer_km_sum_7,
        se.id AS service_ticket_id,
        se.drive_started_at AS service_ticket_drive_started_at,
        se.odometer_km AS service_ticket_odometer_km
    FROM with_activity s
    JOIN service_tickets se ON se.showroom_ref = s.showroom_ref
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep rows whose showroom matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM exploded_detail_service_tickets s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM showrooms sh
            WHERE sh.id = s.showroom_ref
              AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(sh.option_tags, 'leather')
        )
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching car_stock
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM car_stock c
            WHERE c.showroom_id = s.showroom_ref
              AND c.term_months <= 77
        )
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    showroom_ref,
    odometer_km,
    service_ticket_drive_started_at,
    FLOOR(odometer_km / 50000) * 50000 AS odometer_km_bucket
FROM screened
ORDER BY service_ticket_drive_started_at DESC

WITH valid_test_drives AS (
    -- Scope the test_drives rows
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        drive_mins,
        is_fleet,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', vin_tail, drive_outcome) AS vin_tail_drive_outcome_label,
        COALESCE(drive_outcome, 'UNKNOWN') AS drive_outcome_or_unknown
    FROM test_drives
    WHERE drive_outcome IN ('declined', 'bought')
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        drive_mins,
        is_fleet,
        vin_tail_drive_outcome_label,
        drive_outcome_or_unknown,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_drive_mins AS seq_no,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_is_fleet AS rows_in_is_fleet,
        LAG(drive_mins, 3) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id) AS prev3_drive_mins,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins) OVER w_car_stock_id_drive_outcome, 2) AS car_stock_id_drive_outcome_avg_drive_mins,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, is_fleet ORDER BY drive_mins), 3) AS drive_mins_percent_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(drive_outcome) OVER (PARTITION BY is_fleet)) AS distinct_drive_outcome_in_is_fleet,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_drive_mins AS drive_mins_rank,
        MIN(drive_mins) OVER w_is_fleet AS is_fleet_min_drive_mins,
        ROUND(drive_mins - AVG(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, drive_outcome), 2) AS drive_mins_vs_car_stock_id_drive_outcome_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY is_fleet), 2) AS is_fleet_avg_drive_mins,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY is_fleet ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        ROUND(drive_mins / NULLIF(SUM(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, drive_outcome), 0), 4) AS drive_mins_share_of_car_stock_id_drive_outcome,
        MAX(drive_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY is_fleet ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_drive_mins_so_far
    FROM valid_test_drives
    WINDOW w_all_by_drive_mins AS (ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id), w_is_fleet AS (PARTITION BY is_fleet), w_car_stock_id_drive_outcome AS (PARTITION BY car_stock_id, drive_outcome)
),
ranked_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        car_stock_id,
        drive_outcome,
        drive_mins,
        is_fleet,
        seq_no,
        rows_in_is_fleet,
        prev3_drive_mins,
        car_stock_id_drive_outcome_avg_drive_mins,
        distinct_drive_outcome_in_is_fleet,
        drive_mins_vs_car_stock_id_drive_outcome_avg,
        is_fleet_avg_drive_mins,
        drive_mins_share_of_car_stock_id_drive_outcome,
        max_drive_mins_so_far,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY drive_outcome_or_unknown ORDER BY drive_mins DESC, id) AS seq_no_2,
        LEAD(running_count) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins, id) AS next_running_count,
        NTH_VALUE(max_drive_mins_so_far, 2) OVER (ORDER BY prev3_drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_max_drive_mins_so_far,
        MAX(prev3_drive_mins) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_prev3_drive_mins_so_far,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY drive_mins, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_2
    FROM ranked
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        is_fleet,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_fleet = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_is_fleet_false,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(drive_outcome)) AS drive_outcome_list
    FROM ranked_2
    GROUP BY is_fleet
)
SELECT
    is_fleet,
    distinct_ids,
    n_is_fleet_false,
    drive_outcome_list
FROM stats
WHERE is_fleet = TRUE
ORDER BY n_is_fleet_false

        "drive_mins_vs_car_stock_id_drive_outcome_avg",
        "is_fleet_avg_drive_mins",
        "drive_mins_share_of_car_stock_id_drive_outcome",
        "max_drive_mins_so_far",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("drive_outcome_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("drive_mins").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.lead("running_count").over(Window.orderBy("drive_mins", "id")).alias("next_running_count"),
        F.nth_value("max_drive_mins_so_far", 2).over(Window.orderBy("prev3_drive_mins", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_max_drive_mins_so_far"),
        F.max("prev3_drive_mins").over(Window.orderBy("drive_mins", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_prev3_drive_mins_so_far"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.orderBy("drive_mins", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_2"),
    )
)

stats = (
    ranked_2
    .groupBy("is_fleet")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sum(F.when(~F.col("is_fleet"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_is_fleet_false"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("drive_outcome")).alias("drive_outcome_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .filter(F.col("is_fleet"))
    .select(
        "is_fleet",
        "distinct_ids",
        "n_is_fleet_false",
        "drive_outcome_list",
    )
    .orderBy("n_is_fleet_false")
)
